Vaarini champakumu elayanagaa naa prajalu daanini marachipoduremo. maakedèmaina prabhuvaa, nee balamucheta vaarini chèllaa chèdaru chesi anagagòttumu.
Vaari pèdavula maatalanubattiyu vaari noti paapa munubattiyu vaaru paluku shaapamulanubattiyu abaddhamulanubattiyu vaaru tama garvamulo chikkubadudurugaaka.
Kopamucheta vaarini nirmoolamu cheyumu vaaru lekapovunatlu vaarini nirmoolamu cheyumu devudu yaakobu vamshamunu eluchunnaadani bhoodigamtamulavaraku manushyulu èrugunatlu cheyumu.(sèlaa.)
Saayamkaalamuna vaaru marala vachchèdaru kukkavalè mòruguchu pattanamuchuttu tiruguduru
Timdikòraku vaaru itu atu tirugulaadèdaru trripti kaluganiyèdala raatri amtayu aaguduru.
Neevu naaku èttayina kotagaa unnaavu aapaddinamuna naaku aashrayamugaa unnaavu. nee balamunugoorchi nenu keertimchèdanu udayamuna neekrripanugoorchiutsaahagaanamu chesèdanu
Devudu naaku èttayina kotagaanu krripagala devudugaanu unnaadu naa balamaa, ninne keertimchèdanu.
Devaa, mammu vidanaadiyunnaavu mammu chèdaragòtti yunnaavu neevu kopapaditivi mammu marala baagucheyumu.
Neevu deshamunu kampimpajesiyunnaavu daanini baddalu chesiyunnaavu adi vanakuchunnadi adi padipoyina chotulu baagu cheyumu.
Nee prajalaku neevu kathinakaaryamulu chesitivi toolunatlu cheyu madyamunu maaku traagimchitivi
Satyamu nimittamu ètti pattutakai neeyamdu bhayabhaktulugalavaariki neevòka dhvajamu nichchi yunnaavu.(sèlaa.)
Nee priyulu vimochimpabadunatlu nee kudicheta nannu rakshimchi naakuttaramimmu
Tana parishuddhatatodani devudu maata yichchi yunnaadu nenu praharshimchèdanu shèkèmunu pamchipèttèdanu sukkotu loyanu kòlipimchèdanu.
Gilaadu naadi manashshe naadi èphraayimu naaku shirastraanamu yoodaa naa raajadamdamu.
Moyaabu nenu kaallu kadugukònu pallèmu èdomumeeda naa chèppu visariveyudunu philishtiyaa, nannugoorchi utsaahadhvanicheyumu.
Kotagala pattanamuloniki nannèvadu todukòni povunu? èdomuloniki nannèvadu nadipimchunu?
Devaa, neevu mammu vidanaadiyunnaavu gadaa? devaa, maa senalatokooda neevu bayaluderuta maani yunnaavu gadaa?
Manushyula sahaayamu vyarthamu shatruvulanu jayimchutaku maaku sahaayamu daya cheyumu.
Devuni valana memu shoorakaaryamulu jarigimchèdamu maa shatruvulanu anagadròkkuvaadu aayane.
Devaa, naa mòrra aalakimpumu naa praarthanaku chèviyòggumu
Naa praanamu talladillagaa bhoodigamtamulanumdi neeku mòrra pèttuchunnaanu nenu èkkalenamtayèttayina kòmdapaikinannu èkkim chumu.
Neevu naaku aashrayamugaa numtini. shatruvulayèduta balamaina kotagaanumtivi
Yugayugamulu nenu nee gudaaramulo nivasimchèdanu nee rèkkala chaatuna daagukòmdunu (sèlaa.)
Devaa, neevu naa mròkkubadula namgeekarimchi yunnaavu nee naamamunamdu bhayabhaktulugalavaari svaasthyamu neevu naakanugrahimchi yunnaavu.
Raajunaku deerghaayuvu kalugajeyuduvu gaaka atani samvatsaramulu tarataramulugadachunu gaaka.
Devuni sannidhini atadu niramtaramu nivasimchunu gaaka atani kaapaadutakai krripaasatyamulanu niyamim chumu.
Dinadinamu naa mròkkubadulanu nenu chèllimchu natlu nee naamamunu nityamu keertimchèdanu.
Naa praanamu devuni nammukòni maunamugaa unnadi. aayanavalana naaku rakshana kalugunu. aayane naa aashrayadurgamu aayane naa rakshanakara
Èttayina naakota aayane, nenu amtagaa kadalimpa badanu. ènnaallu meeru òkanipaibaduduru?
Òruguchunna godanu padabovu kamchènu òkadu pada droyunatlu mee ramdaru ènnaallu òkani pada droya choochuduru?
Atani aunnatyamunumdi atani padadroyutake vaaru aalochimchuduru abaddhamaaduta vaariki samtoshamu vaaru tama notito shubhavachanamulu palukuchu amta ramgamulo dooshimchuduru. (sèlaa.)
Naa praanamaa, devuni nammukòni maunamugaa numdumu aayana valanane naaku nireekshana kaluguchunnadi.
Aayane naa aashrayadurgamu naa rakshanaadhaaramu naa èttayina kota aayane, nenu kadalimpabadanu.
Naa rakshanaku naa mahimaku devude aadhaaramu. naa balamaina aashrayadurgamu naa yaashrayamu devuniyamde yunnadi.
Janulaaraa, yèllappudu aayanayamdu namimaka yumchudi aayana sannidhini mee hrridayamulu kummarimchudi devudu manaku aashrayamu.(sèlaa.)
Alpulainavaaru vatti oopiriyai yunnaaru. ghanulainavaaru maayasvaroopulu traasulo vaaramdaru telipovuduru vatti oopirikanna alakanagaa unnaaru
Balaatkaaramamdu namimakayumchakudi dochukònutacheta garvapadakudi dhanamu hèchchinanu daanini lakshyapèttakudi.
Balamu tanadani òka maaru devudu sèlavichchènu rèmdu maarulu aa maata naaku vinabadènu.
Prabhuvaa, manushyulakamdariki vaari vaari kriyala chòppuna neeve pratiphalamichchuchunnaavu. kaagaa krripachooputayu needi.
Devaa, naa devudavu neeve, vekuvane ninnu vèdakudunu

Nee balamunu nee prabhaavamunu choodavalènani parishuddhaalayamamdu ne nèmto aashato neetattu kani pèttiyunnaanu. neellu lekayèmdiyunna deshamamdu naa praanamu neekòraku trrishnagòniyunnadi neemeedi aashacheta ninnu choodavalènani naa shareeramu krrishimchuchunnadi.
Nee krripa jeevamukamtè uttamamu naa pèdavulu ninnu stutimchunu.
Naa mamchamumeeda ninnu j~naapakamu chesikòni raatri jaamulayamdu ninnu dhyaanimchunappudu
Kròvvu mèdadu naaku dòrakinatlugaa naa praanamu trriptipòmduchunnadi utsahimchu pèdavulato naa noru ninnugoorchi gaanamu cheyuchunnadi
Kaagaa naa jeevitakaalamamtayu neneelaaguna ninnu stutimchèdanu nee naamamunubatti naa chetulèttèdanu.
Neevu naaku sahaayakudavai yumtivi nee rèkkala chaatuna sharanujòchchi utsaahadhvani chesèdanu.
Naa praanamu ninnu amti vèmbadimchuchunnadi nee kudicheyi nannu aadukònuchunnadi.
Naa praanamunu nashimpajeyavalènani vaaru daani vèdakuchunnaaru vaaru bhoomi krimdi chotlaku digipovuduru
Balamaina khadgamunaku appagimpabaduduru nakkalapaalaguduru.
Raaju devunibatti samtoshimchunu. aayanatodani pramaanamu cheyu prativaadunu atishayillunu abaddhamulaaduvaari noru mooyabadunu.
Devaa, nenu mòrrapèttagaa naa manavi aalakimpumu shatrubhayamunumdi naa praanamunu kaapaadumu.
Keeducheyuvaari kutranumdi dushtakriyalu cheyuvaari allarinumdi nannu daachumu
Òkadu kattiki padunu pèttunatlu vaaru tama naaluka laku padunu pèttuduru.
Yathaarthavamtulanu kòttavalènani chaataina sthalamulalo chedumaatalanu baanamulugaa samdhimchuduru.vaaru bhayamemiyu leka akasmaattugaa vaarinikòttèdaru
Vaaru duraalochana drridhaparachukòmduru chaatugaa urula nòddutaku yochimchukònuchu manalanu èvaru choochèdarani chèppukòmduru.
Vaaru dushtakriyalanu tèlisikònutaku prayatnim turu vèdaki vèdaki upaayamu siddhaparachukòmduru prativaani hrridayaamtaramgamu agaadhamu.
Devudu baanamuto vaarini kòttunu vaaru aakasmikamugaa gaayaparachabadèdaru.
Vaaru koolèdaru vaaru koolutaku vaari naaluke kaaranamu. vaarini choochuvaaramdaru tala oochuduru
Manushyulamdaru bhayamukaligi devuni kaarya mulu tèliyajeyuduru aayana kaaryamulu chakkagaa yochimchu kòmduru
Neetimamtulu yèhovaanubatti samtoshimchuchu aayana sharanujòchchèdaru yathaarthahrridayulamdaru atishayilluduru.
Devaa, seeyonulo maunamugaanumduta neeku stuti chèllimchute neeku mròkkubadi chèllimpavalasiyunnadi.
Praarthana aalakimchuvaadaa, sarvashareerulu neeyòddaku vachchèdaru
Naameeda mopabadina doshamulu bharimpajaalanivi maa atikramamula nimittamu neeve praayashchittamu cheyuduvu.
Nee aavaranamulalo nivasimchunatlu neevu erparachukòni cherchukònuvaadu dhanyudu nee parishuddhaalayamucheta nee mamdiramuloni melucheta memu trriptipòmdèdamu.
Maaku rakshanakartavaina devaa, bhoodigamtamula nivaasulakamdarikini doora samudramu meedanunna vaarikini aashrayamaina vaadaa, neevu neetinibatti bheekarakriyalacheta maaku uttaramichchu chunnaavu
Balamune nadikattugaa kattukòninavaadai tana shakticheta parvatamulanu sthiraparachuvaadu aayanè
Aayane samudramula ghoshanu vaati taramgamula ghoshanu anachuvaadu janamula allarini challaarchuvaadu.
Nee soochaka kriyalanu choochi digamta nivaasulunu bhayapaduduru udaya saayamtramula utpattulanu neevu samtosha bharitamulugaa cheyuchunnaavu.

Neevu bhoomini darshimchi daani tadupuchunnaavu daaniki mahadaishvaryamu kalugajeyuchunnaavu devuni nadi neellato nimdiyunnadi neevu bhoomini atlu siddhaparachina taruvaata vaariki dhaanyamu dayacheyuchunnaavu.
Daani dukkulanu vistaaramaina neellato tadipi daani ganimalanu chadunu cheyuchunnaavu. vaana jallulacheta daanini padunucheyuchunnaavu adi mòlakèttagaa neevu daani naasheervadimchuchunnaavu.
Samvatsaramunu nee dayaakireetamu dharimpajesiyunnaavu nee jaadalu saaramu vèdajalluchunnavi.
Adavi beedulu saaramu chilakarimchuchunnavi kòmdalu aanamdamunu nadikattugaa dharimchukòni yunnavi.
Pachchikapatlu mamdalanu vastramuvalè dharimchiyunnavi. loyalu sasyamulato kappabadiyunnavi anniyu samtoshadhvani cheyuchunnavi anniyu gaanamu cheyuchunnavi.
Sarvalokanivaasulaaraa, devunigoorchi samtosha geetamu paadudi. aayana naamaprabhaavamu keertimchudi
Aayanaku prabhaavamuaaropimchi aayananu stotrimchudi
Eelaagu devuniki stotramu chèllimchudi. nee kaaryamulu èmto bheekaramainavi nee balaatishayamunubatti nee shatruvulu lòmgi nee yòddaku vachchèdaru
Sarvalokamu neeku namaskarimchi ninnu keertimchunu nee naamamunubatti ninnu keertimchunu.(sèlaa.)
Devuni aashcharyakaaryamulanu chooda ramdi narulayèdala aayana jarigimchu kaaryamulanu choodagaa aayana bheekarudai yunnaadu.
Aayana samudramunu èmdina bhoomigaa jesènu janulu kaalinadakache daatiri. akkada aayanayamdu memu samtoshimchitiviu.
Aayana tana paraakramamuvalana nityamu eluchunnaadu? anyajanulameeda aayana tana drrishtiyumchiyunnaadu. drohulu tammu taamu hèchchimchukòna tagadu.(sèlaa.)
Janamulaaraa, poo devuni sannutimchudi gòppa svaramuto aayana keerti vinipimchudi.
Jeevapraaptulanugaa mammunu kalugajeyuvaadu aayane aayana maa paadamulu kadalaniyyadu.
Devaa, neevu mammunu parisheelimchiyunnaavu. vèmdini nirmalamu cheyureetigaa mammunu nirmalulanu chesiyunnaavu.
Neevu bamdeegrrihamulo mammu umchitivi maa nadumulameeda gòppabhaaramu pèttitivi.
Narulu maa nèttimeeda èkkunatlu chesitivi memu nippulalonu neellalonu paditiviu ayinanu neevu samrridhdhigalachotiki mammu rappimchi yunnaavu.
Dahanabalulanu teesikòni nenu nee mamdiramuloniki vachchèdanu.
Naaku shrama kaliginappudu naa pèdavulu palikina mròkkubadulanu naa noru vachimchina mròkkubadulanu nenu neeku chèllimchèdanu
Pòttellanu dhoopamunu kròvvina gòrralanu teesikòni neeku dahanabalulu arpimchèdanu. èddulanu potumekalanu arpimchèdanu.(sèlaa).
Devuniyamdu bhayabhaktulugalavaaralaaraa, meeramdaru vachchi aalakimchudi aayana naakòraku chesina kaaryamulanu nenu vini pimchèdanu.
Aayanaku nenu mòrrapèttitini appude naa nota shreshthamaina keertana yumdènu.
Naa hrridayamulo nenu paapamunu lakshyamu chesina yèdala prabhuvu naa manavi vinakapovunu.
Nishchayamugaa devudu naa manavi amgeekarimchi yunnaadu aayana naa vij~naapana aalakimchiyunnaadu
Devudu naa praarthananu trosiveyaledu naayòddanumdi tana krripanu tòlagimpaledu; aayana sannutimpabadunu gaaka.
Bhoomimeeda nee maargamu tèliyabadunatlunu anyajanulamdarilo nee rakshana tèliyabadunatlunu
Devudu mammunu karunimchi mammunu aasheervadimchunu gaaka aayana tana mukhakaamti maameeda prakaashimpajeyunu gaaka.(sèlaa.)
Devaa, prajalu ninnu stutimchuduru gaaka. prajalamdaru ninnu stutimchuduru gaaka. nyaayamunubatti neevu janamulaku teerpu teerchuduvu bhoomimeedanunna janamulanu elèdavu.(sèlaa.)
Janamulu samtoshimchuchu utsaahadhvani cheyunu gaaka
Devaa, prajalu ninnu stutimchuduru gaaka. prajalamdaru ninnu stutimchuduru gaaka.
Appudu bhoomi daani phalamulichchunu devudu maa devudu mammunu aasheervadimchunu.
Devudu mammunu deevimchunu bhoodigamta nivaasulamdaru aayanayamdu bhayabhaktulu nilupuduru.
Devudu lechunu gaaka aayana shatruvulu chèdaripovuduru gaaka aayananu dveshimchuvaaru aayana sannidhinumdi paari povuduru gaaka.
Pòga chèdaragòttabadunatlu neevu vaarini chèdaragòttumu agniki mainamu karugunatlu bhaktiheenulu devuni sannidhiki karagi nashimchuduru gaaka.
Neetimamtulu samtoshimchuduru gaaka vaaru devuni sannidhini ullasimchuduru gaaka vaaru mahadaanamdamu pòmduduru gaaka

Devunigoorchipaadudi aayana naamamunubatti stotra gaanamu cheyudi vaahanamèkki aranyamulalo prayaanamucheyu devunikòraku òka raajamaargamu cheyudi yèhovaa anu aayana naamamunubatti aayana sannidhini praharshimchudi.
Tana parishuddhaalayamamdumdu devudu, tamdri leni vaariki tamdriyu vidhavaraamdraku nyaayakartayunai yunnaadu
Devudu ekaamgulanu samsaarulugaa cheyuvaadu. aayana bamdhimpabadinavaarini vidipimchi vaarini vardhilla jeyuvaadu vishvaasaghaatakulu nirjaladeshamamdu nivasimchuduru.
Devaa, neevu nee prajalamumdara bayaluderinappudu aranyamulo neevu prayaanamu chesinappudu (sèlaa.)
Bhoomi vanakènu devuni sannidhini amtarikshamu diga jaarènu ishraayelu devudagu devuni sannidhini aavali seenaayi kampimchènu.
Devaa, nee svaasthyamumeeda neevu varshamu samrriddhigaa kuripimchitivi adi alasiyumdagaa neevu daanini balaparachitivi.
Nee samoohamu daanilo nivasimchunu devaa, nee anugrahamucheta deenulaku sadupaayamu kalugajesitivi.
Prabhuvu maata sèlavichchuchunnaadu daanini prakatimchu streelu gòppa sainyamugaa unnaaru.
Senala raajulu paaripoyèdaru paaripoyèdaru imta nilichinadi dopudusòmmu pamchukònunu.
Gòrrala dòdlamadhyanu meeru pamdukònagaa guvvala rèkkalu vèmdito kappabadinatlunnadi vaati yeekèla rèkkalu pachchani bamgaaruto kappa badinattunnadi.
Sarvashaktudu akkada raajulanu chèdaragòttinappudu salmonumeeda himamu kurisinatlaayènu.
Baashaanu parvatamu devaparvatamu baashaanu parvatamu shikharamulugala parvatamu.
Shikharamulugala parvatamulaaraa, devudu nivaasamugaa korukònna kòmdanu meerela orachoopulu choochuchunnaaru? yèhovaa nityamu amdulone nivasimchunu.
Devuni rathamulu sahasramulu sahasrasahasramulu prabhuvu vaatilo nunnaadu seenaayi parishuddhamainattu aa kòmda parishuddhamaayènu.

Neevu aarohanamaitivi pattabadinavaarini chèrapattukòni potivi manushyulacheta neevu kaanukalu teesikòniyunnaavu. yèhovaa anu devudu akkada nivasimchunatlu vishvaasaghaatakulacheta sahitamu neevu kaanukalu teesi kòni yunnaavu.
Prabhuvu stutinòmdunu gaaka anudinamu aayana maa bhaaramu bharimchuchunnaadu devude maaku rakshanakartayai yunnaadu.
Devudu maa pakshamuna poornarakshana kalugajeyu devudai yunnaadu maranamu tappimchuta prabhuvaina yèhovaa vashamu.
Devudu nishchayamugaa tana shatruvula talalu pagula gòttunu. maanaka doshamulu cheyuvaari vèmdrukalugala nadi nèttini aayana pagulagòttunu.
Prabhuvu sèlavichchinademanagaanenu baashaanulonumdi vaarini rappimchèdanu agaadha samudramulalonumdi vaarini rappimchèdanu.
Vaari raktamulo neevu nee paadamu mumchuduvu nee shatruvulu nee kukkala naalukalaku bhaagamaguduru.
Devaa, nee gamanamunu parishuddha sthalamunaku povu naa raajagu devuni gamanamunu vaaru choochi yunnaaru. chuttunu kanyakalu tamburalu vaayimchuchumdagaa
Keertanalu paaduvaaru mumdara nadachiri. tamtivaadyamulu vaayimchuvaaru vènuka vachchèdaru.
Samaajamulalo devuni stutimchudi ishraayelulonumdi udbhavimchinavaaralaaraa, prabhu vunu stutimchudi.
Kanishthudagu bènyaameenu anu, vaari yelika achchata nunnaadu. yoodaa adhipatula parivaaramachchata nunnadi jèbooloonu adhipatulunu naphtaali adhipatulunu unnaaru.
Nee devudu neeku balamu kaluga niyamimchiyunnaadu. devaa, neevu maakòraku chesinadaanini balaparachumu
Yèrooshalemuloni nee aalayamunubatti raajulu nee yòddaku kaanukalu tèchchèdaru.
Rèlluloni mrrigamunu aabotula gumpunu doodalavamti janamulunu lòmgi, vèmdi kaddeelanu tèchchunatlugaa vaatini gaddimpumu kalahapriyulanu aayana chèdaragòttiyunnaadu.
Aiguptulonumdi pradhaanulu vachchèdaru koosheeyulu devunitattu tama chetulu chaachukòni parugèttivachchèdaru.
Bhooraajyamulaaraa, devunigoorchi paadudi prabhuvunu keertimchudi.(sèlaa.)
Anaadigaanunna aakaashaakaashavaahana mèkkuvaanini keertimchudi aayana tana svaramu vinabadajeyunu adi balamaina svaramu.
Devuniki balaatishayamu naaropimchudi mahimonnatudai aayana ishraayelumeeda elu chunnaadu amtarikshamuna aayana balaatishayamunnadi
Tana parishuddha sthalamulalo devudu bheekarudu ishraayelu devude tana prajalaku balaparaakrama mula nanugrahimchuchunnaadu devudu stutinòmdunu gaaka.
Devaa, jalamulu naa praanamumeeda pòrluchunnavi nannu rakshimpumu.
Niluka yiyyani agaadhamaina dòmga oobilo nenu digipovuchunnaanu agaadha jalamulalo nenu digabadiyunnaanu varadalu nannu mumchiveyuchunnavi.
Nenu mòrrapèttutacheta alasiyunnaanu naa gòmtuka yèmdipoyènu naa devunikòraku kanipèttutacheta naa kannulu ksheenimchipoyènu.

Nirnimittamugaa naameeda pagapattuvaaru naa talavèmdrukalakamtè vistaaramugaa unnaaru abaddhamunubatti naakushatruvulai nannu samharimpa goruvaaru anekulu nenu dochukònanidaanini nenu ichchukònavalasi vachchènu.
Devaa, naa buddhiheenata neeku tèliseyunnadi naa aparaadhamulu neeku marugainavi kaavu.
Prabhuvaa, sainyamulakadhipativagu yèhovaa, neekòraku kanipèttukònuvaariki naavalana siggu kaluga niyyakumu ishraayelu devaa, ninnu vèdakuvaarini naavalana avamaanamu nòmda niyyakumu.
Nee nimittamu nenu nimdanòmdinavaadanaitini nee nimittamu siggu naa mukhamunu kappènu.
Naa sahodarulaku nenu anyudanaitini naa talli kumaarulaku parudanaitini.
Nee yimtinigoorchina aasakti nannu bhakshimchiyunnadi ninnu nimdimchinavaari nimdalu naameeda padiyunnavi.
Upavaasamumdi nenu kanneeru viduvagaa adi naaku nimdaaspadamaayènu.
Nenu gonèpatta vastramugaa kattukòninappudu vaariki haasyaaspadudanaitini.
Gummamulalo koorchumduvaaru nannugoorchi maata laadukòmduru traagubotulu nannugoorchi paatalu paaduduru.
Yèhovaa, anukoola samayamuna nenu ninnu praarthimchuchunnaanu. devaa, nee krripaabaahulyamunubatti nee rakshana satyamunubatti naakuttaramimmu.
Nenu digipokumda oobilonumdi nannu tappimchumu naa pagavaarichetilonumdi agaadhajalamulalonumdi nannu tappimchumu.
Neetivaradalu nannu mumchaniyyakumu agaadhasamudramu nannu mimganiyyakumu gumta nannu mimganiyyakumu.
Yèhovaa, nee krripa uttamatvamunubatti naaku uttara mimmu nee vaatsalyabaahulyatanubatti naatattu tirugumu.
Nee sevakuniki vimukhudavai yumdakumu nenu ibbamdilonunnaanu tvaragaa naaku uttaramimmu.
Naayòddaku sameepimchi nannu vimochimpumu. naa shatruvulanu choochi nannu vidipimpumu.
Nimdayu siggunu avamaanamunu naaku kaligènanineeku tèlisiyunnadi. naa virodhulamdaru neeku kanabaduchunnaaru.

Nimdaku naa hrridayamu baddalaayènu nenu bahugaa krrishimchiyunnaanu karunimchuvaarikòraku kanipèttukòmtinigaani yèva runu lekapoyiri. odaarchuvaarikòraku kanipèttukòmtinigaani yèvarunu kaanaraarairi.
Vaaru chedunu naaku aahaaramugaa pèttiri naaku dappiyainappudu chirakanu traaganichchiri.

Prabhuvula prabhuvunaku krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchudi aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Aayana òkkade mahaashcharyakaaryamulu cheyuvaadu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Tana j~naanamucheta aayana aakaashamunu kalugajesènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Aayana bhoomini neellameeda parachinavaadu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Aayana gòppa jyotulanu nirmimchinavaadu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Pagati nelutaku aayana sooryuni chesènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Raatri nelutaku aayana chamdruni nakshatramulanu chesènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Aiguptudeshapu tòlichoolulanu aayana hatamu chesènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Vaari madhyanumdi ishraayeleeyulanu aayana rappim chènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Cheyi chaachi tana baahubalamucheta vaarini rappimchènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Èrrasamudramunu aayana paayalugaa cheelchènu. aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Aayana ishraayeleeyulanu daani naduma daatipo jesènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Pharonu atani sainyamunu èrrasamudramulo aayana mumchivesènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Aranyamaargamuna aayana tana prajalanu todukòni vachchènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Gòppa raajulanu aayana hatamuchesènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Prasiddhinòmdina raajulanu aayana hatamuchesènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Amoreeyula raajaina seehonunu aayana hatamu chesènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Baashaanu raajaina ogunu aayana hatamu chesènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Aayana vaari deshamunu manaku svaasthyamugaa appa gimchènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Tana sevakudaina ishraayelunaku daanini svaasthyamugaa appagimchènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Manamu deenadashalonunnappudu aayana manalanu j~naapa kamu chesikònènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Mana shatruvula chetilonumdi manalanu vidipimchènu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Samasta jeevulakunu aayana aahaaramichchuchunnaadu aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Aakaashamamdumdu devuniki krritaj~nataastutulu chèllim chudi aayana krripa niramtaramumdunu.
Babulonu nadulayòdda koorchumdiyunnappudu manamu seeyonunu j~naapakamu chesikòni yedchu chumtimi.
Vaatimadhyanunna niravamjichètlaku mana sitaaraalu tagi limchitiviu.
Achchata manalanu chèragònnavaaruòka keertanapaadudi aniri manalanu baadhimchinavaaru seeyonu keertanalalo òkadaanini maaku vinipimchudi ani manavalana ullaasamu goriri
Anyula deshamulo yèhovaa keertanalu manamètlu paadudumu?
Yèrooshalemaa, nenu ninnu marachinayèdala naa kudicheyi tana nerpu marachunu gaaka.
Nenu ninnu j~naapakamu chesikònaniyèdala, naa mukhya samtoshamukamtè nenu yèrooshalemunu hèchchugaa èmchaniyèdala naa naaluka naa amgitiki amtukònunu gaaka.
Yèhovaa, èdomu janulu chesinadi j~naapakamu chesi kònumu yèrooshalemu paadaina dinamunu j~naapakamunaku tèchchu kònumu. daanini naashanamucheyudi samooladhvamsamu cheyudi ani vaaru chaatiri gadaa.
Paadu cheyabadabovu babulonu kumaaree, neevu maaku chesina kriyalanubatti neeku pratikaaramu cheyuvaadu dhanyudu
Nee pasipillalanu pattukòni vaarini bamdakuvesi kòttu vaadu dhanyudu.
Nenu naa poornahrridayamuto neeku krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchuchunnaanu devatala yèduta ninnu keertimchèdanu.

Nee parishuddhaalayamutattu nenu namaskaaramu cheyu chunnaanu nee naamamamtatikamtè neevichchina vaakyamunu neevu gòppachesiyunnaavu. nee krripaasatyamulanubatti nee naamamunaku krritaj~nataa stutulu nenu chèllimchèdanu.
Nenu mòrrapèttina dinamuna neevu naaku uttaramichchitivi. naa praanamulo traana puttimchi nannu dhairyaparachi tivi.
Yèhovaa, bhooraajulamdaru neevu sèlavichchina maatalu vini neeku krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchèdaru.
Yèhovaa mahaa prabhaavamugalavaadani vaaru yèhovaa maargamulanugoorchi gaanamu chesè daru.
Yèhovaa mahonnatudainanu aayana deenulanu lakshyapèttunu aayana dooramunumdi garvishthulanu baagugaa èrugunu.
Nenu aapadalalo chikkubadi yunnanu neevu nannu bradikimchèdavu naa shatruvula kopamunumdi nannu rakshimchutakai neevu neecheyi chaapèdavu nee kudicheyi nannu rakshimchunu.
Yèhovaa naa pakshamuna kaaryamu saphalamucheyunu. yèhovaa, nee krripa niramtaramumdunu nee chetikaaryamulanu vidichipèttakumu.
Yèhovaa, neevu nannu parishodhimchi tèlisikòni yunnaavu
Nenu koorchumduta nenu lechuta neeku tèliyunu naaku talampu puttakamunupe neevu naa manassu grahimchuchunnaavu.
Naa nadakanu naa padakanu neevu parisheelana chesiyunnaavu, naa charyalannitini neevu baagugaa tèlisikòniyunnaavu.
Yèhovaa, maata naa naalukaku raakamunupe adi neeku poortigaa tèlisiyunnadi.
Vènukanu mumdunu neevu nannu aavarimchiyunnaavu nee cheyi naameeda umchiyunnaavu.
Itti tèlivi naaku mimchinadi adi agocharamu adi naakamdadu.
Nee aatmayòddanumdi nenèkkadiki povudunu? nee sannidhinumdi nenèkkadiki paaripovudunu?
Nenu aakaashamunakèkkinanu neevu akkadanu unnaavu nenu paataalamamdu pamdukòninanu neevu akkadanu unnaavu
Nenu vekuva rèkkalu kattukòni samudra digamtamulalo nivasimchinanu
Akkadanu nee cheyi nannu nadipimchunu nee kudicheyi nannu pattukònunu
​amdhakaaramu nannu marugucheyunu naaku kalugu vèlugu raatrivalè umdunu ani nenanu kònina yèdala
Cheekatiyainanu neeku cheekati kaakapovunu raatri pagativalè neeku vèlugugaa umdunu cheekatiyu vèlugunu neeku ekareetigaa unnavi
Naa amtarimdriyamulanu neeve kalugajesitivi naa talli garbhamamdu nannu nirmimchinavaadavu neeve.

Neevu nannu kalugajesina vidhamu choodagaa bhayamunu aashcharyamunu naaku puttuchunnavi amdunubatti nenu neeku krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchu chunnaanu nee kaaryamulu aashcharyakaramulu. aa samgati naaku baagugaa tèlisiyunnadi.
Nenu rahasyamamdu puttinanaadu bhoomiyòkka agaadhasthalamulalo vichitramugaa nirmimpabadinanaadu naaku kaliginayèmukalunu neeku marugai yumdaledu
Nenu pimdamunai yumdagaa nee kannulu nannu choochènu niyamimpabadina dinamulalo òkataina kaakamunupe naa dinamulanniyu nee gramthamulo likhitamu laayènu.
Devaa, nee talampulu naa kèmta priyamainavi vaati mòttamèmta gòppadi.
Vaatini lèkkimchèda nanukòmtinaa avi yisuka kamtènu lèkkaku èkkuvai yunnavi nenu melkòmtinaa yimkanu neeyòddane yumdunu.
Devaa,neevu bhaktiheenulanu nishchayamugaa samharimchèdavu narahamtakulaaraa, naayòddanumdi tòlagipovudi.
Vaaru duraalochanato ninnugoorchi palukuduru mosapuchchutakai nee naamamunubatti pramaanamu cheyuduru.
Yèhovaa, ninnu dveshimchuvaarini nenunu dveshimchu chunnaanu gadaa? nee meeda lechuvaarini nenu asahyimchukònuchunnaanu gadaa?
Vaariyamdu naaku poornadveshamu kaladu vaarini naaku shatruvulanugaa bhaavimchukònuchunnaanu
Devaa, nannu parishodhimchi naa hrridayamunu tèlisi kònumu nannu pareekshimchi naa aalochanalanu tèlisikònumu
Neekaayaasakaramaina maargamu naayamdunna demo choodumu nityamaargamuna nannu nadipimpumu.
Yèhovaa, dushtula chetilonumdi nannu vidi pimpumu balaatkaaramu cheyuvaari chetilo padakumda nannu kaapaadumu.
Vaaru tama hrridayamulalo apaayakaramaina yocha nalu cheyuduru vaaru nityamu yuddhamu repa joochuchumduru.
Paamu naalukavalè vaaru tama naalukalu vaadi cheyuduru vaari pèdavulakrimda sarpavishamunnadi. (sèlaa.)
Yèhovaa, bhaktiheenula chetilopadakumda nannu kaapaa dumu. balaatkaaramu cheyuvaari chetilonumdi nannu rakshim pumu. nenu adugu jaaripadunatlu cheyutaku vaaru udde shimchuchunnaaru.
Garvishthulu naakòraku urini traallanu chaatugaa òddi yunnaaru vaaru trovaprakkanu vala parachiyunnaaru. nannu pattukònutakai uchchula nòggiyunnaaru. (sèlaa.)
Ayinanu nenu yèhovaato eelaagu manavicheyu chunnaanu yèhovaa, neeve naa devudavu naa vij~naapanalaku chèviyòggumu.
Prabhuvaina yèhovaa naa rakshanadurgamu yuddhadinamuna neevu naa talanu kaayuduvu.
Yèhovaa, bhaktiheenula korikalanu teerchakumu vaaru atishayimchakumdunatlu vaari aalochananu kòna saagimpakumu. (sèlaa.)
Nannu chuttukònuvaaru talayèttinayèdala vaari pèdavula chetu vaarini mumchunu gaaka
Kanakanalaadu nippulu vaarimeeda veyabadunu gaaka vaaru tirigi levakumdunatlu agnigumdamulo vaaru koolchabadudurugaaka agaadha jalamulaloniki troyabaduduru gaaka
Kòmdèmulaaduvaaru bhoomimeeda sthirapadakumdurugaaka aapattu balaatkaarulanu tarimi vaarini padadroyunu gaaka.
Baadhimpabaduvaari pakshamuna yèhovaa vyaajyèmaadu naniyu daridrulaku aayana nyaayamu teerchunaniyu nenèrugu dunu.
Nishchayamugaa neetimamtulu nee naamamunaku krritaj~na taastutulu chèllimchèdaru yathaarthavamtulu nee sannidhini nivasimchèdaru.
Yèhovaa nenu neeku mòrrapèttuchunnaanu naayòddaku tvarapadi rammu nenu mòrrapèttagaa naa maataku chèviyòggumu
Naa praarthana dhoopamuvalènu nenu chetulèttuta saayamkaala naivedyamuvalènu nee drrishtiki amgeekaaramulagunu gaaka.
Yèhovaa, naa notiki kaavaliyumchumu naa pèdavula dvaaramunaku kaapu pèttumu.
Paapamu cheyuvaarito kooda nenu durneetikaaryamulalo chòrabadakumdunatlu naa manassu dushkaaryamunaku tiruganiyyakumu vaari ruchigala padaarthamulu nenu tinakayumdunu gaaka.

Neetimamtulu nannu kòttuta naaku upakaaramu vaaru nannu gaddimchuta naaku tailaabhishekamu nenu atti abhishekamunu trosiveyakumdunu gaaka. vaari dushtakriyalanu choochiyu nenu tappaka praarthanacheyuchunnaanu.
Vaari nyaayaadhipatulu kòmda petumeedanumdi pada droyabaduduru. kaavuna janulu naa maatalu madhuramainavani vaatini amgeekarimchuchunnaaru.
Òkadu bhoomini dunnuchu daanini pagulagòttunatlu maayèmukalu paataaladvaaramuna chèdariyunnavi.
Yèhovaa, naa prabhuvaa, naa kannulu neetattu choochuchunnavi nee sharanujòchchiyunnaanu naa praanamu dhaarapoya kumu.
Naa nimittamu vaaru òddina valanumdi paapamu cheyuvaari uchchulanumdi nannu tappimchi kaapaadumu.
Nenu tappimchukòni povuchumdagaa bhaktiheenulu tama valalalo chikkukòmduru gaaka.
Nenu èlugètti yèhovaaku mòraliduchunnaanu. èlugètti yèhovaanu batimaalukònuchunnaanu.
Bahu vinayamugaa aayana sannidhini nenu mòrra pèttuchunnaanu naaku kaligina baadha aayana sannidhini tèliyajèppukònu chunnaanu.
Naalo naa praanamu krumgiyunnappudu naa maargamu neeku tèliyunu nannu pattukònutakai nenu naduvavalasina trovalo chaatugaa pagavaaru urinòdduchunnaaru.
Naa kudiprakkanu nidaanimchi choodumu nannèriginavaadu òkadunu naaku lekapoyènu aashrayamediyu naaku dòrakaledu naayèdala jaalipaduvaadu òkadunu ledu.
Yèhovaa, neeke nenu mòrrapèttuchunnaanu naa aashrayadurgamu neeve sajeevulunna bhoomimeeda naa svaasthyamu neeve ani nenanukòmtini.
Nenu chaalaa krumgiyunnaanu naa mòrraku chèvi yòggumu nannu tarumuvaaru naakamtè balishthulu vaari chetilo numdi nannu vidipimpumu.
Nenu nee naamamunaku krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchunatlu chèrasaalalonumdi naa praanamunu tappimpumu appudu neevu naaku mahopakaaramu chesiyumduta choochi neetimamtulu nannubatti atishayapaduduru.
Yèhovaa, naa praarthana aalakimpumu naa vinnapamulaku chèvi yòggumu nee vishvaasyatanubattiyu nee neetinibattiyu naaku uttaramimmu.
Nee sevakunito vyaajyèmaadakumu sajeevulalo òkadunu nee sannidhini neetimamtudugaa èmcha badadu.
Shatruvulu nannu tarumuchunnaaru vaaru naa praanamunu nela padagòttuchunnaaru chirakaalamukrimdata chanipoyina vaaritopaatu gaadhaamdhakaaramulo nannu nivasimpajeyuchunnaaru.
Kaavuna naa aatma naalo krumgiyunnadi naalo naa hrridayamu vismayamòmdènu.
Poorvadinamulu j~naapakamu chesikònuchunnaanu nee kriyalanniyu dhyaanimchuchunnaanu. nenu nee chetula pani yochimchuchunnaanu
Nee tattu naa chetulu chaapuchunnaanu èmdipoyina bhoomivalè naa praanamu neekòraku aasha paduchunnadi.
Yèhovaa, naa aatma ksheenimchuchunnadi tvaragaa naaku uttaramimmu nenu samaadhiloniki diguvaarivalè kaakumdunatlu nee mukhamunu naaku marugucheyakumu
Neeyamdu nenu namimaka yumchiyunnaanu udayamuna nee krripaavaartanu naaku vinipimpumu nee vaipu naa manassu ne nèttikònuchunnaanu. nenu naduvavalasina maargamu naaku tèliyajeyumu.
Yèhovaa, nenu nee marugu jòchchiyunnaanu naa shatruvula chetilonumdi nannu vidipimpumu
Neeve naa devudavu nee chittaanusaaramugaa pravartimchutaku naaku nerpumu dayagala nee aatma samabhoomigala pradeshamamdu nannu nadipimchunu gaaka.
Yèhovaa, nee naamamunubatti nannu bradikim pumu nee neetinibatti naa praanamunu shramalonumdi tappimpumu.
Nenu nee sevakudanu nee krripanubatti naa shatruvulanu samharimpumu naa praanamunu baadhaparachuvaarinamdarini nashimpa jeyumu.
Naaku aashrayadurgamagu yèhovaa sannutimpabadunu gaaka aayana naa chetulaku yuddhamunu naa vrellaku poraatamunu nerpuvaadaiyunnaadu.
Aayana naaku krripaanidhi naa kota naa durgamu nannu tappimchuvaadu naa kedèmu ne naashrayimchuvaadu aayana naa janulanu naaku lobarachuvaadaiyunnaadu.
Yèhovaa, neevu narulanu lakshyapèttutaku vaaru epaativaaru? neevu vaarini ènnikacheyutaku manashyulu epaati vaaru?
Narulu vatti oopirini poliyunnaaru vaari dinamulu daatipovu needavalè nunnavi.
Yèhovaa, nee aakaashamunu vamchi digi rammu parvatamulu pòga raajunatlu neevu vaatini muttumu
Mèrupulu mèripimchi vaarini chèdaragòttumu nee baanamulu vesi vaarini odagòttumu.
Painumdi nee chèyyi chaachi nannu tappimpumu mahaa jalamulalonumdi anyulachetilonumdi nannu vidipimpumu.
Vaari noru vatti maatalaaduchunnadi vaari kudicheyi abaddhamuto koodiyunnadi.
Devaa, ninnugoorchi nenòka kròtta keertana paadèdanu paditamtula sitaaraato ninnu keertimchèdanu.
Neeve raajulaku vijayamu dayacheyuvaadavu dushtula khadgamunumdi neevu nee sevakudaina daaveedunu tappimchuvaadavu
Nannu tappimpumu anyula chetilonumdi nannuvidi pimpumu vaari noru vatti maatalaaduchunnadi vaari kudicheyi abaddhamuto koodiyunnadi.
Maa kumaarulu tama ¸°vana kaalamamdu èdigina mòkkalavalè unnaaru maa kumaartèlu nagarunakai chèkkina moolakambamulavalè unnaaru.
Maa kòtlu nimpabadi paluvidhamulaina dravyamulaku nidhulugaa unnavi maa gòrralu velakòladigaanu padivelakòladigaanu maa gaddi beellalo pillalu veyuchunnavi.
Maa yèdlu gòppa baruvulu moyagalavi maa veedhulalo chòrabadutayainanu urukulèttuta yainanu ledu vaatilo shramagalavaari mòrra vinabadutayainanu ledu
Itti sthitigalavaaru dhanyulu. yèhovaa tamaku devudugaagala janulu dhanyulu.
Raajavaina naa devaa, ninnu ghanaparachèdanu. nee naamamunu nityamu sannutimchèdanu
Anudinamu nenu ninnu stutimchèdanu nityamu nee naamamunu stutimchèdanu.
Yèhovaa mahaatmyamugalavaadu aayana adhikastotramu nòmdadaginavaadu aayana mahaatmyamu grahimpa shakyamu kaanidi
Òka taramuvaaru mariyòka taramuvaariyèduta nee kriyalanu kòniyaaduduru nee paraakramakriyalanu tèliyajeyuduru
Mahonnatamaina nee prabhaavamahimanu nee aashcharya kaaryamulanu nenu dhyaanimchèdanu
Nee bheekarakaaryamula vikramamunu manushyulu vivarimchè daru nenu nee mahaatmyamunu varnimchèdanu.
Nee mahaa dayaalutvamunu goorchina keertini vaaru prakatimchèdaru nee neetinigoorchi vaaru gaanamu chesèdaru
Yèhovaa dayaadaakshinyamulu galavaadu aayana deerghashaamtudu krripaatishayamugalavaadu.
Yèhovaa amdariki upakaari aayana kanikaramulu aayana samasta kaaryamulameeda nunnavi.
Yèhovaa, nee kriyalanniyu neeku krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchuchunnavi nee bhaktulu ninnu sannutimchuduru.
Aayana raajya mahonnata prabhaavamunu aayana balamunu narulaku tèliyajeyutakai
Nee bhaktulu nee raajyaprabhaavamunugoorchi chèppukòmduru nee shauryamunugoorchi palukuduru
Nee raajyamu shaashvataraajyamu nee raajyaparipaalana tarataramulu niluchunu.
Yèhovaa padipovuvaarinamdarini uddharimchuvaadu krumgipoyina vaarinamdarini levanèttuvaadu
Sarvajeevula kannulu neevaipu choochuchunnavi tagina kaalamamdu neevu vaariki aahaaramichchuduvu.
Neevu nee guppilini vippi prati jeevi korikanu trripti parachuchunnaavu.
Yèhovaa tana maargamulannitilo neetigalavaadu tana kriyalannitilo krripachoopuvaadu
Tanaku mòrrapèttuvaari kamdariki tanaku nijamugaa mòrrapèttuvaari kamdariki yèhovaa sameepamugaa unnaadu.
Tanayamdu bhayabhaktulugalavaari korika aayana nèra verchunu vaari mòrra aalakimchi vaarini rakshimchunu.
Yèhovaa tannu premimchuvaarinamdarini kaapaa dunu ayite bhaktiheenulanamdarini aayana naashanamu cheyunu. naa noru yèhovaanu stotramu cheyunu
Shareerulamdaru aayana parishuddha naamamunu nityamu sannutimchuduru gaaka.
Yèhovaanu stutimchudi. naa praanamaa, yèhovaanu stutimpumu
Naa jeevitakaalamamtayu nenu yèhovaanu stutimchè danu nenu bratukukaalamamtayu naa devuni keertimchèdanu
Raajulachetanainanu narulachetanainanu rakshana kalugadu vaarini nammukònakudi
Vaari praanamu vèdalipovunu vaaru mamtipaalagu duru. vaari samkalpamulu naade nashimchunu.
Èvaniki yaakobu devudu sahaayudaguno èvadu tana devudaina yèhovaameeda aashapèttu kònuno vaadu dhanyudu
Aayana aakaashamunu bhoomini samudramunu daani loni sarvamunu srrijimchinavaadu aayana ènnadunu maata tappanivaadu.
Baadhaparachabaduvaariki aayana nyaayamu teerchunu aakaligòninavaariki aahaaramu dayacheyunu yèhovaa bamdhimpabadinavaarini vidudalacheyunu.
Yèhovaa gruddivaari kannulu tèravajeyuvaadu yèhovaa krumginavaarini levanèttuvaadu yèhovaa neetimamtulanu premimchuvaadu
Yèhovaa paradeshulanu kaapaaduvaadu aayana tamdrilenivaarini vidhavaraamdranu aadarimchu vaadu bhaktiheenula maargamunu aayana vamkaramaargamugaa cheyunu.
Yèhovaa niramtaramu elunu seeyonoo, nee devudu taramulannitanu raajyamu cheyunu
Yèhovaanu stutimchudi. yèhovaanu stutimchudi mana devuniki stotragaanamu cheyuta mamchidi adi manoharamu stotramucheyuta òppidamu.
Yèhovaaye yèrooshalemunu kattuvaadu chèdarina ishraayeleeyulanu pogucheyuvaadu
Gumdè chèdarinavaarini aayana baagucheyuvaadu vaari gaayamulu kattuvaadu.
Nakshatramula samkhyanu aayana niyamimchiyunnaadu vaatikannitiki perulu pèttuchunnaadu.
Mana prabhuvu gòppavaadu aayana adhika shaktigalavaadu aayana j~naanamunaku mitiledu.
Yèhovaa deenulanu levanèttuvaadu bhaktiheenulanu aayana nelanu koolchunu.
Krritaj~nataastutulato yèhovaanu keertimchudi. sitaaraato mana devuni keertimchudi.
Aayana aakaashamunu meghamulato kappuvaadu bhoomikòraku varshamu siddhaparachuvaadu parvatamulameeda gaddi mòlipimchuvaadu

​avevanagaa èllamrrigamulalo paraakramamugaladai èvanikaina bhayapadi vènukaku tirugani simhamu
Shonamgi kukka, mekapotu, tana sainyamunaku mumdu naduchuchunna raaju.
Neevu buddhiheenudavai atishayapadi yumdinayèdala keedu yochimchi yumdinayèdala nee chetito noru moosikònumu.
Paalu tarachagaa vènna puttunu, mukku pimdagaa raktamu vachchunu, kopamu repagaa kalahamu puttunu
Raajaina lèmooyelu maatalu, atani talli atani kupadeshimchina devokti,
Naa kumaarudaa, nenemamdunu? nenu kanna kumaa rudaa, nenemamdunu? naa mròkkulu mròkki kanina kumaarudaa, nene mamdunu?
Nee balamunu streelakiyyakumu raajulanu nashimpajeyu streelato sahavaasamu cheya kumu
Draakshaarasamu traaguta raajulaku tagadu lèmooyeloo, adi raajulaku tagadu madyapaanaasakti adhikaarulaku tagadu.
Traaginayèdala vaaru kattadalanu maraturu deenulakamdariki anyaayamu cheyuduru
Praanamu povuchunnavaaniki madyamu niyyudi manovyaakulamugalavaariki draakshaarasamu niyyudi.
Vaaru traagi tama pedarikamu maraturu tama shramanu ika talamchakumduru.
Moogavaarikini dikkulenivaarikamdarikini nyaayamu jarugunatlu nee noru tèruvumu.
Nee noru tèrachi nyaayamugaa teerpu teerchumu deenulakunu shramapaduvaarikini daridrulakunu nyaayamu jarigimpumu.
Gunavatiyaina bhaarya dòrukuta arudu attidi mutyamukamtè amoolyamainadi.
Aamè pènimiti aamèyamdu namimakayumchunu atani laabhapraaptiki vèliti kalugadu.
Aamè taanu braduku dinamulanniyu ataniki melu cheyunu gaani keedemiyu cheyadu.
Aamè gòrrabòchchunu avisènaaranu vèdakunu tana chetulaara vaatito panicheyunu.
Vartakapu odalu dooramunumdi aahaaramu tèchchunatlu aamè dooramunumdi aahaaramu tèchchukònunu.
Aamè cheekatitone lechi, tana yimtivaariki bhojanamu siddhaparachunu tana panikattèlaku battèmu erparachunu.
Aamè pòlamunu choochi daanini teesikònunu taamu koodabèttina dravyamu pètti draakshatota yòkati naatimchunu.
Aamè nadikattucheta nadumu balaparachukòni chetulato balamugaa panicheyunu
Tana vyaapaaralaabhamu anubhavamuche tèlisikònunu raatrivela aamè deepamu aaripodu.
Aamè pamtènu cheta pattukònunu tana vrellato kaduru pattukòni vadukunu.
Deenulaku tana chèyyi chaapunu daridrulaku tana chetulu chaapunu
Tana yimtivaariki chali tagulunani bhayapadadu aamè yimtivaaramdaru raktavarna vastramulu dharimchina vaaru.

J~naanamu kaligi tana noru tèrachunu krripagala upadeshamu aamè bodhimchunu.

Aamè kumaarulu lechi aamènu dhanyuraalamdaru chaalamamdi kumaartèlu pativrataadharmamu nanusarimchi
Yunnaaru gaani vaaramdarini neevu mimchinadaanavu ani aamè pènimiti aamènu pògadunu.

​sooryunikrimda narulu paduchumdu paatu amtativalana vaariki kaluguchunna laabha memi?
​taramu vèmbadi taramu gatimchi povuchunnadi; bhoomiyòkate yèllappudunu niluchunadi.
​sooryududa yimchunu, sooryudu astamimchunu, taanudayimchu sthalamu marala cherutaku tvarapadunu.
​gaali dakshinamunaku poyi uttaramunaku tirugunu; itlu marala marala tiruguchu tana samchaaramaargamuna tirigi vachchunu.
​nadulanniyu samudramulo padunu, ayite samudramu nimduta ledu; nadulu èkkadanumdi paarivachchuno akkadike avi èppudunu maralipovunu
​​èdatèripi lekumda samastamu jaruguchunnadi; manushyulu daani vivarimpa jaalaru; choochutacheta kannu trriptipòmdakunnadi, vinutacheta chèviki trriptikaluguta ledu.
Munupu umdinade ika umdabovu nadi; munupu jariginade ika jarugabovunadi; sooryuni krimda nootanamaina dediyu ledu.
Idi nootanamainadani yòkadaanigoorchi yòkadu chèppunu; adiyunu manaku mumdumdina taramulalo umdinade.
Poorvulu j~naapaka munaku raaru; puttabovuvaari j~naapakamu aa taruvaata numda bovuvaariki kalugadu.
Prasamginaina nenu yèrooshalemunamdu ishraayelee yulameeda raajunai yumtini.

Aakaashamukrimda jarugu nadi amtatini j~naanamucheta vichaarimchi grahimchutakai naa manassu nilipitini; vaaru deenicheta abhyaasamu nòmdavalè nani devudu maanavulaku erpaatuchesina prayaasamu bahu kathinamainadi.
​sooryunikrimda jaruguchunna kriyala nannitini nenu choochitini; avi anniyu vyarthamule, avi yòkadu gaalikai prayaasa padinattunnavi.
​vamkaragaanunna daanini chakkaparacha shakyamukaadu, lopamugaladi lèkkaku raadu.
​yèrooshalemunamdu naaku mumdunna vaaramdari kamtènu nenu chaala èkkuvagaa j~naanamu sampaadimchiti naniyu, j~naanamunu vidyanu nenu poornamugaa abhyasimchiti naniyu naa manassulo nenanukòmtini.
Naa manassu nilipi, j~naanaabhyaasamunu vèrritanamunu matiheenatanu tèlisikònutaku prayatnimchitini; ayite idiyu gaalikai prayaasapadutaye ani tèlisikòmtini.
Vistaara maina j~naanaabhyaasamucheta vistaaramaina duhkhamu kalugunu; adhika vidya sampaadimchinavaaniki adhika shokamu kalugunu.
Kaanee ninnu samtoshamucheta shodhimchi chootunu; neevu melu nanubhavimchi choodumani nenu naa hrridaya muto chèppukòmtini; ayite adiyu vyarthaprayatna maayènu.
Navvutoneevu vèrridaanavaniyu, samtosha mutoneecheta kalugunademiyaniyu nevamtini.

Naa manassu imkanu j~naanamu anusarimchuchumdagaa aakaashamu krimda taamu bradukukaalamamtayu manushyulu emichesi melu anubhavimturo choodavalènani talachi, naa dehamunu draakshaarasamucheta samtoshaparachukòmdunaniyu, mati heenatayòkka samgati amtayu grahimtunaniyu naa manassulo nenu yochana chesikòmtini.
​nenu gòppa panulu cheyaboonukòmtini, naakòraku imdlu kattimchu kòmtini, draakshatotalu naatimchukòmtini.
Naakòraku totalanu shrrimgaaravanamulanu veyimchukòni vaatilo sakalavidhamulaina phalavrrikshamulanu naatimchitini.
Vrrikshamula naarumallaku neerupaarutakai nenu chèruvulu travvimchu kòmtini.

​panivaarini pani kattèlanu sampaadimchukòmtini; naa yimta puttina daasulu naakumdiri; yèrooshalemu namdu naaku mumdumdina vaaramdarikamtè èkkuvagaa pasula mamdalunu gòrra mekala mamdalunu bahu vistaaramugaa sampaadimchukòmtini.

Naakòraku nenu vèmdi bamgaara mulanu, raajulu sampaadimchu sampadanu, aa yaa desha mulalo dòruku sampattunu koorchukòmtini; nenu gaaya kulanu gaayakuraamdranu manushyulichchayimchu sampadalanu sampaadimchukòni bahumamdi upapatnulanu umchu kòmtini.
Naaku mumdu yèrooshalemunamdunna vaaramdari kamtènu nenu ghanudanai abhivrriddhi nòmditini; naa j~naanamu nannu vidichi poledu.

Naa kannulu aashimchina vaatilo denini avi choodakumda nenu abhyamtaramu cheyaledu; mariyu naa hrridayamu naa panulannitinibatti samto shimpagaa samtoshakaramainadediyu anubhavimchakumda nenu naa hrridayamunu nirbamdhimpaledu. ide naa panulanniti valana naaku dòrikina bhaagyamu.

​appudu nenu chesina panulanniyu, vaatikòrakai nenu padina prayaasamamtayu nenu nidaanimchi vivechimpagaa avanniyu vyarthamainavigaanu òkadu gaaliki prayaasapadinattugaanu agupadènu, sooryuni krimda laabhakaramainadediyu lenattu naaku kanabadènu.
Raaju taruvaata raabovu vaadu, idivaraku jarigina daani vishayamu sayitamu emi cheyuno anukòni, nenu j~naanamunu vèrritanamunu matiheenatanu parisheelimchu takai poonukòmtini.
Amtata cheekatikamtè vèlugu èmta prayojanakaramo buddhiheenatakamtè j~naanamu amta prayo janakaramani nenu tèlisikòmtini.
​j~naaniki kannulu talalo nunnavi, buddhiheenudu cheekatiyamdu naduchuchunnaadu; ayinanu amdarikini òkkate gati sambhavimchunani nenu grahimchitini.
Kaavuna buddhi heenuniki sambhavimchunatle naakunu sambhavimchunu ganuka nenu adhika j~naanamu ela sampaadimchitinani naa hrridayamamdanukòmtini. idiyu vyarthame.

Buddhiheenulanu goorchinatlugaane j~naanulanu goorchiyu j~naapakamu ènnatikini yumchabadadu; raabovu dina mulalo vaaramdarunu maruvabadinavaarai yumduru; j~naanulu mrritinòmdu vidhamèttido buddhiheenulu mrritinòmdu vidhamattide.
Idi choodagaa sooryuni krimda jarugunadi naaku vyasanamu puttimchènu amtayu vyarthamu gaanu òkadu gaalikai prayaasapadinattugaanu kanabadènu ganuka bradukuta naa kasahyamaayènu.
Sooryuni krimda nenu prayaasapadi chesina panulannitini naa taruvaata vachchuvaaniki nenu vidichipèttavalènani tèlisi kòni nenu vaatiyamdu asahyapaditini.

Vaadu j~naanamu galavaadai yumduno buddhiheenudai yumduno adi èva niki tèliyunu? ayite sooryuni krimda nenu prayaasa padi j~naanamucheta sampaadimchukònna naa kashtaphalamamtati meedanu vaadu adhikaariyai yumdunu; idiyunu vyarthame.
Kaavuna sooryuni krimda nenu padina prayaasa mamtati vishayamai nenu aasha vidichina vaadanaitini.

​òkadu j~naanamutonu tèlivitonu yuktitonu prayaasapadi edo òka pani cheyunu; ayite daanikòraku prayaasa padani vaaniki atadu daanini svaasthyamugaa ichchiveya valasi vachchunu; idiyu vyarthamunu gòppa chèdugunai yunnadi.
​sooryuni krimda naruniki tatasthimchu prayaasa mamtati chetanu, vaadu talapèttu kaaryamu lannitichetanu, vaanikemi dòrukuchunnadi?
​vaani dinamulanniyu shramakaramulu, vaani paatlu vyasanakaramulu, raatriyam dainanu vaani manassunaku nèmmadi dòrakadu; idiyuvyarthame.
Annapaanamulu puchchukònutakamtènu, tana kashtaarji tamucheta sukhapadutakamtènu naruniki melukara mainadediyu ledu. idiyunu devunivalana kalugunani nenu tèlisi kòmtini.
Aayana sèlavuleka bhojanamuchesi samto shimchuta èvariki saadhyamu?

Elayanagaa daivadrrishtiki mamchivaadugaa numduvaaniki devudu j~naanamunu tèlivini aanamdamunu anugrahimchunu; ayite daivadrrishtiki ishtu daguvaani kichchutakai prayaasapadi pogucheyu panini aayana paapaatmuniki nirnayimchunu. idiyu vyarthamu gaanu òkadu gaalikai prayaasapadinattugaanu unnadi.

​kashtapadinavaariki tama kashtamuvalana vachchina laabhamemi?
Narulu abhyaasamu pòmdavalènani devudu vaariki pèttiyunna kashtaanubhavamunu nenu choochi tini.

Denikaalamunamdu adi chakkagaa numdunatlu samastamunu aayana niyamimchiyunnaadu; aayana shaashvatakaala j~naanamunu narula hrridayamamdumchi yunnaadugaani devudu cheyukriyalanu parisheelanagaa tèlisikònutaku adi chaaladu.
Kaavuna samtoshamugaa numdutakamtènu tama bradukunu sukhamugaa vèllabuchchuta kamtènu, shreshthamainadediyu narulaku ledani nenu tèlisi kòmtini.
Mariyu prativaadu annapaanamulu puchchu kònuchu tana kashtaarjitamuvalana sukhamanubhavimchuta devu dichchu bahumaaname ani tèlisikòmtini.

Devudu cheyu panulanniyu shaashvatamulani nenu tèlisikòmtini; daani kediyu cherchabadadu daaninumdi ediyu teeyabadadu; manushyulu tanayamdu bhayabhaktulu kaligiyumdunatlu devuditti niyamamu chesiyunnaadu.
​mumdu jariginade ippudunu jarugunu; jarugabovunadi poorvamamdu jarigi nade; jarigipoyinadaanini devudu marala rappimchunu.
Mariyu lokamunamdu vimarshasthaanamuna durmaargata jarugutayu, nyaayamumdavalasina sthaanamuna durmaargata jarugutayu naaku kanabadènu.
Prati prayatnamunakunu prati kriyakunu tagina samaya munnadaniyu, neetimamtula kunu durmaargulakunu devude teerpu teerchunaniyu naa hrridayamulo nenanukòmtini.
Kaagaa taamu mrrigamulavamtivaarani narulu tèlisikònunatlunu, devudu vaarini vimarshimchunatlunu eelaagu jaruguchunnadani anu kòmtini.

Narulaku sambhavimchunadi yedo ade, mrriga mulaku sambhavimchunu; vaarikini vaatikini kalugu gati òkkate; narulu chachchunatlu mrrigamulunu chachchunu; sakala jeevulaku òkkate praanamu; mrrigamulakamtè narula kemiyu èkkuvaledu; samastamunu vyarthamu.
​samastamu òkka sthalamunake povunu; samastamu mamtilonumdi puttènu, samastamu mamtike tirigipovunu.
​narula aatma paramuna kèkkipovuno ledo, mrrigamula praanamu bhoomiki digipovuno ledo yèvariki tèliyunu?

Kaagaa tamaku taruvaata jarugudaanini choochutakai naruni tirigi lepikònipovuvaadèvadunu lekapovuta nenu choodagaa vaaru tama kriyalayamdu samtoshimchutakamtè vaariki mari e melunu ledanu samgati nenu tèlisikòmtini; ide vaari bhaagamu.

Pimmata sooryunikrimda jarugu vividhamaina anyaaya kriyalanu gurimchi nenu yochimchitini. baadhimpabadu vaaru aadarimchu dikkuleka kanneellu viduchuduru; vaarini baadhapèttuvaaru balavamtulu ganuka aadarimchuvaadèvadunu lekapoyènu.
Kaabatti yimkanu bradukuchunnavaari kamtè imtakumumdu kaalamu chesinavaare dhanyulanu kòmtini.
Imkanu puttani vaaru sooryunikrimda jarugu anyaayapu panulu choochiyumdani hetuvucheta ee ubhayulakamtènu vaare dhanyulanukòmtini.
Mariyu kashtamamtayu nerputo koodina panu lanniyu narulaku roshakaaranamulani naaku kanabadènu; idiyu vyarthamugaa nòkadu gaalini pattukònutakai cheyu prayatnamuvalènunnadi.
​buddhiheenudu chetulu muduchu kòni tana maamsamu bhakshimchunu.
Shramayunu gaali kaina yatnamulunu rèmdu chetulanimda numdutakamtè òka chetinimda nèmmadikaligi yumduta melu.
Nenaalochimpagaa vyarthamainadi mariyòkati sooryuni krimda naaku kanabadènu.

Òmtarigaa nunna òkadu kaladu, ataniki jatagaadu ledu kumaarudu ledu sahodarudu ledu; ayinanu atadu èdatègaka kashtapadunu; atani kannu aishvaryamucheta trriptipòmdadu, atadusukhamanunadi nenèrugaka èvarinimittamu kashtapaduchunnaanani anu kònadu; idiyu vyarthamainadai bahu chimta kaligimchunu.
Iddari kashtamucheta ubhayulaku mamchiphalamukalugunu ganuka òmtigaadai yumdutakamtè iddaru koodi yumduta melu.
Vaaru padipoyinanu òkadu tanatodivaanini levanèttunu; ayite òmtarigaadu padipoyinayèdala vaaniki shramaye kalugunu, vaani levanèttuvaadu leka povunu.
Iddaru kalisi pamdukòninayèdala vaariki vètta kalugunu; òmtarigaaniki vètta elaagu puttunu?
Òmtari yagu nòkanimeeda mariyòkadu padinayèdala iddaru koodi vaani nèdirimpa galaru, moodu petala traadu tvaragaa tègipodu gadaa?
Moodhatvamucheta buddhi maatalakika chèviyòggaleni musali raajukamtè beedavaadaina j~naanavamtudagu chinna vaade shreshthudu.
Attivaadu tana deshamamdu beedavaadugaa puttinanu pattaabhishekamu nòmdutaku chèrasaalalonumdi bayaluvèllunu.
Sooryunikrimda samcharimchu sajeevu lamdaru gatimchina raajunaku badulugaa raajaina aa chinna vaani pakshamuna numdurani nenu tèlisikòmtini.
​atani aadhipatyamu krimdi janulaku lèkkaye ledu, ayinanu taruvaata raabovuvaaru veeniyamdu ishtapadaru. nijamugaa idiyu vyarthame, òkadu gaalikai prayaasapadinatte.

Neevu devuni mamdiramunaku povunappudu nee pravartana jaagrattagaa choochukònumu; buddhiheenulu arpimchu natlugaa bali arpimchutakamtè sameepimchi aalakimchuta shreshthamu; vaaru tèliyakaye durmaargapu panulu cheyu duru.

Neevu devuni sannidhini anaalochanagaa palukutaku nee hrridayamunu tvarapadaniyyaka nee notini kaachu kòmmu; devudu aakaashamamdunnaadu neevu bhoomimeeda unnaavu, kaavuna nee maatalu kòddigaa umdavalènu.
Vistaaramaina panipaatulavalana svapnamu puttunu, pèkku maatalu palukuvaadu buddhiheenudagunu.
Neevu devuniki mròkkubadi chesikòninayèdala daanini chèllimchutaku aalasyamu cheyakumu;buddhiheenulayamdu aayana kishtamu ledu.
Neevu mròkkukòninadaani chèllimchumu, neevu mròkkukòni chèllimpakumdutakamtè mròkkukòna kumdutaye melu.

Nee dehamunu shikshaku loparachu namta pani nee notivalana jaruganiyyakumu; adi pòra paatucheta jarigènani doota yèduta chèppakumu; nee maatalavalana devuniki kopamu puttimchi neevela nee kashtamunu vyarthaparachukònèdavu?
​adhikamaina svapnamulunu maata lunu nish‌prayojanamulu; neemattuku neevu devuniyamdu bhayabhaktulu kaligiyumdumu.

Òka raajyamamdu beedalanu baadhimchutayu, dharmamunu nyaayamunu balaatkaaramucheta meerutayu neeku kana badinayèdala daaniki aashcharyapadakumu; adhikaaramu nòmdinavaarimeeda mari èkkuva adhikaaramu nòmdinavaa runnaaru; mariyu mari èkkuvaina adhikaaramu nòmdina vaadu vaariki paigaa nunnaadu.
E deshamulo raaju bhoomivishayamai shraddha puchchukònuno aa deshamunaku sarvavishayamulayamdu melu kalugunu.
Dravyamu napekshimchuvaadu dravyamucheta trripti nòmdadu, dhanasamrriddhi napekshimchuvaadu daanicheta trripti nòmdadu; idiyu vyarthame.
Aasti yèkkuvaina yèdala daani bhakshimchuvaarunu èkkuva aguduru; kannulaara choochutayegaaka aastiparuniki tana aastivalani prayojana memi?
Kashtajeevulu kòddigaa tininanu èkkuvagaa tininanu sukhanidra nòmduduru; ayite aishvaryavamtulaku tama dhanasamrridhthicheta nidrapattadu.
Sooryuni krimda manassunaku aayaasakaramainadòkati jaruguta nenu choochitini. adedanagaa aastigalavaadu tana aastini daachipèttukòni tanaku naashanamu tèppimchu kònunu.
Ayite aa aasti duradrrishtamuvalana nashimchi povunu; atadu putrulugalavaadainanu atanichetilo emiyu lekapovunu.
Vaadu e prakaaramugaa talli garbhamunumdi vachchèno aa prakaaramugaane taanu vachchi natle digambarigaane marala povunu, taanu prayaasa padi chesikòninadaanilo edainanu chetapattukònipodu;
Atadu vachchina prakaaramugaane marala povunu; gaaliki prayaasapadi sampaadimchinadaanivalana vaaniki laabhamemi?

Idamtayu vinina taruvaata telina phalitaarthamide; devuniyamdu bhayabhaktulu kaligiyumdi aayana kattadala nanusarimchi naduchuchumdavalènu, maanavakotiki idiye vidhi.
Goodhamaina prati yamshamunugoorchi devudu vimarshacheyunappudu aayana pratikriyanu adi mamchide gaani chèddade gaani, teerpuloniki tèchchunu.
Sòlòmonu rachimchina paramageetamu.
Notimuddulato atadu nannu muddupèttukònunu gaaka nee prema draakshaarasamukanna madhuramu.
Neevu poosikònu parimalatailamu suvaasanagaladi nee peru poyabadina parimalatailamuto samaanamu kanyakalu ninnu premimchuduru.

Nannu aakarshimchumu memu neeyòddaku parugètti vachchèdamu raaju tana amtahpuramuloniki nannu cherchukònènu ninnubatti memu samtoshimchi utsahimchèdamu draakshaarasamukanna nee premanu èkkuvagaa smarimchè damu yathaarthamaina manassuto vaaru ninnu premimchu chunnaaru.
Yèrooshalemu kumaartèlaaraa, nenu nallanidaananainanu saumdaryavamturaalanu kedaaruvaari gudaaramulavalènu sòlòmonu nagaru tèralavalènu nenu saumdaryavamturaalanu
Nallanidaananani nannu chinna choopulu choodakudi. nenu èmda tagilinadaananu naa sahodarulu naameeda kopimchi nannu draakshatotaku kaavalikattègaa numchiri ayite naa sòmta totanu nenu kaayakapotini.
Naa praana priyudaa, nee mamdanu neevèchchata mepuduvo madhyaahnamuna nèchchata needaku vaatini toluduvo naato chèppumu musukuvesikòninadaananai nee jatakaamdla mamdalayòdda nenèmdukumdavalènu?
Naareemanee, sumdaree, adi neeku tèliyakapoyènaa? mamdala yadugujaadalanubatti neevu pòmmu mamdakaaparula gudaaramulayòdda nee mekapillalanu mepumu.
Naa priyuraalaa, pharoyòkka rathaashvamulato ninnu polchèdanu.
Aabharanamulacheta nee chèkkillunu haaramulacheta nee kamthamunu shobhilluchunnavi.
Vèmdi puvvulugala bamgaaru saramulu memu neeku cheyimtumu
Raaju vimduku koorchumdiyumdagaa naa parimalatailapu suvaasana vyaapimchènu.
Naa priyudu naa ròmmunanumdu goparasamamta suvaasanagalavaadu
Naaku naa priyudu engèdee draakshaavanamuloni karpoorapu pooguttulato samaanudu.
Naa priyuraalaa, neevu sumdarivi neevu sumdarivi nee kannulu guvva kamdlu.
Naa priyudaa, neevu sumdarudavu atimanoharudavu mana shayanasthaanamu pachchanichotu
Mana mamdiramula doolamulu devadaaru mraanulu mana vaasamulu saralapu mraanulu.
Nenu shaaronu pòlamulo pooyu pushpamu vamti daananu loyalalo puttu padmamuvamtidaananu.
Balurakkasi chètlalo vallipadmamu kanabadunatlu streelalo naa priyuraalu kanabaduchunnadi.
Adavi vrrikshamulalo jaldaru vrrikshamètlunnado purushulalo naa priyudu atlunnaadu aanamdabharitanai nenatani needanu koorchumtini atani phalamu naa jihvaku madhuramu.
Atadu nannu vimdushaalaku todukònipoyènu naameeda premanu dhvajamugaa èttènu.
Premaatishayamucheta nenu moorchilluchunnaanu draakshapamdla yadalu pètti nannu balaparachudi jaldaru pamdlu pètti nannaadarimchudi
Atani yèdamachèyyi naa talakrimdanunnadi kudicheta atadu nannu kaugilimchuchunnaadu.

Yèrooshalemu kumaartèlaaraa, pòlamuloni yirrulanubattiyu lellanubattiyu meecheta pramaanamu cheyimchukòni premaku ishtamaguvaraku meeru lepakayu kalataparachakayu numdudani mimmunu batimaalukònuchunnaanu.
Aalakimchudi; naa priyuni svaramu vinabaduchunnadi idigo atadu vachchuchunnaadu gamtuluveyuchu kòmdalameedanu ègasidaatuchu mèttalameedanu atadu vachchuchunnaadu.
Naa priyudu irrivalè nunnaadu ledipillavalè nunnaadu adigo mana godaku vèligaa natadu niluchuchunnaadu kitikeegumda choochuchunnaadu kitikeekamtagumda tòmgi choochuchunnaadu
Ippudu naa priyudu naato maatalaadu chunnaadu
Naa priyuraalaa, sumdaravatee, lèmmu rammu chalikaalamu gadichipoyènu varshakaalamu teeripoyènu varshamika raadu.
Deshamamtata puvvulu poosiyunnavi pittalu kolaahalamu cheyu kaalamu vachchènu paavura svaramu mana deshamulo vinabaduchunnadi.
Amjoorapukaayalu pakvamaguchunnavi draakshachètlu pootapatti suvaasana nichchuchunnavi naa priyuraalaa, sumdaravatee, lèmmu rammu
Bamdasamdulalo èguru naa paavuramaa, petubeetala naashrayimchu naa paavuramaa, nee svaramu madhuramu nee mukhamu manoharamu nee mukhamu naaku kanabadanimmu nee svaramu naaku vinabadanimmu.
Mana draakshatotalu pootapattiyunnavi draakshatotalanu chèrupu nakkalanu pattukònudi sahaayamu chesi gumtanakkalanu pattukònudi.
Naa priyudu naa vaadu nenu atanidaananu padmamulunnachota atadu mamdanu mepuchunnaadu
Challanigaali veechuvaraku needalu lekapovuvaraku irrivalènu ledipillavalènu kòmdabaatalameeda tvarapadi rammu.
Raatrivela parumdiyumdi nenu naa praanapriyuni vèdakitini vèdakinanu atadu kanabadaka yumdènu.
Nenippude lechèdanu pattanamu vèmbadipoyi vèdakudunu samtaveedhulalonu raajaveedhulalonu tirugudunu naa praanapriyuni vèdakudunu ani nenanukòmtini. nenu vèdakinanu atadu kanabadaledu.
Pattanamunamdu samcharimchu kaavalivaaru naakèduru padagaa meeru naa praanapriyuni choochitiraa? ani nenadigi tini

Nenu vaarini vidichi kòmchèmu dooramu pogaa naa praanapriyudu naakèdurupadènu vadalipèttaka nenatani pattukòmtini naa talli yimtikatani todukòni vachchitini nannu kaninadaani yaraloniki todukòni vachchitini.

Yèrooshalemu kumaartèlaaraa, pòlamuloni yirrulanubattiyu lellanubattiyu meecheta pramaanamu cheyimchukòni lechutaku premaku ishtamaguvaraku meeru lepakayu kalataparachakayu numdudani nenu mimmunu batimaalukònuchunnaanu.
Dhooma stambhamulavalè aranyamaargamugaa vachchu idi emi? goparasamutonu saambraanitonu vartakulammu vividha maina sugamdha choornamulatonu parimalimchuchu vachchu idi emi?
Idigo sòlòmonu pallaki vachchuchunnadi aruvadimamdi shoorulu daaniki parivaaramu vaaru ishraayeleeyulalo paraakramashaalulu vaaramdarunu khadgadhaarulu yuddhaveerulu
Raatri bhayamucheta vaaru khadgamu dharimchi vachchu chunnaaru.
Lèbaanonu mraanuto mamchamòkati sòlòmonuraaju tanaku cheyimchukòni yunnaadu.

Daani stambhamulu vèmdimayamulu daani paadamulu svarnamayamulu daani mèttalu dhoomravarnavastramuto cheyabadènu premanu soochimchu vichitramaina kuttupanito yèrooshalemu kumaartèlu daani lopalibhaagamu nalamka rimchiri.
Seeyonu kumaartèlaaraa, vemcheyudi kireetamu dharimchina sòlòmonuraajunu choodudi vivaahadinamuna atani talli ataniki pèttina kireetamu choodudi aa dinamu ataniki bahu samtoshakaramu.
Naa priyuraalaa, neevu sumdarivi neevu sumdarivi nee musukugumda nee kannulu guvvakannulavalè kanabadu chunnavi nee talavèmdrukalu gilaadu parvatamumeedi mekala mamdanu poliyunnavi.
Nee paluvarusa kattèraveyabadinaviyu kadugabadi appude paiki vachchinaviyunai jodujodu pillalu kaligi òkadaaninaina pogòttukònaka sukhamugaanunna gòrrala kadupulanu poliyunnadi.
Nee pèdavulu èrupunoolunu poliyunnavi. nee noru sumdaramu nee musukugumda nee kanatalu vichchina daadima phalamu valè nagapaduchunnavi.
Jayasoochakamula numchutakai daaveedu kattimchina gopuramutonu veyi daalulunu, shoorula kavachamulanniyunu vrelaadu aa gopuramutonu nee kamdharamu samaanamu.
Nee yiru kuchamulu òka jimkapillalayi taamaralo meyu kavalanu poliyunnavi.
Èmda challaari needalu jarigipovuvaraku goparasa parvatamulaku saambraani parvatamulaku nenu vèlludunu.
Naa priyuraalaa, neevu adhikasumdarivi neeyamdu kalamkamemiyu ledu.

Praaneshvaree, lèbaanonu vidichi naatokooda rammu lèbaanonu vidichi naato kooda rammu amaanaparvatapu shikharamunumdi shèneeru hèrmonula shikharamunumdi simhavyaaghramulumdu guhalugala kòmdalapainumdi neevu krimdiki choochèdavu.
Naa sahodaree, praaneshvaree, neevu naa hrridayamunu vashaparachukòmtivi òka chooputo naa hrridayamunu vashaparachukòmtivi. nee haaramulalo òkadaanicheta nannu vashaparachukòmtivi.
Sahodaree, praaneshvaree, nee prema èmta madhuramu! draakshaarasamukanna nee prema èmta samtoshakaramu neevu poosikònu parimala tailamula vaasana sakala gamdhavargamulakanna samtoshakaramu.
Praaneshvaree, nee pèdavulu teniyalòlukuchunna ttunnavi nee jihvakrimda madhuksheeramulu kalavu nee vastramula suvaasana lèbaanonu suvaasanavalè nunnadi.
Naa sahodari naa praaneshvari mooyabadina udyaanamu mootaveyabadina jalakoopamu.
Nee chigurulu daadimavanamu vimtaina shreshtha phalavrrikshamulu karpooravrrikshamulu jataamaamsi vrrikshamulu
Jataamaamsiyu kumkumayu nimmagaddiyu lavamgapattayu vividhamaina parimalataila vrrikshamulu goparasamunu agaru vrrikshamulu naanaavidha shreshtha parimaladravyamulu.
Naa sahodaree, naa praaneshvaree, neevu udyaanajalaashayamu pravaahajalakoopamu lèbaanonu parvatapravaahamu.

Uttaravaayuvoo, etèmchumu dakshinavaayuvoo, vemcheyumu naa udyaanavanamumeeda visarudi daani parimalamulu vyaapimpajeyudi naa priyudu tana udyaanavanamunaku vemcheyunu gaaka tanakishtamaina phalamula natadu bhujimchunugaaka.

Naa sahodaree, praaneshvaree, naa udyaanavanamunaku nenu etèmchitini naa jataamaamsini naa gamdhavargamulanu koorchukònu chunnaanu tenèyu tenèpattunu bhujimchuchunnaanu ksheerasahitadraakshaarasamu paanamu cheyuchunnaanu. naa sakhulaaraa, bhujimchudi lèssagaa paanamu cheyudi snehitulaaraa, paanamu cheyudi.

Nenu nidrimchitine gaani naa manassu melukòni yunnadi naa sahodaree, naa priyuraalaa, naa paavuramaa, nishkalamkuraalaa, aalamkipumu naa tala mamchuku tadisinadi naa vèmdrukalu raatri kuriyu chinukulaku tadisinavi. naaku taluputeeyumanuchu naapriyudu vaakili tattu chunnaadu.
Nenu vastramu teesivesitini nenu marala daani dharimpanela? naa paadamulu kadugukòmtini nenu marala vaatini murikicheyanela?
Talupusamdulo naa priyudu chèyyiyumchagaa naa amtaramgamu ataniyèdala jaaligònènu.
Naa priyuniki talupu teeya lechitini naa chetulanumdiyu naa vrellanumdiyu jataamaamsi gadiyalameeda sravimchènu
Naa priyuniki nenu talupu teeyunamtalo atadu vèllipoyènu atanimaata vinutatone naa praanamu sòmmasillènu nenatani vèdakinanu atadu kanabadakapoyènu nenu pilichinanu atadu palukaledu.
Pattanamulo tirugu kaavalivaaru naa kèdurupadi nannu kòtti gaayaparachiri praakaaramumeedi kaavalivaaru naa paivastramunu dòmgilimchiri.
Yèrooshalemu kumaartèlaaraa, naa priyudu meeku kanabadinayèdala premaatishayamucheta nee priyuraalu moorchillènani meerataniki tèliyajeyunatlu nenu meecheta pramaanamu cheyimchukòmdunu.
Streelalo adhika sumdarivagudaanaa, veru priyunikanna nee priyuni visheshamemi? neevu maacheta pramaanamu cheyimchukònutaku veru priyunikanna nee priyuni visheshamemi?
Naa priyudu dhavalavarnudu ratnavarnudu padivelamamdi purushulalo atani gurtimpavachchunu
Atani shirassu aparamjivamtidi atani talavèmdrukalu kaakapakshamulavalè krrishna varna mulu avi nòkkulu nòkkulugaa kanabaduchunnavi.
Atani netramulu nadeeteeramulamdumdu guvvalavalè kanabaduchunnavi avi paalato kadugabadinattunnavi avi chakkagaa taachina ratnamulavalè unnavi.
Atani chèkkillu parimala pushpasthaanamulu sugamdhavrrikshamulacheta shobhillu unnata bhoobhaaga mulu atani pèdavulu padmamulavamtivi dravaroopaka jataamaamsivalè avi parimalimchunu.
Atani karamulu taarsheeshu ratnabhooshitamaina svarnagolamuvalè unnavi atani kaayamu neelaratnakhachitamaina vichitramagu damtapupanigaa kanabaduchunnadi.
Atani kaallu melimibamgaaru matlayamdu nilipina chaluvaraati stambhamulavalè unnavi. atani vaikhari lèbaanonu parvatatulyamu adi devadaaru vrrikshamulamta prasiddhamu
Atani noru atimadhuramu. atadu atikaamkshaneeyudu yèrooshalemu koomaartèlaaraa, itade naa priyudu itade naa snehitudu.
Streelalo adhika sumdarivagudaanaa, nee priyudu èkkadiki poyènu? atadedikkunaku tirigènu?
Udyaanavanamunamdu meputakunu padmamulanu erukònutakunu. naa priyudu tana udyaanavanamunaku poyènu parimala pushpasthaanamunaku poyènu.
Nenu padmamulalo mepuchunna naa priyunidaananu atadunu naavaadu.
Naa sakhee, neevu tirsaapattanamuvalè sumdaramaina daanavu. yèrooshalemamta saumdaryavamturaalavu tèkkèmula nèttina sainyamuvalè bhayamu puttimchu daanavu
Nee kanudrrishti naameeda umchakumu adi nannu vashaparachukònunu nee talavèmdrukalu gilaadu parvatamumeedi mekalamamdanu poliyunnavi.
Nee paluvarusa kattèra veyabadinaviyu kadugabadi yappude paiki vachchinaviyunai jodujodu pillalu kaligi òkadaaninaina pogòttu kònaka sukhamugaanunna gòrrala kadupulanu poliyunnavi.
Nee musukugumda nee kanatalu vichchina daadima phalamuvalè agapaduchunnavi.
Aruvadimamdi raanulunu ènubadimamdi upapatnu lunu lèkkaku mimchina kanyakalunu kalaru.
Naa paavuramu naa nishkalamkuraalu òkate aamè tana talliki òkate kumaartè kannatalliki muddu bidda streelu daani choochi dhanyuraalamduru raanulunu upapatnulunu daani pògaduduru.
Samdhyaaraagamu choopattuchu chamdrabimbamamta amdamugaladai sooryuni amta svachchamunu kalalunugaladai vyoohitasainya samabheekara roopiniyunagu eemè èvaru?
Loyaloni chètlu ètlunnavo choochutaku draakshaavallulu chigirchèno ledo daadimavrrikshamulu pootapattèno ledo choochutaku nenu akshota vrrikshodyaanamunaku vèllitini.
Tèliyakaye naa janulalo ghanulaguvaari rathamulanu nenu kalisikòmtini.
Shoolameematee, rammu rammu memu ninnu aashateera choochutakai tirigirammu, tirigi rammu. shoolameemateeyamdu meeku muchchata puttimchunadedi? amè mahanayeemu naatakamamta vimtayainadaa?
Raajakumaara putrikaa, nee paadarakshalato neevèmta amdamugaa naduchu chunnaavu! nee ooruvulu shilpakaari chesina aabharana sootramulavalè aaduchunnavi.
Nee naabheedeshamu mamdalaakaara kalashamu samimalita draakshaarasamu daaniyamdu vèlitipadakumdunu gaaka nee gaatramu padmaalamkrrita godhumaraashi
Nee yiru kuchamulu jimkapillalayi taamaralo meyu òka kavalanu poli yunnavi.
Nee kamdharamu damtagopura roopamu nee netramulu janapoornamaina hèshbonu pattanamuna nunna rèmdu tataakamulato samaanamulu nee naasika damasku dikkunaku choochu lèbaanonu shikharamuto samaanamu.
Nee shirassu karmèlu parvataroopamu nee talavèmdrukalu dhoomravarnamugalavi. raaju vaati yumgaramulacheta baddhudaguchunnaadu.
Naa priyuraalaa, aanamdakaramainavaatilo neevu atisumdaramainadaanavu ati manoharamainadaanavu.
Neevu taalavrrikshamamta tinnanidaanavu nee kuchamulu gèlalavalè nunnavi.
Taalavrrikshamu nèkkudunanukòmtini daani shaakhalanu pattukòmdunanukòmtini nee kuchamulu draakshagèlalavalè nunnavi. nee shvaasavaasana jaldaruphala suvaasanavalè nunnadi.
Nee noru shreshtadraakshaarasamuvalè nunnadi aa shreshthadraakshaarasamu naa priyuniki madhura paaneeyamu adi nidritula yadharamulu aadajeyunu.
Nenu naa priyunidaananu atadu naayamdu aashaabaddhudu.
Naa priyudaa, lèmmu rammu manamu pallèlaku podamu graamaseemalo nivasimtamu.

Pèmdalakada lechi draakshavanamulaku podamu draakshaavallulu chigirimchèno ledo vaati puvvulu vikasimchèno ledo daadimachètlu pootapattèno ledo chootamu rammu achchatane naa premasoochanalu neeku choopèdanu
Putradaata vrrikshamu suvaasana nichchuchunnadi naa priyudaa, nenu neekòraku daachiyumchina naanaavidha shreshthaphalamulu pachchiviyu pamduviyu maa dvaarabamdhamulameeda vrelaaduchunnavi.
Naa talliyòdda stanyapaanamu chesina yòka sahodaruni valè neevu naayèdalanumdina nèmtamelu! appudu nenu bayata neeku èdurai muddulidudunu èvarunu nannu nimdimparu.
Nenu neeku maargadarshinaudunu naa talliyimta cherchudunu neevu naaku upadeshamu chèppuduvu sambhaara samimalita draakshaarasamunu naa daadimaphalarasamunu nenu neekittunu.
Atani yèdamachèyyi naa talakrimda nunnadi atani kudichèyyi nannu kaugilimchuchunnadi
Yèrooshalemu kumaartèlaaraa, lechutaku premaku ichchaputtuvaraku lepakayu kalataparachakayu numdumani nenu meecheta pramaanamu cheyimchukòmdunu.

Tana priyunimeeda aanukòni aranyamaargamuna vachchunadi èvatè? jaldaruvrrikshamu krimda nenu ninnu lepitini achchata nee talliki neevalana prasavavedana kaligènu ninnu kanina talli yichchatane prasavavedana padènu.

Prema maranamamta balavamtamainadi eershya paataalamamta kathoramainadi daani jvaalalu agnijvaalaa samamulu adi yèhovaa puttimchu jvaala nee hrridayamumeeda nannu naamaaksharamugaa umchumu nee bhujamunaku naamaaksharamugaa nannumchumu.
Agaadhasamudra jalamu premanu aarpajaaladu nadee pravaahamulu daani mumchiveyajaalavu premakai yòkadu tana svaasthyamamta ichchinanu tiraskaaramuto atadu trosiveyabadunu.
Maakòka chinna chèllèlu kaladu daaniki imkanu vayassu raaledu vivaahakaalamu vachchinappudu memu daanivishayamai yemi cheyudumu?
Adi praakaaramuvamtidaayènaa? memu daanipaina vèmdi gopuramòkati kattudumu. adi kavaatamuvamtidaayènaa? devadaaru mraanuto daaniki addulanu kattudumu
Nenu praakaaramuvamtidaananaitini naa kuchamulu durgamulaayènu amduvalana atanidrrishtiki nenu kshemamu nòmdadaginadaananaitini.
Bayalu haamonunamdu saalòmonu kòka draakshaavanamu kaladu atadu daanini kaapulakichchènu daani phalamulaku vachchubadigaa òkkòkkadu veyi roopaayilu tevalènu.
Naa draakshaavanamu naa vashamuna unnadi sòlòmonoo, aa veyi roopaayilu neeke chèllunu. daanini kaapucheyuvaariki rèmduvamdalu vachchunu.
Udyaanavanamulalo pèmchabadinadaanaa, nee chèlikattèlu nee svaramu vinagoruduru nannunu daani vinanimmu.
Naa priyudaa, tvarapadumu laghuvaina yirrivalè umdumu gamdhavargavrriksha parvatamulameeda gamtuluveyu ledipillavalè umdumu.
Ujjiyaa yotaamu aahaaju hijkiyaayanu yoodaaraajula dinamulalo yoodaanu goorchiyu yèrooshalemunu goorchiyu aamoju kumaarudagu yèsha yaaku kaligina darshanamu.
Yèhovaa maatalaaduchunnaadu aakaashamaa, aalakimchumu; bhoomee, chèviyòggumu. nenu pillalanu pèmchi gòppavaarinigaa chesitini vaaru naameeda tirugabadiyunnaaru.
Èddu tana kaamamdu nèrugunu gaadida sòmtavaani dòddi tèlisikònunu ishraayeluku tèliviledu naajanulu yochimparu

Paapishthi janamaa, doshabharitamaina prajalaaraa, dushtasamtaanamaa, chèrupucheyu pillalaaraa, meekushrama. vaaru yèhovaanu visarjimchi yunnaaru ishraayeluyòkka parishuddhadevuni dooshimturu aayananu vidichi tòlagipoyi yunnaaru.
Nityamu tirugubaatu cheyuchu meerela imkanu kòttabaduduru? prativaadu nadinèttini vyaadhi galigi yunnaadu prativaani gumdè balaheenamayyènu.
Arakaalu mòdalukòni talavaraku svasthata kòmchèmainanu ledu èkkada choochinanu gaayamulu dèbbalu pachchi pumdlu avi pimdabadaledu kattabadaledu tailamuto mèttana cheyabadaledu.
Mee deshamu paadaipoyènu mee pattanamulu agnicheta kaalipoyènu mee yèdutane anyulu mee bhoomini tiniveyu chunnaaru anyulaku tatasthimchu naashanamuvalè adi paadaipoyènu.
Draakshatotaloni gudisèvalènu dosapaadulaloni paakavalènu muttadi veyabadina pattanamuvalènu seeyonu kumaartè viduvabadiyunnadi.
Sainyamulakadhipatiyagu yèhovaa bahu kòddipaati sheshamu manaku nilupani yèdala manamu sòdòmavalè numdumu gòmòrraato samaana mugaa umdumu.
Sòdòma nyaayaadhipatulaaraa, yèhovaamaata aala kimchudi. gòmòrraa janulaaraa, mana devuni upadeshamunaku chèvi yòggudi.

Yèhovaa sèlavichchina maata ide vistaaramaina mee balulu naakela? dahanabalulagu paattellunu baagugaa mepina doodala kròvvunu naaku vèkkasa maayènu kodèla raktamamdainanu gòrrapillala raktamamdainanu meka potula raktamamdainanu naakishtamuledu.
Naa sannidhini kanabadavalènani meeru vachchuchunnaare naa aavaranamulanu tròkkutaku mimmunu rammanna vaadèvadu?

Keeducheyuta maanudi melucheya nerchukònudi nyaayamu jaagrattagaa vichaarimchudi, himsimchabadu vaanini vidipimchudi tamdrilenivaaniki nyaayamu teerchudi vidhavaraali paksha mugaa vaadimchudi.

Meeru sammatimchi naa maata vininayèdala meeru bhoomi yòkka mamchipadaarthamulanu anubhavimturu.
Sammatimpaka tirugabadinayèdala nishchayamugaa meeru khadgamu paalaguduru yèhovaa yeelaagunane sèlavichchiyunnaadu.
Ayyo, nammakamaina nagaramu veshya aayène! adi nyaayamuto nimdiyumdènu neeti daanilo nivasimchènu ippudaite narahamtakulu daanilo kaapuramunnaaru.
Nee vèmdi mashtaayènu, nee draakshaarasamu neellato kalisi chèdipoyènu.
Nee adhikaarulu drohulu dòmgala sahavaasulu vaaramdaru lamchamu koruduru bahumaanamulakòraku kanipèttuduru tamdrilenivaaripakshamuna nyaayamu teercharu, vidhava raamdra vyaajyèmu vichaarimcharu.

Kaavuna prabhuvunu ishraayeluyòkka balishthudunu sainyamulakadhipatiyunagu yèhovaa eelaaguna anukònuchunnaadu aahaa, naa shatruvulanugoorchi nenikanu aayaasapadanu naa virodhulameeda nenu paga teerchukòmdunu.

Amtyadinamulalo parvatamulapaina yèhovaa mamdira parvatamu parvata shikharamuna sthiraparachabadi kòmdala kamtè èttugaa èttabadunu pravaahamu vachchinatlu samasta anyajanulu daaniloniki vachchèdaru

Aa kaalamuna seeyonulonumdi dharmashaastramu yèrooshalemulonumdi yèhovaa vaakku bayalu vèllunu. janamulu gumpulu gumpulugaa vachchi yaakobu devuni mamdiramunaku yèhovaa parvata munaku manamu vèlludamu ramdi aayana tana maargamula vishayamai manaku bodhimchunu manamu aayana trovalalo nadutamu ani chèppukòmduru.

Unnataparvatamulakannitikini èttayina mètlakannitikini

Appudu narula ahamkaaramu anagadròkkabadunu manushyula garvamu taggimpabadunu aa dinamuna yèhovaamaatrame ghanata vahimchunu.
Vigrahamulu bòttigaa nashimchipovunu.
Yèhovaa bhoomini gajagaja vanakimpa lechunappudu aayana bheekara sannidhinumdiyu aayana prabhaava maahaatmyamunumdiyu manushyulu kòmdala guhalalo dooruduru nela bòriyalalo dooruduru.
Aa dinamuna yèhovaa bhoomini gajagaja vanakimpa lechunappudu aayana bheekara sannidhinumdiyu aayana prabhaava maahaatmyamunumdiyu kòmdala guhalalonu bamdabeetalalonu
Dooravalènanna aashato narulu taamu poojimchutakai cheyimchukònina vèmdi vigrahamulanu suvarna vigraha mulanu èlukalakunu gabbilamulakunu paaraveyuduru.
Tana naasikaaramdhramulalo praanamukaligina naruni lakshyapèttakumu; vaanini evishayamulo ènnika cheyavachchunu?
Aalakimchudi prabhuvunu sainyamulakadhipatiyunagu yèhovaa poshanamunu poshanaadhaaramunu annodakamula aadhaaramamtayu poshanamamtayu
Shoorulanu yodhulanu nyaayaadhipatulanu pravaktalanu
Sodèkaamdranu pèddalanu pamchaadashaadhipatulanu ghanata vahimchinavaarini mamtrulanu shilpashaastramulanu èriginavaarini maamtrikulanu yèrooshalemulonumdiyu yoodaadeshamulo numdiyu teesiveyunu.
Baalakulanu vaariki adhipatulanugaa niyamimchèdanu vaaru baalacheshtaluchesi janulanu elèdaru.
Prajalalo òkaditlunu mariyòkadatlunu prativaadu tana pòruguvaanini òttudu cheyunu. pèddavaanipaini baaludunu ghanunipaini neechudunu garvimchi tiraskaaramugaa naduchunu.
Òkadu tana tamdriyimta tana sahodaruni pattukòni neeku vastramu kaladu neevu maameeda adhipativai yumduvu ee paadusthalamu nee vashamumdanimmanunu
Atadu aa dinamuna kekavesinenu samrakshana kartanugaa umdanòllanu naayimta aahaaramemiyu ledu vastramemiyu ledu nannu janaadhipatigaa niyamimparaadanunu.
Yèrooshalemu paadaipoyènu yoodaa naashana maayènu yèhovaa mahimagala drrishtiki tirugubaatu cheyu namtagaa vaari maatalunu kriyalunu aayanaku pratikoolamugaa unnavi.
Vaari mukhalakshaname vaarimeeda saakshyamichchunu. tama paapamunu marugucheyaka sòdòmavaarivalè daani bayaluparachuduru. tamaku taame vaaru keeduchesikòni yunnaaru vaariki shrama

Vaaru nee trovala jaadanu chèripiveyuduru. yèhovaa vaadimchutaku niluvabadiyunnaadu janamulanu vimarshimchutaku lechiyunnaadu
Yèhovaa tana janula pèddalanu vaari yadhipatulanu vimarshimpa vachchuchunnaadu. meere draakshalatotanu tinivesitiri meeru dochukònina daridrula sòmmu mee yimdlalone yunnadi
Naa prajalanu nalugagòtti meeremi cheyuduru? beedala mukhamulanu noori meeremi cheyuduru? ani prabhuvunu sainyamulakadhipatiyunagu yèhovaa sèlavichchuchunnaadu.

Aa dinamuna yèhovaa chiguru mahimayu bhoosha namunagunu. ishraayelulo tappimchukòninavaariki bhoomipamta atishayaaspadamugaanu shubhalakshanamu gaanu umdunu.
Seeyonulo sheshimchinavaariki yèrooshalemulo niluvabadinavaaniki anagaa jeevamupòmdutakai yèrooshalemulo daakha laina prativaaniki parishuddhudani peru pèttuduru.

Teerputeerchu aatmavalananu dahimchu aatmavalananu prabhuvu seeyonu koomaartèlakunna kalmashamunu kadigiveyu nappudu yèrooshalemunaku tagilina raktamunu daani madhyanumdi teesivesi daani shuddhicheyunappudu
Seeyonukòmdaloni prati nivaasasthalamumeedanu daani utsava samghamulameedanu pagalu meghadhoomamulanu raatri agnijvaalaa prakaashamunu yèhovaa kalugajeyunu.

Aayana daanini baagugaa travvi raallanu eri amdulo sheshthamaina draakshateegèlanu naatimchènu daani madhyanu buruju òkati veyimchi draaksha tòttini tòlipimchènu.draakshapamdlu phalimpavalènani yèduru choochuchumdènu gaani adi kaarudraakshalu kaachènu
Kaavuna yèrooshalemu nivaasulaaraa, yoodaavaara laaraa, naa draakshatota vishayamu naaku nyaayamu teercha valènani mimmu vedukònuchunnaanu.

Aalochimchudi, nenu naa draakshatotaku cheyabovu kaaryamunu meeku tèliyajèppèdanu nenu adi mesiveyabadunatlu daani kamchènu kòtti vesèdanu. adi tròkkabadunatlu daani godanu padagòtti daani paaduchesèdanu
Adi shuddhicheyabadadu paarato travvabadadu daanilo gachchapòdalunu balurakkasi chètlunu balisi yumdunu daanimeeda varshimpavaladani meghamulaku aaj~na nichchèdanu.

Ishraayelu vamshamu sainyamulakadhipatiyagu yèhovaa draakshatota yoodaa manushyulu aayana kishtamaina vanamu. aayana nyaayamu kaavalènani choodagaa balaa tkaaramu kanabadènu neeti kaavalènani choodagaa rodanamu vinabadènu.
Sthalamu migulakumda meeru maatrame deshamulo nivasimchunatlu imtiki illu kalupukòni pòlamunaku pòlamu cherchu kònu meeku shrama.
Nenu chèvulaara vinunatlu sainyamulakadhipatiyagu yèhovaa spashtamugaa ee maata naato sèla vichchènu. nijamugaa gòppaviyu divyamainaviyunaina yimdlu anekamulu nivaasululeka paadaipovunu.
Padi èkaramula draakshatota òka kumchèdu rasa michchunu toomèdugimjala pamta òka padi yagunu.
Madyamu traagudamani vekuvane lechi draakshaarasamu tamaku mamta puttimchu varaku chaala raatrivaraku paanamucheyuvaariki shrama.
Vaaru sitaaraa svaramamdala tambura sannaayilanu vaayimchuchu draakshaarasamu traaguchu vimdu cheyudurugaani yèhovaa pani yochimparu aayana hastakrrityamulanu lakshyapèttaru.
Kaavuna naa prajalu j~naanamu lekaye chèrapattabadi povuchunnaaru vaarilo ghanulainavaaru niraahaarulugaa nunnaaru saamaanyulu dappicheta jvarapeeditulaguduru.
Amduchetane paataalamu gòppa aasha pèttukòni apari mitamugaa tana noru tèrachuchunnadi vaarilo ghanulunu saamaanyulunu ghoshacheyuvaarunu harshimchuvaarunu padipovuduru.

Keedu melaniyu melu keedaniyu chèppukòni cheekati vèluganiyu vèlugu cheekataniyu èmchukònu vaariki shrama. chedu teepi aniyu teepi chedaniyu èmchukònuvaariki shrama.

Sainyamulakadhipatiyagu yèhovaayòkka dharma shaastramunu nirlakshyapèttuduru ishraayeluyòkka parishuddhadevuni vaakkunu trrineeka rimchuduru. kaabatti agnijvaala kòyyakaalunu kaalchiveyu natlu èmdina gaddi mamtalo bhasmamagunatlu vaari veru kulli povunu vaari puvvu dhoolivalè paiki ègiripovunu.

Aadusimhamu garjimchinatlu vaaru garjimchuduru kòdamasimhamu garjimchinatlu garjanacheyuchu vetanu pattukòni addamemiyu lekumda daanini èttukòni povuduru vidipimpagalavaadèvadunu umdadu.

Raajaina ujjiyaa mrritinòmdina samvatsaramuna atyu nnatamaina simhaasanamamdu prabhuvu aaseenudaiyumdagaa nenu choochitini; aayana chòkkaayi amchulu devaalayamunu nimdukònènu.

Idi nee pèdavulaku tagilènu ganuka nee paapa munaku praayashchittamaayènu, nee doshamu tòlagi poyènu anènu.
