Naraputrudaa, samaachaara mètti pravachimpumu, prabhuvagu yèhovaa sèlavichchu nademanagaaaahaa shramadinamu vachchène, amgalaarchudi, shrama dinamu vachchène,
Yèhovaa dinamu vachchènu, adi durdinamu, anyajanulu shikshanòmdu dinamu.
Khadgamu aiguptu deshamumeeda padunu, aigupteeyulalo hatulu koolagaa kooshudeshasthulu vyaakulapaduduru, shatruvulu aiguptee yula aastini pattukòni deshapu punaadulanu padagòttu duru.
Koosheeyulunu pooteeyulunu loodeeyulunu koobeeyulunu nibamdhana deshapuvaarunu mishrita janulamda runu khadgamucheta kooluduru.
Yèhovaa sèlavichchunademanagaaaiguptunu uddharimchu vaaru kooluduru, daani balagarvamu anagipovunu, migdolu mòdalukòni sèvenevaraku janulu khadgamucheta kooluduru.
Paadaipoyina deshamula madhya aigupteeyulu dikkulenivaarugaa numduru, naludikkula paadaipoyina pattanamulamadhya vaari pattanamu lumdunu.
Aiguptudesha mulo agni ragulabètti nenu daaniki sahaayakulu lekumda cheyagaa nenu yèhovaanai yunnaanani vaaru tèlisikòmduru.

Aa dinamamdu dootalu naa yèduta numdi bayaluderi odalèkki nirvichaarulaina koosheeyulanu bhayapèttuduru, aiguptunaku vimarshakaligina dinamuna jarigi nattu vaariki bhayabhraamtulu puttunu, adigo adi vachche yunnadi.
Prabhuvaina yèhovaa sèlavichchunademanagaaaiguptee yulu cheyu allari babulonuraajaina nèbukadrèjarucheta nenu maanpimchèdanu.
Janamulalo bhayamkarulagu tana janulanu todukòni aa deshamunu layaparuchutaku atadu vachchunu, aigupteeyulanu champutakai vaaru tama khadgamu lanu òradeesi hatamaina vaarito deshamunu nimpèdaru.
Nailunadini èmdipojesi nenaa deshamunu durjanulaku amima vesèdanu, paradeshulacheta nenu aa deshamunu daanilonunna samastamunu paaducheyimchèdanu, yèhovaanaina nenu maata yichchiyunnaanu

Yèhovaa eelaagu sèla vichchuchunnaaduvigrahamulanu nirmoolamuchesi, nòpulo òka bòmmalekumda chesèdanu, ika aiguptudeshamulo adhi patigaa umduta kèvadunu lekapovunu, aiguptudeshamulo bhayamu puttimchèdanu.
Patrosunu paaduchesèdanu. soyanulo agniyumchèdanu, nolo teerpulu chesèdanu.
Aiguptunaku kotagaa nunna seenumeeda naa krodhamu kumma rimchèdanu, noloni janasamoohamunu nirmoolamu chesèdanu
Aiguptudeshamulo nenu agni yumchagaa seenu naku mèmduga nòppipattunu, nopuramu padagòttabadunu, pagativela shatruvulu vachchi nòpumeeda paduduru.

Naraputrudaa, nenu aigupturaajaina pharo baahuvunu virichitini, adi baagavutaku èvarunu daaniki kattukattaru, adi kudarchabadi khadgamu pattukònulaaguna èvarunu daaniki baddakattaru; kaavuna prabhuvaina yèhovaa sèlavichchunademanagaa
Nenu aigupturaajaina pharoku virodhinaiyunnaanu, baagugaa unna daanini virigipoyina daanini atani rèmdu chetulanu virichi, atani chetilonumdi khadgamu jaaripadajesèdanu.
​aigupteeyulanu janamulaloniki chèdaragòttudunu, aa yaa deshamulaku vaarini vèllagòttudunu.

​mariyu babulonu raajuyòkka chetulanu balaparachi naa khadgamu atani chetikichchèdanu, pharoyòkka chetulanu nenu virichinamduna babulonuraaju choochu chumdagaa pharo chaavu dèbbatinina vaadai moolgulidunu.

Babulonu raajuyòkka chetulanu balaparachi pharo chetulanu èttakumdachesi, aiguptudeshamumeeda chaaputakai nenu naa khadgamunu babulonuraaju chetikiyyagaa nenu yèhovaanaiyunnaanani aigupteeyulu tèlisikòmduru.
Nene yèhovaanai yunnaanani vaaru tèlisikònunatlu nenu aigupteeyulanu janamulaloniki chèdaragòtti aa yaa deshamulaku vaarini vèllagòttudunu.
Mariyu padakòmdava samvatsaramu moodava nèla mòdati dinamuna yèhovaa vaakku naaku pratyakshamai yeelaagu sèlavichchènu.
Naraputrudaa, neevu aiguptu raajaina pharotonu atani samoohamutonu itlanumu ghanudavaina neevu èvanito samaanudavu?
Ashshooreeyulu lèbaanonu devadaaru vrrikshamainattumdiri. daani kòmmalu shrrimgaaramulu, daani guburu vishaalamu, daanikòna bahu èttayinamduna meghamulaku amtènu.
Neellumdutavalana adi mikkili gòppadaayènu, lotaina nadi aadhaaramai namduna adi mikkili yèttugaa pèrigènu, adi yumdu chotuna aa nadi kaaluvalu paaruchu pòlamulonu chètlannitikini pravahimchènu.
Kaabatti adi èdigi pòlamu loni chètlannitikamtè èttugaladaayènu, daani shaakhalu bahu vistaaramulaayènu, neeru samrriddhigaa unnamduna daani chigullu pèddakòmmalaayènu.
Aakaashapakshulanniyu daani shaakhalalo goollukattukònènu, bhoojamtuvulanniyu daani kòmmalakrimda pillalu pèttènu, daani needanu sakalamaina gòppa janamulu nivasimchènu.
Eelaaguna adi pòdugaina kòmmalu kaligi daaniveru vistaara jalamunna chota paarutavalana adi mikkili gòppadai kamtiki amda maina daayènu.

​devuni vanamulonunna devadaaru vrriksha mulu daani marugu cheyalekapoyènu, saralavrrikshamulu daani shaakhalamta gòppavikaavu akshota vrrikshamulu daani kòmmalamta gòppavikaavu, daanikunna shrrimgaaramu devuni vanamulonunna vrrikshamulalo denikini ledu.
Vistaara maina kòmmalato nenu daanini shrrimgaarimchinamduna devuni vanamaina edènulonunna vrrikshamulanniyu daani sògasu choochi daaniyamdu asooyapadènu.
Kaavuna prabhuvaina yèhovaa ee maata sèlavichchu chunnaadunee yèttunubatti neevu atishayapaditivi, tana kòna meghamulakamtajesi tana yèttunubatti atadu garvim chènu.
​kaabatti yatani dushtatvamunubatti yata nini tarimi vesi, janamulalo balamugala janamunaku nenatani nappagimchè danu; aa janamu ataniki taginapani cheyunu.

​janamulalo kroorulaina paradeshulu atanini nariki paaravesiri, kòmdala lonu loyalannitilonu atani kòmmalu padènu, bhoomi yamdunna vaagulalo atani shaakhalu virigi padènu, bhoojanulamdarunu atani needanu vidichi atanini padiyumda nichchiri.
​padipoyina atani modumeeda aakaashapakshu lanniyu digi vraalunu, atani kòmmalameeda bhoojamtuvu lanniyu padunu.

Neerunnachotuna nunna vrrikshamu lannitilo ediyu tana yèttunubatti atishayapadi, tana kònanu meghamula kamtajesi, ye vrrikshamugaani daani yèttunubatti garvimpakumdunatlu, krimdilokamunakupovu narula yòddaku diguvaaritokooda maranamu paalairi.

Prabhuvaina yèhovaa sèlavichchunademanagaa atadu paataalamuloniki poyina dinamuna nenu amgalaarpu kalugajesitini, agaadhajalamulu atani kappajesitini, aneka jalamulanu aapi ataninibatti nenu vaati pravaahamulanu bamdhimchitini, atanikòraku nenu lèbaanonu parvatamunu gaadhaamdhakaaramu kammajesitini, phalavrrikshamulanniyu atanigoorchi vyaakulapadènu, paataalamuloniki nenatani dimpagaa gotiloniki povuvaariyòddaku atani pada veyagaa
Atani paatu dhvanicheta janamulanu vanakajesi tini, neeru peelchu lèbaanonu shreshthavrrikshamulanniyu edènu vrrikshamulanniyu paataalamulo tammunu taamu odaarchukòniri.

Naraputrudaa, aigupturaajaina pharonugoorchi amgalaarpu vachanamètti ataniki ee maata prakatimpumujanamulalo kòdama simhamuvamtivaada vani neevu èmchabaditivi, jalamulalo mòsalivamtivaadavai nee nadulalo reguchu nee kaallato neellu kaliyabèttitivi, vaati vaagulanu buradagaa chesitivi.
Prabhuvaina yèhovaa sèlavichchunademanagaa gumpulu gumpulugaa janamulanu samakoorchi nenu naa valanu neemeeda veyagaa vaaru naa valalo chikkina ninnu bayatiki laagèdaru.
Nenu ninnu nela padavesi tèrapanelameeda paaravesèdanu, aakaashapakshulanniyu neemeeda vraalunatluchesi neevalana bhoojamtuvulannitini kadupaara tinanichchèdanu,
​nee maamsa munu parvatamulameeda vesèdanu, loyalannitini nee kale baramulato nimpèdanu.
Mariyu bhoomini nee raktadhaara cheta parvatamulavaraku nenu tadupudunu, loyalu neeto nimpabadunu.
​nenu ninnu aarpivesi aakaashamamdalamunu marugu chesèdanu, nakshatramulanu cheekati kammajesèdanu, sooryuni mabbucheta kappèdanu, chamdrudu vènnèla kaayakapovunu.
Ninnubatti aakaashamamdu prakaashimchu jyotula kannitikini amdhakaaramu kammajesèdanu, nee deshamu meeda gaadhaamdhakaaramu vyaapimpajesèdanu; ide prabhuvagu yèhovaa vaakku.
Neevu èrugani deshamulaloniki nenu ninnu vèllagòtti, janamulalo neeku samooladhvamsamu kalugajesi bahu janamulaku kopamu puttimtunu,

Naa khadgamunu nenu vaarimeeda jhalipimchèdanu, ninnubatti chaalamamdi janulu kalavarimchuduru, vaari raajulunu ninnubatti bheetulaguduru, neevu koolu dinamuna vaaramdarunu èdatègaka praanabhayamucheta vanakuduru.
Prabhuvaina yèhovaa sèlavichchunademanagaababulonuraaju khadgamu neemeediki vachchunu,
Shoorula khadgamulacheta nenu nee sainya munu koolchèdanu, vaaramdarunu janamulalo bhayamkarulu; aigupteeyula garvamu nanachiveyagaa daani sainya mamtayu layamagunu.
Mariyu gòppapravaahamula darinunna pashuvulanannitini nenu layaparachèdanu, naruni kaalainanu pashuvukaalainanu vaatini kadalimpakayumdunu.
Appudu nenu vaati neellu tònakakumdajesi tailamu paarunatlu vaari nadulanu paarajesèdanu; ide prabhuvagu yèhovaa vaakku.
Nenu aiguptu deshamunu paadu chesi amduloni samastamunu naashanamu chesi daani nivaasulanamdarini nirmoolamucheyagaa nenu yèhovaanai yunnaanani vaaru tèlisikòmduru.

Idi amgalaarpu vachanamu, vaaru daanini yètti paaduduru, anyajanula kumaartèlu daanini yètti paaduduru; aiguptunu goorchiyu amduloni samoohamunu goorchiyu aa vachanamètti vaaru paaduduru; ide prabhuvagu yèhovaa vaakku.
Pamdrèmdava samvatsaramu nèla padunaidava dinamuna yèhovaa vaakku naaku pratyakshamai yeelaagu sèla vichchènu

Naraputrudaa, allaricheyu aigupteeyula samoohamunugoorchi amgalaarchumu, prasiddhinòmdina jana mula kumaarttèlu bhoomikrimdiki digipoyinatlu bhoomi krimdikini paataalamunaku poyina vaari yòddakunu vaarini padaveyumu.
Saumdaryamamdu neevu èvanini mimchina vaadavu?digi sunnati nòmdani vaariyòdda padiyumdumu.
Khadgamucheta hatamaina vaarimadhya vaaru kooluduru, adi kattipaalagunu, daanini daani janulanu laagi padaveyudi.
Vaaru digipoyire, sunnatinòmdani veeru khadgamucheta hatamai akkada padiyumdire, ani yamduru; paataala mulonunna paraakramashaaluralo balaadhyulu daani goorchiyu daani sahaayulanugoorchiyu amduru.
Ashshoorunu daani samoohamamtayu achchatanunnavi, daani chuttunu vaari samaadhulunnavi, vaaramdaru kattipaalai chachchi yunnaaru.
Daani samaadhulu paataalaagaadhamulo niyamimpabadinavi, daani samoohamu daani samaadhichuttu nunnadi, vaaramdaru sajeevula lokamulo bhayamkarulaina vaaru, vaaru kattipaalai chachchipadiyumdiri.

Akkada elaamunu daani samoohamunu samaadhichuttu nunnavi; amdarunu kattipaalai chachchiri; vaaru sajeevulalokamulo bhayamkarulainavaaru, vaaru sunnatilenivaarai paataalamuloniki digipoyiri, gotiloniki digipoyinavaarito kooda vaaru avamaanamu nòmduduru.

Hatulaina vaarimadhya daanikini daani samoohamunakunu padakayòkati erpadènu, daani samaadhulu daanichuttu nunnavi; vaaramdarunu sunnati lenivaarai hatulairi; vaaru sajeevulalokamulo bhayam karulu ganuka gotiloniki digipoyinavaarito kooda vaarunu avamaanamu nòmduduru, hatulaina vaarimadhya adi yumchabadunu.

Akkada mèshèkunu tubaalunu daani samoohamunu unnavi; daani samaadhulu daani chuttununnavi. vaaramdaru sunnatilenivaaru, sajeevula lokamulo vaaru bhayamkarulairi ganuka vaaru kattipaalairi, aayudhamulanu chetapattukòni paataalamuloniki digi poyiri.

Ayite veeru sunnatileni vaarilo padipoyina shooruladaggara pamdukònaru; vaaru tama yudhdaayudhamu lanu chetapattukòni paataalamuloniki digipoyi, tama khadgamulanu talala krimda umchukòni pamdukòmduru; veeru sajeevula lokamulo bhayamkarulairi ganuka vaari doshamu vaari yèmukalaku tagilènu.
​neevu sunnatilenivaari madhya naashanamai kattipaalainavaariyòdda pamdukòmduvu.

Akkada èdomunu daani raajulunu daani adhipatu lamdarunu unnaaru; vaaru paraakramavamtulainanu katti paalaina vaariyòdda umchabadiri; sunnatileni vaariyòddanu paataalamuloniki digipoyinavaariyòddanu vaarunu pamdu kòniri.

Akkada uttaradeshapu adhipatulamdurunu seedo neeyulamdarunu hatamaina vaarito digipoyiyunnaaru; vaaru paraakramavamtulai bhayamu puttimchinanu avamaanamu nòmdiyunnaaru; sunnati lenivaarai kattipaalaina vaarimadhya pamdukòniyunnaaru; gotiloniki digipoyina vaaritopaatu vaarunu avamaanamu nòmduduru.
Kattipaalaina pharoyu atanivaaramdarunu vaarinichoochi tama samoohamamtatinigoorchi odaarpu tèchchukòmduru; ide prabhuvagu yèhovaa vaakku.
Sajeevula lokamulo atanicheta bhayamu puttimchitini ganuka pharoyu atani vaaramdarunu kattipaalainavaariyòdda sunnatilenivaarito kooda pamdukòmduru, ide prabhuvagu yèhovaa vaakku.
Mariyu yèhovaa vaakku naaku pratyakshamai yeelaagu sèlavichchènu.
Naraputrudaa, neevu nee janulaku samaachaaramu prakatimchi vaarito itlanumunenu òkaanòka deshamumeediki khadgamunu rappimpagaa aa janulu tamalo òkanini erparachukòni kaavaligaa nirnayimchina yèdala
Atadu deshamumeediki khadgamu vachchuta choochi, baakaa oodi janulanu hèchcharika chesina samayamuna
Èvadainanu baakaanaadamu viniyunu jaagrattapadanamduna khadgamuvachchi vaani praanamu teesinayèdala vaadu tana praanamunaku taane uttaravaadi
Baakaanaadamu vini yunu vaadu jaagrattapadakapoyènu ganuka tana praana munaku taane uttaravaadi; elayanagaa vaadujaagrattapadina yèdala tanapraanamunu rakshimchukònunu.

Ayite kaavali vaadu khadgamu vachchuta choochiyu, baakaa oodanamdu cheta janulu ajaagrattagaa umdutayu, khadgamu vachchi vaarilo òkani praanamu teeyutayu tatasthimchina yèdala vaadu tana doshamunu batti pattabadinanu, nenu kaavalivaaniyòdda vaani praanamunugoorchi vichaaranacheyu dunu.
Naraputrudaa, nenu ninnu ishraayeleeyulaku kaavalivaanigaa niyamimchiyunnaanu ganuka neevu naa notimaatanu vini naaku pratigaa vaarini hèchcharika cheyavalènu.

Meeru upavaasamu cheyunappudu veshadhaarulavalè duhkhamukhulai yumdakudi; taamu upavaasamu cheyu chunnattu manushyulaku kanabadavalènani vaaru tama mukhamu lanu vikaaramu chesikòmduru; vaaru tama phalamu pòmdi yunnaarani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Upavaasamu cheyuchunnattu manushyulaku kanabadavalènani kaaka, rahasyamamdunna nee tamdrike kanabadavalènani, neevu upavaasamu cheyunappudu nee tala amtukòni, nee mukhamu kadugukònumu.
Appudu rahasyamamdu choochuchunna nee tamdri neeku pratiphalamichchunu.
Bhoomimeeda meekòraku dhanamunu koorchukònavaddu; ikkada chimmètayu, tuppunu tiniveyunu, dòmgalu kannamuvesi dòmgilèdaru.
Paralokamamdu meekòraku dhanamunu koorchukònudi; achchata chimmètayainanu, tuppai nanu daani tiniveyadu, dòmgalu kannamuvesi dòmgilaru.
Nee dhanamèkkada numduno akkadane nee hrridayamu umdunu.
Dehamunaku deepamu kanne ganuka nee kannu tetagaa umdinayèdala nee dehamamtayu vèlugu mayamaiyumdunu.
Nee kannu chèdinadaite nee deha mamtayu cheekatimayamai yumdunu; neelonunna vèlugu cheekatiyai yumdina yèdala aa cheekati yèmto gòppadi.

Èvadunu iddaru yajamaanulaku daasudugaa numdaneradu; atadu òkani dveshimchiyòkani premimchunu; ledaa yòkani paksha mugaanumdi yòkani trrineekarimchunu. meeru devunikini sirikini daasulugaa numdaneraru.
Amduvalana nenu meeto chèppunademanagaaemi timdumo yemi traagu dumo ani mee praanamunu goorchiyainanu, emi dharimchukòmdumo ani mee dehamunu goorchiyainanu chimtimpakudi;
Aakaashapakshulanu choodudi; avi vittavu koyavu kòtlalo koorchukònavu; ayinanu mee paralokapu tamdri vaatini poshimchu chunnaadu; meeru vaatikamtè bahu shreshtulu kaaraa?
Meelo nèvadu chimtimchutavalana tana yèttu moorèdèkkuva chesikònagaladu?

Ayinanu tana samasta vaibhavamuto koodina sòlòmonu sahitamu veetilo nòkadaanivalènainanu alamkarimpabadaledu.
Nedumdi repu pòyilo veyabadu adavi gaddini devudeelaagu alamka rimchinayèdala, alpavishvaasulaaraa, meeku mari nishchaya mugaa vastramulu dharimpajeyunu gadaa.
Kaabatti emi timdumo yemi traagudumo yemi dharimchu kòmdumo ani chimtimpakudi; anyajanulu veetanniti vishayamai vichaarimturu.
Ivanniyu meeku kaavalènani mee paralokapu tamdriki tèliyunu.

Nee kamtilonunna doolamu nèmchaka nee sahodaruni kamtilonunna nalusunu choochuta yela?
Nee kamtilo doolamumdagaa, neevu nee sahodaruni choochineekamtilo nunna nalusunu teesi veyanimmani chèppa nela?
Veshadhaaree, mòdata nee kamtilo nunna doolamunu teesivesikònumu, appudu nee sahodaruni kamtilonunna nalusunu teesiveyutaku neeku tetagaa kana badunu.
Parishuddhamainadi kukkalaku pèttakudi, mee mutyamulanu pamdulayèduta veyakudi; vesinayèdala avi yòkavela vaatini kaallato tròkki meemeeda padi mimmunu cheelchi veyunu.

Adugu prativaadunu pòmdunu, vèdakuvaaniki dòrakunu, tattuvaaniki teeya badunu.
Meelo e manushyudainanu tana kumaarudu tannu ròttènu adiginayèdala vaaniki raatinichchunaa? chepanu adiginayèdala paamunichchunaa?
Meeru chèdda vaarai yumdiyu mee pillalaku mamchi yeevula niyya nèrigi yumdagaa
Paralokamamdunna mee tamdri tannu aduguvaariki amtakamtè èmto nishchayamugaa mamchi yeevula nichchunu.

Vaari phalamulavalana meeru vaarini tèlisikòmduru. mumdlapòdalalo draaksha pamdlanainanu, palleruchètlanu amjoorapu pamdlanainanu koyu duraa?

Prabhuvaa, prabhuvaa, ani nannu piluchu prativaadunu paralokaraajyamulo praveshimpadugaani paralokamamdunna naa tamdri chittaprakaaramu cheyuvaade praveshimchunu.

Aa dinamamdu anekulu nannu choochiprabhuvaa, prabhuvaa, memu nee naamamuna pravachimpaledaa? nee naamamuna dayyamulanu vèllagòttaledaa? nee naamamuna anekamaina adbhutamulu cheyaledaa? ani chèppuduru.
Appudu nenu mimmunu ènnadunu èruganu, akramamu cheyu vaaralaaraa, naayòddanumdi pòmdani vaarito chèppudunu.
Kaabatti yee naa maatalu vini vaatichòppuna cheyu prativaadunu bamdameeda tana yillu kattukònina buddhi mamtuni poliyumdunu.
Vaana kurisènu, varadalu vachchènu, gaali visiri aa yimtimeeda kòttènu gaani daani punaadi bamdameeda veyabadènu ganuka adi padaledu.

Vaana kurisènu, varadalu vachchènu, gaali visiri aa yimtimeeda kòttènu, appudadi koola badènu; daani paatu gòppadani chèppènu.
Yesu ee maatalu chèppi mugimchinappudu janasamooha mulu aayana bodhaku aashcharyapaduchumdiri.

Ganuka tana kotaku panivaarini pampumani kota yajamaanuni vedu kònudani tana shishyulato chèppènu.
Aayana tana pamdrèmdumamdi shishyulanu pilichi, apavitraatmalanu vèllagòttutakunu, pratividhamaina roga munu pratividhamaina vyaadhini svasthaparachutakunu, vaariki adhikaara michchènu.
Aa pamdrèmdumamdi apòstalula perlu evanagaa, mòdata peturanabadina seemonu, atani sahodarudagu amdrèya; jèbèdayi kumaarudagu yaakobu, atani sahodarudagu yohaanu;
Philippu, bartòlòmayi; tomaa, sumkariyaina mattayi, alphayi kumaarudagu yaakobu, taddayiyanu maaruperugala lèbbayi;
Kanaa neeyudaina seemonu, aayananu appagimchina iskariyotu yoodaa.
Yesu aa pamdrèmdumamdini pampuchu, vaarinichoochi vaarikaaj~naapimchinademanagaameeru anyajanula daariloniki vèllakudi, samarayula ye pattanamulonainanu praveshimpa kudi gaani
Ishraayelu vamshamuloni nashimchina gòrrala yòddake vèlludi.
Vèlluchuparalokaraajyamu sameepimchi yunnadani prakatimchudi.
Rogulanu svasthaparachudi, chanipoyinavaarini lepudi, kushtharogulanu shuddhulanugaa cheyudi, dayyamulanu vèllagòttudi. uchitamugaa pòmditiri uchitamugaa iyyudi.
Mee samchulalo bamgaaramunainanu vèmdinainanu raaginainanu prayaanamu kòraku jaalènainanu rèmdu amgeelanainanu chèppulanainanu chetikarranainanu siddhaparachukònakudi;
Panivaadu tana aahaara munaku paatrudu kaadaa?
Mariyu meeru epatta namulo nainanu graamamulonainanu praveshimchunappudu, amdulo èvadu yogyudo vichaaranachesi, akkadanumdi vèlluvaraku atani yimtane basacheyudi.
Aa yimtilo praveshimchuchu, imtivaariki shubhamani chèppudi.
Aa yillu yogyamainadaite mee samaadhaanamu daanimeediki vachchunu; adi ayogyamainadaite mee samaadhaanamu meeku tirigi vachchunu.
Èvadainanu mimmunu cherchu kònaka mee maatalu vinakumdina yèdala meeru aa yimtinainanu aa pattanamainanu vidichipovunappudu mee paadadhooli dulipiveyudi.
Vimarshadinamamdu aa patta napu gatikamtè sòdòma gòmòrraa pradeshamula gati orvataginadai yumdunani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppu chunnaanu.
Idigo todellamadhyaku gòrralanu pampinattu nenu mimmunu pampuchunnaanu ganuka paamulavalè vivekulunu paavuramulavalè nishkapatulunai yumdudi.
Manushyu lanugoorchi jaagrattapadudi; vaaru mimmunu mahaasabhalaku appagimchi, tama samaajamamdiramulalo mimmunu kòradaa lato kòttimturu,
Veerikini anyajanulakunu saakshyaarthamai naanimittamu meeru adhipatulayòddakunu raajulayòddakunu tebaduduru.
Vaaru mimmunu appagimchunappudu, elaagu maataadudumu? emi chèppudumu? ani chimtimpa kudi; meeremi chèppavalèno adi aa gadiyalone meekanu grahimpabadunu.
Mee tamdri aatma meelo umdi maatalaaduchunnaade gaani maatalaaduvaaru meeru kaaru.
Sahodarudu sahodaruni, tamdri kumaaruni, maranamunaku appagimchèdaru; pillalu talidamdrulameeda lechi vaarini champimchèdaru.
Meeru naa naamamu nimittamu amdaricheta dveshimpabaduduru; amtamuvarakunu sahimchina vaadu rakshampabadunu.

Vaaru ee pattanamulo mimmunu himsimchunappudu mariyòka pattanamunaku paaripovudi; manushyakumaarudu vachchuvaraku meeru ishraayelu pattana mulalo samchaaramu chesiyumdarani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppu chunnaanu.
Shishyudu bodhakunikamtè adhikudu kaadu; daasudu yajamaanunikamtè adhikudu kaadu.

Shishyudu tana bodhakunivalènu daasudu tana yajamaanunivalènu umdina chaalunu. imti yajamaanuniki bayèljèboolani vaaru perupètti yumdinayèdala aayana yimtivaariki mari nishcha yamugaa aa peru pèttuduru gadaa.
Kaabatti meeru vaariki bhayapadakudi, marugainadediyu bayaluparacha badakapodu, rahasyamainadediyu tèliyabadakapodu.
Cheekatilo nenu meeto chèppunadi meeru vèlugulo chèppudi; chèvilo meeku chèppabadinadi medalameeda praka timchudi.
Mariyu aatmanu champaneraka dehamune champuvaariki bhayapadakudi gaani, aatmanu dehamunukooda narakamulo nashimpajeyagalavaaniki mikkili bhayapadudi.
Rèmdu pichchukalu kaasuku ammabadunu gadaa; ayinanu mee tamdri sèlavuleka vaatilo òkatainanu nelanu padadu.
Mee talavèmdrukalanniyu lèkkimpabadiyunnavi
Ganuka meeru bhayapadakudi; meeranekamaina pichchukalakamtè shreshthulu.
Manushyulayèduta nannu òppukònuvaadèvado paralokamamdunna naa tamdri yèduta nenunu vaanini òppukòmdunu.
Manushyula yèduta èvadu nannu èrugananuno vaanini paraloka mamdunna naa tamdriyèduta nenunu èruganamdunu.
Nenu bhoomimeediki samaadhaanamunu pampavachchitinani talamchakudi; khadgamune gaani samaadhaanamunu pamputaku nenu raaledu.
Òka manushyunikini vaani tamdrikini, kumaartèkunu aamè tallikini, kodalikini aamè attakunu virodhamu pèttavachchitini.
​òka manushyuni yimtivaare ataniki shatruvulaguduru.
Tamdrinainanu tallinainanu naa kamtè èkkuvagaa premimchuvaadu naaku paatrudukaadu; kumaaruninainanu kumaartènainanu naakamtè èkku vagaa premimchuvaadu naaku paatrudu kaadu;
Tana siluvanu èttikòni nannu vèmbadimpanivaadu naaku paatrudu kaadu.
Tana praanamu dakkimchukònuvaadu daani pogòttukònunu gaani naa nimittamu tana praanamu pogòttukònuvaadu daani dakkimchukònunu.
Mimmunu cherchukònuvaadu nannu cherchukònunu; nannu cherchukònuvaadu nannu pampinavaani cherchukònunu.
Pravakta ani pravaktanu cherchukònuvaadu pravaktaphalamu pòmdunu; neetimamtudani neetimamtuni cherchukònuvaadu neetimamtuni phalamu pòmdunu.
Mariyu shishyudani yèvadu ee chinnavaarilo òkaniki ginnèdu channeellu maatramu traaganichchuno vaadu tana phalamu pogòttu kònadani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Yesu tana pamdrèmdumamdi shishyulaku aaj~naapimchuta.... . chaalimchina taruvaata vaari pattanamulalo bodhimchutakunu prakatimchutakunu akkadanumdi vèllipoyènu.
Kreestu cheyuchunna kaaryamulanu goorchi yohaanu chèrasaalalo viniraabovu vaadavu neevenaa, memu mari yòkanikòraku kanipèttavalènaa?
Ani aayananu adugu taku tana shishyulanampènu.
Yesu vaarini choochi meeru vèlli, vinnavaatini kannavaatini yohaanuku tèlu pudi.

Gruddivaaru choopupòmduchunnaaru, kumtivaaru naduchuchunnaaru, kushtharogulu shuddhulaguchunnaaru, chèviti vaaru vinuchunnaaru, chanipoyinavaaru lepabaduchunnaaru, beedalaku suvaarta prakatimpabaduchunnadi.
Mariyu naa vishayamai abhyamtarapadanivaadu dhanyudani yuttara michchènu.
Vaaru vèllipovuchumdagaa yesu yohaa nunugoorchi janasamoohamulato eelaagu chèppasaagènu meeremi choochutaku aranyamuloniki vèllitiri? gaaliki kadalu chunna rèllunaa? mari emi chooda vèllitiri?
​sannapu battalu dharimchukònna manushyunaa? idigosannapu battalu dharimchukònuvaaru raajagrrihamulalo numduru gadaa.
Mari emi chooda vèllitiri? pravaktanaa? avunugaani pravaktakamtè gòppavaaninani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Idigo nenu naa dootanu neeku mumdugaa pampuchunnaanu, atadu nee mumdara nee maargamunu siddha parachunu.
Streelu kaninavaarilo baaptismamichchu yohaanukamtè gòppavaadu puttaledani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppu chunnaanu. ayinanu paralokaraajyamulo alpudaina vaadu atanikamtè gòppavaadu.
Baaptismamichchu yohaanu dinamulu mòdalukòni yippati varaku paralokaraajyamu balaatkaaramugaa pattabaduchunnadi, balaatkaarulu daani naakramimchukònuchunnaaru.
Yohaanu kaalamu varaku pravaktalamdarunu pravachimchuchuvachchiri; dharmashaastramu sahaa pravachimchuchunum dènu.
Ee samgati namgeekarimchutaku meeku manassumte raabovu eleeyaa yitade.
Vinu taku chèvulugalavaadu vinugaaka.
Ee taramuvaarini denito polchudunu? samta veedhulalo koorchuniyumdi
Meeku pillanagrovi ooditiviugaani meeru naatyamaadaraitiri; pralaapimchitiviu gaani meeru ròmmukòttukònaraitirani tama chèlikaamdrato chèppi pilupulaatalaadukònu pilla kaayalanu poliyunnaaru.
Yohaanu tinakayu traagakayuvachchènu. ganukaveedu dayyamupattina vaadani vaaranuchunnaaru.

Manushyakumaarudu tinuchunu traagu chunu vachchènu ganukaidigo veedu timdibotunu madya paaniyu sumkarulakunu paapulakunu snehitudunani vaaranuchunnaaru. ayinanu j~naanamu j~naanamani daani kriyalanubatti1 teerpupòmdunanènu.
Pimmata e ye pattanamulalo aayana vistaaramaina adbhutamulu chesèno aa pattanamulavaaru maarumanassu pòmdakapovutavalana aayana vaari nitlu gaddimpasaagènu.
Ayyo kòraajeenaa, ayyo betsayidaa, mee madhyanu cheyabadina adbhutamulu tooru seedonupattanamulalo cheyabadina yèdala aa pattanamulavaaru poorvame gonè patta kattukòni boodidè vesikòni maaru
Vimarshadinamamdu mee gatikamtè tooru seedonu pattanamulavaari gati orvataginadai yumdunani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Kapèrnahoomaa, aakaashamu mattunaku hèchchimpabadèdavaa? neevu paataalamuvaraku digi poyèdavu. neelo cheyabadina adbhutamulu sòdò malo cheyabadina yèdala adi netivaraku nilichiyumdunu.
Vimarshadinamamdu nee gatikamtè sòdòma deshapuvaari gati orvataginadai yumdunani meeto chèppuchunnaananènu.

Aa samayamuna yesu chèppinademanagaatamdree, aakaashamunakunu bhoomikini prabhuvaa, neevu j~naanulakunu vivekulakunu ee samgatulanu maruguchesi pasibaaluraku bayaluparachinaavani ninnu stutimchuchunnaanu.
Avunu tamdree, eelaagu cheyuta nee drrishtiki anukoolamaayènu.

Samastamunu naa tamdricheta naa kappagimpabadi yunnadi. tamdrigaaka yèvadunu kumaaruni èrugadu; kumaarudu gaakanu, kumaaru dèvaniki aayananu bayaluparacha nuddeshim chuno vaadu gaakanu mari èvadunu tamdrini èrugadu.
Prayaasapadi bhaaramu mosikònuchunna samasta janu laaraa, naa yòddaku ramdi; nenu meeku vishraamti kaluga jetunu.
Nenu saatvikudanu deenamanassu galavaadanu ganuka meemeeda naa kaadi èttikòni naayòdda nerchu kònudi; appudu mee praanamulaku vishraamti dòrakunu.
Elayanagaa naa kaadi suluvugaanu naa bhaaramu telika gaanu unnavi.
Aa kaalamamdu yesu vishraamtidinamuna pamtachelalo padi vèlluchumdagaa aayana shishyulu aakaligòni vènnulu trumchi tinasaagiri.
Parisayyuladichoochi idigo, vishraamtidinamuna cheyakoodanidi nee shishyulu cheyuchunnaarani aayanato chèppagaa
Aayana vaarito itlanènutaanunu tanato kooda nunnavaarunu aakaligòni yumdagaa daaveedu chesina daanigoorchi meeru chaduva ledaa?
Atadu devuni mamdiramulo praveshimchi, yaajakule tappa taanainanu tanato kooda unnavaarainanu tinakoodani samukhapu ròttèlu tinènu.
Mariyu yaaja kulu vishraamtidinamuna devaalayamulo vishraamtidina munu ullamghimchiyu nirdoshulai yunnaarani meeru dharmashaastramamdu chaduvaledaa?
Devaalayamukamtè gòppa vaadikkada nunnaadani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Mariyukanikaramune koruchunnaanu gaani balini nenu koranu anu vaakyabhaavamu meeku tèlisiyumte nirdoshulanu doshulani teerpu teerchakapoduru.
Kaagaa manushya kumaarudu vishraamti dinamunaku prabhuvaiyunnaadanènu.
Aayana akkadanumdi vèlli vaari samaajamamdiramulo praveshimchinappudu, idigo oochachèyyi galavaadòkadu kanabadènu.
Vaaraayanameeda neramu mopavalènanivishraamtidinamuna svasthaparachuta nyaayamaa? ani aayananu adigiri.
Amdukaayanameelo e manushyunikainanu nòka gòrrayumdi adi vishraamtidinamuna gumtalo padinayèdala daani pattukòni paiki teeyadaa?
Gòrra kamtè manushyudèmto shreshthudu; kaabatti vishraamti dinamuna melucheyuta dharmame ani chèppi
Aa manushyu nitonee chèyyi chaapumanènu. vaadu chèyyi chaapagaa rèmdavadaanivalè adi baagupadènu.
Amtata parisayyulu vèlupaliki poyi, aayananu elaagu samharimtumaa ani aayanaku virodhamugaa aalochana chesiri.
Yesu aa samgati tèlisikòni achchatanumdi vèllipoyènu. bahu janulaayananu vèmbadimpagaa
Aayana vaarinamdarini svastha parachi, tannu prasiddhicheyavaddani vaariki aaj~naapimchènu.
Pravaktayaina yèshayaadvaaraa chèppinadi nèraverunatlu (aalaagu jarigènu) ademanagaa
Idigo eeyana naa sevakudu eeyananu nenu erparachukòmtini eeyana naa praanamuna kishtudaina naa priyudu eeyanameeda naa aatma numchèdanu eeyana anyajanulaku nyaayavidhini prachuramu cheyunu.
Eeyana jagadamaadadu, kekaluveyadu veedhulalo eeyana shabdamèvanikini vinabadadu
Vijayamòmdutaku nyaayavidhini prabalamu cheyuvaraku eeyana naligina rèllunu viruvadu makamakalaaduchunna avisènaaranu aarpadu
Eeyana naamamamdu anyajanulu nireekshimchèdaru anu
Appudu dayyamupattina gruddivaadunu moogavaadunaina yòkadu aayanayòddaku tebadènu. aayana vaanini svastha parachinamduna aa moogavaadu maatalaadu shaktiyu choopunu galavaadaayènu.
Amduku prajalamdaru vismayamòmdi eeyana daaveedu kumaarudu kaadaa, ani chèppukònu chumdiri.
Parisayyulu aa maata viniveedu dayya mulaku adhipatiyaina bayèljèbooluvalanane dayyamulanu vèllagòttuchunnaadu gaani mariyòkanivalana kaadaniri.
Aayana vaari talampula nèrigi vaarito itlanènutanaku taane virodhamugaa verupadina prati raajyamu paadai povunu. tanakutaane virodhamugaa verupadina ye pattana mainanu e yillayinanu niluvadu.
Saataanu saataanunu vèllagòttinayèdala tanakutaane virodhamugaa verupadunu; atlayite vaani raajyamelaagu niluchunu?
Nenu bayèljèbooluvalana dayyamulanu vèllagòttuchunna yèdala mee kumaarulu èvarivalana vaatini vèllagòttu chunnaaru? kaabatti vaare meeku teerparulaiyumduru.
Devuni aatmavalana nenu dayyamulanu vèllagòttuchunna yèdala nishchayamugaa devuni raajyamu mee yòddaku vachchi yunnadi.
Òkadu mòdata balavamtuni bamdhimpani yèdala yelaagu aa balavamtuni yimtilo chòchchi atani saamagri dochukònagaladu? atlu bamdhimchinayèdala vaani yillu dochukònunu.
Naa pakshamuna numdanivaadu naaku virodhi; naato kalisi samakoorchanivaadu chèdara gòttuvaadu.
Kaabatti nenu meeto chèppunademanagaamanushyulucheyu prati paapamunu dooshanayu vaariki kshamimpabadunu gaani aatma vishayamaina dooshanaku paapa kshamaapana ledu.
Manushyakumaaruniki virodhamugaa maatalaaduvaaniki paapakshamaapana kaladugaani parishuddhaatmaku virodhamugaa maatalaaduvaaniki ee yugamamdainanu raabovu yugamamdainanu paapakshamaapana ledu.
Chèttu mamchidani yèmchi daani pamdunu mamchide ani yèmchudi; ledaa, chèttu chèddadani yèmchi daani pamdunu chèddade ani yèmchudi. chèttu daani pamduvalana tèliyabadunu.
Sarpasamtaanamaa, meeru chèddavaaraiyumdi elaagu mamchi maatalu palukagalaru? hrridayamamdu nimdiyumdu daaninibatti noru maatalaadunu gadaa.
Sajjanudu tana mamchi dhananidhilo numdi sadvishayamulanu tèchchunu; durjanudu tana chèdda dhananidhilonumdi durvishayamulanu tèchchunu.
Nenu meeto chèppunademanagaa manushyulu paluku vyarthamaina prati maatanugoorchiyu vimarshadinamuna lèkka chèppavalasiyumdunu.
Nee maatalanubatti neeti mamtudavani teerpunòmduduvu, nee maatalanubattiye apa raadhivani teerpunòmduduvu.
Appudu shaastrulalonu parisayyulalonu kòmdarubodhakudaa, neevalana òka soochakakriya choodagoru chunnaamani aayanato chèppagaa aayana itlanènu.
Vyabhichaarulaina chèdda taramuvaaru soochaka kriyanu adugu chunnaaru. pravaktayaina yonaanugoorchina soochaka kriyaye gaani mari e soochaka kriyayainanu vaariki anugrahimpabadadu.
Yonaa moodu raatrimbagallu tiviumgilamu kadupulo elaagumdèno aalaagu manushya kumaarudu moodu raatrimbagallu bhoogarbamulo umdunu.

Neenèvèvaaru yonaa prakatana vini maaru manassu pòmdiri ganuka vimarsha samayamuna neenèvèvaaru ee taramuvaarito niluvabadi vaarimeeda nerasthaapana cheturu. idigo yonaakamtè gòppavaadu ikkada unnaadu.

Vimarsha samayamuna dakshinadeshapuraani yee taramu vaarito niluvabadi vaarimeeda nerasthaapana cheyunu; aamè sòlòmonu j~naanamu vinutaku bhoomyamta mulanumdivachchènu; idigo sòlòmonukamtè gòppavaadu ikkada unnaadu.
Apavitraatma òka manushyuni vadalipoyina taruvaata adi vishraamtivèdakuchu neeruleni chotla tiruguchumdunu.

Vishraamti dòrakanamdunanenu vadalivachchina naa yimtiki tirigi vèlludunanukòni vachchi, aa yimta èvarunu leka adi oodchi amarchiyumdutachoochi, vèlli tanakamtè chèddavaina mari yedu dayyamulanu vèmtabèttukòni vachchunu; avi daanilo praveshimchi akkadane kaapuramumdunu.
Amducheta aa manushyuni kadapatisthiti mòdatisthitikamtè chèddadagunu. aalaage yee dushtataramuvaarikini sambhavimchu nanènu.
Aayana janasamoohamulato imka maatalaaduchumdagaa idigo aayana talliyu sahodarulunu aayanato maata laada goruchu vèlupala nilichiyumdiri.
Appudòkadu idigo nee talliyu nee sahodarulunu neeto maatalaada valènani vèlupala nilichiyunnaarani aayanato chèppènu.
Amdukaayana tanato ee samgati chèppinavaanichoochi naa talli yèvaru? naa sahodaru lèvaru? ani chèppi
Tana shishyulavaipu chèyyi chaapiidigo naa talliyu naa sahodarulunu;
Paralokamamdunna naa tamdri chittamu chòppuna cheyuvaade naa sahodarudunu, naa saho dariyu, naatalliyu nanènu.
Aa dinamamdu yesu imtanumdi vèlli samudra....teeramuna koorchumdènu.
Bahu janasamoohamulu tana yòddaku koodivachchinamduna aayana donèyèkki koorchum dènu. aa janulamdaru darini nilichiyumdagaa
Aayana vaarini choochi chaala samgatulanu upamaana reetigaa chèppènu. ètlanagaaidigo vittuvaadu vittutaku bayalu vèllènu.
Vaadu vittuchumdagaa kònni vittana mulu trovaprakkanu padènu; pakshulu vachchivaatini mimgivesènu
Kònni chaala mannuleni raatinelanu padènu; akkada mannu lotugaa umdanamduna avi vèmtane mòlichènu gaani
Sooryudu udayimchi nappudu avi maadi verulenamduna èmdipoyènu.
Kònni mumdlapòdalalo padènu; mumdlapòdalu èdigi
Kònni mamchi nelanu padi, òkati nooramtalugaanu, òkati aruvadamtalugaanu, òkati muppa damtalugaanu phalimchènu.
Chèvulugalavaadu vinunugaaka ani chèppènu.
Taruvaata shishyulu vachchineevu upamaanareetigaa èmduku vaarito maatalaaduchunnaavani aayananu adugagaa, aayana vaarito itlanènu
Paraloka raajyamarmamulu èruguta meeku anugrahimpabadiyunnadi gaani vaariki anugrahimpa badaledu.
Kaliginavaanike yiyyabadunu, vaaniki samrriddhi kalugunu; lenivaaniki kaliginadiyu vaaniyòddanumdi teesi veyabadunu. mariyuvaaru choochuchumdiyu choodaru, vinuchumdiyu vinakayu grahimpakayu nunnaaru.
Imdu nimittamu nenu upamaanareetigaa vaariki bodhimchu chunnaanu.ee prajalu kannulaara choochi, chèvulaaraa vini, hrridayamuto grahimchi
Manassu trippukòni naavalana svasthata pòmdakumdunatlu vaari hrridayamu kròvvinadi, vaari chèvulu vinutaku mamdamulainavi, vaaru tama kannulu moosikòniyunnaaru
Ganuka meeru vinutamattuku vimdurugaani grahimpane grahamparu, choochutamattuku chooturugaani yèmta maatramunu tèlisikònaru ani yèshayaa chèppina pravachanamu veeri vishayamai nèra veruchunnadi.
Ayite mee kannulu choochuchunnavi ganuka avi dhanyamulainavi, mee chèvulu vinuchunnavi ganuka avi dhanyamulainavi.
Aneka pravaktalunu neetimamtu lunu meeru choochuvaatini choodagoriyu choodaka poyiri, meeru vinuvaatini vinagoriyu vinakapoyirani meeto nishchayamugaa chèppuchunnaanu.
Vittuvaani goorchina upamaana bhaavamu vinudi.
Èvadainanu raajya munugoorchina vaakyamu viniyu grahimpaka yumdagaa, dushtudu vachchi vaani hrridayamulo vittabadinadaanini yèttikònipovunu; trova prakkanu vittabadinavaadu veede.
Raatinelanu vittabadinavaadu vaakyamu vini vèmtane samtoshamuto daani namgeekarimchuvaadu.
Ayite atanilo veru lenamduna atadu kòmtakaalamu niluchunu gaani, vaakyamu nimittamu shramayainanu himsayainanu kalugagaane abhyamtara padunu.
Mumdlapòdalalo vitta badinavaadu vaakyamu vinuvaade gaani aihikavichaaramunu dhanamohamunu aa vaakyamunu anachiveyunu ganuka vaadu nishphaludavunu.
Mamchinelanu vittabadinavaadu vaakyamu vini grahimchuvaadu; attivaaru saphalulai yòkadu nooramtalugaanu òkadu aruvadamtalugaanu òkadu muppadamtalugaanu phalimchunanènu.
Aayana mariyòka upamaanamu vaarito chèppènu, emanagaaparalokaraajyamu, tana pòlamulo mamchi vittanamu vittina yòka manushyuni poliyunnadi.
Manushyulu nidrimchuchumdagaa, atani shatruvu vachchi godhumala madhyanu gurugulu vittipoyènu.
Mòlakalu pèrigi gimjapattinappudu gurugulu kooda agapadènu.
Appudu imti yajamaanuni daasulu ataniyòddaku vachchi ayyaa, neevu nee pòlamulo mamchi vittanamu vittitivi gadaa,amdulo gurugu lèkkadanumdi vachchinavani adigiri.
Idi shatruvu chesina pani ani atadu vaarito chèppagaa, aa daasulu memu vèlli vaatini pèriki koorchuta neekishtamaa? ani atanini adigiri.
Amdukatadu vaddu; gurugulanu pèrukuchumdagaa, vaatitokooda òkavela godhumalanu pèllagimturu.

Kotakaalamuvaraku rèmtinikalisi yèduga niyyudi; kotakaalamamdu gurugulanu mumdugaakoorchi vaatini kaalchiveyutaku kattalu katti, godhumalanu naa kòttulo cherchi pèttudani kotagaamdrato chèppudu nanènu.
Aayana mariyòka upamaanamu vaarito chèppènu paralokaraajyamu, òkadu teesikòni tana pòlamulo vittina aavagimjanu poliyunnadi.
Adi vittanamulannitilo chinnadegaani pèriginappudu koora mòkkalannitilo pèddadai aakaashapakshulu vachchi daani kòmmalayamdu nivasimchu namta chèttagunu.
Aayana mariyòka upamaanamu vaarito chèppènu paralokaraajyamu, òka stree teesikòni pimdi amtayu pulisi pòmguvaraku moodu kumchamula pimdilo daachi pèttina pullani pimdini poliyunnadi.
Nenu naa noru tèrachi upamaanareetigaa bodhimchèdanu, lokamu puttinadi mòdalukòni marugucheyabadinasamgatulanu tèliyajèppèdanu
Ani pravakta chèppinamaata nèraverunatlu yesu ee samga tulanannitini janasamoohamulaku upamaanareetigaa bodhim chènu; upamaanamu leka vaarikemiyu bodhimpaledu.
Appudaayana janasamoohamulanu pampivesi, yimti loniki vèllagaa aayana shishyulaayanayòddaku vachchipòlamu loni gurugulanu goorchina upamaanabhaavamu maaku tèliyajèppumaniri.
Amdukaayana itlanènumamchi vittanamu vittuvaadu manushyakumaarudu;
Pòlamu lokamu; mamchi vittanamulu raajyasambamdhulu1; gurugulu dushtuni sambamdhulu1;
Vaatini vittina shatruvu apavaadi2; kota yugasamaapti; kotakoyuvaaru devadootalu.
Gurugulu elaagu koorchabadi agnilo kaalchiveyabaduno aalaage yuga samaaptiyamdu jarugunu.
Manushyakumaa rudu tana dootalanu pampunu; vaaraayana raajyamulonumdi aatamkamulagu sakalamainavaatini durneetiparulanu samakoorchi agnigumdamulo padaveyuduru.
Akkada edpunu pamdlukòrukutayunu umdunu.
Appudu neetimamtulu tama tamdri raajyamulo sooryunivalè tejarilluduru. chèvulugalavaadu vinunugaaka.
Paralokaraajyamu, pòlamulo daachabadina dhanamunu poliyunnadi. òka manushyudu daani kanugòni daachi pètti, adi dòrikina samtoshamuto vèlli, tanaku kaligina damtayu amima aa pòlamunu kònunu.
Mariyu paralokaraajyamu, mamchi mutyamulanu kòna vèdakuchunna vartakuni poliyunnadi.
Atadu amoolya maina yòka mutyamunu kanugòni, poyi tanaku kaligina damtayu amima daani kònunu.
Mariyu paralokaraajyamu, samudramulo veyabadi naanaavidhamulaina chepalanu pattina valanu poliyunnadi.
Adi nimdinappudu daanini dariki laagi, koorchumdi, mamchi vaatini gampalalo cherchi chèddavaatini bayata paaraveyu duru.
Aalaage yugasamaaptiyamdu jarugunu. deva dootalu vachchi neetimamtulalonumdi dushtulanu veruparachi,
Veerini agni gumdamulo padaveyuduru. akkada edpunu pamdlukòrukutayunu umdunu.
Veetinannitini meeru grahimchitiraa ani vaarini adu gagaa vaarugrahimchiti maniri.

Aayanaamduvalana paralokaraajyamulo shishyudugaacherina pratishaastriyu tana dhananidhilonumdi kròtta padaarthamulanu paata padaartha mulanu vèlupaliki tèchchu imti yajamaanuni poliyunnaa dani vaarito chèppènu.
Yesu ee upamaanamulu chèppi chaalimchina taruvaata, aayana akkada numdi vèlli svadeshamunaku vachchi, samaaja mamdiramulalo vaariki bodhimchuchumdènu.
Amduvalana vaaraashcharyapadiee j~naanamunu ee adbhutamulunu itani kèkkadanumdi vachchinavi?
Itadu vadlavaani kumaarudu kaadaa? itani talliperu mariya kaadaa? yaakobu yosepu seemonu yoodaayanuvaaru itani sodarulu kaaraa?
Itani sodareemanulamdaru manatone yunnaaru kaaraa? itaniki ee kaaryamulanniyu èkkadanumdi vachchènani chèppukòni aayana vishayamai abhyamtarapadiri.
Ayite yesupravakta tana deshamu lonu tana imtanu tappa, mari èkkadanainanu ghanaheenudu kaadani vaarito chèppènu.
Vaari avishvaasamunubatti aayana akkada anekamaina adbhutamulu cheyaledu.
Aa samayamamdu chaturthaadhipatiyaina herodu yesunugoorchina samaachaaramu vini
Itadu baaptisma michchu yohaanu; atadu mrritulalonumdi lechi yunnaadu; amduvalanane adbhutamulu ataniyamdu kriyaaroopakamulaguchunnavani tana sevakulato chèppènu.
Elayanagaaneevu nee sodarudaina philippu bhaaryayagu herodiyanu umchukònuta nyaayamu kaadani yohaanu chèppagaa,
Herodu aamè nimittamu yohaa nunu pattukòni bamdhimchi chèrasaalalo veyimchi yumdènu.
Atadu itani champa gorènu gaani janasamoohamu itanini pravaktayani yèmchinamduna vaariki bhayapadènu.
Ayite herodu janmadinotsavamu vachchinappudu herodiya kumaartè vaarimadhya naatyamaadi herodunu samtosha parachènu
Ganukaaamè emi adiginanu ichchèdanani atadu pramaanapoorvakamugaa vaagdaanamu chesènu.
Appudaamè tanatallicheta prerepimpabadinadaibaaptisma michchu yohaanu talanu ikkada pallèmulo pètti naa kippimchumani yadigènu.
Raaju duhkhapadinanu taanu chesina pramaanamu nimittamunu, tanato kooda bhojanamunaku koorchunnavaari nimittamunu iyyanaaj~naapimchi
Bamtrau tunu pampi chèrasaalalo yohaanu tala gòttimchènu.
Vaadatani tala pallèmulopètti tèchchi aa chinnadaanikichchènu; aamè tana talliyòddaku daani teesikòni vachchènu.
Amtata yohaanu shishyulu vachchi shavamunu èttikònipoyi paati pètti yesunòddakuvachchi tèliyajesiri.
Yesu aa samgati vini donè yèkki, akkadanumdi aranyapradeshamunaku ekaamtamugaa vèllènu. janasamoo hamulu aa samgati vini, pattanamulanumdi kaalinadakanu aayanavèmta vèlliri.
Aayana vachchi aa gòppa samooha munu choochi, vaarimeeda kanikarapadi, vaarilo rogulaina vaarini svasthaparachènu.
Saayamkaalamainappudu shishyu laayanayòddaku vachchiidi aranyapradeshamu, ippatike pròddupoyènu, ee janulu graamamulaloniki vèlli bhojanapadaarthamulu kònukkònutakai vaarini pampiveya mani chèppiri.
Yesuvaaru vèllanakkaraledu, meere vaariki bhojanamu pèttudani vaarito chèppagaa
Vaaru ikkada manayòdda ayidu ròttèlunu rèmdu chepalunu tappa maremiyu ledani aayanato chèppiri.
Amdu ka aayanavaatini naayòddaku tèmdani chèppi

Pachchikameeda koorchumdudani janulakaaj~naapimchi, aa ayidu ròttèlanu rèmdu chepalanu pattukòni aakaashamuvaipu kannulètti aasheervadimchi aa ròttèlu virichi shishyulakichchènu, shishyulu janulaku vaddimchiri.
Vaaramdaru tini trriptipòmdina taru vaata migilina mukkalu pamdrèmdu gampala nimda èttiri
Streelunu pillalunu gaaka tininavaaru imchumimchu ayidu velamamdi purushulu.
Vèmtane aa janasamoohamulanu taanu pampiveyu namtalo tana shishyulu donè yèkki tanakamtè mumdugaa addariki vèllavalènani aayana vaarini balavamtamu chesènu.
Aayana aa janasamoohamulanu pampivesi, praarthanacheyu taku ekaamtamugaa kòmdayèkki poyi, saayamkaala mainappudu òmtarigaa umdènu.
Appatikaadonè dariki dooramuganumdagaa gaali yèdurainamduna alalavalana kòtta baduchumdènu.
Raatri naalugava jaamuna aayana samu dramumeeda naduchuchu vaariyòddaku vachchènu
Aayana samudramumeeda naduchuta shishyulu choochi tòmdarapadi, bhootamani chèppukòni bhayamucheta kekaluvesiri.
Vèmtane yesudhairyamu tèchchukònudi; nene, bhayapadakudanivaarito chèppagaa
Peturuprabhuvaa, neeve ayite neellameeda nadichi neeyòddaku vachchutaku naaku sèlavimmani aayanato anènu.
Aayana rammanagaane peturu donèdigi yesunòddaku vèllutaku neellameeda nadachènu gaani
Gaalini choochi bhayapadi munigiposaagiò prabhuvaa, nannu rakshimchumani kekaluvesènu.
Vèmtane yesu chèyyichaapi atani pattukònialpavishvaasee, yèmduku samdehapaditivani atanito chèppènu.
Vaaru donè yèkkinappudu gaali anigènu.
Amtata donèlo nunnavaaru vachchineevu nijamugaa devuni kumaarudavani chèppi aayanaku mròkkiri.
Vaaraddariki vèlli gènnesarètu deshamunaku vachchiri.
Akkadi janulu aayananu gurtupatti, chuttupatlanunna aa pradeshamamtatiki vartamaanamu pampi, rogulanamdarini aayana yòddaku tèppimchi
Veerini nee vastrapuchèmgu maatramu muttanimmani aayananu vedukòniri; muttinavaaramdarunu svasthatanòmdiri.
Aa samayamuna yèrooshalemunumdi shaastrulunu parisayyulunu yesunòddaku vachchi
Nee shishyulu chetulu kadugukònakumda bhojanamu cheyuchunnaare, vaarèmdu nimittamu pèddala paaramparyaachaaramunu atikramimchu chunnaarani adigiri
Amdukaayanameerunu meepaaram paryaachaaramu nimittamai devuni aaj~nanu èmduku atikra mimchuchunnaaru?
Talidamdrulanu ghanaparachumaniyu, tamdrinainanu tallinainanu dooshimchuvaadu tappaka maranamu pòmdavalènaniyu devudu sèlachichchènu.

Meeraite òkadu tana tamdrinainanu tallinainanu choochi naavalana neekedi prayojanamaguno adi devaarpitamani chèppina yèdala atadu tana tamdrinainanu tallinainanu ghanaparachanakkaraledani chèppuchunnaaru.
Meeru mee paaramparyaachaaramu nimittamai devuni vaakyamunu nirarthakamu cheyuchunnaaru.
Veshadhaarulaaraa
Ee prajalu tama pèdavulato nannu ghanaparachuduru gaani vaari hrridayamu naaku dooramugaa unnadi;
Manushyulu kalpimchina paddhatulu daivopadeshamulani bodhimchuchu vaaru nannu vyarthamugaa aaraadhimchu chunnaaru ani yèshayaa mimmunugoorchi pravachimchina maata sariye ani vaarito chèppi
Janasamoohamulanu pilichimeeru vini grahimchudi;
Notapadunadi manu shyuni apavitra parachadu gaani notanumdi vachchuna diye manushyuni apa vitraparachunani vaarito chèppènu.
Amtata aayana shishyulu vachchiparisayyulu aa maata vini abhyamtarapadirani neeku tèliyunaa ani aayananu adugagaa
Aayana paralokamamdunna naa tamdri naatani prati mòkkayu pèllagimpabadunu.
Vaari joliki pokudi; vaaru gruddivaaraiyumdi gruddivaariki trova choopuvaaru. gruddivaadu gruddivaaniki trova choopina yèdala vaariddaru gumtalo paduduru gadaa anènu.
Amdukupeturu ee upamaanabhaavamu maaku tèlupumani aayananu adugagaa
Aayanameerunu imtavaraku avivekulaiyunnaaraa?
Notiloniki povuna damtayu kadupulopadi bahirbhoomilo viduvabadunu gaani
Notanumdi bayatiki vachchunavi hrridayamulo numdi vachchunu; ive manushyuni apavitraparachunavani meeru grahimparaa?
Duraalochanalu narahatyalu vyabhi chaaramulu veshyaagamanamulu dòmgatanamulu abaddhasaakshya mulu devadooshanalu hrridayamulo numdiye vachchunu
Ive manushyuni apavitraparachunu gaani chetulu kadugu kònaka bhojanamucheyuta manushyuni apavitraparachadani chèppènu.
Yesu akkadanumdi bayaluderi tooru seedonula praamtamulaku vèllagaa,
Idigo aa praamtamulanumdi kanaanu stree yòkatè vachchiprabhuvaa, daaveedu kumaarudaa, nannu karunimpumu; naa kumaartè dayyamupatti, bahu baadhapaduchunnadani kekaluvesènu.
Amdukaayana aamèto òkka maatayainanu chèppaledu. appudaayana shishyulu vachchieemè mana vèmbadi vachchi kekaluveyu chunnadi ganuka eemènu pampi veyumani aayananu vedu kònagaa
Aayanaishraayelu imtivaarai nashimchina gòrralayòddake gaani mari èvariyòddakunu nenu pampabada ledanènu
Ayinanu aamè vachchi aayanaku mròkki prabhuvaa, naaku sahaayamu cheyumani adigènu.
Amdukaayanapillala ròttèteesikòni kukkapillalakuveyuta yuktamu kaadani chèppagaa
Aamènijame prabhuvaa, kukkapillalukooda tama yajamaanula ballameedanumdi padu mukkalu tinunu gadaa ani chèppènu.
Amduku yesu ammaa, nee vishvaasamu gòppadi; neevu korinatte neeku avunugaaka ani aamèto chèppènu. aa gadiyalone aamè kumaartè svasthata nòmdènu.
Yesu akkadanumdi vèlli, galilaya samudrateera munaku vachchi, kòmdèkki akkada koorchumdagaa
Bahu janasamoohamulu aayanayòddaku kumtivaaru gruddivaaru moogavaaru amgaheenulu mòdalaina ane kulanu teesikònivachchi aayana paadamulayòdda padavesiri; aayana vaarini svasthaparachènu.
Moogavaaru maatalaadu tayunu amgaheenulu baagupadutayunu kumtivaaru naduchutayunu gruddivaaru choochutayunu janasamoo hamu choochi aashcharyapadi ishraayelu devuni mahima parachiri.
Amtata yesu tana shishyulanu pilichi ee janulu netiki moodu dinamulanumdi naayòdda nunnaaru; vaariki tina nemiyu ledu ganuka vaarimeeda kanikarapaduchunnaanu; vaaru maargamulo moorcha
Aayana shishyuluimta gòppa jana samoohamunu trriptiparachutaku kaavalasina ròttèlu aranyapradeshamulo manaku èkkadanumdi vachchunani aaya nato aniri.
Yesumeeyòdda ènni ròttèlunnavani vaari nadugagaa vaaruedu ròttèlunu kònni chinna chepalunu unnavani chèppiri.
Appudaayana nelameeda koorchumdudani janasamoohamunaku aaj~naapimchi
Aa yedu ròttèlanu aa chepalanu pattukòni krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchi vaatini virichi tana shishyulakichchènu, shishyulu jana samoohamunaku vaddimchiri
Vaaramdaru tini trripti pòmdinameedata migilina mukkalu edu gampala nimda èttiri.
Streelunu pillalunu gaaka tininavaaru naaluguvela mamdi purushulu.
Taruvaata aayana janasamoohamulanu pampivesi, donèyèkki magadaanu praamtamulaku vachchènu.
Appudu parisayyulunu saddookayyulunu vachchi aayananu shodhimchutaku aakaashamunumdi yòka soochaka kriyanu tamaku choopumani aayananu adugagaa aayana itlanènu
Saayamkaalamuna meeruaakaashamu èrragaa unnadi ganuka varshamu kuriyadaniyu,
Udayamunaaakaashamu èrragaanu mabbugaanu unnadi ganuka nedu gaalivaana vachchunaniyu chèppuduru gadaa. meeru aakaasha vaikhari vivechimpa nèruguduru gaani yee kaalamula soochanalanu vivechimpaleru.

Vyabhichaarulaina chèddataramu vaaru soochaka kriya naduguchunnaaru, ayite yonaanu goorchina soochakakriyayegaani mari e soochaka kriyayaina vaari kanugrahimpabadadani vaarito chèppi vaarini vidichi vèllipoyènu.
Aayana shishyulu addariki vachchi ròttèlu tèchchutaku marachiri.
Appudu yesuchoochukònudi, parisayyulu saddookayyulu anu vaari pulisina pimdinigoorchi jaagratta padudani vaarito chèppènu.
Kaagaa vaarumanamu ròttèlu tenamduna gadaa (yee maata chèppènani) tamalo taamu aalochimchukònuchumdiri.
Yesu adi yèrigi alpavishvaasulaaraamanayòdda ròttèlu levani meelo meerèmduku aalochimchukònuchunnaaru?
Meerimkanu grahimpaledaa? ayidu ròttèlu ayiduvelamamdiki pamchipèttinappudu ènni gampèllu èttitiro adiyainanu
Edu ròttèlu naalugu velamamdiki pamchipèttinappudu ènni gampèllu èttitiro adiyainanu meeku j~naapakamu ledaa?
Nenu ròttèlanugoorchi meeto chèppaledani meerèmduku grahimparu? parisayyulu saddookayyulu anuvaari pulisina pimdinigoorchiye jaagrattapadudani chèppènu.
Appudu ròttèla pulisina pimdinigoorchi kaadugaani parisayyulu saddookayyulu anuvaari bodhanu goorchiye jaagrattapadavalènani aayana tamato chèppènani vaaru grahimchiri.
Yesu philippudaina kaisaraya praamtamulaku vachchimanushyakumaarudèvadani janulu chèppakònuchunnaarani tana shishyulanu adugagaa
Vaarukòmdaru baaptisma michchu yohaananiyu, kòmdaru eleeyaa aniyu, kòmdaru yirmeeyaa aniyu leka pravakta lalo òkadaniyu chèppukònuchunnaaraniri.
Amdukaayanameeraite nenu èvadanani chèppukònuchunnaa rani vaari nadigènu.
Amduku seemonu peturuneevu sajeevudagu devuni kumaarudavaina kreestuvani chèppènu.
Amduku yesuseemonu bar‌ yonaa, neevu dhanyudavu, paralokamamdunna naa tamdri ee samgati neeku bayaluparachènekaani narulu2 neeku bayalu parachaledu.
Mariyu neevu peturuvu3; ee bamdameeda naa samghamunu kattudunu, paataalaloka dvaaramulu daani yèduta niluvaneravani nenu neeto chèppuchunnaanu.

Paralokaraajyamuyòkka taalapuchèvulu nee kichchèdanu, neevu bhoolokamamdu deni bamdhimchuduvo adi paraloka mamdunu bamdhimpabadunu, bhoolokamamdu deni vippuduvo adi paralokamamdunu vippabadunani atanito chèppènu.
Atupimmata taanu kreestu ani yèvanitonu chèppavaddani aayana tana shishyulaku khamditamugaa aaj~naapimchènu.
Appatinumdi taanu yèrooshalemunaku vèllipèddalachetanu pradhaana yaajakulachetanu shaastrulachetanu aneka himsalu pòmdi, champabadi, moodavadinamuna lechuta agatyamani yesu tana
Peturu aayana cheyi pattukòniprabhuvaa, adi neeku dooramagugaaka, adi nee kènnadunu kalugadani aayananu gaddimpasaagènu.
Ayite aayana peturu vaipu tirigisaataanaa, naa vènukaku pòmmu; neevu naaku abhyamtara kaaranamaiyunnaavu; neevu manushyula samgatulane talamchuchunnaavu gaani devuni samgatulanu talampa
Appudu yesu tana shishyulanu choochièvadainanu nannu vèmbadimpagorina yèdala, tannutaanu upekshimchukòni, tana siluvanètti kòni nannu vèmbadimpavalènu.
Tana praanamunu rakshimchu kònagoruvaadu daani pogòttukònunu; naa nimittamu tana praanamunu pogòttukònuvaadu daani dakkimchu kònunu.
Òka manushyudu lokamamtayu sampaadimchu kòni tana praanamunu pogòttukòmte atanikemi prayo janamu? òka manushyudu tana praanamunaku pratigaa nemi yiyyagaladu?
Manushyakumaarudu tana tamdri mahima galavaadai tana dootalato kooda raabovuchunnaadu. appu daayana èvani kriyalachòppuna vaaniki phalamichchunu.
Ikkada nilichiyunna vaarilokòmdaru, manushyakumaarudu tana raajyamuto vachchuta choochuvaraku maranamu ruchi choodarani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppuchunnaananènu.
Aaru dinamulaina taruvaata yesu peturunu... yaakobunu atani sahodarudaina yohaanunu vèmta bèttukòni yèttayina yòka kòmdameediki ekaamtamugaa poyi vaari yèduta roopaamtaramu pòmdènu.
Aayana mukhamu sooryunivalè prakaashimchènu; aayana vastramulu vèluguvalè tèllanivaayènu.
Idigo mosheyu eleeyaayu vaariki kanabadi aayanato maata laaduchumdiri.
Appudu peturu prabhuvaa, mana mikkada umduta mamchidi; neekishtamaite ikkada neeku òkatiyu mosheku òkatiyu eleeyaaku òkatiyu moodu parnashaalalu kattudunani yesuto chèppènu.
Atadu imkanu maatalaaduchumdagaa idigo prakaashamaana maina yòka meghamu vaarini kammukònènu; idigo eeyana naa priyakumaarudu, eeyanayamdu nenaanamdimchu chunnaanu, eeyana maata vinuda
Shishyulu ee maata vini borlabadi mikkili bhayapadagaa
Yesu vaariyòddaku vachchi vaarini muttilèmdi, bhayapadakudani chèppènu.
Vaaru kannulètti choodagaa, yesu tappa mari èvarunu vaariki kanabadaledu.
Vaaru kòmda digi vachchuchumdagaamanushyakumaarudu mrritulalonumdi lechuvaraku ee darshanamu meeru èvari tonu chèppakudani yesu vaari kaaj~naapimchènu.

Adhipatièmduku? itadu e dushkaa ryamu chesènani adugagaa vaarusiluvaveyumani mari èkkuvagaa kekaluvesiri.

Pilaatu allari èkkuvagu chunnade gaani tanavalana prayojanamemiyu ledani grahimchi, neellu teesikòni janasamoohamu èduta chetulu kadugukòniee neetimamtuni raktamunugoorchi nenu nirapa raadhini, meere choochukònudani chèppènu.
Amduku praja lamdaruvaani raktamu maa meedanu maa pillalameedanu umdugaakaniri.
Appudatadu vaaru korinattu barabbanu vaariki vidudala chesi, yesunu kòradaalato kòttimchi siluvaveya nappagimchènu.
Appudu adhipatiyòkka sainikulu yesunu adhikaara mamdiramuloniki teesikònipoyi, aayanayòdda sainikula namdarini samakoorchiri.
Vaaru aayana vastramulu teesi vesi, aayanaku èrrani amgee tòdigimchi
Mumdla kireeta munu alli aayana talaku pètti, òka rèllu aayana kudi chetilonumchi, aayanayèduta mokaallooniyoodula raajaa, neeku shubhamani aayananu apahasimchi
Aayana meeda umimavesi, aa rèllunu teesikòni daanito aayananu talameeda kòttiri.
Aayananu apahasimchina taruvaata aayana meedanunna aa amgeeni teesivesi aayana vastramu laayanaku tòdigimchi, siluva veyutaku aayananu teesikòni poyiri.
Vaaru vèlluchumdagaa kureneeyudaina seemonanu òkadu kanabadagaa aayana siluvamoyutaku atanini balavamtamu chesiri.
Vaaru kapaalasthalamanu arthamichchu gòlgòtaa ana badina chotiki vachchi
Chedu kalipina draakshaarasamunu aayanaku traaganichchiri gaani aayana daanini ruchi choochi traaganòllakapoyènu.
Vaaru aayananu siluvavesina pimmata cheetluvesi aayana vastramulu pamchukòniri.
Amtata vaarakkada koorchumdi aayanaku kaavali yumdiri.
Itadu yoodula raajaina yesu ani aayanameeda mopabadina neramu vraasi aayana talaku paigaa umchiri.
Mariyu kudivaipuna òkadunu èdama vaipuna òkadunu iddaru bamdipotu dòmgalu aayanato kooda siluvaveya badiri.
Aa maargamuna vèlluchumdinavaaru talaloochuchu
Devaalayamunu padagòtti moodu dinamulalo kattu vaadaa, ninnu neeve rakshimchukònumu; neevu devuni kumaarudavaite siluvameedanumdi digumani chèppuchu aayananu dooshimchiri
Aalaage shaastrulunu pèddalunu pradhaanayaaja kulunu kooda aayananu apahasimchuchu
Veedu itarulanu rakshimchènu, tannu taane rakshimchukònaledu; ishraayelu raajugadaa, yippudu siluvameedanumdi diginayèdala vaani nammudumu.
Vaadu devuniyamdu vishvaasamumchènu, nenu devuni kumaarudanani chèppènu ganuka aayanakishtudaite aayana ippudu vaanini tappimchunani chèppiri.
Aayanato kooda siluvaveyabadina bamdipotudòmgalunu aalaage aayananu nimdimchiri.
Madhyaahnamu mòdalukòni moodu gamtalavaraku aa deshamamtatanu cheekatikammènu.
Imchumimchu moodu gamtalappudu yesuelee, elee, laamaa sabaktaanee ani biggaragaa kekavesènu. aa maataku naa devaa, naa devaa nannèmduku chèyyi vidichitivani arthamu.
Akkada nilichiyunnavaarilo kòmdaraa maata viniitadu elee yaanu piluchuchunnaadaniri.
Vèmtane vaarilo òkadu parugèttikòni poyi, spamjee teesikòni chirakaalo mumchi, rèlluna tagilimchi aayanaku traaganichchènu;
Takkinavaaruoorakumdudi eleeyaa atani rakshimpavachchunemo choota maniri.
Yesu marala biggaragaa kekavesi praanamu vidichènu.
Appudu devaalayapu tèra painumdi krimdi varaku rèmdugaa chinigènu; bhoomi vanakènu; bamdalu badda laayènu;
Samaadhulu tèravabadènu; nidrimchina aneka mamdi parishuddhula shareeramulu lechènu.
Vaaru samaadhu lalonumdi bayatiki vachchi aayana lechinataruvaata parishuddha pattanamulo praveshimchi anekulaku agapadiri.
Shataadhi patiyu atanito kooda yesunaku kaavali yunnavaarunu, bhookampamunu jarigina kaaryamulannitini choochi, mikkili bhayapadinijamugaa eeyana devuni kumaarudani chèppu kòniri.
Yesunaku upachaaramu cheyuchu galilaya numdi aayananu vèmbadimchina anekamamdi streelu akkada dooramunumdi choochuchumdiri.
Vaarilo magdalene mariyayu yaakobu yose anuvaari talliyaina mari yayu, jèbèdayi kumaarula talliyu umdiri.
Yesu shishyudugaanunna arimatayiya yosepu anu òka dhanavamtudu saayamkaalamainappudu vachchi
Pilaatu nòddaku vèlli, yesu dehamunu tanakimmani adugagaa, pilaatu daanini atani kappagimpa naaj~naapimchènu.
Yosepu aa dehamunu teesikòni shubhramaina naarabattato chutti
Taanu raatilo tòlipimchukònina kròtta samaadhilo daanini umchi, samaadhi dvaaramunaku pèddaraayi pòrlimchi vèllipoyènu.
Magdalene mariyayu, veròka mari yayu, akkadane samaadhiki èdurugaakoorchumdiyumdiri.
Marunaadu anagaa siddhaparachu dinamunaku marusati dinamuna pradhaanayaajakulunu parisayyulunu pilaatu nòddaku koodivachchi
Ayyaa, aa vamchakudu sajeevudai yumdinappudumoodu dinamulaina taruvaata nenu lechèdanani chèppinadi maaku j~naapakamunnadi.

Kaabatti moodava dinamuvaraku samaadhini bhadramucheya naaj~naa pimchumu; vaani shishyulu vachchi vaanini èttukònipoyiaayana mrritulalonumdi lechènani prajalato chèppudu remo; appudu mòdati vamchanakamtè kadapati vamchana mari chèddadai yumdunani chèppiri.
Amduku pilaatukaavalivaarunnaarugadaa meeru vèlli mee chetanainamta mattuku samaadhini bhadramu cheyudani vaarito chèppènu.
Vaaru vèlli kaavalivaarini kooda umchukòni, raatiki mudravesi samaadhini bhadramuchesiri.
Vishraamtidinamu gadachipoyina taruvaata aadivaara muna, tèllavaaruchumdagaa magdalene mariyayu veròka mariyayu samaadhini choodavachchiri.
Idigo prabhuvu doota paralokamunumdi digivachchi, raayi pòrlimchi daani meeda koorchumdènu; appudu mahaabhookampamu kaligènu.
Aa doota svaroopamu mèrupuvalè numdènu, atani vastramu himamamta tèllagaa umdènu.
Ataniki bhaya padutavalana kaavalivaaru vanaki chachchinavaarivalè numdiri.
Doota aa streelanu choochimeeru bhayapadakudi, siluva veyabadina yesunu meeru vèdakuchunnaarani naaku tèliyunu;
Aayana ikkada ledu; taanu chèppinatte aayana lechi yunnaadu; ramdi prabhuvu pamdukònina sthalamu choochi

Tvaragaa vèlli, aayana mrritulalonumdi lechiyunnaadani aayana shishyulaku tèliyajeyudi; idigo aayana galilayaloniki meeku mumdugaa vèllu chunnaadu, akkada meeru aayananu chooturu; idigo meeto chèppitinanènu.
Vaaru bhayamutonu mahaa aanamdamutonu samaadhiyòddanumdi tvaragaa vèlli aayana shishyulaku aa vartamaanamu tèlupa parugèttuchumdagaa
Yesu vaarini èdurkònimeeku shubhamani chèppènu. vaaru aayanayòddaku vachchi, aayana paadamulu pattukòni aayanaku mròkkagaa
Yesubhayapadakudi; meeru vèlli, naa sahodarulu galilayaku vèllavalènaniyu vaarakkada nannu chooturaniyu vaariki tèlupudanènu.
Vaaru vèlluchumdagaa kaavalivaarilo kòmdaru pattanamu loniki vachchi jarigina samgatulannitini pradhaana yaajaku lato chèppiri.
Kaabatti vaaru pèddalato koodi vachchi aalochanachesi aa sainikulaku chaala dravyamichchi
Memu nidrapovuchumdagaa atani shishyulu raatrivelavachchi atanini èttikònipoyirani meeru chèppudi;
Idi adhipati chèvinibadinayèdala mematani sammatiparachi meekemiyu tòmdarakalugakumda chetumani chèppiri.
Appudu vaaru aa dravyamu teesikòni tamaku bodhimpabadinaprakaaramu chesiri. ee maata yoodulalo vyaapimchi netivaraku prasiddhamaiyunnadi.
Padunòkamdumamdi shishyulu yesu tamaku nirnayimchina galilayaloni kòmdaku vèlliri.
Vaaru aayananu choochi aayanaku mròkkirigaani, kòmdaru samdehimchiri.
Ayite yesu vaariyòddaku vachchi paralokamamdunu bhoomimeedanu naaku sarvaadhi kaaramu iyyabadiyunnadi.
Kaabatti meeru vèlli, samasta janulanu shishyulanugaa cheyudi; tamdriyòkkayu kumaaruniyòkkayu parishuddhaatmayòkkayu naamamuloniki vaariki baaptisma michchuchu
Nenu meeku e ye samgatulanu aaj~naapimchi tino vaatinannitini gaikòna valènani vaariki bodhimchudi. idigo nenu yugasamaapti varaku sadaakaalamu meeto kooda unnaanani vaarito chèppènu.
Devuni kumaarudaina yesu kreestu suvaarta praaram bhamu.
Idigo naa dootanu neeku mumdugaa pampuchunnaanu; atadu nee maargamu siddhaparachunu.
Prabhuvu maargamu siddhaparachudi, aayana trovalu saraalamu cheyudani aranyamulo kekaveyuchunna òkanishabdamu ani pravaktayaina yèshayaacheta vraayabadinattu
Baaptismamichchu yohaanu aranyamulo umdi paapa kshamaapananimittamu maarumanassu vishayamaina baapti smamu prakatimchuchu vachchènu.
Amtata yoodaya deshasthu lamdarunu, yèrooshalemuvaaramdarunu, bayaluderi atani yòddaku vachchi, tama paapamulanu òppukònuchu, yòrdaanu nadilo atanicheta baaptismamu pòmduchumdi
Yohaanu òmtè romamula vastramunu mòlachuttu toludattiyu dharimchu kònuvaadu, adavi tenènu midutalanu tinuvaadu.
Mariyu atadunaakamtè shaktimamtudòkadu naavènuka vachchuchunnaadu; nenu vamgi aayana chèppulavaarunu vipputaku paatrudanukaanu;
Nenu neellalo2 meeku baaptismamichchitini gaani aayana parishuddhaatmalo3 meeku baaptismamichchunani chèppi prakatimchuchumdènu.
Aa dinamulalo yesu galilayaloni najaretunumdi vachchi yòrdaanulo yohaanucheta baaptismamu pòmdènu.
Vèmtane aayana neellalonumdi òddunaku vachchuchumdagaa aakaashamu cheelchabadutayu, parishuddhaatma paavuramuvalè tanameediki digivachchutayu choochènu.
Mariyuneevu naa priyakumaarudavu, neeyamdu nenaanamdimchuchunnaanani yòka shabdamu aakaashamunumdi vachchènu.
Vèmtane parishuddhaatma aayananu aranyamuloniki trosikònipoyènu.
Aayana saataanucheta shodhimpa baduchu aranyamulo naluvadidinamulu adavimrrigamu latokooda numdènu; mariyu devadootalu aayanaku paricharya cheyuchumdiri.
Yohaanu chèrapattabadina taruvaata yesu
Kaalamu sampoornamaiyunnadi, devuniraajyamu sameepimchi yunnadi ; maarumanassu pòmdi suvaarta nammudani chèppuchu devuni suvaarta prakatimchuchu, galilayaku vachchènu.
Aayana galilaya samudrateeramuna vèlluchumdagaa seemonunu seemonu sahodarudagu amdrèyayu, samudramulo valaveyuta choochènu; vaaru jaalarulu.
Yesunaa vèmbadi ramdi, nenu mimmunu manushyulanu pattu jaalarulanugaa chesèdanani vaarito chèppènu.
Vèmtane vaaru tama valalu vidichi aayananu vèmbadimchiri.
Aayana imka kòmtadooramu vèlli jèbèdayi kumaarudagu yaakobunu atani sahodarudagu yohaanunu choochènu; vaaru donèlo umdi tama valalu baaguchesikònuchumdiri.
Vèmtane aayana vaarini piluvagaa vaaru tama tamdriyaina jèbèdayini donèlo jeetagaamdrayòdda vidichipètti aaya nanu vèmbadimchiri.
Amtata vaaru kapèrnahoomuloniki vèlliri. vèmtane aayana vishraamtidinamuna samaajamamdiramuloniki poyi bodhimchènu.
Aayana shaastrulavalè gaaka adhikaaramu galavaanivalè vaariki bodhimchènu ganuka vaaru aayana bodhaku aashcharyapadiri.
Aa samayamuna vaari samaaja mamdiramulo apavitraatmapattina manushyudòkadumdènu.
Vaadunajareyudavagu yesoo, maato neekemi, mammu nashimpajeyutaku vachchitivaa? neevèvadavo naaku tèliyunu; neevu devuni parishuddhudavu ani kekalu vesènu.
Amduku yesuoorakumdumu vaanini vidichipòmmani daanini gaddimpagaa
Aa apavitraatma vaanini vilavilalaadimchi pèdda kekavesi vaani vidichipoyènu.
Amdarunu vismayamòmdi idemito? yidi kròtta bodhagaa unnade; eeyana adhikaaramuto apavitraatmalakunu aaj~naapimpagaa avi aayanaku lobaduchunnavani yòkanito òkadu chèppu kòniri.
Vèmtane aayananugoorchina samaachaaramu tvaralo galilaya praamtamulamdamtata vyaapimchènu.
Vèmtane vaaru samaajamamdiramulonumdi vèlli, yaakobutonu yohaanutonu seemonu amdrèya anuvaariyimta praveshimchiri.
Seemonu atta jvaramuto padiyumdagaa, vèmtane vaaraamènugoorchi aayanato chèppiri.
Aayana aamèdaggaraku vachchi, chèyyipatti aamènu levanèttènu; amtata jvaramu aamènu vadalènu ganuka aamè vaariki upachaaramu cheyasaagènu.
Saayamkaalamu pròddu grumkinappudu, janulu sakala rogulanu dayyamulu pattinavaarini aayanayòddaku teesi kòni vachchiri;
Pattanamamtayu aa yimtivaakita koodi yumdènu.
Aayana naanaavidha rogamulacheta peedimpa badina anekulanu svasthaparachi, anekamaina dayyamulanu vèllagòttènu. avi tannu èrigiyumdinamduna aayana aa dayyamulanu maatalaadaniyyaledu.
Aayana pèmdalakadane lechi yimkanu chaalaa cheekati yumdagaane bayaluderi, aranyapradeshamunaku vèlli, akkada praarthana cheyuchumdènu.
Seemonunu atanito kooda nunnavaarunu aayananu vèdakuchu vèlli
Aayananu kanugòni,amdaru ninnu vèdakuchunnaarani aayanato chèppagaa
Aayanaitara sameepa graamamulalonu nenu prakatimchunatlu vèlludamu ramdi; yimdunimittame gadaa nenu bayaluderi vachchitinani vaarito chèppènu.
Aayana galilayayamdamtata vaari samaajamamdiramulalo praka timchuchu, dayyamulanu vèllagòttuchu numdènu.
Òka kushtharogi aayanayòddaku vachchi aayanayèduta mokaalloonineekishtamaite nannu shuddhunigaa cheyagalavani aayanato chèppi, aayananu vedukònagaa
Aayana kanikara padi, chèyyichaapi vaanini muttinaakishtame; neevu shuddhudavu kammani vaanito chèppènu.
Vèmtane kushtharogamu vaanini vidichènu ganuka vaadu shuddhudaayènu.
Appudaayanaèvanitonu emiyu chèppaku sumee;

Kaani neevu vèlli vaariki saakshyaarthamai nee dehamunu yaajakuniki kanabarachu kòni, neevu shuddhudavainamduku moshe niyamimchina kaanuka lanu samarpimchumani vaaniki khamditamugaa aaj~naapimchi vèmtane vaanini pampivesènu.
Ayite vaadu vèlli daanini goorchi vistaaramugaa prakatimchutakunu, aa samgati prachuramu cheyutakunu aarambhimchènu ganuka aayana ika pattanamulo bahiramgamugaa praveshimpaleka, vèlu
Kònnidinamulaina pimmata aayana marala kapèrna hoomuloniki vachchènu
Aayana yimta unnaadani vinavachchinappudu a nekulu koodivachchiri ganuka vaakitanainanu vaariki sthalamu lekapoyènu. aayana vaariki vaakyamu bodhimchuchumdagaa
Kòmdaru pakshavaayuvugala òka manushyuni naluguricheta moyimchukòni aayanayòddaku teesikòni vachchiri.
Chaalamamdi koodiyunnamduna vaaraayanayòddaku cheraleka, aayana yunnachotiki paigaa imti kappu vippi, samduchesi pakshavaayuvugalavaanini paruputone dimpiri.
Yesu vaari vishvaasamu choochikumaarudaa, nee paapamulu kshamimpabadiyunnavani paksha vaayuvugalavaanito chèppènu.
Shaastrulalo kòmdaru akkada koorchumdiyumdiri.
Vaaruitadu itlèmduku chèppuchunnaadu? devadooshana cheyuchunnaadu gadaa; devudòkkade tappa paapamunu kshamimpagalavaadèvadani tama hrridayamulalo aalochimchukòniri.
Vaaru tamalo taamu eelaaguna aalochimchukònuta yesu vèmtane tana aatmalo tèlisikòni meereelaati samgatulu mee hrridayamulalo èmduku aalochimchukònuchunnaaru?
Ee pakshavaayuvugalavaanito nee paapamulu kshamimpa badiyunnavani chèpputa sulabhamaa? neevu lechi nee parupètti kòni naduvumani chèpputa sulabhamaa?
Ayite paapamulu kshamimchutaku bhoomimeeda manushyakumaaruniki adhikaaramu kaladani meeru tèlisikònavalènani vaarito chèppi
Paksha vaayuvu galavaanini choochineevu lechi nee parupèttikòni yimtiki pòmmani neeto chèppuchunnaananènu.
Takshaname vaadu lechi, parupèttikòni, vaaramdariyèduta nadachi poyènu ganuka, vaaramdaru vibhraamtinòmdimanameelaati kaaryamulanu ènnadunu choodaledani chèppukònuchu devuni mahimaparachiri.
Aayana samudrateeramuna marala nadachipovuchumdènu. janulamdarunu aayanayòddaku raagaa aayana vaariki bodhimchènu.
Aayana maargamuna vèlluchu, sumkapu mèttunòdda koorchunna alphayi kumaarudagu levini choochi nannu vèmbadimchumani atanito chèppagaa, atadu lechi, aayananu vèmbadimchènu.
Atani yimta aayana bhojana munaku koorchumdiyumdagaa, sumkarulunu paapulunu anekulu yesutonu aayana shishyulatonu koorchumdi yumdiri. ittivaaranekulumdiri; vaaraayananu vèmba di
Parisayyulalonunna shaastrulu aayana sumkarulatonu paapulatonu bhujimchuta choochiaayana sumkarulatonu paapulatonu kalisi bhojanamu cheyu chunnaademani aayana shishyula nadugagaa
Yesu aa maata vinirogulake gaani aarogyamugalavaariki vaidyu dakkaraledu; nenu paapulane piluva vachchitinigaani neeti mamtulanu piluvaraaledani vaarito chèppènu.

Yohaanu shishyulunu parisayyulunu upavaasamu cheyuta kaddu. vaaru vachchiyohaanu shishyulunu parisayyula shishyulunu upavaasamu cheyuduru gaani nee shishyulu upavaasamu cheyaru; deeniki hetuvemani aayana nadugagaa
Yesupèmdlikumaarudu tamatokooda unna kaalamuna pèmdli imtivaaru upavaasamu cheya dagunaa? pèmdlikumaarudu tamatokooda unnamtakaalamu upavaasamu cheyadagadu gaani
Pèmdlikumaarudu vaari yòddanumdi kònipobadu dinamulu vachchunu; aa dinamula lone vaarupavaasamu cheturu.
Èvadunu paatabattaku kròttagudda maasika veyadu; vesinayèdala aa kròttamaasika paatabattanu vèlitiparachunu, chinugu mari èkkuvagunu.

Èvadunu paata tittulalo kròtta draakshaarasamu poyadu; posinayèdala draakshaarasamu aa tittulanu pigulchunu, rasamunu tittulunu chèdunu; ayite kròtta draakshaa rasamu kròtta tittulalo poyavalènani chèppènu.
Mariyu aayana vishraamtidinamuna pamtachelalobadi vèlluchumdagaa, shishyulu maargamuna saagipovuchu vènnulu trumchuchunumdiri.
Amduku parisayyuluchoodumu, vishraamtidinamuna cheyakoodanidi vaarela cheyu chunnaarani aayana nadigiri.
Amdukaayana vaarito itlanènutaanunu tanato kooda nunnavaarunu aakaligòni namduna daaveedunaku avasaramu vachchinappudu atadu chesinadi meerènnadunu chaduvaledaa?
Abyaataaru pradhaana yaajakudai yumdagaa devamamdiramuloniki vèlli, yaajakule gaani yitarulu tinakoodani samukhapu ròttèlu taanu tini, tanatokooda unnavaarikichchènu gadaa ani chèppènu.
Mariyuvishraamtidinamu manushyulakòrake niyamimpabadènu gaani manushyulu vishraamtidinamukòraku niyamimpabadaledu.
Amduvalana manushyakumaarudu vishraamtidinamunakunu prabhuvai yunnaadani vaarito chèppènu.
Samaajamamdiramulo aayana marala praveshimpagaa akkada oochachèyyi galavaadu òkadumdènu.
Achchati vaaru aayanameeda neramu mopavalènaniyumdi, vishraamti dinamuna vaanini svasthaparachunemo ani aayananu kani pèttuchumdiri.
Aayananeevu lechi na madhyanu niluvumani oochachèyyigalavaanito chèppi
Vaarini choochivishraamti dinamuna melucheyuta dharmamaa keedu cheyuta dharmamaa? praanarakshana dharmamaa, praanahatya dharmamaa! ani adi gènu; amduku vaaru oorakumdiri.
Aayana vaari hrridaya kaathinyamunaku duhkhapadi, kopamuto vaarini kalaya choochinee chèyyichaapumani aa manushyunito chèppènu; vaadu tana chèyyi chaapagaa adi baagupadènu.
Parisayyulu vèlupaliki poyi vèmtane herodeeyulato kalisikòni, aayana nelaagu samharimtumaa yani aayanaku virodhamugaa aalochana chesiri.
Yesu tana shishyulato kooda samudramunòddaku vèllagaa, galilayanumdi vachchina gòppa janasamoohamu aayananu vèmbadimchènu,

Mariyu aayana inni gòppa kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaadani vini janulu yoodayanumdiyu, yèrooshalemunumdiyu, idoomayanumdiyu, yòrdaanu avatalanumdiyu, tooru seedonu anèdi pattanapraamta mulanumdiyu aayanayòddaku gumpulu gumpulugaa vachchiri.
Janulu gumpukoodagaa choochi, vaaru tanaku iruku kaligimpakumdunatlu chinnadonè yòkati tanaku siddha parachiyumchavalènani aayana tana shishyulato chèppènu.
Aayana anekulanu svasthaparachènu ganuka rogapeeditulaina vaaramdaru aayananu muttukònavalènani aayanameeda padu chumdiri.
Apavitraatmalu pattinavaaru aayananu chooda gaane aayana yèduta saagilapadineevu devuni kumaaruda vani chèppuchu kekaluvesiri.
Tannu prasiddhicheyavaddani aayana vaariki khamditamugaa aaj~naapimchènu.
Aayana kòmdèkki tanakishtamainavaarini piluvagaa vaaraa yana yòddaku vachchiri.

Amdaru aayananu choochi tòmdarapadagaa, vèmtane aayana vaarini palukarimchidhairyamu tèchchu kònudi, nene, bhayapadakudani chèppènu.
Taruvaata aayana donè yèkki vaariyòddaku vachchinappudu gaali anagènu, amduku vaaru tamalotaamu mikkili vibhraamti nòmdiri;
Ayinanu vaari hrridayamu kathina maayènu ganuka vaaru ròttèlanugoorchina samgati grahimpaledu.
Vaaru avatalaku vèlli gènnesarètu daggara òdduku vachchi dari pattiri.
Vaaru donè digagaane, janulu aayananu gurutupatti
Aa pradeshamamdamtata parugèttikònipoyi, aayana yunnaadani vininachotunaku rogulanu mamchamula meeda mosikòni vachchutaku mòdalupèttiri.

Graamamula lonu pattanamulalonu pallètoollalonu aayana yèkka dèkkada praveshimchèno akkadi janulu rogulanu samta veethulalo umchi, vaarini aayana vastrapuchèmgumaatramu muttanimmani aayananu vedukònuchumdiri. aayananu muttina vaaramdaru svasthatanòmdiri.
Yèrooshalemunumdi vachchina parisayyulunu shaastru lalo kòmdarunu aayanayòddaku koodivachchi
Aayana shishyulalo kòmdaru apavitramaina chetulato, anagaa kadugani chetulato bhojanamu cheyuta choochiri.
Pari sayyulunu yoodulamdarunu pèddala paaramparyaachaara munubatti chetulu kadugukòmtene gaani bhojanamu cheyaru.

Mariyu vaaru samtanumdi vachchinappudu neellu challukòmtene gaani bhojanamu cheyaru. idiyugaaka ginnèlanu kumdalanu ittadi paatralanu1 neellalo kaduguta2 mòdalagu anekaachaaramulanu vaaranusarimchèdivaaru.
Appudu parisayyulunu shaastrulununee shishyulèmduku pèddala paaramparyaachaaramuchòppuna naduchukònaka, apa vitramaina chetulato bhojanamu cheyudurani aayana nadi giri.
Amdukaayana vaarito eelaagu chèppènuee prajalu pèdavulato nannu ghanaparachudurugaani, vaari hrridayamu naaku dooramugaa unnadi.
Vaaru, maanavulu kalpimchina paddhatulu devopa deshamulani bodhimchuchu nannu vyarthamugaa aaraadhimchuduru ani vraayabadinattu veshadhaarulaina mimmunugoorchi yèshayaa pravachimchinadi sariye.
Meeru devuni aaj~nanu vidichipètti, manushyula paaramparyaachaaramunu gaikònu chunnaaru.
Mariyu aayanameeru mee paaramparyaa chaaramunu gaikònutaku devuni aaj~nanu bòttigaa niraaka rimchuduru.
Nee talidamdrulanu ghanaparachavalènaniyu, tamdrinainanu tallinainanu dooshimchuvaaniki maranashiksha vidhimpavalènaniyu moshe chèppènu gadaa.
Ayinanu meeruòkadu tana tamdrinainanu tallinainanu choochi naavalana neeku prayojanamagunadi edo adi kòrbaanu, anagaa devaarpitamani chèppinayèdala,
Tana tamdrikainanu talli kainanu vaanini emiyu cheyaniyyaka
Meeru niya mimchina mee paaramparyaachaaramuvalana devuni vaakyamunu nirartha kamu cheyuduru. ituvamtivi anekamulu meeru cheyudurani chèppènu.
Appudaayana janasamoohamunu marala tanayòddaku pilichimeeramdaru naa maata vini grahimchudi.
Valupalinumdi lopaliki poyi manushyuni apavitrunigaa cheyagalugunadi ediyu ledu gaani,
Lopalinumdi bayalu vèllunave manushyuni apavitrunigaa cheyunanènu.
Aayana janasamoohamunu vidichi yimti loniki vachchinappudu, aayana shishyulu ee upamaanamunu goorchi aayana nadugagaa
Aayana vaarito itlanènumeerunu imta avivekulai yunnaaraa? vèlupalinumdi manushyuni lopaliki povunadediyu vaani napavitrunigaa cheyajaaladani meeru grahimpakunnaaraa?
Adi vaani hrridayamulo praveshimpaka kadupulone praveshimchi bahirboo émilo viduvabadunu; itlu adi bhojanapadaarthamu lanni tini pavitraparachunu.
Manushyuni lopalinumdi bayalu vèllunadi manushyuni apavitraparachunu.
Lopalinumdi, anagaa manushyula hrridayamulonumdi duraalochanalunu jaaratvamulunu dòmgatanamulunu
Narahatyalunu vyabhi chaaramulunu lobhamulunu chèdutanamulunu krritrima munu kaamavikaaramunu matsaramunu3 devadooshanayu ahambhaavamunu avivekamunu vachchunu.
Ee chèdda vanniyu lopalinumdiye bayaluvèlli, manushyuni apa vitra parachunani aayana chèppènu.
Aayana akkadanumdi lechi, tooru seedonula praamta mulaku vèlli, yòka imta praveshimchi, aa samgati èvanikini tèliyakumdavalènani korènu gaani aayana marugai yumda leka poyènu.
Apavitraatma pattina chinnakumaartègala yòka stree aayananugoorchi vini, vèmtane vachchi aayana paadamulameeda padènu.
Aa stree surophènikaya vamsha mamdu puttina greesu deshasthuraalu. aamè tana kumaartèlonumdi aa dayyamunu vèllagòttumani aayananu vedu kònènu.
Aayana aamènu choochipillalu mòdata trripti pòmdavalènu; pillala ròttè teesikòni kukkapillalaku veyuta yuktamu kaadanènu.
Amdukaamènijame prabhuvaa, ayite kukkapillalu kooda ballakrimda umdi, pillalu pada veyu ròttèmukkalu tinunu gadaa ani aayanato chèppènu.
Amdukaayanaee maata chèppinamduna vèllumu; dayyamu nee kumaartènu vadalipoyinadani aamèto chèppènu.
Aamè yimtiki vachchi , tana kumaartè mamchamumeeda pamdukòni yumdutayu dayyamu vadali poyi yumdutayu choochènu.
Aayana marala tooru praamtamulu vidichi, seedonu dvaaraa dèkapòli praamtamulameedugaa galilaya samu dramunòddaku vachchènu.
Appudu vaaru chèvudugala natti vaani òkani aayanayòddaku todukònivachchi, vaanimeeda chèyyi yumchumani aayananu vedukòniri.
Samooha mulonumdi aayana vaanini ekaamtamunaku todukòni poyi, vaani chèvulalo tana vrellupètti, umimavesi, vaani naaluka mutti
Aakaashamuvaipu kannulètti nittoorpu vidichi èpphataa ani vaanito chèppènu; aa maataku tèravabadu mani arthamu.
Amtata vaani chèvulu tèravabadènu, vaani naaluka naramu sadali vaadu tetagaa maatalaaduchumdènu.
Appudaayanaidi èvanitonu chèppavaddani vaari kaaj~naa pimchènu; ayite aayana chèppavaddani vaari kaaj~naapimchina kòladi vaaru mari èkkuvagaa daanini prasiddhicheyuchu
Eeyana samastamunu baagugaa chesiyunnaadu; chèviti vaaru vinunatlugaanu moogavaaru maatalaadunatlugaanu cheyuchunnaadani chèppukòni aparimitamugaa aashcharyapadiri.
Aa dinamulalo mariyòka saari bahu janulu koodi raagaa, vaariki tinanemiyu lenamduna yesu tana shishyu lanu tanayòddaku pilichi
Janulu netiki moodu dinamula numdi naayòddanunnaaru; vaariki tinanemiyu lenamduna, nenu vaarimeeda kanikarapaduchunnaanu;
Nenu vaarini upavaasamuto tama imdlaku pampivesinayèdala maarga mulo moorchapovuduru; vaarilo kòmdaru dooramu numdi vachchiyunnaarani vaarito chèppènu.
Amdu kaayana shishyulu ee aranyapradeshamulo òka dèkkada numdi ròttèlu tèchchi, veerini trriptiparachagaladani aayana nadigiri.
Aayanameeyòdda ènni ròttèlunnavani vaari nadugagaa vaaruedaniri.

Appudaayananelameeda koorchumdudani janulakaaj~naapimchi aa yedu ròttèlu pattukòni krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchi, virichi, vaddimchutakai tana shishyulakichchènu, vaaru janasamoohamunaku vaddimchiri
Kònni chinnachepalu kooda vaariyòddanumdagaa aayana aasheervadimchi vaatinikooda vaddimchudani chèppènu.
Vaaru bhojanamuchesi trriptipòmdinameedata, migilina mukkalu edu gampalanimda èttiri.
Bhojanamuchesinavaaru imchu mimchu naalugu vela mamdi. vaarini pampivesina vèmtane
Aayana tana shishyulatokooda donè yèkki dalmanootaa praamtamulaku vachchènu.
Amtata parisayyulu vachchi aayananu shodhimchuchu, aakaashamunumdi yòka soochakakriyanu choopumani aayana nadigi aayanato tarkimpasaagiri.
Aayana aatmayamdu pèdda nittoorpu vidichiee taramuvaaru èmduku soochaka kriya naduguchunnaaru? ee taramunaku e soochaka kriyayu nanugrahimpabadadani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppuchunnaanani chèppi
Vaarini vidichi marala donè yèkki addariki poyènu.
Vaaru tinutaku ròttèlu tèchchutaku marachiri; donèlo vaariyòdda òkka ròttè tappa maremiyu lekapoyènu.
Aayanachoochukònudi; parisayyula pulisina pimdini goorchiyu herodu pulisina pimdinigoorchiyu jaagratta padudani vaarini hèchcharimpagaa
Vaarutamayòdda ròttèlu leveyani tamalotaamu aalochimchukòniri.
Yesu adi yèrigimanayòdda ròttèlu leveyani meerèmduku aalochimchukònuchunnaaru? meerimkanu grahimpaledaa? vivechimpaledaa? meeru kathinahrridayamu galavaarai yunnaaraa?
Meeru kannulumdiyu choodaraa? chèvulumdiyu vinaraa? j~naapakamu chesikònaraa?
Nenu aa ayiduvelamamdiki ayidu ròttèlu virichi pamchipètti nappudu meeru mukkalu ènni gampalanimda èttitirani vaari nadigènu. vaarupamdrèmdani aayanato chèppiri.
Aa naalugu velamamdiki edu ròttèlu nenu virichi, pamchi pètti nappudu mukkalu ènni gampalanimda èttitirani aayana adugagaa vaaruedaniri.
Amdukaayanameerimkanu grahimpakunnaaraa? ani anènu.
Amtalo vaaru betsayidaaku vachchiri. appudu akkadi vaaru aayanayòddaku òka gruddivaani todu kònivachchi, vaani muttavalènani aayananu vedukòniri.
Aayana aa gruddivaani chèyyipattukòni oorivèlupaliki todukòni poyi, vaani kannulameeda umimavesi, vaani meeda chetulumchineekemainanu kanabaduchunnadaa? ani vaaninadugagaa,
Vaadu kannulèttimanushyulu naaku kanabaduchunnaaru; vaaru chètlavalènumdi naduchu chunnatlugaa naaku kanabaduchunnaaranènu.
Amtata aayana marala tana chetulu vaani kannulameeda numchagaa, vaadu terichoochi kudurchabadi samastamunu tetagaa chooda saagènu.
Appudu yesuneevu ooriloniki vèllavaddani chèppi vaani yimtiki vaanini pampivesènu.
Yesu tana shishyulato philippudaina kaisarayato cherina graamamulaku bayaluderènu. maargamulonumdagaa nenu èvadanani janulu chèppuchunnaarani tana shishyula nadigènu.
Amduku vaarukòmdaru baaptismamichchu yohaanu aniyu, kòmdaru eleeyaa aniyu, mari kòmdaru pravaktalalo òkadaniyu chèppu kònuchunnaaraniri.
