Amdukaayanameeraite nenu èvadani chèppuchunnaarani vaarinadugagaa peturuneevu kreestu1vani aayanato chèppènu.
Appudu tannu goorchina yee samgati èvani tonu chèppavaddani aayana vaariki khamditamugaa chèppènu.

Mariyu manushyakumaarudu aneka himsalupòmdi, pèddala chetanu pradhaanayaajakulachetanu shaastrulachetanu upekshimpa badi champabadi, moodu dinamulaina taruvaata lechuta agatyamani aayana vaariki bodhimpa naarambhimchènu.
Aayana ee maata bahiramgamugaa chèppènu. peturu aayana cheyipattukòni aayananu gaddimpasaagènu
Amdu kaayana tana shishyulavaipu tirigi, vaarini choochi saataanaa, naa vènukaku pòmmu; neevu manushyula samgatulanu manaskarimchuchunnaavu gaani devuni samgatulanu manaska rimpakunnaavani peta
Amtata aayana tana shishyulanu janasamoohamunu tana yòddaku pilichinannu vèmbadimpa goruvaadu tannu taanu upekshimchukòni tana siluvayèttti kòni nannu vèmba dimpavalènu.
Tana praanamunu rakshimchukònagoruvaadu daani pogòttukònunu; naa nimittamunu suvaarta nimittamunu tana praanamunu pogòttukònuvaadu daani rakshimchu kònunu.
Òkadu sarvalokamunu sampaadimchukòni tana praanamunu pogòttukònuta vaanikemi prayojanamu?
Manushyudu tana praanamunaku pratigaa emi iyya galugunu?

Vyabhichaaramunu paapamunucheyu ee taramu vaarilo nannu goorchiyu naamaatalanugoorchiyu siggupadu vaadèvado, vaaninigoorchi manushyakumaarudu tana tamdri mahimagalavaadai parishuddha dootalatokooda vachchunappudu siggupadunani chèppènu.
Mariyu aayana ikkada nilichiyunna vaarilo kòmdaru devuniraajyamu balamuto vachchuta choochuvaraku maranamu ruchichoodarani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppu chunnaananènu.
Aarudinamulaina taruvaata, yesu peturunu yaakobunu yohaanunu maatramu vèmtabèttukòni, yèttayina yòka kòmdameediki ekaamtamugaa vaarini todukònipoyi, vaariyèduta roopaamtaramu pòmdènu.
Amtalo aayana vastramulu prakaashamaanamainaviyu migula tèllaniviyu aayènu; lokamamdu e chaakaliyunu amta tèllagaa chaluvacheyaledu.
Mariyu mosheyu eleeyaayu vaariki kanabadi yesuto maatalaaduchumdiri.
Appudu peturu bodhakudaa, manamikkada umduta mamchidi; memu neeku òkatiyu mosheku òkatiyu eleeyaaku òkatiyu moodu parnashaalalu kattudumani chèppènu;
Vaaru migula bhayapadiri ganuka taanu chèppavalasinademo ataniki tèliyaledu.
Meghamòkati vachchi vaarini kammagaa eeyana naa priyakumaarudu, eeyana maata vinudani yòka shabdamu aa meghamulonumdi puttènu.
Vèmtane vaaru chuttu choochinappudu, tama yòddanunna yesu tappa mari èvarunu vaariki kanabadaledu.
Vaaru aa kòmda digi vachchuchumdagaamanushya kumaarudu mrritulalonumdi lechinappude gaani, amtaku mumdu meeru choochinavaatini èvanitonu chèppavaddani aayana vaariki aaj~naapimchènu.
Mrritulalonumdi lechuta anagaa emito ani vaaròkanito òkadu tarkimchuchu aa maata manassuna umchukòniri.
Vaaru eleeyaa mumdugaa raavalènani shaastrulu chèppuchunnaare, yidemani aayana nadigiri.
Amdukaayanaeleeyaa mumdugaa vachchi samastamunu chakka pèttunanu maata nijame; ayinanu manushyakumaarudu aneka shramalupadi, trrineekarimpabada valènani vraayabaduta emi?
Eleeyaa vachchènaniyu atanigoorchi vraayabadina prakaaramu vaaru tamakishtamu vachchinattu ataniyèdala chesiraniyu meeto chèppu chunnaanani vaarito anènu.
Vaaru shishyulayòddaku vachchi, vaari chuttu bahu janulu koodiyumdutayu shaastrulu vaarito tarkimchutayu choochiri.
Vèmtane janasamoohamamtayu aayananu choochi, migula vibhraamtinòmdi aayanayòddaku parugètti kònivachchi aayanaku vamdanamuchesiri.
Appudaayanameeru denigoorchi vaarito tarkimchuchunnaarani vaari nadugagaa
Janasamoohamulo òkadubodhakudaa, moogadayyamu2 pattina naa kumaaruni neeyòddaku teesikòni vachchitini;
Adi èkkada vaanini pattuno akkada vaanini padadroyunu; appudu vaadu nurugu kaarchukòni, pamdlu kòrukukòni moorchillunu; daanini vèllagòttudani nee shishyulanu adigitini gaani adi vaaricheta
Amdukaayana vishvaasamuleni taramuvaaralaaraa, nenu èmtakaalamu meeto numdunu? èmtavaraku mimmunu sahimtunu? vaanini naayòddaku teesikòni ramdani vaarito chèppagaa
Vaaraayanayòddaku vaanini teesikòni vachchiri. dayyamu aayananu chooda gaane, vaani vilavila laadimchènu ganuka vaadu nelapadi nurugu kaarchukònuchu pòrlaaduchumdènu.
Appudaayana idi veeniki sambhavimchi yèmtakaalamainadani vaani tamdri nadugagaa atadu baalyamunumdiye;
Adi vaani naashanamu cheyavalènani tarachugaa agnilonu neellalonu padadroyunu. emainanu neevalananaite maameeda kanikarapadi maaku sahaayamu cheyumanènu.
Amduku yesu (nammuta) neevalananaite, nammuvaaniki samastamunu saadhyame yani atanito chèppènu.
Vèmtane aa chinnavaani tamdrinammuchunnaanu, naaku apanammakamumdakumda sahaayamu cheyumani1 biggaragaa chèppènu.

Janulu gumpukoodi tanayòddaku paru gèttikònivachchuta yesu choochi moogavaina chèviti dayyamaa, vaanini vadilipòmmu, ika vaanilopraveshimpavaddani neeku aaj~naapimchuchunnaanani chèppi aa apavitraatmanu gaddimchènu.
Appudu adi kekavesi, vaaninèmto vilavila laadimchi vadalipoyènu. amtata vaadu chachchinavaanivalè umdènu ganuka anekuluvaadu chanipoyènaniri.
Ayite yesu vaani chèyyi patti vaani levanèttagaa vaadu niluvabadènu.
Aayana imti loniki vèllina taruvaata aayana shishyulume mèmduku aa dayyamunu vèllagòttaleka potimani ekaamtamuna aayana nadigiri.
Amdukaayana praarthanavalanane  2 gaani mari denivalananainanu ee vidhamainadi vadalipovuta asaadhyamani vaarito chèppènu.
Vaarakkadanumdi bayaluderi galilaya gumdaa vèllu chumdiri; adi èvanikini tèliyuta aayanakishtamuleka poyènu;
Elayanagaa aayana tana shishyulaku bodhimchuchu manushyakumaarudu manushyula chetiki appagimpabadu chunnaadu, vaaraayananu champèdaru; champabadina moodu dinamulaku aayana lechunani vaarito chèppènu.
Vaaru aa maata grahimpaledu gaani aayana naduga bhayapadiri.
Amtata vaaru kapèrnahoomunaku vachchiri. vaaru èvadu gòppavaadani maargamuna òkanito òkadu vaadimchiri ganuka
Aayana imta unnappudumaargamuna meeru òkarito òkaru deninigoorchi vaadimchuchumtirani vaarinadugagaa
Vaaru oorakumdiri. appudaayana koorchumdi pamdrèmdumamdini pilichièvadainanu mòdati vaadaiyumda gorinayèdala, vaadamdarilo kadapativaadunu amdariki parichaarakudunai yumdavalènani chèppi
Yòka chinna biddanu teesikòni vaari madhyanu niluvabètti, vaanini ètti kaugilimchukòni
Itti chinna biddalalo òkanini naa perata cherchukònuvaadu nannu cherchukònunu; nannu cherchukònuvaadu nannu gaaka nannu pampinavaanini cherchu kònunani vaarito chèppènu.
Amtata yohaanubodhakudaa, òkadu nee perata dayyamulanu vèllagòttuta choochitiviu; vaadu manalanu vèmbadimchuvaadu kaadu ganuka vaanini aatamkaparachitimani chèppènu.
Amduku yesuvaanini aatamkaparachakudi; naaperata adbhutamu chesi nannu chulakanagaa nimdimpagala vaadèvadunu ledu;
Manaku virodhikaanivaadu mana pakshamugaa nunnavaade.
Meeru kreestuvaarani naa perata meeku ginnèdu neellu traaganichchuvaadu, tanaku raavalasina phalamu pogòttukònadani meetonishchayamugaa chèppu chunnaanu.
Naayamdu vishvaasamumchu ee chinnavaarilo nòkani abhyamtaraparachuvaadèvado, vaadu mèdaku pèdda tirugatiraayi kattabadi samudramulo padaveyabaduta vaaniki melu.
Nee chèyyi ninnu abhyamtaraparachina yèdala daanini narikiveyumu;
Neevu rèmdu chetulu kaligi narakamuloni aarani agniloniki povutakamtè amga heenudavai jeevamulo praveshimchuta melu.
Nee paadamu ninnu abhyamtaraparachinayèdala daanini narikiveyumu;
Rèmdu paadamulu kaligi narakamulo padaveyabadutakamtè, kumtivaadavai (nitya) jeevamulo praveshimchutamelu.
Nee kannu ninnu abhyamtaraparachinayèdala daani teesipaara veyumu; rèmdu kannulu kaligi narakamulo padaveya badutakamtè òmtikannu galavaadavai devuni raajyamulo praveshimchuta melu.
Narakamuna vaari purugu chaavadu; agni aaradu.
Prativaaniki uppusaaramu agnivalana kalugunu.
Uppu mamchidegaani uppu nissaaramaina yèdala denivalana meeru daaniki saaramu kalugujeturu? meelo meeru uppusaaramu galavaarai yumdi yòkarito òkaru samaadhaanamugaa umdudani chèppènu.
Aayana akkadanumdi lechi yoodaya praamta..mulakunu yòrdaanu addarikini vachchènu. janasamoohamulu tirigi aayanayòddaku koodivachchiri. aayana tana vaaduka chòppuna vaariki marala bodhimchuchumdènu.
Parisayyulu aayanayòddaku vachchi, aayananu shodhimchutakaipurushudu tana bhaaryanu vidanaaduta nyaayamaa? ani aayana nadigiri.
Amdukaayanamoshe meekemi aaj~naapimchènani vaari nadigènu.
Vaaruparityaaga patrika vraayimchi, aamènu vidanaadavalènani moshe sèlavichchènani chèppagaa
Yesumee hrridayakaathinyamunubatti atadee aaj~nanu meeku vraasi yichchènu gaani
Srrishtyaadinumdi (devudu) vaarini puru shunigaanu streenigaanu kaluga jesènu.
Ee hetuvucheta purushudu tana talidamdrulanu vidichi pètti tana bhaaryanu hattukònunu;
Vaariddaru ekashareeramai yumduru, ganuka vaarika iddarugaa numdaka yekashareeramugaa numduru.
Kaabatti devudu jataparachina vaarini manushyudu veruparacha koodadani vaarito chèppènu.
Imtiki vachchi shishyulu ee samgatinigoorchi aayananu marala nadigiri.
Amdukaayanatana bhaaryanu vidanaadi mariyòkatènu pèmdlichesikònuvaadu taanu vidanaadina aamè vishayamai vyabhicharimchuvaadagunu.
Mariyu stree tana purushuni vidanaadi mariyòkani pèmdlijesikòninayèdala aamè vyabhicharimchunadagunani vaarito chèppènu.
Tama chinnabiddalanu muttavalènani kòmdaraayanayòddaku vaarini teesikòni vachchiri; ayite shishyulu (vaarini teesikòni vachchina) vaarini gaddimchiri.
Yesu adi choochi kopapadichinnabiddalanu naayèddaku raaniyyudi, vaari naatamka parachavaddu; devuniraajyamu eelaativaaride.
Chinnabidda valè devuniraajyamu namgeekarimpanivaadu amdulo nèmta maatramu praveshimpadani meeto nishchayamugaa chèppu chunnaanani chèppi
Aa biddalanu ètti kaugilimchukòni, vaari meeda chetulumchi aasheervadimchènu.
Aayana bayaluderi maargamuna povuchumdagaa òkadu parugèttikònivachchi aayanayèduta mokaalloonisadbodha kudaa, nityajeevamunaku vaarasudanagutaku nenemi cheyudu nani aayana nadigènu.
Yesunannu satpurushudani yela chèppuchunnaavu? devudòkkade gaani mari èvadunu satpurushudu kaadu.
Narahatya cheyavaddu, vyabhicha rimpavaddu, dòmgilavaddu, abaddhasaakshyamu palukavaddu, mosa puchchavaddu, nee talidamdrulanu sanmaanimpumu anu aaj~nalu neeku tèliyunu gadaa ani atanito chèppènu.
Amdu katadubodhakudaa, baalyamunumdi ivanniyu anusa rimchuchune yumtinani chèppènu.

Yesu atani choochi atani premimchineeku òkati kòduvagaanunnadi; neevu vèlli neeku kaliginavanniyu amima beedalakimmu, paralokamamdu neeku dhanamu kalugunu; neevu vachchi nannu vèmbadimchumani chèppènu.
Atadu migula aastigalavaadu, ganuka aa maataku mukhamu chinnabuchchukòni, duhkhapaduchu vèllipoyènu.
Appudu yesu chuttu choochiaastigalavaaru devuni raajyamulo praveshimchuta èmto durlabhamani tana shishyu lato chèppènu.
Aayana maatalaku shishyulu vismaya mòmdiri. amduku yesu tirigi vaarito itlanènupillalaaraa, tama aastiyamdu namimakayumchuvaaru devuni raajyamulo praveshimchuta èmto durlabhamu;
Dhana vamtudu devuni raajyamulo praveshimchutakamtè òmtè soodibèjjamulo dooruta sulabhamu.
Amduku vaaru atyadhikamugaa aashcharyapadi atlayite èvadu rakshanapòmda galadani aayana nadigiri.
Yesu vaarini choochiidi manu shyulaku asaadhyame gaani, devuniki asaadhyamu kaadu; devuniki samastamunu saadhyame anènu.
Peturu idigomemu samastamunu vidichipètti ninnu vèmbadimchitimani aayanato chèppasaagènu.
Amduku yesu itlanènunaa nimittamunu suvaarta nimittamunu imtinainanu annadammulanainanu akka chèllèmdranainanu tali damdrulanainanu pillalanainanu bhoomulanainanu vidichinavaadu
Ippudu ihamamdu himsalato paatu nooramtalugaa imdlanu annadammulanu akkachèllèmdranu tallulanu pillalanu bhoomulanu, raabovu lokamamdu nityajeevamunu pòmdu nani meeto nishchayamugaa chèppuchunnaanu.
Mòdati vaaru anekulu kadapativaaraguduru, kadapativaaru mòdati vaaraguduru anènu.

Vaaru prayaanamai yèrooshalemunaku vèlluchumdiri. yesu vaariki mumdu naduchuchumdagaa vaaru vismaya mòmdiri, vèmbadimchuvaaru bhayapadiri. appudaayana marala pamdrèmduguru shishyulanu piluchukòni, tanaku sambha vimpabovuvaatini vaariki tèliyajèppanaarambhimchi
Idigo manamu yèrooshalemunaku vèlluchunnaamu; manushya kumaarudu pradhaanayaajakulakunu shaastrulakunu appagimpa badunu; vaaraayanaku maranashiksha vidhimchi aayananu anya janula kappagimchèdaru.
Vaaru aayananu apahasimchi, aayanameeda umimavesi, kòradaalato aayananu kòtti champèdaru; moodu dinamulaina taruvaata aayana tirigi lechunani chèppènu.
Jèbèdayi kumaarulaina yaakobunu yohaanunu aayanayòddaku vachchibodhakudaa, memu adugunadèlla neevu maaku cheya goruchunnaamani chèppagaa
Aayananenu meekemi cheya goruchunnaarani vaari nadigènu.
Vaarunee mahimayamdu nee kudivaipuna òkadunu nee yèdamavaipuna òkadunu koorchumdunatlu maaku daya cheyumani chèppiri.
Yesumeeremi aduguchunnaaro meeku tèliyadu; nenu traaguchunna ginnèlonidi traagutayainanu, nenu pòmduchunna baaptismamu pòmduta yainanu meecheta agunaa? ani vaari nadugagaa vaarumaa cheta agunaniri.
Appudu yesunenu traaguchunna ginnèlonidi meeru traagèdaru; nenu pòmduchunna baapti smamu meeru pòmdèdaru, gaani
Naa kudivaipunanu èdama vaipunanu koorchumdanichchuta naavashamulo ledu; adi èvariki siddhaparachabadèno vaarike (dòrakunani) vaarito chèppènu.
Takkinapadimamdi shishyulu aa maata vini, yaakobu yohaanula meeda kopapadasaagiri.
Yesu vaarini tanayòddaku pilichi vaarito itlanènuanyajanulalo adhikaarulani yèmchabadinavaaru vaarimeeda prabhutvamu cheyuduru; vaarilo gòppavaaru vaarimeeda adhikaaramu cheyudurani meeku tèliyunu.
Meelo aalaagumda koodadu. meelo èvadainanu gòppavaadai yumdagorina yèdala vaadu meeku parichaaramu cheyuvaadai yumda valènu.
Meelo èvadainanu pramukhudai yumdagorina yèdala, vaadu amdariki daasudai yumdavalènu.
Manushya kumaarudu parichaaramu cheyimchukònutaku raaledu gaani parichaaramu cheyutakunu, anekulaku pratigaa vimochana krayadhanamugaa tana praanamu ichchutakunu vachchènanènu.

Vaaru yèrikopattanamunaku vachchiri. aayana tana shishyulatonu bahu janasamoohamutonu yèrikonumdi bayaluderi vachchuchumdagaa, teemayi kumaarudagu bartimayi yanu gruddi bhikshakudu trovaprakkanu koorchumdènu.
Eeyana najareyudaina yesu ani vaadu vini daaveedu kumaarudaa yesoo, nannu karunimpumani kekalu veya mòdalupèttènu.
Oorakumdumani a nekulu vaanini gaddimchiri gaani vaadudaaveedu kumaarudaa, nannu karu nimpumani mari èkkuvagaa kekaluvesènu.
Appudu yesu nilichivaanini piluvudani chèppagaa vaaraa gruddivaanini pilichidhairyamu tèchchukònumu, aayana ninnu piluchu chunnaadu, lèmmani vaanito chèppiri.
Amtata vaadu battanu paaravesi, digguna lechi yesunòddaku vachchènu.
Yesunenu neekemi cheya goruchunnaavani vaani nadu gagaa, aa gruddivaadubodhakudaa, naaku drrishti kaluga gagaa, aa gruddivaadubodhakudaa, naaku drrishti kaluga jeyumani aayanato anènu.
Amduku yesuneevu vèllumu; nee vishvaasamu ninnu svasthaparachènani chèppènu. vèmtane vaadu trovanu aayanavèmta choopupòmdi vèllènu.
Vaaru yèrooshalemunaku sameepimchi òleevala kòmda daggaranunna betpage betaniya anu graamamulaku vachchi nappudu, aayana tana shishyulalo iddarini choochi
Mee yèdutanunna graamamunaku vèlludi; amdulo meeru praveshimpagaane kattabadiyunna yòka gaadida pilla kana badunu; daanimeeda e manushyudunu èppudunu koorchumda ledu; daanini vippi, tolukòni ramdi.
Èvadainanumeerèmduku eelaagu cheyu chunnaarani mimmu nadigina yèdalaadi prabhuvunaku kaavalasiyunnadani chèppudi. takshaname atadu daanini ikkadikitoli pampunani chèppi vaarini pampènu.
Vaaru vèllagaa veedhilo imti bayata talavaakita kattabadiyunna gaadida pilla yòkati vaariki kanabadènu; daanini vippuchumdagaa,
Akkada nilichiyunna vaarilo kòmdaru meeremi cheyuchunnaaru? gaadida pillanu èmduku vippuchunnaarani vaarinadigiri.
Amduku shishyulu, yesu aaj~naapimchinattu vaarito chèppagaa vaaru ponichchiri.
Vaaru aa gaadidapillanu yesunòddaku tolukòni vachchi, tama battalu daanipai veyagaa aayana daanimeeda koorchum dènu.
Anekulu tama battalanu daari pòdugunanu parachiri, kòmdaru taamu pòlamulalo narikina kòmmalanu parachiri.
Mariyu mumdu vèlluchumdinavaarunu vènuka vachchuchumdina vaarunu jayamu1
Prabhuvu perata vachchuvaadu stutimpabadugaaka vachchuchunna mana tamdriyaina daaveedu raajyamu stutimpabadugaaka sarvonnatamaina sthalamulalo jayamu1 ani kekalu veyuchumdiri.
Aayana yèrooshalemunaku vachchi devaalayamulo praveshimchi, chuttu samastamunu choochi, saayamkaala mainamduna pamdrèmdumamdito kooda betaniyaku vèllènu.
Marunaadu vaaru betaniyanumdi vèlluchumdagaa aayana aakaligòni

Aakulugala òka amjoorapu chèttunu dooramu numdi choochi, daanimeeda emainanu dòrakunemo ani vachchènu. daaniyòddaku vachchi choodagaa, aakulu tappa maremiyu kanabadaledu; elayanagaa adi amjoorapu pamdlakaalamu kaadu.
Amdukaayanaikameedata ènnati kini nee pamdlu èvarunu tinakumduru gaaka ani chèppènu ; idi aayana shishyulu viniri.

Vaaru yèrooshalemunaku vachchinappudu aayana devaa layamulo praveshimchi, devaalayamulo kraya vikraya mulu cheyuvaarini vèllagòtta naarambhimchi, rookalu maarchuvaari ballalanu, guvvalammuvaari peetalanu padadrosi
Devaalayamu gumda epaatrayainanu èvanini teniyya kumdènu.
Mariyu aayana bodhimchuchu naa mamdiramu samastamaina anyajanulaku praarthana mamdiramanabadunu ani vraayabadaledaa? ayite meeru daanini dòmgala guhagaa chesitiranènu.

Shaastrulunu pradhaanayaajakulunu aa maata vini, jana samoohamamtayu aayana bodhaku bahugaa aashcharya paduta choochi, aayanaku bhayapadi, aayana nelaagu samharimchudamaa ani samayamu choochuchumdiri.
Saayamkaalamainappudu aayana pattanamulonumdi bayaluderènu.
Pròdduna vaaru maargamuna povuchumdagaa aa amjoo rapuchèttu vellu mòdalukòni yèmdiyumduta choochiri.
Appudu peturu aa samgati j~naapakamunaku tèchchukònibodhakudaa, yidigo neevu shapimchina amjoorapuchèttu èmdipoyènani aayanato chèppènu.
Amduku yesu vaarito itlanènumeeru devuniyamdu vishvaasamumchudi.

Èvadainanu ee kòmdanu choochineevu èttabadi samudra mulo padaveyabadu mani chèppi, tana manassulo samde himpaka taanu chèppinadi jarugunani namimanayèdala vaadu chèppinadi jarugunani meeto nishchayamugaa chèppuchunnaanu.
Amducheta praarthana cheyunappudu meeru aduguchunna vaatinèllanu pòmdiyunnaamani nammudi; appudu avi meeku kalugunani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Meeku òkanimeeda virodha memainanu kaligiyunna yèdala, meeru niluvabadi praarthana cheyunappudèllanu vaani kshamimchudi.
Appudu paralokamamdunna mee tamdriyu mee paapamulu kshamimchunu.
Vaaru yèrooshalemunaku tirigi vachchiri. aayana devaalayamulo tiruguchumdagaa pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu pèddalunu aayanayòddakuvachchi
Neevu e adhi kaaramuvalana ee kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaavu? veetini cheyutaku ee yadhikaaramu neekèvadichchènani adigiri.
Amduku yesunenunu mimmunu òka maata adigèdanu, naa kuttaramiyyudi, appudu nenu e adhikaaramuvalana veetini cheyuchunnaano adi meeto chèppudunu.
Yohaanu ichchina baaptismamu paralokamunumdi kaliginadaa manushyulanumdi kaliginadaa? naaku uttaramiyyudani chèppènu.
Amduku vaarumanamu paralokamunumdi kaliginadani chèppinayèdala, aayanaaalaagaite meeru èmdukatani nammaledani adugunu;
Manushyulavalana kaligina dani chèppudumaa ani tamalotaamu aalochimchukòniri gaani, amdaru yohaanu nijamugaa pravakta yani yèmchiri
Ganuka prajalaku bhayapadiaa samgati maaku tèliyadani yesunaku uttaramichchiri. amduku yesue adhikaaramu valana ee kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaano adiyu nenu meeto chèppananènu.

Aayana upamaanareetigaa vaariki bodhimpanaaram bhimchènu; ètlanagaaòka manushyudu draakshatota naatimchi, daanichuttu kamchè veyimchi, draakshalatòtti tòlipimchi gopuramu kattimchi, kaapulaku daanini guttakichchi deshaamtaramupoyènu.
Pamtakaalamamdu aa kaapula numdi draakshatota pamdlalo tana bhaagamu teesikòni vachchutaku, kaapulayòddaku atadu òka daasunipampagaa
Vaaru vaani pattukòni kòtti, vattichetulato pampivesiri.
Marala atadu mariyòka daasuni vaariyòddaku pampagaa, vaaru vaani tala gaayamuchesi avamaanaparachiri.
Atadu mariyòkani pampagaa vaanini champiri. atadimka anekulanu pampagaa, vaaru kòmdarini kòttiri, kòmdarini champiri.
Imkanu ataniki priya kumaarudu òkadumdènu ganukavaaru tana kumaaruni sanmaanimchèdaranukòni tudaku vaari yòddaku atanini pampènu.
Ayite aa kaapuluitadu vaarasudu; itani champudamu ramdi, appudu svaasthyamu manadagunani tamalotaamu chèppukòni
Atanini pattukòni champi, draakshatota vèlupala paaravesiri.
Kaavuna aa draakshatota yajamaanudemi cheyunu? atadu vachchi, aa kaapulanu samharimchi, yitarulaku aa draakshatota ichchunu gadaa. mariyu
Illu kattuvaaru niraakarimchina raayi moolaku talaraayi aayènu
Idi prabhuvuvalanane kaligènu idi mana kannulaku aashcharyamu anu lekhanamu meeru chaduvaledaa? ani adugagaa
Tammunu goorchi aa upamaanamu chèppènani vaaru grahimchi aaya nanu pattukònutaku samayamu choochuchumdiri gaani jana samoohamunaku bhayapadi aayananu vidichipoyiri.
Vaaru maatalalo aayananu chikkuparachavalènani, parisayyulanu herodeeyulanu kòmdarini aayana yòddaku pampiri.

Vaaru vachchibodhakudaa, neevu satyavamtudavu; neevu èvanini lakshyapèttanivaadavani me mèrugudumu; neevu momotamulenivaadavai devuni maargamu satyamugaa bodhimchuvaadavu. kaisaruku panni chchuta nyaayamaa kaadaa?
Ichchèdamaa iyyakumdumaa? ani aayana nadigiri. aayana vaari veshadhaarananu èrigimeeru nannu èmduku shodhimchuchunnaaru? òka denaaramu1 naa yòddaku tèchchi choopudani vaarito chèppènu.
Vaaru tèchchiri, aayanaee roopamunu, pai vraatayu, èvarivani vaari nadugagaa vaarukaisaruvi aniri.
Amduku yesukaisaruvi kaisarunakunu devunivi devunikini chèllimchudani vaarito chèppagaa vaaraayananugoorchi bahugaa aashcharyapadiri.
Punarutthaanamu ledani chèppèdi saddookayyulu aayana yòddakuvachchi

Bodhakudaa, tanabhaarya bradikiyumdagaa òkadu pillalu leka chanipoyinayèdala vaani sahodarudu vaani bhaaryanu pèmdlichesikòni tana sahodaruniki samtaa namu kalugajeyavalènani moshe maaku vraasiyichchènu.
Eduguru sahodarulumdiri. mòdativaadu òka streeni pèmdlichesikòni samtaanamuleka chanipoyènu
Ganuka rèmdavavaadu aamènu pèmdli chesikònènu, vaadunu samtaa namu leka chanipoyènu; atuvalène moodavavaadunu chanipoyènu.
Itlu edugurunu samtaanamulekaye chani poyiri. amdarivènuka aa streeyu chanipoyènu.
Punarutthaanamamdu vaarilo èvaniki aamè bhaaryagaa umdunu? aamè aa yedugurikini bhaarya aayènu gadaa ani adigiri.
Amduku yesumeeru lekhanamulanugaani devuni shaktinigaani yèrugaka povutavalanane pòrabadu chunnaaru.
Vaaru mrritulalonumdi lechunappudu pèmdlichesikònaru, pèmdlikiyyabadaru gaani paraloka mamdunna dootalavalè numduru.

Vaaru lechèdarani mrritulanugoorchina samgati moshe gramthamamdali pòdanu gurimchina bhaagamulo meeru chaduvaledaa? aa bhaagamulo devudunenu abraahaamu devudanu issaaku devudanu yaakobu devudanani atanito chèppènu.
Aayana sajeevula devudu gaani mrritula devudu kaadu. kaavuna meeru bahugaa pòrabadu chunnaarani vaarito chèppènu.
Shaastrulalo òkadu vachchi, vaaru tarkimchuta vini, aayana vaariki baagugaa uttaramichchènani grahimchiaaj~na lannitilo pradhaanamainadedani aayana nadigènu.
Amduku yesupradhaanamainadi edanagaao ishraayeloo, vinumu; mana devudaina prabhuvu adviteeya prabhuvu.
Neevu nee poornahrridayamutonu, nee poornaatmatonu, nee poornavivekamutonu, nee poornabalamutonu, nee devudaina prabhuvunu premimpavalè nanunadi pradhaanamaina aaj~na.
Rèmdavadi, neevu ninnuvalè nee pòruguvaanini premimpavalè nanunadi rèmdava aaj~na; veetikamtè mukhyamaina aaj~na mare diyu ledani atanito chèppènu
Aa shaastribodhakudaa, baagugaa chèppitivi; aayana adviteeyudaniyu, aayana tappa veròkadu ledaniyu neevu chèppina maata satyame.

Poorna hrridayamutonu, poornavivekamutonu, poorna balamutonu, aayananu premimchutayu òkadu tannu valè tana pòruguvaani premimchutayu sarvaamga homamulannitikamtènu balulakamtènu adhikamani aaya nato chèppènu.
Atadu vivekamugaa nuttaramichchènani yesu grahimchineevu devuni raajyamunaku dooramuga levani atanito chèppènu. aa taruvaata èvadunu aaya nanu e prashnayu aduga tègimpaledu.
Òkappudu yesu devaalayamulo bodhimchuchumdagaa kreestu, daaveedu kumaarudani shaastrulu chèppuchunnaa remi?
Nenu nee shatruvulanu neeku paadapeethamugaa umchu varaku neevu naa kudivaipuna koorchumdumani prabhuvu naa prabhuvuto chèppènu ani daaveede parishuddhaatmavalana chèppènu.
Daaveedu aaya nanu prabhuvani chèppuchunnaade, aayana elaagu atani kumaarudagunani adigènu. saamaanyajanulu aayana maatalu samtoshamuto vinuchumdiri.
Mariyu aayana vaariki bodhimchuchu nitlanènu shaastrulanugoorchi jaagrattapadudi. vaaru niluvu tamgeelu dharimchukòni tirugutanu, samtaveedhulalo vamdanamulanu
Samaajamamdiramulalo agrapeethamulanu, vimdulalo agra sthaanamulanu koruchu
Vidhavaraamdra yimdlu digamim guchu, maayaveshamugaa deerghapraarthanalu cheyuduru. veeru mari visheshamugaa shiksha pòmduduranènu.
Aayana kaanukapèttè yèduta koorchumdi, janasamoo hamu aa kaanukapèttèlo dabbulu veyuta choochu chumdènu. dhanavamtulainavaaranekulu amdulo vishesha mugaa sòmmu veyuchumdiri.
Òka beeda vidhavaraalu vachchi rèmdu kaasulu veyagaa
Aayana tana shishyulanu pilichikaanukapèttèlo dabbulu vesina vaaramdarikamtè ee beeda vidhavaraalu èkkuva vesènani meeto nishchaya mugaa chèppuchunnaanu.
Vaaramdaru tamaku kaligina samrriddhilonumdi vesiri gaani, yeemè tana lemilo tanaku kaliginadamtayu, anagaa tana jeevanamamtayu vesènani chèppènu.
Aayana devaalayamulonumdi vèlluchumdagaa aayana shishyulalo òkadubodhakudaa, yee raallelaativo yee kattadamulu elaativo choodumani aayanato anènu.
Amduku yesuee gòppa kattadamulu choochuchunnaave; raatimeeda raayi yòkatiyaina ikkada nilichiyumdakumda padadroyabadunani atanito chèppènu.
Aayana devaalayamu èduta òleevala kòmdameeda koorchumdiyumdagaa, peturu yaakobu yohaanu amdrèya anu vaaru aayananu choochi
Ivi èppudu jarugunu? ivanniyu nèraverabovukaalamunaku e gurutu kalugunu? adi maato chèppumani aayananu ekaamta mamdu adugagaa
Yesu vaarito itlu chèppasaagènu èvadunu mimmunu mosapuchchakumda choochukònudi.
Anekulu naa perata vachchinene aayananani chèppi anekulanu mosapuchchèdaru.
Meeru yuddhamulanu goorchiyu yuddhasamaachaaramulanu goorchiyu vinu nappudu kalavarapadakudi; ivi jarugavalasiyunnavi gaani amtamu vèmtane raadu.
Janamumeediki janamunu raajyamumeediki raajyamunu lechunu, akkadakkada bhookampamulu kalugunu, karavulu vachchunu. ive veda nalakupraarambhamu.

Mimmunugoorchi meere jaagrattapadudi. vaaru mimmunu sabhala kappagimchèdaru; mimmunu samaajamamdiramulalo kòttimchèdaru; meeru vaariki saakshyaarthamai adhipatula yèdutanu raajula yèdutanu naa nimittamu niluvabadè daru.
Sakala janamulaku suvaarta mumdugaa prakatimpa badavalènu.
Vaaru mimmunu appagimchutaku kònipovu nappudu meeruemi chèppudumaa ani mumdugaa chimtimpakudi, aa gadiyalone meekedi iyyabaduno ade chèppudi; chèppuvaadu parishuddhaatmaye gaani meeru kaaru.
Sahodarudu sahodaruni, tamdri kumaaruni, maranamuna kappagimturu; kumaarulu talidamdrulameeda lechi vaarini champimturu;
Naa naamamu nimittamu amdaricheta meeru dveshimpabaduduru; amtamuvaraku sahimchinavaade rakshana pòmdunu.
Mariyu naashakaramaina heyavastuvu niluvaraani sthalamamdu niluchuta meeru choochunappudu chaduvu vaadu grahimchugaakayoodayalo umduvaaru kòmdalaku paaripovalènu;
Middèmeeda umduvaadu imtilonumdi edainanu teesikònipovutakai digi amdulo praveshimpakoodadu;
Pòlamulo umduvaadu tana vastramu teesikònipovutaku imtiloniki tirigi raakoodadu.
Ayyo, aa dinamulalo garbhinulakunu paalichchu vaarikini shrama.
Adi chalikaalamamdu sambhavimpakumda valènani praarthimchudi.
Avi shramagala dinamulu; devudu srrijimchina srrishtyaadinumdi idivaraku amta shrama kaluga ledu, ika ènnadunu kalugabodu.
Prabhuvu aa dinamulanu takkuvacheyaniyèdala e shareeriyu tappimchu kònaka povunu; erparachabadinavaari nimittamu, anagaa taanu erparachukònina vaarinimittamu aayana aa dinamulanu takkuva chesènu.
Kaagaaidigo kreestu ikkada nunnaadu, adigo akkada nunnaadu ani yèvadainanu meeto chèppinayèdala nammakudi.
Aa kaalamamdu abaddhapu kreestulunu abaddhapu pravaktalunu vachchi, saadhyamainayèdala erparachabadinavaarini mosapuchchutakai soochaka kriyalanu mahatkaaryamulanu agaparachèdaru.
Meeru jaagrattagaa umdudi; idigo samastamunu meeto mumdugaa chèppi yunnaanu.
Aa dinamulalo aa shramateerina taruvaata cheekati sooryuni kammunu, chamdrudu tana kaamtini iyyadu, aakaashamunumdi nakshatramulu raalunu,
Aakaashamamdali shaktulu kadalimpabadunu.
Appudu manushyakumaarudu mahaa prabhaavamutonu mahimatonu meghaaroodhudai vachchuta choochèdaru.
Appudaayana tana dootalanu pampi, bhoomyamtamu mòdalukòni aakaashaamtamuvaraku naludikkulanumdi taanu erparachukòninavaarini pogu cheyimchunu.
Amjoorapuchèttunu choochi yòka upamaanamu nerchu kònudi. daani kòmma yimka letadai chigirimchunappudu vasamtakaalamu sameepamugaa unnadani meeku tèliyunu.
Aa prakaarame meeru ee samgatulu jaruguta choochu nappudu aayana sameepamunane dvaaramu daggarane unnaadani tèlisikònudi.
Ivanniyu jarugu varaku ee taramu gatimpadani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppu chunnaanu.
Aakaashamunu bhoomiyunu gatimchunu gaani naa maatalu gatimpavu.
Aa dinamunu goorchiyu aa gadiyanu goorchiyu tamdri tappa e manushyudainanu, paralokamamdali doota lainanu, kumaarudainanu èrugaru.
Jaagrattapadudi; mèlakuvagaanumdi praarthanacheyudi; aa kaalamèppudu vachchuno meeku tèliyadu.

Òka manushyudu tana daasulaku adhikaaramichchi, prativaaniki vaani vaani pani niyamimchimèlakuvagaa numdumani dvaarapaalakuniki aaj~naapimchi, yillu vidichi deshaamtaramu poyinatte (aa kaalamu umdunu.)
Imti yajamaanudu pròddu grumkivachchuno, ardharaatrivachchuno, kodikooyunappudu vachchuno, tèllavaarunappudu vachchuno, yèppudu vachchuno meeku tèliyadu.
Aayana akasmaattugaa vachchi meeru nidrabovuchumduta choochunemo ganuka meeru mèlakuvagaa numdudi.
Nenu meeto chèppuchunnadi amdaritonu chèppuchunnaanu; mèlakuvagaa numdudanènu.

Rèmdu dinamulaina pimmata paskaapamduga, anagaa puliyani ròttèlapamduga vachchènu. appudu pradhaana yaajakulunu shaastrulunu maayopaayamucheta aayana nelaagu pattukòni champudumaa yani aalochimchukònu chumdiri gaani
Prajalalo allari kalugu nemo ani pamdugalo vaddani chèppukòniri.

Aayana betaniyalo kushtharogiyaina seemonu imta bhojanamunaku koorchumdiyunnappudu òka stree mikkili viluvagala achcha jataamaamsi attarubuddi teesikòni vachchi, aa attarubuddi pagulagòtti aa attaru aayana talameeda posènu.
Ayite kòmdaru kopapadi ee attaru eelaagu nashtaparachanela?
Ee attaru munnooru denaara mula1 kamtè èkkuva vèlakammi, beedalakiyyavachchunani chèppi aamènugoorchi sanugukòniri.
Amduku yesu itlanènueemè jolikipokudi; eemènu èmduku tòmdarapèttuchunnaaru? eemè naayèdala mamchi kaaryamu chesènu.
Beedalu èllappudunu meetone yunnaaru, meekishtamainappudèlla vaariki melu cheya vachchunu; nenu èllappudunu meeto numdanu.
Eemè tana shaktikòladichesi, naa bhoosthaapana nimittamu naa shareeramunu mumdugaa abhishekimchènu.
Sarvalokamulo èkkada ee suvaarta prakatimpabaduno akkada eemè chesinadiyu j~naapakaarthamugaa prashamsimpabadunani meeto nishchayamugaa chèppuchunnaananènu.
Pamdrèmdumamdilo nòkadagu iskariyotu yoodaa, pradhaanayaajakulachetiki aayananu appagimpa valènani vaariyòddaku pogaa
Vaaru vini, samtoshimchi vaaniki dravyamittumani vaagdaanamu chesiri ganuka vaadu aayananu appagimchutaku tagina samayamu kanipèttu chumdènu.

Puliyani ròttèla pamdugalo mòdati dinamuna vaaru paskaapashuvunu vadhimchunappudu, aayana shishyuluneevu paskaanu bhujimchutaku memèkkadiki vèlli siddhaparacha valènani koruchunnaavani aayana nadugagaa,
Aayana meeru pattanamuloniki vèlludi; akkada neellakumda moyuchunna yòka manushyudu meekèdurupadunu;
Vaani vèmtaboyi vaadu èkkada praveshimchuno aa yimti yajamaanuni choochinenu naa shishyulato kooda paskaanu bhujimchutaku naa vididi gadi yèkkadanani bodhakudadugu chunnaadani chèppudi.
Atadu saamagrito siddhaparachabadina gòppa medagadi meeku choopimchunu; akkada manakòraku siddhaparachu dani chèppi tana shishyulalo iddarini pampènu.
Shishyulu vèlli pattanamuloniki vachchi aayana vaarito chèppinattu kanugòni paskaanu siddha parachiri.
Saayamkaalamainappudu aayana tana pamdrèmdumamdi shishyulato kooda vachchènu.
Vaaru koorchumdi bhojanamu cheyuchumdagaa yesumeelo òkadu, anagaa naato bhujimchuchunnavaadu nannu appagimchunani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppuchunnaanani vaarito chèppagaa
Vaaru duhkhapadinenaa ani yòkani taruvaata òkadu aayana nadugasaagiri.
Amdukaayanapamdrèmdu mamdilo òkade, anagaa naatokooda paatralo (chèyyi) mumchu vaade.

Nijamugaa manushyakumaarudu aayananugoorchi vraayabadinattu povuchunnaadu; ayite èvanicheta manushyakumaarudu appagimpabaduchunnaado, aa manu shyuniki shrama; aa manushyudu puttiyumdaniyèdala vaaniki melanènu.
Vaaru bhojanamu cheyuchumdagaa, aayana yòka ròttènu pattukòni, aasheervadimchi virichi, vaarikichchimeeru teesikònudi; idi naa shareeramanènu.
Pimmata aayana ginnèpattukòni krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchi daani vaari kichchènu; vaaramdaru daanilonidi traagiri.
Appudaayana idi nibamdhanavishayamai2 anekula kòraku chimdimpabadu chunna naa raktamu.
Nenu devuni raajyamulo draakshaa rasamu kròttadigaa traagudinamuvaraku ikanu daanini traaganani meeto nishchayamugaa chèppuchunnaananènu.
Amtata vaaru keertana paadi òleevalakòmdaku vèlliri.
Appudu yesu vaarini choochimeeramdaru abhyamtara padèdaru; gòrrala kaaparini kòttudunu; gòrralu chèdari povunu ani vraayabadiyunnadi gadaa.
Ayite nenu lechina taruvaata meekamtè mumdugaa galilaya loniki vèllèdananènu.
Amduku peturuamdaru abhyamtarapadinanu nenu abhyamtarapadanani aayanato chèppagaa
Yesu atani choochineti raatri kodi rèmdumaarulu kooyakamunupe neevu nannu èruganani mummaaru chèppèdavani neeto nishchayamugaa chèppuchunnaa nanènu.
Atadu mari khamditamugaanenu neeto kooda chaavavalasi vachchinanu ninnu èruganani chèppane chèppananènu. atlu vaaramdarunaniri.
Vaaru gètsemane anabadina chotunaku vachchinappudu, aayana--nenu praarthanachesi vachchuvaraku meerikkada koorchumdudani tana shishyulato chèppi
Peturunu yaakobunu yohaanunu vèmtabèttu kònipoyi, migula vibhraamti nòmdutakunu chimtaa kraamtudagutakunu aaram bhimchènu
Appudaayananaa praanamu maranamagu namtagaa duhkhamulo munigiyunnadi; meerikkada umdi mèlakuvagaa numdudani vaarito chèppi
Kòmtadooramu saagipoyi nelameeda padi, saadhyamaite aa gadiya tanayòddanumdi tòlagipovalènani praarthimchuchu
Naayanaa tamdree, neeku samastamu saadhyamu; ee ginnè naayòddanumdi tòlagimchumu; ayinanu naa yishta prakaaramu kaadu nee chittaprakaarame kaanimmu anènu.
Marala aayana vachchi vaaru nidrimchuchumduta choochiseemonoo, neevu nidrimchuchunnaavaa? òkka gadiya yainanu melukòniyumdalevaa?
Meeru shodhanalo praveshimchakumdunatlu mèlakuvagaanumdi praarthana cheyudi; aatma siddhame gaani shareeramu balaheenamani peturuto chèppi
Tirigi poyi, yimtakumumdu palikina maatalane palukuchu praarthimchènu.
Aayana tirigivachchi choodagaa, vaaru nidrimchuchumdiri; elayanagaa vaari kannulu bhaaramugaa umdènu, aayanakemi uttaramiyyavalèno vaariki tocha ledu.
Aayana moodava saari vachchimeerika nidrapoyi alasata teerchukònudi. ika chaalunu, gadiya vachchinadi; idigo manushyakumaarudu paapulachetiki appagimpabadu chunnaadu;
Lèmdi vèlludamu; idigo nannu appagimchu vaadu sameepimchiyunnaadani chèppènu.

Vèmtane, aayana imkanu maatalaaduchumdagaa pamdrèmdumamdi shishyulalo òkadaina iskariyotu yoodaa vachchènu. vaanitokooda bahujanulu kattulu gudiyalu pattukòni, pradhaanayaajakulayòddanumdiyu shaastrulayòddanumdiyu pèddalayòddanumdiyu vachchiri.
Aayananu appagimchuvaadunenèvarini muddupèttu kòmduno aayane (yesu); aayananu pattukòni bhadramugaa kònipovudani vaariki gurutu chèppiyumdènu.
Vaadu vachchi vèmtane aayanayòddaku poyibodhakudaa ani chèppi, aayananu muddupèttukònagaa
Vaaru aayanameeda padi aayananu pattukòniri.
Daggara nilichi yunnavaarilo òkadu kattidoosi pradhaanayaajakuni daasuni kòtti vaani chèvi tèganarikènu.
Amduku yesumeeru bamdipotu dòmgameediki vachchinattu kattulatonu gudiyalatonu nannu pattukòna vachchitiraa?
Nenu pratidinamu devaalayamulo meeyòdda umdi bodhimchu chumdagaa, meeru nannu pattukònaledu, ayite lekhanamulu nèraverunatlu (eelaagu jaruguchunnadani chèppènu).
Appudu vaaramdaru aayananu vidichi paaripoyiri.
Tana digambara shareeramumeeda naarabatta vesikòniyunna yòka paduchuvaadu aayana vèmta vèlluchumdagaa, vaaratanini pattukòniri.
Atadu naarabatta vidichi, digam barudai paaripoyènu.
Vaaru yesunu pradhaanayaajakuniyòddaku teesikòni poyiri. pradhaanayaajakulu pèddalu shaastrulu amda runu atanitokoodavachchiri.
Peturu pradhaanayaajakuni yimtimumgitivaraku dooramunumdi aayana vèmtapoyi bamtrautulatokooda koorchumdi, mamtayòdda chali kaachu kònuchumdènu.
Pradhaanayaajakulunu mahaasabhavaaramda runu yesunu champimpavalènani aayanameeda saakshyamu vèdakirigaani, yemiyu vaariki dòrakaledu.
Anekulu aayanameeda abaddhasaakshyamu palikinanu vaari saakshyamulu òkadaaniki òkati saripadaledu.
Appudu kòmdaru lechi chetipaniyaina ee devaalayamunu padagòtti, moodu dina mulalo chetipanikaani mariyòka devaalayamunu nenu kattudunani veedu chèppuchumdagaa vimtimani
Aayanameeda abaddhasaakshyamu chèppiri
Gaani aalaagainanu veeri saakshyamunu saripadaledu.
Pradhaanayaajakudu vaari madhyanu lechi nilichiuttaramemiyu chèppavaa? veeru nee meeda paluku chunna saakshyamemani yesu nadigènu.
Ayite aayana uttaramemiyu chèppaka oorakumdènu. tirigi pradhaana yaajakuduparamaatmuni kumaarudavaina kreestuvu neevenaa? ani aayana nadugagaa
Yesuavunu nene; meeru manushyakumaarudu sarvashaktimamtuni kudipaarshvamuna koorchumdutayu, aakaashameghaaroodhudai vachchutayu choochèdarani chèppènu.
Pradhaanayaajakudu tana vastra mulu chimpukònimanaku ika saakshulato pani yemi?
Ee devadooshana meeru vinnaaru kaaraa; meekemi tochu chunnadani adugagaa vaaramdarumaranamunaku paatrudani aayanameeda nerasthaapanachesiri.
Kòmdaru aayanameeda umimavesi aayana mukhamunaku musukuvesi, aayananu gudduchupravachimpumani aayanato chèppasaagiri. bamtrautulunu aayananu arachetulato kòtti pattukòniri.
Peturu mumgiti krimdibhaagamulo umdagaa pradhaana yaajakuni panikattèlalo òkatè vachchi
Peturu chali kaachukònuchumduta choochènu; atanini nidaanimchi choochi neevunu najareyudagu aa yesuto kooda umdinavaadavu kaavaa? anènu.
Amdukatadu aayana èvado nenèru ganu; neevu chèppinadi naaku bodhapadaledani chèppi nadava loniki vèllènu; amtata kodi koosènu.
Aa panikattè atanini choochiveedu vaarilo òkadani daggara nilichiyunna vaarito marala chèppasaagènu.
Atadu maralanenu kaananènu. kòmtasepaina taruvaata daggara nilichiyunnavaaru marala peturunu choochinijamugaa neevu vaarilo òkadavu; neevu galilayudavu gadaa aniri.
Amdukatadumeeru chèppuchunna manushyuni nenèruganani chèppi, shapimchukònutakunu òttu bèttukònutakunu mòdalu pèttènu.
Vèmtane rèmdavamaaru kodikoosènu ganukakodi rèmdu maarulu kooyakamunupu neevu nannu èruga nani mummaaru chèppèdavani yesu tanato chèppina maata peturu j~naapakamunaku tèchchukòni talapoyuchu edchènu.
Udayamu kaagaane pradhaanayaajakulunu pèdda lunu shaastrulunu mahaasabhavaaramdarunu kalisi aalochana chesi, yesunu bamdhimchi teesikònipoyi pilaatunaku appa gimchiri.
Pilaatuyoodularaajavu neevenaa? ani aayana nadugagaa aayananeevannatte ani atanito chèppènu.
Pradhaanayaajakulu aayanameeda anekamaina neramulu mopagaa
Pilaatu aayananu choochi maralaneevu uttara memiyu chèppavaa? nee meeda veeru ènnènni neramulu mopuchunnaaro choodumanènu.
Ayinanu yesu mari e uttaramu chèppaledu ganuka pilaatu aashcharya padènu.
Aa pamdugalo vaaru korukònina yòka khayideeni pilaatu vidipimchuvaadu.
Adhikaarula nèdirimchi, kalaha mulo narahatya chesinavaarito kooda bamdhimchabadiyumdina barabba anu òkadumdènu.
Janulu gumpugaa koodivachchi, atadu adivaraku tamaku cheyuchuvachchina prakaaramu cheyavalènani adugagaa
Pradhaanayaajakulu asooya cheta yesunu appagimchirani
Pilaatu tèlisikòninenu yoodula raajunu meeku vidudala cheyagoruchunnaaraa? ani adigènu.
Atadu barabbanu tamaku vidudala cheya valènani janulu adugukònunatlu pradhaanayaajakulu vaarini prerepimchiri.
Amduku pilaatu alaagaite yoodula raajani meeru chèppuvaani nenemi cheyudunani marala vaari nadigènu.
Vaaruvaanini siluvaveyumani marala kekaluvesiri.
Amduku pilaatuèmduku? atade chèdukaaryamu chesè nani vaari nadugagaa vaaruvaanini siluvaveyumani mari èkkuvagaa kekaluvesiri.
Pilaatu janasamoohamunu samtoshapèttutaku manassugalavaadai vaariki barabbanu vidudalachesi yesunu kòradaalato kòttimchi siluvaveya nappagimchènu.
Amtata sainikulu aayananu pretoryamanu adhikaara mamdiramulopaliki teesikònipoyi, sainikulanamdarini sama koorchukòninataruvaata
Aayanaku oodaaramgu vastramu tòdigimchi, mumdla kireetamunu aayana tala meedapètti,
Yoodularaajaa, neeku shubhamani chèppi aayanaku vamdanamu cheyasaagiri.
Mariyu rèlluto aayana talameedakòtti, aayanameeda umimavesi, mokaallooni aayanaku nama skaaramuchesiri.
Vaaru aayananu apahasimchina taru vaata aayanameeda nunna oodaaramgu vastramu teesivesi, aayana battalaayanaku tòdigimchi, aayananu siluvaveyu taku teesikònipoyiri.
Kureneeyudaina seemonanu òkadu pallètoorinumdi vachchi aa maargamuna povuchumdagaa, aayana siluvanu moyu taku atanini balavamtamuchesiri.
Atadu alèksamdru nakunu roophunakunu tamdri. vaaru gòlgòtaa anabadina chotunaku aayananu teesikòni vachchiri. gòlgòtaa anagaa kapaala sthalamani arthamu.
Amtata bolamu kalipina draakshaarasamu aayanakichchiri gaani aayana daani puchchu kònaledu.
Vaaraayananu siluvavesi, aayana vastramula bhaagamu èvaniki raavalèno cheetluvesi, vaatini pamchu kòniri.
Aayananu siluvavesinappudu pagalu tòmimadi gamtalaayènu.
Mariyuyoodularaajaina yesu ani aayanameeda mopabadina neramunu vraasi paigaanumchiri.
Mariyu kudivaipuna òkanini èdamavaipuna òkanini
Iddaru bamdipotu dòmgalanu aayanatòkooda siluvavesiri.
Appudu aa maargamuna vèlluchunnavaaru tama talaloochuchu aahaa devaalayamunu padagòtti moodu dinamulalo kattuvaadaa,
Siluvameedanumdi digi, ninnu neeve rakshimchu kònumani chèppi aayananu dooshimchiri.
Atlu shaastru lunu pradhaanayaajakulunu apahaasyamu cheyuchuveeditarulanu rakshimchènu, tannu taanu rakshimchukònaledu.
Ishraayelu raajagu kreestu ippudu siluvameedanumdi digi raavachchunu. appudu manamu choochi nammudamani yòkarito òkaru chèppukòniri. aayanatokooda siluva veyabadinavaarunu aayananu nimdimchiri.
Madhyaahnamu mòdalukòni moodu gamtalavaraku aa deshamamtatanu cheekati kammènu.
Moodu gamtalaku yesu èloyee, èloyee, laamaa sabaktaanee ani biggaragaa keka vesènu; a maatalaku naa devaa, naa devaa, nannu èmduku chèyyividichitivani arthamu.
Daggara nilichinavaarilo kòmdaru aa maatalu vini adigo eleeyaanu piluchu chunnaadaniri.
Òkadu parugèttipoyi yòka spamjee chirakaalomumchi rèlluna tagilimchi aayanaku traaganichchi taaludi; eleeyaa veeni dimpavachchu nemo chootamanènu.
Amtata yesu gòppa kekavesi praanamu vidichènu.
Appudu devaalayapu tèra painumdi krimdivaraku rèmdugaa chinigènu.
Aayana kèdurugaa nilichiyunna shataadhipati aayana eelaagu praanamu viduchuta choochi--nijamugaa ee manushyudu devuni kumaarude ani chèppènu. kòmdaru streelu dooramunumdi choochuchumdiri.
Vaarilo magdalene mariyayu, chinnayaakobu yose anuvaari talliyaina mariyayu, salomeyu umdiri.
Aayana galilayalo unnappudu veeraayananu vèmbadimchi aayanaku parichaaramu chesinavaaru. veeru kaaka aayanato yèroosha lemunaku vachchina itara streela nekulunu vaarilo umdiri.
Aa dinamu siddhaparachu dinamu, anagaa vishraamti dinamunaku poorvadinamu
Ganuka saayamkaalamainappudu arimatayiya yosepu tègimchi, pilaatunòddaku vèlli yesu dehamu (tanakimmani) yadigènu. atadu ghanata vahimchina yòka sabhyudai, devuni raajyamukòraku èduru choochuvaadu.
Pilaatuaayana imtalone chani poyènaa ani aashcharyapadi yòka shataadhipatinitana yòddaku pilipimchiaayana imtalone chanipoyènaa ani atani nadigènu.
Shataadhipativalana samgati tèlisikòni, yosepunaku aa shavamu nappagimchènu.
Atadu naarabatta kòni, aayananu dimpi, aa battato chutti, bamdalo tòlipimchina samaadhiyamdu aayananu pètti aa samaadhi dvaaramunaku raayi pòrlimchènu.
Magdalene mariyayu yose talliyaina mariyayu aayana yumchabadina chotu choochiri.
Vishraamtidinamu gadachipogaane magdalene mariyayu yaakobu talliyaina mariyayu salomeyu vachchi, aayanaku pooyavalènani sugamdhadravyamulu kòniri.
Vaaru aadivaaramuna pèmdalakada (lechi, bayaluderi) sooryodayamainappudu samaadhiyòddaku vachchuchumdagaa,
Samaadhi dvaaramunumdi manakòraku aa raayi yèvadu pòrlimchunani òkarito òkaru chèppukònuchumdiri.
Vaaru vachchi kannulèttichoodagaa, raayi pòrlimpabadi yumduta choochiri. aa raayi yèmto pèddadi.
Appudu vaaru samaadhilo praveshimchi, tèllani niluvutamgee dharimchu kòniyunna yòka paduchuvaadu kudivaipuna koorchumduta choochi migula kalavarapadiri.
Amdu katadukalavara padakudi siluva veyabadina najareyudagu yesunu meeru vèdakuchunnaaru; aayana lechiyunnaadu, ikkada ledu; vaaru aayananu umchina sthalamu choodudi.
Meeru vèlli aayana meekamtè mumdugaa galilayaloniki vèlluchunnaa daniyu, aayana meeto chèppinattu akkada meeru aayananu chooturaniyu aayana shishyulatonu peturu tonu chèppudanènu.
Vaaru bayataku vachchi, vismayamu nòmdi vanakuchu samaadhiyòddanumdi paaripoyiri; vaaru bhayapadinamduna èvanito emiyu chèppa ledu.
Aadivaaramu tèllavaarinappudu yesu lechi, taanu edu dayyamulanu vèllagòttina magdalene mariyaku mòdata kanabadènu.
Aayanato umdinavaaru duhkhapadi yedchu chumdagaa aamè vèlli aa samgati vaariki tèliya jesènu gaani,
Aayana bradikiyunnaadaniyu aamèku kanabadè naniyu vaaru vini nammakapoyiri.
Aa taruvaata vaarilo iddaru òka pallètooriki nadichi povuchumdagaa, aayana maaruroopamugalavaadai vaariki pratyakshamaayènu.
Vaaru vèlli takkina vaariki aa samgati tèliyajesiri gaani, vaaru veeri maatanainanu nammaka poyiri.

Pimmata padunòkamdumamdi shishyulu bhojanamunaku koorchunnappudu aayana vaariki pratyakshamai, taanu lechina taruvaata tannu choochinavaari maata nammanamduna vaari apanamimaka nimittamunu hrridayakaathi nyamu nimittamunu vaarini gaddimchènu.
Mariyumeeru sarvalokamunaku vèlli sarvasrrishtiki suvaartanu prakatimchudi.
Namima baaptismamu pòmdinavaadu rakshimpabadunu; nammani vaaniki shiksha vidhimpabadunu.
Namimanavaarivalana ee soochaka kriyalu kanabadunu; evanagaa, naa naamamuna dayya mulanu vèllagòttuduru; kròtta bhaashalu maatalaadu duru,
Paamulanu ètti pattukòmduru, maranakara mainadedi traaginanu adi vaariki haani cheyadu, rogula meeda chetulumchinappudu vaaru svasthata nòmdudurani vaarito chèppènu.
Eelaagu prabhuvaina yesu vaarito maatalaadina taruvaata paralokamunaku cherchukònabadi, devuni kudi paarshvamuna aaseenudayyènu.
Vaaru bayaluderi vaakya mamtata prakatimchiri. prabhuvu vaariki sahakaarudai yumdi, vènuvèmta jaruguchuvachchina2 soochaka kriyalavalana vaakyamunu sthiraparachuchumdènu. aamen‌.
Ghanatavahimchina thèyòphilaa,
Aarambhamunumdi kannu laara choochi vaakyasevakulainavaaru manaku appagimchina prakaaramu manamadhyanu nèraverina kaaryamulanugoorchi vivaramuga vraayutaku anekulu poonukònnaaru
Ganuka neeku upadeshimpabadina samgatulu nishchayamugaa jariginavani neevu tèlisikònutaku vaati nannitini mòdatanumdi tarachi parishkaaramugaa tèlisikòniyunna nenunu nee perata
Vaatinigoorchi varusagaa rachimchuta yuktamani yèmchitini.
Yoodayadeshapu raajaina herodu dinamulalo abeeyaa taragatilonunna jèkaryaa anu òka yaajaku dumdènu. atani bhaarya aharonu kumaartèlalo òkatè; aamè peru èleesabètu.
Veeriddaru prabhuvuyòkka sakala maina aaj~nalachòppunanu nyaayavidhula chòppunanu nirapa raadhulugaa naduchukònuchu devuni drrishtiki neetimamtulai yumdiri.
Èleesabètu gòdraalainamduna vaariki pillalu lekapoyiri; mariyu vaariddaru bahu kaalamu gadachina (vrriddhulairi.)
Jèkaryaa tana taragati kramamuchòppuna devuniyèduta yaajaka dharmamu jarigimchuchumdagaa
Yaajaka maryaada chòppuna prabhuvu aalayamuloniki vèlli dhoopamuveyu taku ataniki vamtu vachchènu.
Dhoopa samayamamdu prajala samoohamamtayu vèlupala praarthana cheyuchumdagaa
Prabhuvu doota dhoopavedika kudivaipuna nilichi ataniki kana badagaa
Jèkaryaa atani choochi, tòmdarapadi bhayapadina vaadaayènu.
Appudaa doota atanitojèkaryaa bhaya padakumu; nee praarthana vinabadinadi, nee bhaaryayaina èleesa bètu neeku kumaaruni kanunu, ataniki yohaanu anu peru pèttuduvu.
Atadu prabhuvu drrishtiki gòppavaadai, draakshaarasamainanu madyamainanu traagaka,
Tana talligarbha muna puttinadi mòdalukòni parishuddhaatmato nimdukònina vaadai,
Ishraayeleeyulalo anekulanu prabhuvaina vaari devuni vaipunaku trippunu.

Mariyu atadu tamdrula hrridayamulanu pillala tattunakunu, avidheyulanu neeti mamtula j~naanamu nanusarimchutakunu trippi, prabhuvu kòraku aayattapadiyunna prajalanu siddha parachutakai eleeyaayòkka aatmayu shaktiyu galavaadai aayanaku mumdugaa vèllunu ganuka neeku samtoshamunu mahaa aanamda munu kalugunu; atadu puttinamduna anekulu samto shimturanènu.
Jèkaryaayidi naakelaagu tèliyunu? nenu musalivaadanu, naabhaaryayu bahukaalamu gada chinadani aa dootato chèppagaa
Dootanenu devuni samukhamamdu niluchu gabriyelunu; neeto maatalaaduta kunu ee suvartamaanamu neeku tèluputakunu pampabaditini.
Mariyu naa maatalu vaatikaalamamdu nèraverunu; neevu vaatini nammaledu ganuka ee samgatulu jarugu dinamu varaku neevu maatalaadaka maunivai yumduvani atanito chèppènu.
Prajalu jèkaryaakòraku kanipèttuchumdi, aala yamunamdu atadu aalasyamu chesinamduku aashcharyapadiri.
Atadu vèlupaliki vachchinappudu vaarito maatalaadaleka poyinamduna, aalayamu namdu ataniki darshanamu kaligina dani vaaru grahimchiri; appudatadu vaariki samj~nalu cheyuchu, moogavaadai ¸
Atadu sevacheyu dinamulu sampoorna mainappudu tana yimtiki vèllènu.
Aa dinamulaina pimmata atani bhaarya èleesabètu garbha vatiyaimanushyulalo naakumdina avamaanamunu teesi veyutaku
Nannu kataakshimchina dinamulalo prabhuvu eelaaguna chesènanukòni, ayidu nèlalu itarula kamta badakumdènu.
Aarava nèlalo gabriyelanu devadoota galilayaloni najaretanu oorilo
Daaveedu vamshasthudaina yosepanu òka purushuniki pradhaanamu cheyabadina kanyakayòddaku devuni cheta pampabadènu. aa kanyaka peru mariya.
Aa doota lopaliki vachchi aamènu choochidayaapraapturaalaa neeku shubhamu; prabhuvu neeku todaiyunnaadani chèppènu.
Aamè aa maataku bahugaa tòmdarapadiee shubhavachana memito ani aalochimchu kònuchumdagaa
Doota mariyaa,bhayapadakumu; devunivalana neevu krripapòmditivi.
Idigo neevu garbhamu dharimchi kumaaruni kani aayanaku yesu anu peru pèttuduvu;
Aayana gòppavaadai sarvonnatuni kumaa rudanabadunu; prabhuvaina devudu aayana tamdriyaina daaveedu simhaasanamunu aayana kichchunu.
Aayana yaakobu vamshasthulanu yugayuga mulu elunu; aayana raajyamu amtamulenidai yumdunani aamèto chèppènu.
Amduku mariyanenu purushuni èruganidaanane; yidelaagu jarugunani dootato anagaa
Dootaparishuddhaatma neemeediki vachchunu; sarvonnatuni shakti ninnu kammukònunu ganuka puttabovu shishuvu parishuddhudai devuni kumaarudanabadunu.
Mariyu nee bamdhuvuraalu èleesabètukooda tana vrriddhaapyamamdu òka kumaaruni garbhamu dharimchi yunnadi; gòdraalanabadina aamèku idi aaravamaasamu;
Devudu chèppina yemaatayainanu nirartha kamu kaaneradani aamèto chèppènu.
Amduku mariyaidigo prabhuvu daasuraalanu; nee maata chòppuna naaku jarugunu gaaka anènu. amtata doota aamèyòdda numdi vèllènu.
Aa dinamulayamdu mariya lechi yoodaa pradesha mu loni kòmda seemalonunna òka ooriki tvaragaa vèlli
Jèkaryaa yimtilo praveshimchi, èleesabètuku vamdanamu chesènu.
Èleesabètu mariyayòkka vamdanavachanamu vina gaane, aamè garbhamulo shishuvu gamtulu vesènu. amtata èleesabètu parishuddhaatmato nimdukòninadai biggaragaa itlanènu
Streelalo neevu aasheervadimpabadinadaanavu nee garbhaphalamunu aasheervadimpabadunu
Naa prabhuvu talli naayòddaku vachchuta naa kelaagu praaptimchènu?
Idigo nee shubhavachanamu naa chèvinipadagaane naa garbhamuloni shishuvu aanamdamuto gamtulu vesènu.
Prabhuvu aamèku tèliyajeyimchina maatalu siddhimchunu ganuka namimana aamè dhanyuraalanènu.
Appudu mariya yitlanènu naa praanamu prabhuvunu ghanaparachuchunnadi.
Aayana tana daasuraali deenasthitini kataakshimchènu
Naa aatma naa rakshakudaina devuniyamdu aanamdimchènu.
Sarvashaktimamtudu naaku gòppakaaryamulu chesènu ganuka idi mòdalukòni annitaramulavaarunu nannu dhanyuraalani yamduru. aayana naamamu parishuddhamu.
Aayanaku bhayapaduvaarimeeda aayana kanikaramu tara taramulakumdunu.
Aayana tana baahuvuto paraakramamu choopènu vaari hrridayamula aalochana vishayamai garvishthulanu chèdaragòttènu.
Simhaasanamulanumdi balavamtulanu padadrosi deenula nèkkimchènu
Aakaligòninavaarini mamchi padaarthamulato samtrripti parachi dhanavamtulanu vattichetulato pampivesènu.
Abraahaamunakunu atani samtaanamunakunu yugaam tamuvaraku tana kanikaramu choopi j~naapakamu chesikòmdunani manapitarulato sèlavichchinattu
Aayana tana sevakudaina ishraayelunaku sahaayamu chesènu.
Amtata mariya, yimchumimchu moodu nèlalu aamètokooda umdi, pimmata tana yimtiki tirigi vèllènu.
Prasavakaalamu vachchinappudu èleesabètu kumaaruni kanènu.
Appudu prabhuvu aamèmeeda mahaakanikaramumchè nani aamè pòruguvaarunu bamdhuvulunu vini aamèto kooda samtoshimchiri.
Ènimidava dinamuna vaaru aa shishu vuku sunnati cheyavachchi, tamdri perunubatti jèkaryaa anu peru vaaniki pèttabovuchumdagaa
Talli aalaagu vaddu; vaaniki yohaananu peru pèttavalènani chèppènu.
Amduku vaaru nee bamdhuvulalo aa peru galavaadèvadunu lede ani aamèto chèppi
Vaaniki e peru pèttagoru chunnaavani vaani tamdriki samj~naluchesi adigiri.
Atadu vraatapalaka tèmmani vaani peru yohaanani vraasènu; amduku vaaramdaru aashcharyapadiri.
Vèmtane atani noru tèravabadi, naaluka sadali, atadu devuni stutimchuchu maatalaadasaagènu.
Amdunubatti vaari chuttupatla kaapura munna vaarikamdarikini bhayamu kaligènu. aa samgatu lanniyu yoodaya kòmdaseemalayamdamtata prachura maayènu.
Prabhuvu hastamu ataniki todaiyumdènu ganuka aa samgatulanu goorchi vininavaaramdarunu ee bidda yelaativaadaguno ani vaatini manassulo umchukòniri.
Mariyu atani tamdri jèkaryaa parishuddhaatma poornudai yitlu pravachimchènu
Prabhuvaina ishraayelu devudu stutimpabadunugaaka
Aayana tana prajalaku darshanamichchi, vaariki vimochana kalugajesènu
Tana sevakudaina daaveedu vamshamunamdu manakòraku rakshanashrrimgamunu, anagaa
Mana shatruvulanumdiyu manalanu dveshimchu vaaramdari chetinumdiyu tappimchi rakshana kalugajesènu.
Deeninigoorchi aayana aadinumdi tana parishuddhapravaktala nota palikimchènu.
Aayana mana pitarulanu karunimchutakunu tana parishuddha nibamdhananu, anagaa mana tamdriyaina
Abraahaamuto taanu chesina pramaanamunu j~naapakamu chesikònutakunu
Manamu shatruvula chetinumdi vidipimpabadi, mana jeevita kaalamamtayu nirbhayulamai, aayana sannidhini
Parishuddhamugaanu neetigaanu aayananu sevimpanu anugrahimchutakunu ee rakshana kalugajesènu.
Mariyu o shishuvaa, neevu sarvonnatuni pravaktavana baduduvu mana devuni mahaa vaatsalyamunubatti vaari paapamu lanu kshamimchutavalana
Tana prajalaku rakshanaj~naanamu aayana anugrahimchu natlu aayana maargamulanu siddhaparachutakai neevu prabhuvunaku mumdugaa nadutuvu.

Mana paadamulanu samaadhaana maargamuloniki nadi pimchunatlu cheekatilonu maranachchaayalonu koorchumduvaariki vèlugichchutakai aa mahaa vaatsalya munubatti painumdi aayana manaku arunodaya darshana manugrahimchènu.
Shishuvu èdigi, aatmayamdu balamu pòmdi, ishraayelu naku pratyakshamagu dinamuvaraku aranya mulo numdènu.
Aa dinamulalo sarvalokamunaku prajaasamkhya vraayavalènani kaisaru augustuvalana aaj~na aayènu.
Idi kureniyu siriyadeshamunaku adhipatiyai yunna ppudu jarigina mòdati prajaasamkhya.
Amdarunu aa samkhyalo vraayabadutaku tamatama pattanamulaku vèlliri.
Yosepu daaveedu vamshamulonu gotramulonu puttinavaadu ganuka, tanaku bhaaryagaa pradhaanamu cheyabadi garbha vatiyai yumdina mariyatokooda aa samkhyalo vraaya badutaku
Galilayaloni najaretunumdi yoodayaloni betlèhemanabadina daaveedu ooriki vèllènu.
Vaarakkada unnappudu aamè prasavadinamulu nimdènu ganuka
Tana tòlichoolu kumaaruni kani, pòttiguddalato chutti, satramulo vaariki sthalamu lenamduna aayananu pashuvula tòttilo parumdabèttènu.
Aa deshamulo kòmdaru gòrrala kaaparulu pòla mulo umdi raatrivela tama mamdanu kaachukònu chumdagaa
Prabhuvu doota vaariyòddaku vachchi nili chènu; prabhuvu mahima vaarichuttu prakaashimchinamduna, vaaru mikkili bhayapadiri.
Ayite aa dootabhaya padakudi; idigo prajalamdarikini kalugabovu mahaa samtoshakaramaina suvartamaanamu nenu meeku tèliyajeyu chunnaanu;
Daaveedu pattanamamdu nedu rakshakudu mee kòraku putti yunnaadu, eeyana prabhuvaina kreestu
Daanikide meekaanavaalu; òka shishuvu pòttiguddalato chutta badi yòka tòttilo pamdukòniyumduta meeru choochèda rani vaarito chèppènu.
Vèmtane paraloka sainya samoohamu aa dootato koodanumdi
Sarvonnata maina sthalamulalo devuniki mahimayu aayana kishtulaina manushyulaku bhoomimeeda samaadhaanamunu kalugunugaaka ani devuni stotramu cheyuchumdènu.

Aa dootalu tamayòddanumdi paralokamunaku vèllina taruvaata aa gòrrala kaaparulujarigina yee kaaryamunu prabhuvu manaku tèliyajeyimchi yunnaadu; manamu betlèhemuvaraku vèlli chootamu ramdani yòkanito nòkadu chèppukòni
Tvaragaa vèlli, mariyanu yosepunu tòttilo pamdukòniyunna shishuvunu choochiri.
Vaaru choochi, yee shishuvunugoorchi tamato chèppabadina maatalu prachuramu chesiri.
Gòrrala kaaparulu tamato chèppina samgatulanugoorchi vinna vaaramdaru mikkili aashcharyapadiri.
Ayite mariya aa maatalanniyu tana hrridayamulo talaposikònuchu bhadramu chesikònènu.
Amtata aa gòrrala kaaparulu tamato chèppabadinattugaa taamu vinnavaatini kannavaatinannitinigoorchi devuni mahima parachuchu stotramucheyuchu tirigi vèlliri.
Aa shishuvunaku sunnati cheyavalasina yènimidava dinamu vachchinappudu, garbhamamdaayana padakamu nupu devadootacheta pèttabadina yesu2 anu peru vaaru aayanaku pèttiri.
Moshe dharmashaastramuchòppuna vaaru tammunu shuddhi chesikònu dinamulu gadachinappudu
Prati tòlichoolu magapilla prabhuvuku pratishtha cheyabadavalènu ani prabhuvu dharmashaastramamdu vraayabadinattu aaya nanu prabhuvuku pratishthimchutakunu,
Prabhuvu dharmashaastra mamdu chèppabadinattu guvvala jatanainanu rèmdu paavurapu pillalanainanu baligaa samarpimchutakunu, vaaru aayananu yèrooshalemunaku teesikònipoyiri.
Yèrooshalemu namdu sumèyonanu òka manushyudumdènu. atadu neeti mamtudunu bhaktiparudunaiyumdi, ishraayeluyòkka aadaranakòraku kanipèttuvaadu; parishuddhaatma atanimeeda umdènu.
Atadu prabhuvuyòkka kreestunu choodaka munupu maranamu pòmdadani ataniki parishuddhaatmacheta bayalu parachabadi yumdènu; aatmavashudai atadu devaalayamu loniki vachchènu.
Amtata dharmashaastrapaddhati chòppuna aayana vishayamai jarigimchutaku tali damdrulu shishuvaina yesunu devaalayamuloniki teesikònivachchinappudu
Atadu tana chetulalo aayananu èttikòni devuni stutimchuchu itlanènu
Naathaa, yippudu nee maatachòppuna samaadhaana muto nee daasuni ponichchuchunnaavu;
Anyajanulaku ninnu bayaluparachutaku vèlugugaanu nee prajalaina ishraayeluku mahimagaanu
Neevu sakala prajalayèduta siddhaparachina
Nee rakshana nenukannulaara choochitini.
Yosepunu aayana talliyu aayananugoorchi chèppa badina maatalanu vini aashcharyapadiri.
Sumèyonu vaarini deevimchiidigo aneka hrridayaalochanalu bayalu padunatlu, ishraayelulo anekulu padutakunu tirigi lechutakunu vivaadaaspadamaina gurutugaa eeyana niya mimpabadiyunnaadu;
Mariyu nee hrridayamuloniki òka khadgamu doosikònipovunani aayana talliyaina mari yato chèppènu.
Mariyu aasheru gotrikuraalunu panooyelu kumaartèyunaina anna anu òka pravaktri yumdènu. aamè kanyaatvamu mòdalu edemdlu pèni mitito samsaaramuchesi bahukaalamu gadichinadai,
Yènubadi naalugu samvatsaramulu vidhavaraalaiyumdi, devaala yamu viduvaka upavaasa praarthanalato reyimbagallu sevacheyuchumdènu.
Aamèkooda aa gadiyalone lopaliki vachchi devuni kòniyaadi, yèrooshalemulò vimochanakòraku kanipèttuchunnavaaramdarito aayananu goorchi maatalaaduchumdènu.
Amtata vaaru prabhuvu dharmashaastramu chòppuna samastamu teerchina pimmata galilaya loni najaretanu tama ooriki tirigi vèlliri.
Baaludu j~naanamuto nimdukònuchu, èdigi balamu pòmduchumdènu; devuni daya aayanameeda numdènu.
Paskaapamdugappudu aayana talidamdrulu eteta yèrooshalemunaku vèlluchumduvaaru.
Aayana pamdrèm demdlavaadai yunnappudu aa pamduga naacha rimchutakai vaadukachòppuna vaaru yèrooshalemunaku vèlliri.
Aa dinamulu teerinataruvaata vaaru tirigi vèlluchumdagaa baalu daina yesu yèrooshalemulo nilichènu.
Aayana tali damdrulu aa samgati èrugaka aayana samoohamulo unnaadani talamchi, yòka dinaprayaanamu saagi poyi, tama bamdhuvulalonu nèlavainavaarilonu aaya nanu vèdakuchumdiri.
Aayana kanabadanamduna aayananu vèdakuchu yèrooshalemunaku tirigi vachchiri.
Moodu dinamulaina taruvaata aayana devaalayamulo bodhakula madhya koorchumdi, vaari maatalanu aalakimchuchu vaarini prashnaladuguchu umdagaa choochiri.
Aayana maatalu vininavaaramdaru aayana praj~nakunu pratyuttaramulakunu vismaya mòmdiri.
Aayana talidamdrulu aayananu choochi mikkili aashcharyapadiri. aayana tallikumaarudaa, mammunu èmdukeelaagu chesitivi? idigo nee tamdriyu nenunu duhkhapaduchu ninnu vèdakuchumtimani ayanato chèppagaa
Aayanameerela nannu vèdakuchumtiri? nenu naa tamdri panulameeda numdavalènani meerèrugaraa1 ani vaarito chèppènu;
Ayite aayana tamato chèppina maata vaaru grahimpaledu.
Amtata aayana vaarito kooda bayaluderi najaretunaku vachchi vaariki lobadi yumdènu. aayana talli ee samgatulannitini tana hrrida yamulo bhadramu chesikònènu.
Yesu j~naanamamdunu, vayassunamdunu, devuni dayayamdunu, manushyula daya yamdunu vardhillu chumdènu.

Tibèrikaisaru elubadilo padunaidava samvatsaramamdu yoodayaku pòmtipilaatu adhipatigaanu, galilayaku herodu chaturthaadhipatigaanu, itooraya trakoneeti desha mulaku atani tammudaina philippu chaturthaadhipatigaanu, abi lene deshamunaku lusaaniya adhipatigaanu,
Annayu, kayapayu pradhaana yaajakulugaanu, unnakaalamuna aranyamulonunna jèkaryaa kumaarudaina yohaanu nòddaku devuni vaakyamu vachchènu.
Amtata atadu vachchi, paapakshamaapana nimittamu maaru manassu vishayamaina baaptismamu pòmdava lènani yòrdaanu nadee pradeshamamdamtata prakatimchu chumdènu.
Prabhuvu maargamu siddhaparachudi aayana trovalu saraalamucheyudi
Prati pallamu poodchabadunu prati kòmdayu mèttayu pallamu cheyabadunu vamkara maargamulu tinnanivagunu karaku maargamulu nunnanivagunu
Sakala shareerulu devuni rakshana chooturu ani aranyamulo kekaluveyuchunna yòkani shabdamu ani pravaktayaina yèshayaa vaakyamula gramthamamdu vraayabadinattu idi jarigènu.
Atadu tanacheta baaptismamu pòmdavachchina janasamooha mulanu choochisarpasamtaanamaa, raabovu ugratanu tappimchukònutaku meeku buddhi chèppina vaadèvadu?

Maarumanassunaku tagina phalamulu phalimchudi abraahaamu maaku tamdri ani meelo meeranukòna mòdalupèttukònavaddu; devudu ee raallavalana abraa haamunaku pillalanu puttimpagaladani meeto chèppu chunnaanu.
Ippude gòddali chètla veruna umchabadi yunnadi ganuka mamchi phalamu phalimchani prati chèttunu narakabadi agnilo veyabadunani chèppènu.
Amduku januluaalaagaite mememi cheyavalènani atani nadugagaa
Atadurèmdu amgeelugalavaadu emiyu lenivaanikiyya valènaniyu, aahaaramugalavaadunu aalaage cheyavalè naniyu vaarito chèppènu.
Sumkarulunu baaptismamu pòmdavachchibodhakudaa, mememi cheyavalènani atani nadugagaa
Atadu meeku nirnayimpabadinadaani kamtè èkkuvateesikònavaddani vaarito chèppènu.
Sainikulunu mememi cheyavalènani atani nadigiri. amduku ataduèvanini baadhapèttakayu, èvani meedanu apanimda veya kayu, mee jeetamulato trriptipòmdiyumdudani vaarito chèppènu.
Prajalu kanipèttuchu, itadu kreestayi yumdunemo ani amdarunu yohaanunu goorchi tama hrridayamulalo aalochimchukònuchumdagaa

Yohaanu nenu neellalo meeku baaptismamichchuchunnaanu; ayite naakamtè shakti mamtudòkadu vachchuchunnaadu; aayana chèppula vaarunu vipputaku nenu paatrudanu kaanu; aayana parishuddhaatma lonu1 agnitonu meeku baaptismamichchunu;
Aayana cheta aayana chetilonunnadi; aayana tana kallamunu baagugaa shubhramuchesi, tana kòttulo godhumaluposi, aarani agnito pòttu kaalchi veyunani amdarito chèppènu.
Idiyugaaka atadimkanu, chaala samgatulu chèppi prajalanu hèchcharimchuchu vaariki suvaarta prakatimchu chumdènu.
Ayite chaturthaadhipatiyaina heroduchesina sakala dushkaaryamula nimittamunu, atani sodaruni bhaarya yaina herodiya nimittamunu, yohaanu atanini gaddimchinamduku
Adivaraku taanu chesinavanniyu chaala vannattu atadu yohaanunu chèrasaalalo veyimchènu.
Prajalamdarunu baaptismamu pòmdinappudu yesukooda baaptismamu pòmdi praarthana cheyuchumdagaa aakaashamu tèravabadi
Parishuddhaatma shareeraakaaramuto paavuramuvalè aayanameediki digi vachchènu. appuduneevu naa priya kumaarudavu, neeyamdu nenaanamdimchuchunnaanani yòka shabdamu aakaashamunumdi vachchènu.
Yesu (bodhimpa) mòdalupèttinappudu aayana daadaapu muppadi emdla yeedugalavaadu; aayana yosepu kumaarudani yèmchabadènu. yosepu heleeki,
Helee mattatuku, mattatu leviki, levi mèlkeeki,
Mèlkee yannaku, yanna yosepuku, yosepu mattateeyaku, mattateeya aamosuku, aamosu naahomuku, naahomu èsliki, èsli naggayiki,
Naggayi mayatuku, mayatu mattateeyaku, mattateeya simiyaku, simiya yoshekhuku, yoshekhu yodaaku,
Yodaa yohannaku, yohanna resaaku, resaa jèrubbaabèluku, jèrubbaabèlu shayaltee yeluku, shayalteeyelu neriki,
Neri mèlkeeki, mèlkee addiki, addi kosaamuku, kosaamu èlmadaamuku, èlmadaamu eruku,
Eru yèhoshuvaku, yèhoshuva èleeyèjèruku, èleeyèjèru yoreemuku, yoreemu mattatuku, mattatu leviki,
Levi shimyonuku, shimyonu yoodaaku, yoodaa yosepuku, yosepu yonaamuku, yonaamu èlyaa keemuku,
Èlyaakeemu mèlèyaaku, mèlèyaa mènnaaku, mènnaa mattataaku, mattataa naataanuku, naataanu daavee duku,
Daaveedu yèshshayiki, yèshshayi obeduku, obedu boyajuku, boyaju shalmaanuku, shalmaanu nayassonuku,
Nayassonu ameemanaadaabuku, ameemanaadaabu araamuku, araamu èsromuku, èsromu pèrèsuku, pèrèsu yoodaaku,
Yoodaa yaakobuku, yaakobu issaakuku, issaaku abraahaamuku, abraahaamu tèra huku, tèrahu naahoruku,
Naahoru sèrooguku, sèroogu rayooku, rayoo pèlèguku, pèlègu hèbèruku, hèbèru shelahuku,
Shelahu keyinaanuku, keyi naanu arpakshaduku, arpakshadu shemuku, shemu novahuku, novahu lèmèkuku,
Lèmèku mètooshèlaku, mètoo shèla hanokuku, hanoku yèrèduku, yèrèdu mahala leluku, mahalalelu keyinaanuku,
Keyinaanu ènoshuku, ènoshu shetuku, shetu aadaamuku, aadaamu devuniki kumaarudu.
Yesu parishuddhaatma poornudai yòrdaanunadinumdi tirigi vachchi, naluvadi dinamulu aatmacheta aranyamulo nadipimpa badi
Apavaadicheta1 shodhimpabaduchumdènu. aa dinamu lalo aayana emiyu tinaledu. avi teerina taruvaata aayana aakaligònagaa
Apavaadineevu devuni kumaarudavaite, ròttè agunatlu ee raatito chèppumani aayanato chèppènu
Amduku yesu manushyudu ròttèvalana maatrame jeevimchadu ani vraayabadiyunnadani vaaniki pratyuttaramichchènu.
Appudu apavaadi aayananu teesikònipoyi, bhooloka raajyamulannitini òka nimishamulo aayanaku choopimchi
Ee adhikaaramamtayu, ee raajyamula mahimayu neekittunu; adi naakappagimpabadiyunnadi, adèvaniki nenu iyyagoruduno vaanikittunu;
Kaabatti neevu naaku mròkkitivaa yidamtayu needagunani aayanato chèppènu.
Amduku yesu nee devudaina prabhuvunaku mròkki aayananu maatramu sevimpavalènu ani vraayabadiyunnadani vaaniki pratyuttara michchènu.
Pimmata aayananu yèrooshalemunaku teesikònipoyi, devaalaya shikharamuna aayananu niluvabèttineevu devuni kumaarudavaite ikkadanumdi krimdiki dumukumu
Ninnu kaapaadutaku ninnu goorchi tana dootalaku aaj~naapimchunu.
Nee paadamèppudainanu raatiki tagulakumda vaaru ninnu chetulato èttikòmduru ani vraayabadiyunnadani aayanato chèppènu.
Amduku yesu nee devudaina prabhuvunu shodhimpavaladu ani chèppabadiyunnadani vaaniki pratyuttaramichchènu.
Apavaadi prati shodhananu mugimchi, kòmtakaalamu aayananu vidichipoyènu.
Appudu yesu, aatma balamuto galilayaku tirigi vèllènu; aayananugoorchina samaachaaramu aa pradeshamam damtata vyaapimchènu.
Aayana amdaricheta ghanatanòmdi, vaari samaajamamdiramulalo bodhimchuchu vachchènu.
Taruvaata aayana taanu pèrigina najaretunaku vachchènu. tana vaaduka chòppuna vishraamtidinamamdu samaajamamdiramu loniki vèlli, chaduvutakai niluchumdagaa
Pravaktayaina yèshayaa gramthamu aayana cheti kiyyabadènu; aayana gramthamu vippagaa --
Prabhuvu aatma naameeda unnadi beedalaku suvaarta prakatimchutakai aayana nannu abhishekimchènu chèralonunna vaariki vidudalanu, gruddivaariki choopunu, (kalugunani) prakatimchutakunu naligi
Prabhuvu hitavatsaramu prakatimchutakunu aayana nannu pampiyunnaadu. ani vraayabadina chotu aayanaku dòrakènu.
Aayana gramthamu chutti parichaarakunikichchi koorchumdènu.
Samaaja mamdiramulo nunnavaaramdaru aayananu terichoodagaa, aayananedu mee vinikidilo ee lekhanamu nèraverinadani vaarito chèppasaagènu.
Appudamdarunu aayananugoorchi saakshyamichchuchu, aayana notanumdi vachchina dayagala maatala kaashcharyapadieeyana yosepu kumaarudu kaadaa? ani chèppukònuchumdagaa

Aayana vaarini choochivaidyudaa, ninnu neeve svasthaparachukònumu anu saamèta chèppi, kapèrnahoomulo e kaaryamulu neevu chesitivani memu vimtimo, aa kaaryamulu ee nee svadeshamamdunu cheyumani meeru naato nishchayamugaa chèppuduranènu.
Mariyu aayanae pravaktayu svadesha mamdu hitudukaadani meeto nishchayamugaa chèppu chunnaanu.
Eleeyaa dinamulayamdu moodemdla aaru nèlalu aakaashamu mooyabadi deshamamdamtatanu gòppa karavu sambhavimchinappudu, ishraayelulo anekamamdi vidhavaraamdrumdinanu,
Eleeyaa seedonuloni saarèpatu anu oorilo unna yòka vidhavaraaliyòddake gaani mari èvari yòddakunu pampabadaledu.
Mariyu pravaktayaina èleeshaa kaalamamdu ishraayelulo aneka kushtharogulumdinanu, siriya deshasthudaina nayamaanu tappa mari èvadunu shuddhi nòmdaledani nenu meeto nishchayamugaa chèppuchunnaanu.
Samaajamamdiramulo unnavaaramdaru aa maatalu vini
Aagrahamuto nimdukòni, lechi aayananu pattanamulo numdi vèllagòtti, aayananu talakrimdugaa padadroya valènani tama pattanamu kattabadina kòmdapetuvaraku aayananu teesikòni poyiri.
Ayite aayana vaari madhyanumdi daati tana maargamuna vèllipoyènu.
Appudaayana galilayaloni kapèrnahoomu pattanamu naku vachchi, vishraamtidinamuna vaariki bodhimchu chumdènu.
Aayana vaakyamu adhikaaramuto koodinadai yumdènu ganuka vaaraayana bodhaku aashcharyapadiri.
Aa samaaja mamdiramulo apavitramaina dayyapu aatmapattina vaadòka dumdènu.
Vaadunajareyudavaina yesoo, maato neekemi? mammu nashimpajeya vachchitivaa? nee vèvadavo nenèrugudunu; neevu devuni parishuddhudavani biggaragaa kekalu vesènu.
Amduku yesuoorakumdumu, itanini vadali pòmmani daanini gaddimpagaa, dayyamu vaanini vaarimadhyanu padadrosi vaaniki e haaniyu cheyaka vadali poyènu.
Amdu kamdaru vismayamòmdiidi ètti maata? eeyana adhikaaramutonu balamutonu apavitraatmalaku aaj~naa pimpagaane avi vadalipovuchunnavani yòkanito nòkadu chèppukòniri.
Amtata aayananugoorchina samaachaaramu aa praamtamulamdamtatanu vyaapimchènu.
Aayana samaajamamdiramulonumdi lechi, seemonu imtiloniki vèllènu. seemonu atta teevramaina jvaramuto padiyumdènu ganuka aamè vishayamai aayanayòdda manavi chesikòniri.
Aayana aamè chèmtanu niluvabadi, jvaramunu gaddimpagaane adi aamènu vidichènu; vèmtane aamè lechi vaariki upachaaramu cheyasaagènu.

Sooryudastamimchuchumdagaa naanaavidha rogamulacheta peedimpabaduchunnavaaru èvarèvariyòddanumdiro vaaramdaru aa rogulanu aayanayòddaku teesikòni vachchiri; appudaayana vaarilo prativaanimeeda chetulumchi, vaarini svasthaparachènu.
Imtekaaka dayya muluneevu devuni kumaarudavani kekalu vesi anekulanu vadalipoyènu; aayana kreestu ani vaatiki tèlisiyumdènu ganuka aayana vaatini gaddimchi vaatini maataadaneeyaledu.
Udayamainappudu aayana bayaluderi aranya pradesha munaku vèllènu. janasamoohamu aayananu vèdakuchu aayanayòddaku vachchi, tammunu vidichi pokumda aapagaa
Aayananenitara pattanamulalonu devuni raajyasuvaartanu prakatimpavalènu; imdunimittame nenu pampabaditinani vaarito chèppènu.
Taruvaata aayana yoodaya samaajamamdiramulalo prakatimchuchumdènu.
1 janasamoohamu devuni vaakyamu vinuchu aayanameeda paduchumdagaa aayana gènnesarètu sarassuteeramuna nilichi,
Aa sarassuteeramunanunna rèmdudonèlanu choochènu; jaalarulu vaatilonumdi digi tama valalu kaduguchumdiri.
Aayana aa donèlalo seemonudaina yòka donè yèkkidarinumdi kòmchèmu troyumani atani nadigi, koorchumdi donèlonumdi janasamoohamulaku bodhimchuchumdènu.
Aayana bodhimchuta chaalimchina taruvaataneevu donènu lotunaku nadipimchi, chepalu pattutaku mee valalu veyudani seemonuto chèppagaa
Seemonu elinavaadaa, raatri amtayu memu prayaasapaditiviu gaani maakemiyu dòrakaledu; ayinanu nee maata chòppuna valalu vetunani aayanato chèppènu.
Vaaraalaagu chesi vistaaramaina chepalu pattiri, amducheta vaari valalu pigilipovuchumdagaa
Vaaru veròka donè lonunna tama paalivaaru vachchi tamaku sahaayamu cheyavalènani vaariki samj~nalu chesiri; vaaru vachchi rèmdu donèlu munugunatlu nimpiri.
Seemonu peturu adi choochi, yesu mokaallayèduta saagilapadiprabhuvaa, nannuvidichi pòmmu, nenu paapaatmuda nani chèppènu.
Elayanagaa vaaru pattina chepala raashiki atadunu atanito koodanunna vaaramdarunu vismaya mòmdiri.

Aalaaguna seemonuto kooda paalivaaraina jèbèdayi kumaarulagu yaakobunu yohaanunu (vismaya mòmdiri). amduku yesubhayapadakumu, ippati numdi neevu manushyulanu pattuvaadavai yumduvani seemonuto chèppènu.
Vaaru donèlanu darikicherchi, samastamunu vidichipètti aayananu vèmbadimchiri.

Aayana yòka pattanamulo nunnappudu idigo kushtha rogamuto nimdina yòka manushyudumdènu. vaadu yesunu choochi, saagilapadiprabhuvaa, nee kishta maite nannu shuddhunigaa cheyagalavani aayananu vedukònènu.
Appu daayana chèyyichaapi vaanini muttinaakishtame; neevu shuddhudavukammani anagaane, kushtharogamu vaanini vidichènu.
Appudaayana neevu èvanitonu chèppaka vèlli, vaariki saakshyaarthamai nee dehamunu yaajakuniki kanuparachukòni, neevu shuddhudavainamduku moshe niyamimchinattu kaanukalanu samarpimchumani
Ayite aayananu goorchina samaachaaramu mari èkkuvagaa vyaapimchènu. bahujana samoohamulu aayana maata vinutakunu tama rogamulanu kudurchukònutakunu koodivachchu chumdènu.
Aayana praarthana cheyutaku aranyamu loniki vèlluchumdènu.

Òkanaadaayana bodhimchuchumdagaa, galilaya yoodayadeshamula prati graamamunumdiyu yèroosha lemunumdiyu vachchina parisayyulunu dharmashaastropadesha kulunu koorchumdiyumdagaa, aayana svasthaparachunatlu prabhuvu shakti aayanakumdènu.
Idigo kòmdaru manushyulu pakshavaayuvugala yòka manushyuni mamchamumeeda mosi kòni, vaanini lopaliki tèchchi, aayana yèduta umchu taku prayatnamu chesiri gaani
Janulu gumpukoodi yumdi namduna, vaanini lopaliki tèchchutaku vallapadaka poyènu ganuka, imtimeedi kèkki pèmkulu vippi, mamchamuto kooda yesu èduta vaari madhyanu vaanini dimchiri.
Aayana vaari vishvaasamu choochimanushyudaa, nee paapa mulu kshamimpabadiyunnavani vaanito chèppagaa,
Shaastru lunu parisayyulunudevadooshana cheyuchunna yita dèvadu? devudòkkade tappa mari èvadu paapamulu kshamimpagaladani aalochimchukònasaagiri.
Yesu vaari aalochana lèrigimeeru mee hrridayamulalo emi aalo chimchuchunnaaru?
Nee paapamulu kshamimpabadi yunna vani chèpputa sulabhamaa? neevu lechi naduvumani chèpputa sulabhamaa?
Ayite paapamulu kshamimchutaku bhoomi meeda manushyakumaaruniki adhikaaramu kaladani meeru tèlisikònavalènu ani vaarito chèppi, pakshavaayuvu gala vaani choochineevu lechi, nee mamchamèttikò
Vèmtane vaadu vaariyèduta lechi, taanu pamdukòniyunna mamchamu ètti kòni, devuni mahimaparachuchu tana yimtiki vèllènu.
Amdarunu vismayamòmdinedu gòppa vimtalu choochiti mani devuni mahimaparachuchu bhayamuto nimdukòniri.
Atupimmata aayana bayaluderi, levi yanu òka sumkari, sumkapu mèttunòdda koorchumdiyumduta choochi nannu vèmbadimchumani atanito chèppagaa
Atadu samastamunu vidichipètti, lechi, aayananu vèmbadimchènu.
Aa levi, tana yimta aayanaku gòppa vimdu chesènu. sumkarulunu itarulu anekulunu vaarito kooda bhojana munaku koorchumdiri.
Parisayyulunu vaari shaastrulunu idi choochisumkarulatonu paapulatonu meerela tini traaguchunnaarani aayana shishyulameeda sanigiri.
Amduku yesurogulake gaani aarogyamugalavaariki vaidyu dakkaraledu.
Maarumanassu pòmdutakai nenu paapulanu piluvavachchitini gaani neetimamtulanu piluvaraaledani vaarito chèppènu.
Vaaraayananu choochiyohaanu shishyulu tarachugaa upavaasapraarthanalu cheyuduru; aalaage pari sayyula shishyulunu cheyuduru gaani, nee shishyulu tini traaguchunnaare ani chèppiri.
Amduku yesupèmdli kumaarudu tamato unnamtakaalamu pèmdli imti vaari cheta meeru upavaasamu cheyimpa galaraa?
Pèmdlikumaa rudu vaariyòddanumdi kònipobadu dinamulu vachchunu; aa dinamulalo vaaru upavaasamu cheturani vaarito chèppènu.

Aayana vaarito òka upamaanamu chèppènu. ètlanagaaèvadunu paatabattaku kròttagudda maasikaveyadu; vesina yèdala kròttadi daanini chimpiveyunu; adiyunugaaka kròttadaanilonumdi teesina mukka paatadaanito kali yadu.
Èvadunu paata tittulalo kròtta draakshaarasamu poyadu; posinayèdala kròtta draakshaarasamu tittulanu pigulchunu, rasamu kaaripovunu, tittulunu paadagunu.
Ayite kròtta draakshaarasamu kòtta tittulalo poya valènu.
Paata draakshaarasamu traagi vèmtane kròtta daanini koruvaadèvadunu ledu; paatade mamchidanunani chèppènu.
Òka vishraamtidinamuna aayana pamtachelalobadi vèllu chumdagaa, aayana shishyulu vènnulu trumchi, chetulato nalupukòni, tinuchumdiri.
Appudu parisayyulalo kòmdaruvishraamtidinamuna cheyadaganidi meerèmduku cheyuchunnaarani vaarinadugagaa
Yesu vaarito itla nènutaanunu tanato kooda unnavaarunu aakaligòni nappudu daaveedu emichesèno adiyainanu meeru chaduva ledaa?
Atadu devuni mamdiramulo praveshimchi, yaaja kulu tappa mari èvarunu tinakoodani samukhapu ròttèlu teesikòni tini, tanato kooda unnavaarikini ichchènu gadaa anènu.
Kaagaamanushyakumaarudu vishraamtidinamuna kunu yajamaanudani vaarito chèppènu.
Mariyòka vishraamtidinamuna aayana samaajamamdiramu loniki vèlli bodhimchuchunnappudu, akkada oocha kudi chèyyigalavaadòkadumdènu.
Shaastrulunu parisayyulunu aayanameeda neramu mopavalènani, vishraamtidinamuna svastha parachunemo ani aayananu kanipèttuchumdiri;
Ayite aayana vaari aalochana lèrigi, oochachèyyigalavaanitoneevu lechi madhyanu niluvumani chèppagaa, vaadu lechi nili chènu.
Appudu yesuvishraamtidinamuna melucheyuta dharmamaa keeducheyuta dharmamaa? praanarakshana dharmamaa praana hatya dharmamaa? ani mimmu naduguchunnaanani vaarito chèppi
Vaarinamdarini chuttu kalayajoochinee chèyyi chaapumani vaanito chèppènu; vaadaalaagu cheyagaane vaani chèyyi baagupadènu.
Appudu vaaru vèrrikopa muto nimdukòni, yesunu emi cheyu damaa ani yòkanitonòkadu maatalaadukòniri.
Aa dinamulayamdu aayana praarthanacheyutaku kòmdaku vèlli, devuni praarthimchutayamdu raatri gadipènu.
Udayamainappudu aayana tana shishyulanu pilichi, vaarilo pamdrèmdumamdini erparachi, vaariki apòstalulu anu peru pèttènu.
Veerèvaranagaa aayana èvaniki peturu anu maaruperu pèttèno aa seemonu, atani sahodarudaina amdrèya, yaakobu, yohaanu, philippu, bartòlò mayi,
Mattayi, tomaa, alphayi kumaarudaina yaakobu, jèlote1 anabadina seemonu,
Yaakobu sahodarudaina yoodaa, drohiyagu iskariyotu yoodaa anu vaaru.

Aayana vaarito kooda digivachchi maidaanamamdu nilichinappudu aayana shishyula gòppa samoohamunu, aayana bodha vinutakunu tama rogamulanu kudurchukònuta kunu yoodaya deshamamtatinumdiyu, yèrooshalemu numdiyu, tooru seedonanu pattanamula samudra teeramula numdiyu vachchina bahujanasamooha munu,
Apavitraatmala cheta baadhimpabadinavaarunu vachchi svasthatanòmdiri.
Prabhaa vamu aayanalonumdi bayaluderi amdarini svasthaparachu chumdènu ganuka janasamoohamamtayu aayananu mutta valènani yatnamuchesènu.
Amtata aayana tana shishyulatattu paarachoochi itlanènu beedalaina meeru dhanyulu, devuniraajyamu meedi.
Ippudu akaligònuchunna meeru dhanyulu, meeru trripti parachabaduduru. ippudu edchuchunna meeru dhanyulu, meeru navvuduru.
Manushyakumaaruni nimi ttamu manu shyulu mimmunu dveshimchi vèlivesi nimdimchi mee peru chèddadani kòttiveyunappudu meeru dhanyulu.
Aa dina mamdu meeru samtoshimchi gamtulu veyudi; idigo mee phalamu paralokamamdu gòppadai yumdunu; vaari pita rulu pravaktalaku ade vidhamugaa chesiri.
Ayyo, dhana vamtulaaraa, meeru (korina) aadarana meeru pòmdi yunnaaru.
Ayyo yippudu (kadupu) nimdiyunna vaaralaaraa, meeraakaligòmduru. ayyo yippudu navvuchunnavaaralaaraa, meeru duhkhimchi yedturu.
Manushyulamdaru mimmunu kòniyaadunappudu meeku shrama; vaari pitarulu abaddhapravaktalaku ade vidhamugaa chesiri.
Vinuchunna meeto nenu chèppunademanagaamee shatru vulanu premimchudi, mimmunu dveshimchuvaariki melu cheyudi,
Mimmunu shapimchuvaarini deevimchudi, mimmunu baadhimchuvaarikòraku praarthanacheyudi.
Ninnu òka chèmpa meeda kòttuvaani vaipunaku rèmdava chèmpakooda trippumu. nee paibatta èttikòni povuvaanini, nee amgeeni kooda ètti kònipokumda addagimpakumu.
Ninnadugu prativaanikini immu; nee sòttu èttikòni povu vaaniyòdda daani marala adugavaddu.
Manushyulu meekelaagu cheyavalènani meeru koruduro aalaagu meerunu vaariki cheyudi.
Mimmunu premimchuvaarine meeru premimchinayèdala meekemi mèppu kalugunu? paapulunu tammunu premimchu vaarini premimturu gadaa
Meeku melu cheyuvaarike melu chesinayèdala meekemi mèppukalugunu? paapulunu aalaage cheturu gadaa
Meerèvariyòdda marala puchchukònavalènani nireekshimturo vaarike appu ichchinayèdala meekemi mèppu kalugunu? paapulunu taamichchinamta marala puchchukòna valènani paapulaku appu ichchèdaru gadaa.
