Meeraite ètti vaarini goorchi yainanu niraasha chesikònaka mee shatruvulanu premimchudi, melucheyudi, appu iyyudi; appudu mee phalamu gòppadaiyumdunu, meeru sarvonnatuni kumaarulai yumduru. aayana, krritaj~natalenivaariyèda lanu dushtulayèdalanu upakaariyai yunnaadu.

Apòstalulu tirigi vachchi, taamu chesinavanniyu aayanaku tèliyajeyagaa, aayana vaarini vèmta bèttukòni betsayidaa anu ooriki ekaamtamugaa vèllènu.
Jana samoohamulu adi tèlisikòni aayananu vèmbadimpagaa, aayana vaarini cherchukòni, devuni raajyamunugoorchi vaarito maatalaaduchu, svasthata kaavalasinavaarini svastha parachènu.

Pròddu grumka naarambhimchinappudu pamdrèmduguru shishyulu vachchi manamee aranyamulo unnaamu ganuka chuttupatlanunna graamamulakunu pallè lakunu vèlli basa choochukòni, aahaaramu sampaadimchu kònunatlu janasamooha munu pampiveyumani aayanato chèppiri.

Aayanameere vaariki bhojanamu pèttudani vaarito chèppagaa vaarumanayòdda ayidu ròttèlunu rèmdu chepalunu tappa maremiyu ledu; memu vèlli yee prajalamdarikòraku bhojanapadaarthamulanu kòni tèttumaa ani chèppiri.
Vachchinavaaru imchumimchu ayiduvela mamdi purushulu. aayanavaarini ebadesimamdi chòppuna pamktulu teerchi koorchumdabèttudani tana shishyulato chèppagaa,
Vaaraalaagu chesi amdarini koorchumdabèttiri.
Amtata aayana aa ayidu ròttèlanu rèmdu chepalanu èttikòni, aakaashamu vaipu kannu lètti vaatini aasheervadimchi, virichi, janasamoohamu naku vaddimchutakai shishyulakichchènu.
Vaaramdarutini trripti pòm dina taruvaata migilina mukkalu pamdrèmdu gampèllèttiri.
Òkappudaayana òmtarigaa praarthana cheyuchumdagaa aayana shishyulu aayanayòdda umdiri. nenèvadanani janasamoohamulu chèppukònuchunnaarani aayana vaari nadugagaa
Vaarubaaptismamichchu yohaananiyu, kòmdarueleeyaayaniyu, kòmdarupoorvakaalapu pravakta yòkadu lechènaniyu chèppu kònuchunnaaraniri.
Amdukaayanameeraite nenèvadanani chèppukònuchunnaarani vaarinadugagaa peturuneevu devuni kreestuvanènu.
Aayana idi èvanitonu chèppavaddani vaariki khamditamugaa aaj~naapimchi
Manushyakumaarudu bahu shramalu pòmdi, pèddala chetanu pradhaana yaajakulachetanu shaastrulachetanu visarjimpabadi, champabadi, moodava dinamuna lechuta agatya mani chèppènu.
Mariyu aayana amdarito itlanènu èvadainanu nannu vèmbadimpa gorinayèdala tannutaanu upekshimchukòni, pratidinamu tana siluvanu èttikòni nannu vèmbadimpavalènu.
Tana praanamunu rakshimchukòna goruvaadu daanini pògòttukònunu, naa nimittamai tana praanamunu pogòttukònuvaadu daanini rakshimchu kònunu.
Òkadu lokamamtayu sampaadimchi, tannu taanu pogòttu kòninayèdala, leka nashtaparachukòninayèdala vaanikemi prayojanamu?
Nannu goorchiyu naa maatalanu goorchiyu siggupaduvaadèvado vaani goorchi manushya kumaarudu, tanakunu tana tamdrikini parishudda dootalakunu kaligiyunna mahimato vachchunappudu siggupadunu.
Ikkada nilichiyunna vaarilo kòmdaru devuni raajyamunu choochuvaraku maranamu ruchichoodarani nenu meeto nijamugaa chèppuchunnaananènu.
Ee maatalu chèppinadi mòdalukòni ramaarami yèni midi dinamulaina taruvaata, aayana peturunu yohaanunu yaakobunu vèmtabèttukòni, praarthanacheyutaku òka kòmda yèkkènu.
Aayana praarthimchu chumdagaa aayana mukharoopamu maarènu; aayana vastramulu tèllanivai dhagadhaga mèrisènu.
Mariyu iddaru purushulu aaya nato maatalaaduchumdiri, vaaru moshe eleeyaa anu vaaru.
Vaaru mahimato agapadi, aayana yèroosha lemulo nèraverchabovu nirgamamunugoorchi maatalaadu chumdiri.
Peturunu atanito kooda unnavaarunu nidra mattugaa umdiri. vaaru melukòninappudu, aayana mahimanu aayanato kooda nilichiyunna yiddaru puru shulanu choochiri.

(aa yiddaru purushulu) aayanayòdda numdi vèllipovuchumdagaa peturu yesutoelina vaadaa, manamikkada umduta mamchidi, neeku òkatiyu mosheku òkatiyu eleeyaaku òkatiyu moodu parna shaalalu memukattudumani, taanu chèppinadi taanèrugakaye chèppènu.
Atadeelaagu maatalaaduchumdagaa megha mòkati vachchi vaarini kammènu; vaaru aa meghamulo praveshimchinappudu shishyulu bhayapadiri.
Mariyu eeyana ne nerparachukònina naa kumaarudu,eeyana maata vinudani yòka shabdamu aa meghamulonumdi puttènu.
Aa shabdamu vachchina taruvaata yesu maatrame agapadènu. taamu choochina vaatilo òkatiyu aa dinamulalo èvarikini tèliya jeyaka vaaru oorakumdiri.
Marunaadu vaaru aa kòmda digi vachchinappudu bahu janasamoohamu aayanaku èdurugaa vachchènu.
Idigo aa janasamoohamulo òkadu bodhakudaa, naa kumaaruni kataakshimchumani ninnu vedukònuchunnaanu. vaadu naa kòkkade kumaarudu.
Idigo òka dayyamu2 vaani pattunu, pattinappudu vaadu akasmaattugaa kekalu veyunu; nurugu kaarunatlu adi vaanini vilavilalaadim chuchu gaayaparachuchu vaanini vadali vadala kumdunu.
Daanini vèllagòttudani nee shishyulanu vedukòmtini gaani vaaricheta kaaledani mòrrapèttukònènu.
Amduku yesu vishvaasamuleni moorkhataramu vaaralaaraa, nenèmtakaalamu meeto kooda umdi mimmunu sahimtunu? nee kumaaruni ikkadiki teesikòni rammani chèppènu.
Vaadu vachchu chumdagaa aa dayyamu vaanini padadrosi, vilavilalaadim chènu; yesu aa apavitraatmanu gaddimchi baaluni svastha parachi vaani tamdri kappagimchènu.
Ganuka amdaru devuni mahaatmyamunu choochi aashcharyapadiri.

Aayana chesina kaaryamulannitini choochi amdaru aashcharya paduchumdagaa aayanaee maatalu mee chèvulalo naataniyyudi. manushyakumaarudu manushyula chetiki appagimpabadabovuchunnaadani tana shishyulato chèppènu.
Ayite vaaraamaata grahimpa kumdunatlu adi vaariki marugucheyabadènu ganuka vaaru daanini tèlisikònaledu; mariyu aa maatanugoorchi vaaru aayananu aduga vèrachiri.
Tamalo èvadu gòppavaado ani vaarilo tarkamu puttagaa
Yesu vaari hrridayaalochana èrigi, òka chinna biddanu teesikòni tanayòdda niluvabètti.
Ee chinna biddanu naa perata cherchukònuvaadu nannu cherchu kònunu, nannu cherchukònuvaadu nannu pampinavaanini cherchukònunu, mee amdarilo èvadu atyalpudai yumduno vaade gòppa vaadani vaarito
Yohaanuelinavaadaa, yèvado yòkadu nee perata dayyamulanu vèllagòttagaa memu choochitiviu; vaadu manalanu vèmbadimchuvaadu kaadu ganuka vaanini aatamka parachitimani chèppènu.
Amduku yesumeeru vaani naatamkaparachakudi? meeku virodhi kaani vaadu mee pakshamuna nunnavaade ani atanito chèppènu.
Aayana paramunaku cherchukònabadu dinamulu paripoorna maguchunnappudu
Aayana yèrooshalemunaku vèllutaku manassu sthiraparachukòni, tanakamtè mumdugaa dootalanu pampènu. vaaru vèlli aayanaku basa siddhamu cheyavalè nani samarayula yòka graamamulo praveshimchiri gaani
Aayana yèrooshale munaku vèlla nabhimukhudainamduna vaa raayananu cherchukònaledu.
Shishyulaina yaakobunu yohaanunu adi choochiprabhuvaa, aakaashamunumdi agni digi veerini naashanamu cheyunatlu memaaj~naapimchuta neekishtamaa ani adugagaa,
Aayana vaaritattu tirigi vaarini gaddimchènu.
Amtata vaaru mariyòka graamamunaku vèlliri.
Vaaru maargamuna vèlluchumdagaa òkadunee vèkkadiki vèllinanu nee vèmta vachchèdanani aayanato chèppènu.
Amduku yesunakkalaku bòriyalunu aakaashapakshulaku nivaasamulunu kalavu gaani manushya kumaaruniki talavaalchu kònutakainanu sthalamu ledani atanito chèppènu.
Aayana mariyòkanitonaa vèmtarammani chèppènu. atadu nenu vèlli mòdata naa tamdrini paatipètti vachchutaku sèla vimmani manavi chesènu
Amdukaayanamrritulu tama mrritulanu paatipèttukònanimmu; neevu vèlli devuni raajya munu prakatimchumani vaanito chèppènu.
Mariyòkadu prabhuvaa, nee vèmta vachchèdanu gaani naa yimta nunna vaariyòdda sèlavu teesikòni vachchutaku mòdata naaku sèlavimmani adugagaa
Yesunaagatimeeda chèyyipètti vènukatattu choochu vaadèvadunu devuni raajyamunaku paatrudukaadani vaanito chèppènu.
Atutaruvaata prabhuvu dèbbadimamdi yitarulanu niyamimchi, taanu vèllabovu prati oorikini pratichotikini tanakamtè mumdu iddariddarinigaa pampènu.
Pampinappu daayana vaarito itlanènukota vistaaramugaa unnadi gaani panivaaru kòddimamdiye; kaabatti kota yajamaanuni tana kotaku panivaarini pampa vedukò nudi.
Meeru vèlludi; idigo todellamadhyaku gòrra pillalanu pampinattu nenu mimmunu pampuchunnaanu.
Meeru samchinainanu jaalè nainanu chèppulanainanu teesi kònipovaddu;
Trovalo èvani nainanu kushalaprashna laduga vaddu; meeru e yimtanainanu praveshimchunappuduee yimtiki samaadhaanamagu gaaka ani mòdata chèppudi.
Samaadhaanapaatrudu5 akkada numdinayèdala mee samaadhaanamu atanimeeda niluchunu; leniyèdala adi meeku tirigi vachchunu.
Vaaru meekichchu padaarthamulanu tinuchu traaguchu aa yimtilone yumdudi, panivaadu tana jeetamunaku paatrudu. imtim tiki tirugavaddu.
Mariyu meeru e pattanamulonaina praveshimchunappudu vaaru mimmunu cherchukòmte mee mumdarapèttunavi tinudi.
Amdulo nunna rogulanu svasthaparachudidevuni raajyamu mee daggaraku vachchiyunna dani vaarito chèppudi.
Meeru e pattanamulonaina praveshimchunappudu vaaru mimmunu cherchukònaka poyina yèdala
Meeru daani veedhulaloniki poyimaa paada mulaku amtina mee pattanapu dhoolinikooda mee yèdutane dulipiveyuchunnaamu; ayinanu devuni raajyamu samee pimchi yunnadani tèlisikònudani chèppudi.
Aa pattanapu gatikamtè sòdòma pattanapu gati aa dinamuna orvataginadai yumdunani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Ayyo kòraajeenaa, ayyo betsayidaa, mee madhya cheyabadina adbhutamulu tooru seedonu pattana mulalo cheyabadinayèdala aa pattanamulavaaru poorvame gonèpatta kattukòni boodidè vesikòni koora
Ayinanu vimarshakaalamu namdu mee gatikamtè tooru seedonu pattanamulavaari gati orvadaginadai yumdunu.
O kapèrnahoomaa, aakaa shamu mattuku hèchchimpa badèdavaa? neevu paataalamuvaraku digipoyèdavu.
Mee maata vinuvaadu naa maata vinunu, mimmunu niraakarimchuvaadu nannu niraakarimchunu, nannu niraakarimchuvaadu nannu pampinavaanini niraakarimchunanènu.
Aa dèbbadimamdi shishyulu samtoshamuto tirigi vachchi prabhuvaa, dayyamulu kooda nee naamamuvalana maaku lobaduchunnavani chèppagaa
Aayanasaataanu mèrupu valè aakaashamunumdi paduta choochitini.
Idigo paamu lanu tellanu tròkkutakunu shatruvu balamamtatimeedanu meeku adhikaaramu anugrahimchiyunnaanu; ediyu mee kèmtamaatramunu haanicheyadu.
Ayinanu dayya mulu meeku lobaduchunnavani samtoshimpaka mee perulu paralokamamdu vraayabadi yunnavani samtoshimchudani vaarito chèppènu.

Aa gadiyalone yesu parishuddhaatmayamdu bahugaa aanamdimchi-tamdree, aakaashamunakunu bhoomikini prabhuvaa, neevu j~naanulakunu vivekulakunu ee samgatulanu marugu chesi pasibaaluraku bayalu parachinaavani ninnu stutimchu chunnaanu; avunu tamdree, aalaagu nee drrishtiki anukoola maayènu.

Samastamunu naa tamdricheta naaku appagimpa badiyunnadi; kumaarudèvado, tamdri tappa marèvadunu èrugadu; tamdri èvado, kumaarudunu kumaarudèvaniki aayananu bayalu parachanuddeshimchuno vaadunu tappa, marèvadunu èrugadani chèppènu.
Appudaayana tana shishyulavaipu tirigi-meeru choochuchunna vaatini choochu kannulu dhanyamulainavi;
Anekamamdi pravaktalunu raaju lunu, meeru choochuchunnavi choodagori choodakayu, vinagori vinakayu umdirani meeto chèppuchunnaanani yekaamtamamdu vaarito anènu.
Idigo òkappudu dharmashaastropadeshakudòkadu lechi bodhakudaa, nityajeevamunaku vaarasudanagutaku nenemi cheyavalènani aayananu shodhimchuchu adigènu.
Amdu kaayanadharmashaastramamdemi vraayabadiyunnadi? nee vemi chaduvuchunnaavani atani nadugagaa
Atadunee devudaina prabhuvunu nee poorna hrridayamutonu, nee poornamanassutonu, nee poorna shaktitonu, nee poornavivekamu tonu premimpavalènaniyu, ninnuvalè nee pòruguvaani pre
Amdukaayananeevu sarigaa uttaramichchitivi; aalaagu cheyumu appudu jeevimchèdavani atanito chèppènu.
Ayite taanu neetimamtudainattu kanabarachukònagori, ataduavunu gaani naa pòruguvaadèvadani yesunadi gènu.
Amduku yesu itlanènuòka manushyudu yèrooshalemu numdi yèrikopattanamunaku digi vèlluchu dòmgala chetilo chikkènu; vaaru atani battalu dochu kòni, atani kòtti kòrapraanamuto vidichi
Appudòka yaajakudu aa trovanu vèlluta tatasthimchènu. atadu atanini choochi, prakkagaa poyènu.
Aalaagu nane leveeyudòkadu aa chotikivachchi choochi prakkagaa poyènu.
Ayite òka samarayudu prayaanamai povuchu, atadu padiyunnachotiki vachchi
Atanini choochi, atanimeeda jaalipadi, daggarakupoyi, noonèyu draakshaarasamunu posi atani gaayamulanu katti, tana vaahanamumeeda èkkimchi yòka pootakoollavaani yimtiki teesikònipoyi atani pa

Marunaadatadu rèmdu denaaramulu teesi aa poota koollavaanikichchiitani paraamarshimchumu, neevimke mainanu kharchu chesinayèdala nenu marala vachchunappudu adi neeku teerchèdanani atanito chèppi poyènu.
Kaagaa dòmgalachetilo chikkinavaaniki ee muggurilo èvadu pòruguvaadaayènani neeku tochu chunnadi ani yesu adugagaa atadu--atanimeeda jaali padinavaade anènu.
Amduku yesuneevunu vèlli aalaagu cheyumani atanito chèppènu.
Amtata vaaru prayaanamai povuchumdagaa, aayana yòka graamamulo praveshimchènu. maarta anu òka stree aayananu tana yimta cherchukònènu.
Aamèku mariya anu sahodariyumdènu. eemè yesu paadamulayòdda koorchumdi aayana bodhavinu chumdènu.

Maarta vistaaramaina pani pèttukònutacheta tòmdarapadi, aayanayòddaku vachchiprabhuvaa, nenu òmtarigaa panicheyutaku naa sahodari nannu vidichi pèttinamduna, neeku chimtaledaa? naaku sahaayamu cheyumani aamèto chèppumanènu.
Amduku prabhuvu maartaa, maartaa, neevanekamaina panulanu goorchi vichaara mukaligi tòmdarapaduchunnaavu gaani avasaramainadi òkkate
Mariya uttamamainadaanini erparachukò nènu, adi aamè yòddanumdi teesiveyabadadani aamèto chèppènu.

Aayana yòka chota praarthana cheyuchumdènu. praarthana chaalimchina taruvaata aayana shishyulalo òkadu prabhuvaa, yohaanu tana shishyulaku nerpi nattugaa maakunu praarthanacheya nerpumani aayana nadigènu.
Amdu kaayanameeru praarthana cheyunappudutamdree, nee naamamu parishuddhaparachabadunu gaaka, nee raajyamu vachchunu gaaka,
Maaku kaavalasina anudinaahaaramu dinadinamu maaku dayacheyumu;
Memu maakachchiyunna prati vaanini kshamimchuchunnaamu ganuka maapaapamulanu kshamimchumu; mammunu shodhanaloniki tekumu ani paluku dani vaarito chèppènu.
Mariyu aayana vaarito itlanènumeelo èvani kaina òka snehitudumdagaa atadu ardharaatrivela aa snehi tuni yòddaku vèllisnehitudaa, naaku mooduròttèlu badulimmu;
Naa snehitudu prayaanamucheyuchu maargamulo naayòddaku vachchi yunnaadu; ataniki pèttu taku naayòdda emiyu ledani atanito chèppinayèdala
Atadu lopalane yumdinannu tòmdarapèttavaddu; talupu vesiyunnadi, naa chinnapillalu naatokooda pamdukòni yunnaaru, nenu lechi iyyalenani chèppunaa?
Atadu tana snehitudainamduna lechi iyyakapoyi nanu, atadu siggumaali maati maatiki adugutavalana nainanu lechi ataniki kaavalasinavanniyu ichchunu ani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Atuvalè meerunu adugudi, mee kiyyabadunu; vèdakudi, meeku dòrakunu; tattudi, meeku teeyabadunu.
Adugu prativaanikiyyabadunu, vèdakuvaaniki dòrakunu, tattu vaaniki teeyabadunani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Meelo tamdriyainavaadu tana kumaarudu chepanadigite chepaku pratigaa paamunichchunaa? guddunadigite telu nichchunaa?
Kaabatti meeru chèddavaaraiyumdiyu, mee pillalaku mamchi yeevulaniyya nèrigiyumdagaa
Paralokamamdunna mee tamdri tannu aduguvaariki parishuddhaatmanu èmto nishchaya mugaa anugrahimchunanènu.
Òkappudaayana moogadayyamunu vèllagòttu chumdènu. aa dayyamu vadalipoyina taruvaata moogavaadu maata laadènu ganuka janasamoohamulu aashcharyapadènu.
Ayite vaarilo kòmdaruveedu dayyamulaku adhipati yaina bayèljèbooluvalana dayyamulanu vèllagòttuchunnaa dani chèppukòniri.
Marikòmdaru aayananu shodhimchuchuparalokamu numdi yòka soochaka kriyanu choopumani aayana nadigiri.
Aayana vaari aalochanala nèrigi vaarito itlanènutanaku taane vyatirekamugaa verupadina prati raajyamunu paadaipovunu; tanakutaane virodhamaina yillu koolipovunu.
Saataanunu tanaku vyatireka mugaa taane verupadinayèdala vaani raajyamelaagu niluchunu? nenu bayèljèbooluvalana dayyamulanu vèllagòttuchunnaanani meeru chèppuchunnaare.
Nenu bayèljèbooluvalana dayya mulanu vèllagòttu chunnayèdala mee kumaarulu èvanivalana vèllagòttuchunnaaru? amducheta vaare meeku teerparulai yumduru.
Ayite nenu devuni vrelito dayyamu lanu vèllagòttuchunnayèdala nishchayamugaa devuni raajyamu meeyòddaku vachchiyunnadi.
Balavamtudu aayudhamulu dharimchukòni, tana aavaranamunu kaachukònunappudu, atani sòttu bhadramugaa umdunu.
Ayite atanikamtè bala vamtudaina òkadu atani paibadi jayimchunappudu, atadu nammukònina aayudhamula nannitini laagukòni atani aastini pamchipèttunu.
Naa pakshamuna umdanivaadu naaku virodhi; naato samakoorchanivaadu chèdaragòttuvaadu.
Apavitraatma yòka manushyuni vadalipoyina taruvaata adi vishraamti vèdakuchu neeruleni chotla tiruguchumdunu. vishraamti dòrakanamdunanenu vidichi vachchina naa yimtiki tirigi vèlludunanukòni
Vachchi, aa yillu oodchi amarchi yumduta choochi

Vèlli, tanakamtè chèddavaina mari yedu (apavitra) aatmalanu vèmtabèttukòni vachchunu; avi amdulo praveshimchi akkadane kaapuramumdunu; amdu cheta aa manushyuni kadapati sthiti mòdatidaanikamtè chèdda dagunani chèppènu.
Aayana yee maatalu chèppuchumdagaa aa samooha mulo nunna yòka stree aayananu choochininnu mosina garbhamunu neevu kudichina stanamulunu dhanyamulainavani kekalu vesi chèppagaa
Aayana avunugaani devuni vaakyamu vini daanini gaikònuvaaru mari dhanyulani chèppènu.

Mariyu janulu gumpulugaa koodinappudu aayana yeelaagu chèppasaagènuee taramuvaaru dushtataramu vaarai yumdi soochaka kriya naduguchu nnaaru. ayite yonaanugoorchina soochaka kriyaye gaani mari e soochaka kriyayu veeriki anugrahimpa badadu.
Yonaa neenèvè pattanasthulaku elaagu soochanagaa umdèno aalaage manushya kumaarudunu ee taramuvaariki soochanagaa umdunu.

Dakshinadeshapu raani vimarshakaalamuna ee taramuvaarito kooda lechi vaarimeeda nerasthaapanacheyunu. aamè sòlò monu j~naanamu vinutaku bhoomyamtamulanumdi vachchènu, idigo sòlòmonukamtè gòppavaadikkada unnaadu.
Neenèvè manushyulu vimarshakaalamuna ee taramuvaarito kooda niluvabadi vaarimeeda nerasthaapanacheyuduru. vaaru yonaa prakatana vini maarumanassu pòmdiri; idigo yonaa kamtè gòppavaadikkada unnaadu.
Èvadunu deepamu vèligimchi, chaatuchotunainanu kumchamukrimdanainanu pèttadu gaani, lopaliki vachchuvaariki vèlugu kanabadutaku deepastambhamumeedane pèttunu.
Nee dehamunaku deepamu nee kanne ganuka, nee kannu tetagaa numtè nee dehamamtayu vèlugu mayamai yumdunu; adi chèdinadaite nee deha munu cheekatimayamai yumdunu.
Kaabatti neelonumdu vèlugu cheekatiyaiyumdakumda choochu kònumu.
E bhaagamainanu cheekatikaaka nee dehamamtayu vèlugu mayamaite, deepamu tana kaamtivalana neeku vèlu gichchu nappudu elaagumduno aalaagu dehamamtayu vèlugumayamai yumdunani chèppènu.
Aayana maatalaaduchumdagaa òka parisayyudu tanato kooda bhojanamu cheyumani aayananu piluvagaa aayana lopaliki vèlli bhojanapamktini koorchumdènu.
Aayana bhojana munaku mumdugaa snaanamu cheyaledani aa parisayyudu choochi aashcharyapadènu.
Amduku prabhuvitlanènupari sayyulaina meeru ginnèyu pallèmunu vèlupala shuddhi cheyuduru gaani mee amtaramgamu doputonu chèdu tanamutonu nimdiyunnadi.
Avivekulaaraa, vèlupali bhaagamunu chesinavaadu lopati bhaagamunu cheyaledaa?
Kaagaa meeku kaliginavi dharmamu cheyudi, appudu mee kanniyu shuddhigaa umdunu.
Ayyo parisayyulaaraa, meeru pudeenaa sadaapa mòdalaina prati kooralonu padiyavavamtu chèllimchu chunnaare gaani, nyaayamunu devuni premanu vidichi pèttuchunnaaru. vaatini maanaka veetini che¸
Ayyo parisayyulaaraa, meeru samaaja mamdiramulalo agrapeethamulanu samtaveedhulalo vamdanamu lanu koruchunnaaru.
Ayyo, meeru kanabadani samaa dhulavalè unnaaru; vaatimeeda naduchu manushyulu (avi samaadhulani) yèrugaranènu.
Appudu dharmashaastropadeshakudòkadubodhakudaa, yeelaagu chèppi mammunukooda nimdimchuchunnaavani aaya nato chèppagaa
Aayana ayyo, dharma shaastropadeshaku laaraa, moya shakyamukaani baruvulanu meeru manu shyulameeda mopuduru gaani meeru òka vrelitonainanu aa baruvulanu muttaru.
Ayyo, mee pitarulu champina pravaktala samaadhulanu meeru kattimchuchunnaaru.
Kaavuna meeru saakshulai mee pitarula kaaryamulaku sammatimchu chunnaaru; vaaru pravaktalanu champiri, meeru vaari samaa dhulu kattimchuduru.
Amducheta devuni j~naanamu chèppina demanagaanenu vaariyòddaku pravaktalanu apòstalulanu pampudunu.
Vaaru kòmdarini champuduru, kòmdarini himsimturu.

Kaabatti lokamu puttinadi mòdalukòni, anagaa hebèlu raktamu mòdalukòni balipeethamunakunu mamdiramu nakunu madhyanu nashimchina jèkaryaa raktamuvaraku chimdimpabadina pravaktalamdari raktamu nimittamu ee taramu vaaru vichaarimpabaduduru; nishchayamugaa ee taramuvaaru aa raktamu nimittamu vichaarimpabadudurani meeto chèppu chunnaanu.
Ayyo, dharmashaastropadeshakulaaraa, meeru j~naanamanu taalapuchèvini èttikòni potiri; meerunu lopala praveshimparu, praveshimchuvaarini addagimturani chèppènu.
Aayana akkadanumdi vèllinappudu shaastrulunu pari sayyulunu aayana meeda nimda pagabatti aayana meeda neramu mopavalènani yumdi, aayana nota numdi vachchu emaatanainanu pattukònutaku pòmchi,
Vadakuchu chaala samgatulanugoorchi aayananu maata laadimpasaagiri.
Amtalo òkaninòkadu tròkkukònunatlu vela kòladi janulu koodinappudu aayana tana shishyulato mòdata itlani chèppasaagènuparisayyula veshadhaarana anu pulisina pimdinigoorchi jaagrattapaduda
Marugaina dediyu bayaluparachabadakapodu; rahasyamainadediyu tèliyabadakapodu.
Amducheta meeru cheekatilo maata laadukònunavi vèlugulo vinabadunu, meeru gadulayamdu chèvilo chèppukònunadi middèlameeda chaatimpabadunu.
Naa snehitulaina meeto nenu chèppunademanagaa dehamunu champina taruvaata maremiyu cheyanerani vaariki bhayapadakudi.
Èvaniki meeru bhayapadavalèno meeku tèliyajeyudunu; champina taruvaata narakamulo padadroya shaktigalavaaniki bhayapadudi, aayanake bhaya padudani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Ayidu pichchukalu rèmdu kaasulaku ammabadunu gadaa; ayinanu vaatilo òkatai nanu devuniyèduta maruvabadadu.
Mee talavèmdruka lanniyu lèkkimpabadiyunnavi. bhayapadakudi; meeru anekamaina pichchukalakamtè shreshthulu kaaraa?
Mariyu nenu meeto chèppunademanagaa, nannu manushyulayèduta òppukònuvaadèvado, manushyakumaarudu devuni dootala yèduta vaanini òppukònunu.
Manushyulayèduta nannu èrugananuvaanini, nenunu èruganani devuni dootalayèduta chèppudunu.
Manushyakumaarunimeeda vyatirekamugaa òka maata palukuvaaniki paapakshamaapana kalugunugaani, parishuddhaatmanu dooshimchuvaaniki kshamaapana ledu.
Vaaru samaajamamdiramula pèddalayòddakunu adhipatulayòddakunu adhikaarulayòddakunu mimmunu teesi kòni povunappudu meeruelaagu emi uttara michchèdamaa, yemi maatalaadu dumaa ani chimtimpa kudi,
Meeremi chèppavalasinadiyu parishuddhaatma aa gadiyalone meeku nerpunanènu.
Aa janasamoohamulo òkadubodhakudaa, pitraarjita mulo naaku paalupamchipèttavalènani naa sahodarunito chèppumani aayana nadugagaa
Aayana oyee, meemeeda teerparinigaanainanu pamchipèttuvaanigaanainanu nannèvadu niyamimchènani atanito chèppènu.
Mariyu aayana vaaritomeeru evidhamaina lobhamunaku èdamiyyaka jaagrattapadudi; òkani kalimi vistarimchuta vaani jeevamunaku moolamu kaadanènu.
Mariyu aayana vaarito ee upamaanamu chèppènu òka dhanavamtuni bhoomi samrriddhigaa pamdènu.
Appudatadunaa pamta samakoorchukònutaku naaku sthalamu chaaladu ganuka nenemi chetunani tanalo taanaalochimchukònineneelaagu chetunu;
Naa kòtlu vippi, vaatikamtè gòppavaatini kattimchi, amdulo naa dhaanyamamtatini, naa aastinisamakoorchukòni
Naa praanamutopraanamaa, aneka samvatsaramulaku,vistaara maina aasti neeku samakoorchabadiyunnadi; sukhimchumu, tinumu, traagumu, samtoshimchumani chèppu kòmdunanu kònènu.
Ayite devuduvèrrivaadaa, yee raatri nee praanamu naduguchunnaaru; neevu siddhaparachinavi èvani vagunani aatanito chèppènu.
Devuniyèdala dhanavamtudu kaaka tanakòrake samakoorchukònuvaadu aalaagunane yumdunani chèppènu.
Amtata aayana tana shishyulato itlanènuee hetuvucheta meeru -- emi timdumo, ani mee praanamunu goorchiyainanu, emi dharimchukòmdumo, ani mee dehamunu goorchiyainanu chimtimpa
Aahaaramukamtè praanamunu vastramukamtè dehamunu gòppavi kaavaa?
Kaakula samgati vichaarimchi choodudi. avi vittavu, koyavu, vaatiki garisèledu, kòttuledu; ayinanu devudu vaatini poshimchuchunnaadu; meeru pakshulakamtè èmto shreshthulu.
Mariyu meelo èvadu chimtichutavalana tana yèttunu moorèdèkkuva chesikòna galadu?
Kaabatti annitikamtè takkuvainavi meecheta kaakapote takkina vaatini goorchi meeru chimtimpanela? puvvulelaagu èduguchunnavo aalochimchudi.
Avi kashtapadavu, vadukavu; ayinanu tana samastavaibhavamuto koodina sòlòmonu sayitamu veetilo òkadaanivalènaina alamkarimpabadaledani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Nedu pòlamulo umdi, repu pòyiloveyabadu adavi gaddini devudeelaagu alamkarimchinayèdala, alpa vishvaasulaaraa, meeku mari èmto nishchayamugaa vastra mulanichchunu.
Emi timdumo, yemi traagudumo, ani vichaarimpakudi, anumaanamu kaligiyumdakudi.
Ee lokapu janulu veetinannitini vèdakuduru; ivi meeku kaavalasiyunnavani mee tamdriki tèliyunu.
Meeraite aayana raajyamunu1 vèdakudi, daanito kooda ivi mee kanugrahimpabadunu.
Chinna mamdaa bhayapadakudi, meeku raajyamu anugra himchutaku mee tamdriki ishtamaiyunnadi
Meeku kaliginavaatini amima dharmamu cheyudi, paatagilani samchulanu paralokamamdu akshayamaina dhanamunu sampaadimchu kònudi; akkadiki dòmgaraadu, chimmètakòttadu
Mee dhanamèkkada umduno akkadane mee hrridayamu umdunu.
Mee nadumulu kattukòniyumdudi, mee deepamulu vèluguchumdaniyyudi.
Tama prabhuvu pèmdlivimdunumdi vachchi tattagaane ataniki taluputeeyutaku atadèppudu vachchuno ani atanikòraku èduru choochu manushyulavalè umdudi.

Prabhuvu vachchi ye daasulu mèlakuvagaa umduta kanugònuno aa daasulu dhanyulu; atadu nadumu kattukòni vaarini bhojana pamktini koorchumdabètti, taane vachchi vaariki upachaaramu cheyunani meeto nishchayamugaa chèppuchunnaanu.
Mariyu atadu rèmdava jaamuna vachchinanu moodava jaamuna vachchinanu (e daasulu) mèlakuvagaa umduta kanugònuno aa daasulu dhanyulu.
Dòmga ye gadiyanu vachchuno yimti yajamaanuniki tèlisinayèdala atadu mèlakuvagaa umdi, tana yimtiki kannamu veyaniyyadani tèlisikònudi.
Meeru anukònani gadiyalo manushyakumaarudu vachchunu ganuka meerunu siddhamugaa umdudani chèppènu.
Appudu peturuprabhuvaa, yee upamaanamu maatone chèppuchunnaavaa amdaritonu chèppuchu nnaavaa? ani aayana nadugagaa
Prabhuvu itlanènutagina kaalamuna prativaaniki aahaaramu pèttutaku, yajamaanudu tana yimtivaarimeeda niyamimchunatti nammakamaina buddhigala grrihanirvaahakudèvadu?
Èvani prabhuvu vachchi, vaadu aalaagu cheyuchumduta kanugònuno aa daasudu dhanyudu.
Atadu tanaku kaliginadaaniyamtatimeeda vaani umchunani meeto nijamugaa chèppuchunnaanu.
Ayite aa daasudunaa yajamaanudu vachchuta kaalasyamu cheyuchunnaadani tana manassulo anukòni, daasulanu daaseelanukòtti, tini traagimattugaa umdasaagite
Vaadu kanipèttani dinamulonu èrugani gadiyalonu aa daasuni yajamaanudu vachchi vaani narikimchi, apanammakasthulato vaaniki paalu niyamimchunu.
Tana yajamaanuni chitta mèrigi yumdiyu siddhapadaka, atani chittamuchòppuna jarigimpaka umdu daasuniki anekamaina dèbbalu tagulunu.
Ayite tèliyaka dèbbalaku tagina panulu chesinavaaniki kòddi dèbbale tagulunu. èvaniki èkkuvagaa iyya badèno vaaniyòdda èkkuvagaa teeyajooturu; manushyulu èvaniki èkkuvagaa appagimta
Nenu bhoomimeeda agniveya vachchitini; adi idivarake ragulukòni mamdavalènani yèmto koruchunnaanu.
Ayite nenu pòmdavalasina baaptismamunnadi, adi nèraveru varaku nenèmto ibbamdipaduchunnaanu.
Nenu bhoomi meeda samaadhaanamu kalugajeya vachchi tinani meeru talamchu chunnaaraa? kaadu; bhedamune kaluga jeyavachchitinani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Ipputinumdi òka imtilo ayiduguru verupadi, iddariki virodha mugaa muggurunu, mugguriki virodhamugaa yiddarunu umduru.
Tamdri kumaarunikini, kumaarudu tamdrikini, talli kumaartèkunu, kumaartè tallikini, atta kodalikini, kodalu attakunu virodhulugaa umdurani chèppènu.
Mariyu aayana janasamoohamulato itlanènu meeru padamatanumdi mabbu paiki vachchuta choochu nappudu vaanavachchuchunnadani vèmtane chèppuduru; aalaage jarugunu.
Dakshinapu gaali visaruta choochunappudu vadagaali kòttunani chèppuduru; aalaage jarugunu.
Veshadhaarulaaraa, meeru bhoomyaakaashamula vaikhari gurtimpa nèruguduru; ee kaalamunu meeru gurtimpa nèrugarela?
Edi nyaayamo mee amtata meeru vimarshimparela?

Vaadimchuvaanito kooda adhikaariyòddaku neevu vèlluchumdagaa atani chetinumdi tappimchukònutaku trovalone prayatnamu cheyumu, ledaa, atadòkavela ninnu nyaayaadhipatiyòddaku eedchukòni povunu, nyaayaadhipati ninnu bamtrautunaku appagimchunu, bamtrautu ninnu chèrasaalalo veyunu.
Neevu kadapati kaasu chèllimchuvaraku vèlupaliki raane raavani neeto chèppuchunnaananènu.
Pilaatu galilayulaina kòmdari raktamu vaari balulato kalipiyumdènu. aa kaalamuna akkadanunna kòmdaru aa samgati yesuto chèppagaa
Aayana vaarito itlanènuee galilayulu atti himsalu pòmdinamduna vaaru galilayulamdarikamtè paapulani meeru talamchu chunnaaraa?
Kaarani meeto chèppuchunnaanu; meeru maarumanassu pòmdaniyèdala meeramdarunu aalaage nashimturu.
Mariyu siloyamuloni gopuramu padi chachchina aa padunènimidimamdi, yèrooshalemulo kaapura munnavaaramdarikamtè aparaadhulani talamchuchunnaaraa?
Kaarani meeto chèppuchunnaanu; meeru maarumanassu pòmdaniyèdala meeramdarunu aalaage nashimturu.
Mariyu aayana vaarito ee upamaanamu chèppènu òka manushyuni draakshatotalo amjoorapu chèttòkati naatabadi yumdènu. atadu daani pamdlu vèdaka vachchi nappudu emiyu dòrakaledu

Ganuka atadu idigo moodemdlanumdi nenu ee amjoorapu chèttuna pamdlu vèdakavachchuchunnaanu gaani yemiyu dòrakaledu; deenini narikiveyumu, deenivalana ee bhoomiyu ela vyarthamai povalènani draakshatota maalito chèppènu.
Ayite vaadu ayyaa, nenu daanichuttu travvi, yèruvu veyumattuku ee samvatsaramukooda umdanimmu;
Adi phalimchina sari, leniyèdala narikimchiveyumani atanito chèppènu.
Vishraamti dinamuna aayana yòka samaajamamdiramulo bodhimchuchunnappudu
Padunènimidi emdlanumdi balaheena parachu dayyamu pattina yòka stree achchata numdènu. aamè nadumu vamgipoyi yèmta maatramunu chakkagaa niluvabadalekumdènu.
Yesu aamènu choochi, rammani pilichi ammaa, nee balaheenatanumdi vidudala pòmdi yunnaavani aamèto chèppi
Aamèmeeda chetulumcha gaane aamè chakkagaa niluvabadi devuni mahimaparachènu.

Yesu vishraamtidinamuna svasthaparachinamduna aa samaaja mamdirapu adhikaari kopamuto mamdipadi, janasamooha munu choochipanicheyadagina aaru dinamulu kalavu ganuka aa dinamulalone vachchi svasthatapòmdudi; vishraamtidina mamdu raavaddani chèppènu.
Amduku prabhuvu veshadhaaru laaraa, meelo prativaadunu vishraamtidinamuna tana yèddunainanu gaadidanainanu gaadiyòddanumdi vippi, tolu kònipoyi, neellu pèttunu gadaa.
Idigo padunènimidi emdlanumdi saataanu bamdhimchina abraahaamu kumaartèyaina yeemènu vishraamtidinamamdu ee katlanumdi vidipimpa dagadaa? ani atanito chèppènu.
Aayana ee maatalu chèppinappudu aayana nèdirimchina vaaramdaru siggupadiri; ayite janasamoohamamtayu aayana chesina ghana kaaryamulannitini choochi samtoshimchènu.
Aayanadevuni raajyamu denini poliyunnadi? denito daani poltunu?
Òka manushyudu teesikòni poyi tana totalovesina aavagimjanu poliyunnadi. adi pèrigi vrrikshamaayènu; aakaashapakshulu daani kòmmala yamdu nivasimchènanènu.
Marala aayanadevuni raajya munu denito poltunu?
Òka stree teesikòni, amtayu pulisi pòmguvaraku moodu kumchamula pimdilo daachi pèttina pullani pimdini poliyunnadani chèppènu.
Aayana yèrooshalemunaku prayaanamai povuchu bodhimchuchu pattanamulalonu graamamulalonu samchaa ramu cheyuchumdènu.
Òkadu prabhuvaa, rakshanapòmdu vaaru kòddimamdenaa? ani aayana nadugagaa
Aayana vaarini choochiiruku dvaaramuna praveshimpa poraadudi; anekulu praveshimpa jooturu gaani vaarivalana kaadani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Imti yajamaanudu lechi talupuvesina taruvaata meeru vèlupala nilichi talupu tatti ayyaa, maaku talupu teeyumani chèppa naarambhimchi nappudu
Aayana mee rèkkadivaaro mimmunu èruganani uttaramu meeto chèppunu. amduku meerunee samukha mamdu memu tini traaguchumtime; neevu maa veedhulalo bodhimchitive ani chèppa saaguduru.
Appudaayanamee rèkkadivaaro mimmunu èruganani meeto chèppu chunnaanu; akramamu cheyu meeramdaru naa yòddanumdi tòlagipòmdani chèppunu.
Abraahaamu issaaku yaakobulunu sakala pravaktalunu devuni raajyamulo umdutayu, meeru vèlupaliki troyabadutayu, meeru choochunappudu meeru edchuchu pamdlu kòruku duru.
Mariyu janulu toorpunumdiyu padamata numdiyu uttaramunumdiyu dakshinamunumdiyuvachchi, devuni raajyamamdu koorchumduru.
Idigo kadapati vaarilo kòmdaru mòdati vaaraguduru, mòdativaarilo kòmdaru kadapati vaaragudurani chèppènu.
Aa gadiyalone kòmdaru parisayyulu vachchinee vikkadanumdi bayaluderi pòmmu; herodu ninnu champa goruchunnaadani aayanato chèppagaa
Aayana vaarini choochimeeru vèlli, aa nakkato eelaagu chèppudi idigo nedunu repunu nenu dayyamulanu vèlla gòttuchu (rogulanu) svasthaparachuchunumdi moodava dinamuna poorna siddhi pòmdèdanu.
Ayinanu nedu repu èllumdi naa trovanu nenu povuchumdavalènu; pravakta yèrooshalemu naku vèlupala nashimpa vallapadadu.

Yèrooshalemaa, yèrooshalemaa, pravaktalanu champuchu, neeyòddaku pampa badinavaarini raallato kòttuchu umdudaanaa, kodi tana pillalanu tana rèkkala krimda elaagu cherchukònuno aalaage ènno maarulu nenu nee plilalanu cherchukònavalènani yumtinigaani mee ròllakapotiri.
Idigo mee yillu meeku paadugaa viduvabaduchunnadiprabhuvu perata vachchuvaadu stutimpabadunugaakani meeru chèppuvaraku meeru nannu choodarani meeto chèppuchunnaananènu.
Vishraamtidinamuna aayana bhojanamu cheyutaku parisayyula adhikaarulalo òkani yimtiloniki vèllinappudu, aayana emi cheyuno ani vaaraayananu kanipèttu chumdiri.
Appudu jalodara rogamugala yòkadu aayana yèduta umdènu.
Yesu vishraamtidinamuna svasthaparachuta nyaayamaa kaadaa?
Ani dharmashaastropadesha kulanu parisayyulanu adugagaa vaaroorakumdiri. appu daayana vaanini cheradeesi svasthaparachi pampivesi
Meelo èvani gaadidayainanu èddayinanu gumtalo padinayèdala vishraamtidinamuna daanini paiki teeyadaa? ani vaari nadi gènu.
Ee maatalaku vaaru uttaramu chèppalekapoyiri.
Piluvabadinavaaru bhojanapamktini agrapeethamulu erparachu kònuta choochi aayana vaarito ee upamaanamu chèppènu.
Ninnèvarainanu pèmdlivimduku pilichinappudu agrapeethamu meeda koorchumdavaddu; òkavela neekamtè ghanudu atani cheta piluvabadagaa
Ninnunu atanini pilichinavaadu vachchi itaniki chotimmani neeto chèppunu, appudu neevu siggu padi kadapati chotuna koorchumdasaaguduvu.
Ayite neevu piluvabadi nappudu, ninnu pilichinavaadu vachchisnehi tudaa, paichotiki pòmmani neeto chèppulaaguna neevu poyi kadapati chotuna koorchumdumu; appudu neetokooda koorchumdu
Tannu taanu hèchchimchukònu prativaadunu taggimpabadunu; tannutaanu taggimchukònuvaadu hèchchimpabadunani chèppènu.

Mariyu aayana tannu pilichinavaanito itlanènuneevu pagati vimdainanu raatri vimdainanu cheyunappudu, nee snehitulanainanu nee sahodarulanainanu nee bamdhuvula nainanu dhanavamtulagu nee pòruguvaarinainanu piluvavaddu; vaaru òkavela ninnu marala piluturu ganuka neeku pratyupa kaaramu kalugunu.
Ayite neevu vimdu cheyunappudu beedalanu amgaheenulanu kumtivaamdranu gruddivaamdranu piluvumu.
Neeku pratyupakaaramu cheyutaku vaari kemiyu ledu ganuka neevu dhanyudavaguduvu; neetimamtula punarutthaanamamdu neevu pratyupakaaramu pòmduduvani chèppènu.
Aayanato kooda bhojanapamktini koorchumdinavaarilo òkadu ee maatalu vinidevuni raajyamulo bhojanamu cheyuvaadu dhanyudani aayanato chèppagaa
Aayana atanito nitlanènuòka manushyudu gòppa vimdu cheyimchi anekulanu pilichènu.
Vimdukaalamamdu atadu ippudu siddhamaiyunnadi, ramdani piluvabadinavaarito chèpputaku tana daasuni pampènu.
Ayite vaaramdaru ekamanassuto nèpamulu chèppa saagiri. mòdativaadunenòka pòlamu kòniyunnaanu, avashyamugaa vèlli daani choodavalènu, nannu kshamimpavalènani ninnu vedu kònuchunnaana
Mariyèkadunenu ayidu jatala yèdlanu kòniyunnaanu, vaatini pareekshimpa vèlluchunnaanu, nannu kshamimpavalènani vedukònuchunnaananènu.
Mari yòkadunenòka streeni vivaahamu chesikònnaanu; amducheta nenu raalenanènu.
Appudaa daasudu tirigi vachchi yee maatalu tana yajamaanuniki tèliyajeyagaa, aa yimti yaja maanudu kopapadineevu tvaragaapattanapu veedhulalonikini samdulalonikini vèlli, beedalanu amgaheenu la
Amtata daasudu prabhuvaa,nee vaaj~naapimchinattu chesitinigaani yimkanu chotunnadani chèppènu.
Amduku yajamaanudu--naa yillu nimdu natlu neevu raajamaargamulalonikini kamchèlalonikini vèlli lopaliki vachchutaku akkadivaarini balavamtamu cheyumu;
Elayanagaa piluvabadina aa manushyulalo òkadunu naa vimdu ruchichoodadani meeto chèppuchunnaananènu.
Bahu janasamoohamulu aayanatokooda vèllu chunnappudu aayana vaaritattu tirigi
Èvadainanu naa yòddaku vachchi tana tamdrini tallini bhaaryanu pillalanu anna dammulanu akkachèllèmdranu tana praanamunu sahaa dveshimpakumte vaadu naa shishyudu kaaneradu.
Mariyu èvadainanu tana siluvanu mosikòni nannu vèmbadimpani yèdala vaadu naa shishyudu kaaneradu.
Meelo èva dainanu òka gopuramu kattimpa gorina yèdala daanini kònasaagimchutaku kaavalasinadi tana yòdda unnado ledo ani koorchumdi tagulubadi mòdata lèkkachoochukònadaa?
Choochukònaniyèdala atadu daani punaadivesi, òkavela daanini kònasaagimpa leka poyinamduna
Choochuvaaram daruee manushyudu katta mòdalupèttènu gaani kòna saagimpaleka poyènani atani choochi yègataali cheya saaguduru.
Mariyu e raajainanu mariyòka raajuto yuddhamu cheyabovunappudu tanameediki iruvadivela mamdito vachchuvaanini padivelamamdito èdirimpa shakti tanaku kalado ledo ani koorchumdi mòdata aalo chimpadaa?
Shakti leniyèdala atadimkanu dooramugaa unnappude raayabaaramu pampi samaadhaanamu chesikòna choochunu gadaa.
Aa prakaarame meelo tanaku kaligina damtayu vidichi pèttanivaadu naa shishyudu kaaneradu.
Uppu mamchidegaani uppu nissaaramaite denivalana daaniki saaramu kalugunu?
Adi bhoomikainanu èruvukainanu panikiraadu ganuka daanini bayata paaraveyuduru. vinu taku chèvulugalavaadu vinunugaaka ani vaarito chèppènu.
Òkappudu samastamaina sumkarulunu paapulunu aayana bodha vinutaku aayana daggaraku vachchuchumdagaa
Parisayyulunu shaastrulunu adi choochiitadu paapulanu cherchukòni vaarito kooda bhojanamu cheyuchunnaadani chaala sanugukòniri.
Amdukaayana vaarito ee upamaanamu chèppènu
Meelo e manushyunikainanu nooru gòrralu kaligi yumdagaa vaatilo òkati tappipoyinayèdala atadu tòmbadi tòmimadimtini adavilo vidichipètti, tappipoyi nadi dòrakuvaraku daanini vèdaka vèlladaa?
Adi dòraki nappudu samtoshamuto daanini tana bhujamulameeda vesi kòni yimtiki vachchi tana snehitulanu pòruguvaarini pilichi
Meeru naatokooda samtoshimchudi; tappi poyina naa gòrra dòrakinadani vaarito chèppunu gadaa.
Atuvalè maarumanassu akkaraleni tòmbadi tòmimadi mamdi neetimamtula vishayamai kalugu samtoshamukamtè maarumanassu pòmdu òkka paapi vishayamai paralòka mamdu èkkuva samtosha
E streekainanu padi vèmdi naanamulumdagaa vaatilo òka naanamu pogòttukòmtè aamè deepamu vèligimchi yillu oodchi adi dòrakuvaraku jaagrattagaa vèdakadaa?
Adi dòrakinappudu tana chèlikattèlanu pòruguvaarini pilichi naato kooda samtoshimchudi, nenu pogòttukònina naanamu dòrakinadani vaarito chèppunu gadaa.
Atu valè maarumanassu pòmdu òka paapi vishayamai devuni dootalayèduta samtoshamu kalugunani meeto chèppu chunnaananènu.
Mariyu aayana itlanènuòka manushyuniki iddaru kumaarulumdiri.
Vaarilo chinnavaadutamdree, aastilo naakuvachchu bhaagamimmani tana tamdri nadu gagaa, atadu vaariki tana aastini pamchipèttènu.
Kònnidinamulaina taru vaata aa chinna kumaarudu samastamunu koorchukòni doora deshamunaku prayaanamai poyi, achchata tana aastini durvyaapaaramuvalana paaduchesènu.
Adamtayu kharchu chesina taruvaata aa deshamamdu gòppa karavu raagaa vaadu ibbamdi pada saagi,
Vèlli aa deshasthulalo òkanichèmta jerènu. atadu pamdulanu meputaku tana pòlamulaloniki vaanini pampènu.
Vaadu pamdulu tinu pòttuto tana kadupu nimpukòna ashapadènu gaani yèvadunu vaani kemiyu iyyaledu.
Ayite buddhi vachchinappudu vaadunaa tamdriyòdda èmtomamdi koolivaamdraku annamu samrriddhigaa unnadi, nenaite ikkada aakaliki chachchipovu chunnaanu.
Nenu lechi naa tamdriyòddaku vèlli--tamdree, nenu paralokamunaku virodhamugaanu nee yèdutanu paapamu chesitini;
Ikameedata nee kumaarudanani ani pimchukònutaku yogyudanu kaanu; nannu nee kooli vaarilo òkanigaa pèttukònumani atanito chèppudu nanukòni, lechi tamdriyòddaku vachchènu.
Vaadimka doora mugaa unnappudu tamdri vaanini choochi kanikarapadi, parugètti vaani mèdameedapadi muddupèttukònènu.
Appudu aa kumaarudu atanitotamdree, nenu paraloka munaku virodhamugaanu nee yèdutanu paapamu chesitini; ikameedata nee kumaarudanani anipimchukònutaku yogyu danu kaananènu.
Ayite tamdri tana daasulanu choochi prashasta vastramu tvaragaa tèchchi veenikikatti, veeni chetiki umgaramu pètti, paadamulaku chèppulu tòdigimchudi;
Kròvvina doodanu tèchchi vadhimchudi, manamu tini samtoshapadudamu;
Ee naa kumaarudu chanipoyi marala bradikènu, tappipoyi dòrakènani chèppènu; amtata vaaru samtoshapadasaagiri.
Appudu atani pèdda kumaa rudu pòlamulo umdènu. vaadu (pòlamunumdi) vachchuchu imtidaggaraku raagaa, vaadyamulunu naatyamunu jaruguta vini
Daasulalo òkani pilichiivi emitani adugagaa
Aa daasudu atanitonee tammudu vachchi yunnaadu, atadu tana yòddaku surakshitamugaa vachchi namduna nee tamdri kròvvina doodanu vadhimchènanènu.
Ayite atadu kopapadi lopaliki vèllanòllaka poyènu ganuka atani tamdri vèlupaliki vachchi (lopaliki rammani) batimaalukònènu.
Amdukatadu tana tamdritoidigo yinniyemdlanumdi ninnu sevimchuchunnaane, nee aaj~nanu nenènnadunu meeralede; ayinanu naa snehitulato samtoshapadunatlu neevu naakènnadunu òka meka
Ayite nee aastini veshyalato tini vesina yee nee kumaarudu raagaane veenikòraku kròvvina doodanu vadhimchitivani chèppènu.
Amdukatadukumaarudaa, nee vèllappudunu naatokooda unnaavu; naavanniyu neevi,
Manamu samtoshapadi aanamdimchuta yuktame; ee nee tammudu chanipoyi tirigi bradikènu, tappipoyi dòrakènani atanito chèppènu.
Mariyu aayana tana shishyulato itlanènu òka dhanavamtuniyòdda òka grrihanirvaahakudumdènu. vaa datani aastini paaducheyuchunnaadani ataniyòdda vaani meeda neramu mopabadagaa
Atadu vaani pilipimchininnugoorchi nenu vinuchunna yee maata emiti? nee grrihanirvaahakatvapu lèkka appagimchumu; neevu ika meedata grrihanirvaahakudavai yumda vallakaadani vaanito chèppènu.
Aa grrihanirvaahakudu tanalo taanunaa yajamaanudu ee grrihanirvaaha katvapu panilonumdi nannu teesiveyunu ganuka nenu emi chetunu? travvalenu, bhikshamètta siggupaduchunnaanu.
Nannu ee grrihanirvaaha katvapu paninumdi tòlagimchunappudu vaaru nannu tama yimdlaloniki cherchukònunatlu emi cheyavalèno naaku tèliyunanukòni,
Tana yajamaanuni runasthulalo òkkòkkani pilipimchineevu naa yajamaanuniki èmta achchiyunnaavani mòdativaani nadigènu.
Vaadu nooru manugula noonè ani chèppagaaneevu nee cheeti teesi kòni tvaragaa koorchumdi yebadi manugulani vraasi kòmmani vaanito chèppènu.
Taruvaata vaaduneevu èmta achchiyunnaavani mariyòkani nadugagaa vaadu nooru toomula godhumalani chèppinappudu. vaanitoneevu nee cheeti teesikòni yènubadi toomulani vraasikòmmani chèppènu.
Anyaayasthudaina aa grrihanirvaahakudu yuktigaa naduchukònènani vaani yaja maanudu vaani mèchchukònènu. vèlugu sambamdhula kamtè ee loka sambamdhulu tama taramunubatti choodagaa yuktiparu
Anyaayapu sirivalana meeku snehitulanu sampaadimchukònudi; èmdukanagaa aa siri mimmunu vadili povunappudu vaaru nityamaina nivaasamulalo mimmunu cherchukòmdurani meeto chèppuchunnaana
Mikkili kòmchèmulo nammakamugaa umduvaadu èkkuvalonu nammakamugaa umdunu; mikkili kòmchèmulo anyaaya mugaa umduvaadu èkkuvalonu anyaayamugaa umdunu.
Kaabatti meeru anyaayapu siri vishaya mulo nammakamugaa umdaniyèdala satyamaina dhanamunu èvaru mee vashamu cheyunu?
Meeru parula sòmmu visha yamulo nammakamugaa umdaniyèdala mee sòmtamainadi meeku èvadichchunu?
E sevakudunu iddaru yajamaanu lanu sevimpaledu; vaadu òkani dveshimchi òkani premim chunu, leka òkani anusarimchi òkani trrineekarimchunu; meeru devunini sirini sevimpa lerani chèppènu.
Dhanaapekshagala parisayyulu ee maatalanniyu vini aayananu apahasimchuchumdagaa
Aayana meeru manu shyulayèduta neetimamtulani anipimchukònuvaaru gaani devudu mee hrridayamulanu èrugunu. manushyulalo ghanamugaa èmchabadunadi devuni drrishtiki asahyamu.
Yohaanu kaalamuvaraku dharmashaastra munu pravaktalunu umdiri; appatinumdi devuni raajya suvaarta prakatimpa baduchunnadi; prativaadunu aa raajyamulo balavamta mugaa jòrabaduchunnaadu
Dharmashaastramulo òka pòllayina tappi povutakamtè aakaashamunu bhoomiyu gatimchipovuta sulabhamu.
Tana bhaaryanu vidanaadi, mariyòkatènu vivaahamu chesikònu prativaadu vyabhicha rimchuchunnaadu; bhartanu vidichinadaanini vivaahamu chesi kònuvaadu vyabhi charimchuchunnaadu.
Dhanavamtudòkadumdènu. atadu oodaaramgu batta lunu sannapu naara vastramulunu dharimchukòni prati dinamu bahugaa sukhapaduchumduvaadu.
Laajaru anu òka daridrudumdènu. vaadu kurupulato nimdinavaadai dhanavamtuni yimti vaakita padiyumdi
Atani ballameeda numdi padu ròttèmukkalato aakali teerchukòna gorènu; amtekaaka kukkalu vachchi vaani kurupulu naakènu.
Aa daridrudu chanipoyi devadootalacheta abraahaamu ròmmuna (aanukònutaku) kònipobadènu. dhanavamtudu kooda chanipoyi paatipèttabadènu.
Appudatadu paataa lamulo baadhapaduchu, kannulètti dooramunumdi abraa haamunu atani ròmmuna (aanukòniyunna) laajarunu choochi
Tamdrivaina abraahaamaa, naayamdu kanikara padi, tana vrelikònanu--neellalomumchi naa naalukanu challaarchutaku laajarunu pampumu; nenu ee agnijvaalalo yaatanapadu chunnaanani kekaluvesi chè
Amduku abraahaamu - kumaarudaa, neevu nee jeevitakaalamamdu neekishtamainattu sukhamu anubhavimchitivi, aalaagunane laajaru kashtamu anubhavimchènani j~naapakamu chesikònumu; ippudaite vaadu ika
Amtekaaka ikkadanumdi mee yòddaku daata goruvaaru daati pojaalakumdunatlunu, akkadi vaaru maayòddaku daati raajaalakumdunatlunu, maakunu meekunu madhya mahaa agaadhamumchabadiyunnada
Appudatadutamdree, aalaagaite naa kayidu guru sahodarulunnaaru.
Vaarunu ee vedanakaramaina sthalamunaku raakumda vaariki saakshyamichchutakai naa tamdri yimtiki vaani pampavalènani ninnu vedukònuchunnaa nanènu.
Amduku abraahaamu--vaariyòdda mosheyu pravakta lunu unnaaru; vaari maatalu vinavalènani atanito chèppagaa
Atadutamdrivaina abraahaamaa, aalaagu anavaddu; mrritulalonumdi òkadu vaariyòddaku vèllina yèdala vaaru maarumanassu pòmdudurani chèppènu.
Amdukatadumosheyu pravaktalunu (chèppina maatalu) vaaru vinaniyèdala mrritulalo numdi òkadu lechinanu vaaru nammarani atanito chèppènanènu.
Aayana tana shishyulato itlanènu abhyamtaramulu raakapovuta asaadhyamukaani avi èvanivalana vachchuno vaaniki shrama.
Vaadee chinnavaarilo òkaniki abhyamtaramu kalugajeyutakamtè vaani mèdaku tiru gatiraayi kattabadi samudramulo padadroyabaduta vaaniki melu.
Mee vishayamai meere jaagrattagaa umdudi. nee saho darudu tappidamu chesinayèdala atani gaddimchumu; atadu maarumanassu pòmdina yèdala atani kshamimchumu.
Atadu òka dinamuna edumaarulu neeyèdala tappidamu chesi yedu maarulu neevaiputirigimaarumanassu pòmditi naninayèdala atani kshamimpavalènanènu.
Apòstalulumaa vishvaasamu vrriddhipòmdimchumani prabhuvuto chèppagaa
Prabhuvumeeru aavagimjamta vishvaasamu galavaaraite ee kambalichèttunu choochineevu vellatokooda pèllagimpabadi samudramulo naatabadumani chèppunappudu adi meeku lobadunu.
Dunnuvaadu gaani mepuvaadu gaani meelo èvanikaina òka daasudumdagaa, vaadu pòlamulonumdi vachchi nappuduneevu ippade vèlli bhojanamu cheyumani vaanito chèppunaa? chèppadu.
Amtekaakanenu bhojanamu cheyutaku emainanu siddha parachi, nadumu kattukòni nenu annapaanamulu puchchu kònuvaraku naaku parichaaramu cheyumu; atutaruvaata neevu annapaanamulu pucha
Aa daasudu aaj~naapimpabadina panulu chesi namduku vaadu dayachoopènani vaanini mèchchunaa?
Atuvalè meerunu meeku aaj~naapimpabadinavanniyu chesina taruvaatamemu nish‌prayojakulamaina daasulamu, memu cheyavalasinave chesiyunnaamani chèppudanènu.
Aayana yèrooshalemunaku prayaanamai povuchu samaraya galilayala madhyagaa vèlluchumdènu.
Aayana yòka graamamuloniki vèlluchumdagaa padi mamdi kushtha rogulu aayanaku èdurugaa vachchi dooramuna nilichi
Yesu prabhuvaa, mammu karunimchumani kekalu vesiri.
Aayana vaarini choochimeeru vèlli, mimmunu yaajakulaku kanuparachukònudani vaarito chèppènu. vaaru vèllu chumdagaa, shuddhulairi.
Vaarilo òkadu tanaku svasthata kaluguta choochi
Gòppa shabdamuto devuni mahima parachuchu, tirigi vachchi aayanaku krritaj~nataastutulu chèllim chuchu, aayana paadamulayòdda saagilapadènu; vaadu samarayudu.
Amduku yesupadimamdi shuddhulairi kaaraa; aa tòmmamduguru èkkada?
Ee anyudu tappa devuni mahimaparachutaku tirigi vachchinavaadèvadunu agapadaledaa ani chèppi
Neevu lechipòmmu, nee vishvaa samu ninnu svasthaparachènani vaanito chèppènu.
Devuni raajyamèppudu vachchunani parisayyulu aayana nadiginappudu aayanadevuni raajyamu pratyakshamugaa raadu.
Èmdukanagaa idigo devuni raajyamu mee madhyane yunnadi ganuka, idigo yikkadanani, adigo akkadanani chèppa veelupadadani vaariki uttara michchènu.
Mariyu aayana tana shishyulato itlanènumanushya kumaaruni dinamulalo òkadinamu choodavalènani meeru koru dinamulu vachchunugaani meeru aa dinamunu choodaru.
Vaaruidigo yikkadanani adigo akkadanani meeto chèppinayèdala vèllakudi, vèmbadimpa kudi.
Aakaashamu krimda òka dikkunumdi mèrupumèrisi, aakaashamukrimda mariyòka dikkuna kelaagu prakaashimchuno aalaaguna manushyakumaarudu tana dinamuna umdunu.
Ayite mumdugaa aayana aneka himsalu pòmdi yee taramu vaaricheta upekshimpabadavalènu.
Novahu dinamulalo jariginattu manushyakumaaruni dinamulalonu jarugunu.
Novahu odaloniki vèllina dinamuvaraku janulu tinuchu traaguchu pèmdlaaduchu pèmdli kiyyabaduchu numdiri; amtalo jalapralayamu vachchi vaarinamdarini naashanamuchesènu.
Lotu dinamulalo jarigi nattunu jarugunu. janulu tinuchu traaguchu kònuchu ammuchu naaru naatuchu imdlu kattuchu numdiri.
Ayite lotu sòdòma vidichipoyina dinamuna aakaashamu numdi agni gamdhakamulu kurisi vaarinamdarini naashanamu chesènu.
Aa prakaarame manushyakumaarudu pratyaksha magu dinamuna jarugunu.
Aa dinamuna middèmeeda umdu vaadu imta umdu tana saamagrini teesikònipovutaku diga koodadu; aalaage pòlamulo umduvaadunu tirigi raakoodadu.
Lotu bhaaryanu j~naapakamu chesikònudi.
Tana praanamunu rakshimchukònagoruvaadu daanini pogòttukònunu, daani pogòttukònuvaadu daanini sajeeva mugaa kaapaadukònunu.
Aa raatri yiddaròkka mamchamumeeda umduru; vaarilo òkaru kònipobadunu òkaru vidichipèttabadunu.
Iddaru streelu òkka tirugali visaruchumduru; òkatè kònipobadunu òkatè vidichipètta badunanènu.

Aayanapeenugu èkkada unnado akkada gaddalunu pogavunani vaarito chèppènu.
Vaaru visukaka nityamu praarthana cheyuchumdavalè nanutaku aayana vaarito ee upamaanamu chèppènu.
Devuniki bhayapadakayu manushyulanu lakshya pèttakayu numdu òka nyaayaadhipati yòka pattana mulo umdènu.
Aa pattanamulo òka vidhavaraalunu umdènu. aamè ataniyòddaku tarachugaavachchinaa prativaadikini naakunu nyaayamu teerchumani aduguchu vachchènu gaani
Atadu kòmtakaalamu òppakapoyènu. taruvaata atadu-nenu devuniki bhayapadakayu manushyulanu lakshyapèttakayu umdinanu
Ee vidhavaraalu nannu tòmdarapèttuchunnadi ganuka aamè maati maatiki vachchi gojaadakumdunatlu aamèku nyaayamu teertunani tanalotaananukònènu.
Mariyu prabhuvitlanènu anyaayasthudaina aa nyaayaadhi pati chèppina maata vinudi.
Devudu taanu erparachukònina vaaru divaaraatrulu tannugoorchi mòrrapèttukònu chumdagaa vaariki nyaayamu teerchadaa?

Aayana vaariki tvaragaa nyaayamu teerchunu; vaarinishayame gadaa aayana deerghashaamtamu choopuchunnaadani meeto chèppuchunnaanu. ayinanu manushya kumaarudu vachchunappudu aayana bhoomi meeda vishvaasamu kanugònunaa?
Taame neetimamtulani tammu nammukòniyitarulanu trrinee karimchu kòmdarito aayana ee upamaanamu chèppènu.
Praarthanacheyutakai yiddaru manushyulu devaalayamu naku vèlliri. vaarilo òkadu parisayyudu, òkadu sumkari.
Parisayyudu niluvabadidevaa, nenu chorulunu anyaa yasthulunu vyabhichaarulunaina yitara manushyulavalènainanu, ee sumkarivalènainanu umdanamduku neeku krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchuchunnaanu.
Vaaramunaku rèmdu maarulu upa vaasamu cheyuchu naa sampaadana amtatilo padiyava vamtu chèllimchuchunnaanani tanalotaanu praarthimchu chumdènu.
Ayite sumkari dooramugaa niluchumdi, aakaashamuvaipu kannu lèttutakainanu dhairyamuchaalaka ròmmu kòttukònuchudevaa, paapinaina nannu karunimchumani palikènu.
Atanikamtè itadu neetimamtudugaa teerchabadi tana yimtiki vèllènani meeto chèppuchunnaanu. tannu taanu hèchchimchukònuvaadu taggimpabadunaniyu tannu taanu taggimchukònuvaadu hèchchimpabada
Tama shishuvulanu muttavalènani kòmdaru aayanayòddaku vaarini teesikòniraagaa aayana shishyulu adi choochi teesi kònivachchina vaarini gaddimchiri.
Ayite yesu vaarini tanayòddaku pilichichinna biddalanu aatamkaparachaka vaarini naayòddaku raaniyyudi, devuni raajyamu eelaativaaridi.
Chinna biddavalè devuni raajyamu amgeekarimpanivaadu daanilo èmtamaatramunu praveshimpadani meeto nishchayamugaa chèppuchunnaananènu.
Òka adhikaari aayananu choochisadbodhakudaa, nitya jeevamunaku vaarasudanagutaku nenemi cheyavalènani aayana nadigènu.
Amduku yesunenu satpurushudanani yela chèppuchunnaavu? devudòkkade tappa mari èvadunu satpurushudu kaadu.
Vyabhicharimpa vaddu, narahatyacheya vaddu, dòmgilavaddu, abaddha saakshyamu palukavaddu, nee tali damdrulanu sanmaanimpumanu aaj~nalanu èruguduvu gadaa ani atanito chèppènu.
Amdukatadubaalyamunumdi veetinannitini anusarimchuchune yunnaananènu.
Yesu vinineekimka òkati kòduvagaa nunnadi; neeku kaliginavanniyu amima beedalakimmu, appudu paralokamamdu neeku dhanamu kalugunu; neevu vachchi nannu vèmbadimpumani atanito chèppènu.
Atadu mikkili dhanavamtudu ganuka ee maatalu vini mikkili vyasanapadagaa
Yesu atani choochi aastigalavaaru devuni raajyamulo praveshimchuta èmto durlabhamu.
Dhanavamtudu devuni raajyamulo praveshimchuta kamtè soodibèjjamulo òmtèdooruta sulabhamani chèppènu.
Idi vininavaaru aalaagaite èvadu rakshana pòmdagaladani adugagaa
Aayana manushyulaku asaa dhyamulainavi devuniki saadhyamulani chèppènu.
Peturu idigo memu maaku kaliginavi vidichipètti ninnu vèmba dimchitimanagaa
Aayana devuni raajyamu nimittamai yimtinainanu bhaaryanainanu annadammulanainanu talidamdrula nainanu pillalanainanu vidichipèttinavaadèvadunu,
Ihamamdu chaalarètlunu paramamdu nityajeevamunu pòmdakapodani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppuchunnaanani vaarito anènu.
Aayana tana pamdrèmdumamdi shishyulanu pilichiidigo yèrooshalemunaku vèlluchunnaamu; manushyakumaaruni goorchi pravaktalacheta vraayabadina maatalanniyu nèra verchabadunu.
Aayana anyajanula kappagimpabadunu; vaaru aayananu apahasimchi, avamaanaparachi, aayanameeda umima vesi,
Aayananu kòradaalato kòtti champuduru; moodava dinamuna aayana marala lechunani chèppènu.
Vaaru ee maatalalo òkatainanu grahimpaledu; ee samgati vaariki marugu cheyabadènu ganuka aayana chèppina samgatulu vaariki bodhapadaledu.
Aayana yèriko pattanamunaku sameepimchinappudu òka gruddivaadu trovaprakkanu koorchumdi bhikshamadugukònu chumdènu.
Janasamoohamu daatipovuchunnattu vaadu chappudu viniidiemani adugagaa
Vaarunajareyu daina yesu ee maargamuna vèlluchunnaadani vaanito chèppiri.
Appudu vaaduyesoo, daaveedu kumaarudaa, nannu karunimchumani kekaluveyagaa
Oorakumdumani mumdara naduchuchumdinavaaru vaanini gaddimchiri gaani, vaadu mari èkkuvagaadaaveedu kumaarudaa, nannu karunimchumani kekaluvesènu.
Amtata yesu nilichi, vaanini tanayòddaku teesikòni rammanènu.
Vaadu daggaraku vachchinappudu aayananenu neekemi cheya goruchunnaavani adugagaa, vaaduprabhuvaa, choopu pòmdagoruchunnaa nanènu.
Yesuchoopupòmdumu, nee vishvaasamu ninnu svasthaparachènani vaanito chèppènu;
Vèmtane vaadu choopupòmdi devuni mahimaparachuchu aayananu vèmba dimchènu. prajalamdaru adi choochi devuni stotramu chesiri.
Aayana samcharimchuchu yèriko pattanamulo prave shimchi
Daanigumdaa povuchumdènu. idigo sumkapu guttadaarudunu dhanavamtudunaina jakkayya anu perugala òkadu
Yesu èvaroyani choodagorènugaani, pòtti vaadainamduna janulu gumpukoodi yumduta valana chooda lekapoyènu.
Appudu yesu aa trovanu raanai yumdènu ganuka atadu mumdugaa parugètti, aayananu choochutaku òka medi chèttèkkènu.
Yesu aa chotiki vachchinappudu, kannulètti choochijakkayyaa tvaragaa digumu, nedu nenu nee yimta numdavalasiyunnadani atanito chèppagaa
Atadu tvaragaa digi samtoshamuto aayananu cherchukònènu.
Amdaru adi choochi eeyana paapiyaina manushyuniyòdda basacheya vèllènani chaala sanugukòniri.

Jakkayya niluvabadiidigo prabhuvaa, naa aastilo sagamu beedalakichchuchunnaanu; nenèvaniyòdda nainanu anyaayamugaa deninainanu teesikòninayèdala ataniki naalugamtalu marala chèllimtunani prabhuvuto chèppènu.
Amduku yesuitadunu abraahaamu kumaarude; èmdukanagaa nedu ee yimtiki rakshana vachchiyunnadi.
Nashimchinadaanini vèdaki rakshimchutaku manushyakumaarudu vachchènani atanito chèppènu.
Vaaru ee maatalu vinuchumdagaa taanu yèroosha lemunaku sameepamuna umdutavalananu, devuni raajyamu vèmtane agupadunani vaaru talamchutavalananu, aayana mariyòka upamaanamu chèppènu. emanagaa,
Raaja kumaarudòka raajyamu sampaadimchukòni marala raavalè nani dooradeshamunaku prayaanamai
Tana daasulanu padi mamdini pilichi vaariki padi minaala nichchi nenu vachchu varaku vyaapaaramu cheyudani vaarito chèppènu.
Ayite atani pattana sthulatani dveshimchiitadu mammu neluta maa kishtamu ledani atani vènuka raayabaaramu pampiri.
Atadaa raajyamu sampaadimchukòni tirigi vachchinappudu, prativaadunu vyaapaaramuvalana ememi sampaadimchèno tèlisikònutakai taanu sòmimachchina daasulanu tanayòddaku piluvumani aaj~naapimchènu.
Mòdativaadaayana yèdutiki vachchi ayyaa, nee minaavalana padi minaalu labhimchènani chèppagaa
Atadu bhalaa, mamchi daasudaa, neevu ee kòmchèmulo nammakamugaa umtivi ganuka padi pattanamula meeda adhikaarivai yumdumani vaanito chèppènu.
Amtata rèmdavavaadu vachchi ayyaa, nee minaavalana ayidu minaalu labhimchènanagaa
Atadu neevunu ayidu pattanamulameeda umdumani atanito chèppènu.
Amtata mariyòkadu vachchi ayyaa, yidigo nee minaa;
Neevu pèttanidaanini èttikònuvaadavunu, vittanidaanini koyu vaadavunaina kathinudavu ganuka, neeku bhaya padi deenini rumaa luna katti umchitinani chèppènu.
Amdukatadu chadda daasudaa, nee noti maatanubattiye neeku teerpu teerchudunu; nenu pèttanidaanini èttu vaadanu, vittanidaanini koyu vaadanunaina kathinudanani neeku tèlisiyumdagaa
Neevèmduku naa sòmmu saahukaarulayòdda numchaledu? atlu chesi yumdinayèdala nenu vachchi vaddito daanini teesikòmdune ani vaanito chèppi
Veeniyòddanumdi aa minaa teesivesi padi minaalu galavaani kiyyudani daggara nilichinavaarito chèppènu.
Vaaru ayyaa, vaaniki padi minaalu kalave aniri.
Amdukatadukaligina prativaanikini iyya badunu, lenivaaniyòddanumdi vaaniki kaliginadiyu teesiveyabadunani meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Mariyu nenu tammunu elu taku ishtamuleni naa shatruvulanu ikkadiki teesikònivachchi naayèduta samharimchudani chèppènu.
Yesu ee maatalu chèppi yèrooshalemunaku vèlla valènani mumdu saagipoyènu.
Aayana òleevalakòmdadaggaranunna betpage betaniya anu graamamula sameepamunaku vachchinappudu, tana shishyula niddarini pilichi
Meeru èdutanunna graamamunaku vèlludi; amdulo meeru praveshimpagaane kattabadiyunna òka gaadida pilla meeku kanabadunu; daanimeeda e manushyudunu ènnadu koorchumdaledu
Èvarainanumeerèmduku deeni vippu chunnaarani mimmu nadiginayèdala idi prabhuvunaku kaavalasiyunnadani atanito chèppudani chèppi vaarini pampènu.
Pampabadina vaaru vèlli, aayana tamato chèppinatte kanugòni
Aa gaadidapillanu vippuchumdagaa daani yajamaanulumeeru, gaadida pillanu èmduku vippuchunnaarani vaari nadigiri.
Amduku vaaru idi prabhuvunaku kaavalasiyunnadaniri.
Taruvaata vaaru yesunòddaku daanini tolukòni vachchi, aa gaadidapilla meeda tama battaluvesi, yesunu daanimeeda èkkimchi,
Aayana vèlluchumdagaa tama battalu daaripòduguna parachiri.
Òleevalakòmdanumdi diguchotiki aayana sameepimchu chunnappudu shishyula samoohamamtayu samtoshimchuchu
Prabhuvu perata vachchu raaju stutimpabadunugaaka paralokamamdu samaadhaanamunu sarvonnatamaina sthalamulalo mahimayu umdunugaaka ani taamu choochina adbhutamulannitinigoorchi mahaa sha
Aa samoo hamulo unna kòmdaru parisayyulubodhakudaa, nee shishyulanu gaddimpumani aayanato chèppagaa
Aayana vaarini choochiveeru oorakumdinayèdala ee raallu kekalu veyunani meeto chèppuchunnaananènu.
Aayana pattanamunaku sameepimchinappudu daanini choochi daani vishayamai yedchi
Neevunu ee nee dinamamdainanu samaadhaanasambamdhamaina samgatulanu tèlisikòninayèdala neekèmto melu; gaani yippudavi nee kannulaku marugu cheyabadiyunnavi.
(prabhuvu) ninnu darshimchina kaalamu neevu èrugakumtivi ganuka nee shatruvulu nee chuttu gattu katti muttadivesi, anni prakkalanu ninnu arikatti, neelonunna nee pillalato kooda ninnu nela kalipi
Neelo raatimeeda raayi nilichiyumda niyyani dinamulu vachchunani chèppènu.
Aayana devaalayamulo praveshimchi amdulo vikra yamu cheyuvaarito naa mamdiramu praarthana mamdiramu ani vraayabadiyunnadi.
Ayite meeru daanini dòmgala guhagaa chesitirani chèppi vaarini vèllagòtta naarambhimchènu.
Aayana pratidinamunu devaalayamulo bodhimchu chunnappudu, pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu prajalalo pradhaanulunu aayananu naashanamucheya joochuchumdiri gaani
Prajalamdaru aayana vaakyamunu vinutaku aayananu hattukòni yumdiri ganuka emi cheyavalèno vaariki tochaledu.
Aa dinamulalo òkanaadu aayana devaalayamulo prajalaku bodhimchuchu suvaartanu prakatimchuchunnappudu pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu pèddalatokooda aayana meedikivachchi
Neevu e adhikaaramuvalana ee kaaryamu cheyuchunnaavo, yee adhikaaramu nee kèvadu ichchèno maato chèppumani aayananu adigiri.
Amdukaayananenunu mimmunu òka maata adugudunu, adi naato chèppudi.
Yohaanu ichchina baaptismamu paralokamu numdi kaliginadaa manushyulanumdi kaliginadaa? ani vaari nadugagaa
Vaaru manamu paralokamunumdi kaliginadani chèppinayèdala--aalaa gaite mee rèmdukatani nammaledani aayana manalanu adugunu.
Manushyulavalana kaliginadani chèppinayèdala prajalamdaru manalanu raallato kòttuduru; elayanagaa yohaanu pravakta ani amdarunu roodhigaa nammuchunnaarani tamalo taamu aalochimchukòni
Adi èkkadanumdi kaliginado maaku tèliyadani aayanaku uttaramichchiri.
Amduku yesue adhikaaramuvalana ee kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaano nenu meeto chèppananivaari tonanènu.
Amtata aayana prajalato ee upamaanamu chèppa saagènu òka manushyudu draakshatota naatimchi, kaapulaku guttakichchi, deshaamtaramupoyi bahukaala mumdènu.
Pamtakaalamamdu atadu aa draakshatota pamtalo tana bhaagamimmani aa kaapulayòdda kòka daasuni pampagaa aa kaapulu vaanini kòtti vattichetulato pampi vesiri.
Marala atadu mariyòka daasuni pampagaa vaaru vaanini kòtti avamaanaparachi, vattichetulato pampivesiri.
Marala natadu moodavavaani pampagaa vaaru vaanini gaaya parachi vèlupaliki trosivesiri.
Appudaa draakshatota yajamaanudunenemi chetunu? naa priyakumaaruni pampudunu; òka vela vaaru atani sanmaanimchèda ranu kònènu.
Ayinanu aa kaapulu atanini choochiitadu vaarasudu; ee svaasthyamu manadagunatlu itani champudamu ramdani yòkarito nòkaru aalochimchukòni
Atanini draakshatota vèlupaliki trosivesi champiri. kaabatti aa draakshatota yajamaanudu vaarikemi cheyunu?
Atadu vachchi aa kaapulanu samharimchi tana draakshatotanu itarulaku ichchunani aayana chèppagaa vaaru vini atlu kaakapovunu gaakaniri.
Aayana vaarini choochi aalaagaite illu kattuvaaru nishedhimchina raayi moolaku talaraayi aayènu ani vraayabadina maata emiti?
Ee raatimeeda padu prativaadunu tunakalai povunu; gaani adi èvanimeeda paduno vaanini nalicheyunanènu.
Pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu tammunugoorchi ee upamaanamu aayana chèppènani grahimchi, aa gadiyalone aayananu balaatkaaramugaa pattukòna samayamu choochiri gaani janulaku bhayapadiri.

Vaaraayananu kanipèttuchu, adhipati vashamunakunu adhikaaramunakunu aayananu appagimchutakai aayana maatalayamdu tappu pattavalènani, taamu neetimamtulani anipimchukònu vegula vaarini aayanayòddaku pampiri.
Vaaru vachchibodhakudaa, neevu nyaayamugaa maatalaaduchunu bodhimchuchu nunnaavu; nee vèvani yamdunu momotamu leka satyamu gaane devuni maargamunu bodhimchuchunnaavani yèrugu dumu.
Manamu kaisarunaku pannu ichchuta nyaayamaa kaadaa ani aayana nadigiri.
Aayana vaari kuyuktini gurtèrigiòka denaaramu naaku choopudi.
Deenimeedi roopamunu paivraatayu èvanivani adugagaa vaaru kaisaru vaniri.
Amdukaayanaaalaagaite kaisaruvi kaisarunakunu devunivi devunikini chèllimchudani vaarito chèppènu.
Vaaru prajalayèduta ee maatalo tappu patta neraka aayana pratyuttaramunaku aashcharyapadi oorakumdiri.
Punarutthaanamu ledani chèppèdi saddookayyulu kòmdaru aayanayòddaku vachchi aayananu itladigiri.
Bodhakudaa, bhaarya bradikiyumdagaa òkani sahodarudu samtaanamu leka chanipoyinayèdala, atani sahodaru datani bhaaryanu pèmdlichesikòni tana sahodaruniki samtaanamu kalugajeya valè
Yeduguru sahodaru lumdiri. mòdativaadòka streeni pèmdli chesikòni samtaanamu leka chanipoyènu.
Rèmdavavaadunu moodavavaadunu aamènu pèmdlichesikòniri.
Aa prakaarame yedugurunu aamènu pèmdlaadi samtaanamulekaye chani poyiri. pimmata aa streeyu chanipoyènu.
Kaabatti punarutthaanamamdu aamè vaarilo èvaniki bhaaryagaa umdunu?
Aa yedugurikini aamè bhaaryagaa umdènu gadaa aniri.
Amduku yesuee lokapu janulu pèmdlichesikòmduru,pèmdlikiyyabaduduru gaani
Paramunu mrritula punarutthaanamunu pòmdutaku yogyulani yèmcha badinavaaru pèmdlichesikònaru, pèmdlikiyya badaru.
Vaaru punarutthaanamulo paalivaaraiyumdi,3 devadoota samaa nulunu devuni kumaarulunai yumduru ganuka vaarikanu chaavaneraru.
Pòdanugurimchina bhaagamuloprabhuvu abraahaamu devudaniyu issaaku devudaniyu yaakobu devudaniyu chèppuchu,
Mrritulu leturani moshe soochimchènu; aayana sajeevulake devudu kaani mrritulaku devudu kaadu; aayana drrishtiki amdarunu jeevimchu chunnaarani vaariki uttaramichchènu.
Taruvaata vaaraaya nanu maremiyu aduga tègimpaledu ganuka shaastrulalo kòmdaru bodhakudaa,
Neevu yuktamugaa chèppitivaniri.
Aayana vaaritokreestu daaveedu kumaarudani janu lelaagu chèppuchunnaaru
Nenu nee shatruvulanu nee paadamulaku paadapeethamugaa umchuvaraku neevu naakudipaarshvamuna koorchumdu mani
Prabhuvu naa prabhuvuto chèppènu. ani keertanala gramthamulo daaveede chèppiyunnaadu.
Daaveedu aayananu prabhuvani chèppinayèdala aayana elaagu atani kumaarudagunani chèppènu.
Prajalamdaru vinuchumdagaa aayana itlanènushaastrulanu goorchi jaagrattapadudi. vaaru niluvutamgeelu dharimchu kòni tirugagoruchu
Samtaveedhulalo vamdanamulanu, samaajamamdiramulalo agrapeethamulanu, vimdulalo agra sthaanamulanu koruduru.
Vaaru vidhavaraamdra yimdlanu digamimguchu, maayaveshamugaa deerghapraarthanalu cheyuduru. vaaru mari visheshamugaa shiksha pòmdudurani tana shishyulato chèppènu.
Kaanuka pèttèlo tama kaanukalanu veyuchunna dhanavamtulanu aayana paarajoochènu.
Òka beeda vidhavaraalu rèmdu kaasulu amdulo veyuchumdagaa choochi
Ee beeda vidhavaraalu amdarikamtè èkkuva vesènani meeto nijamugaa chèppuchunnaanu.
Vaaramdaru tamaku kaligina samrriddhilonumdi kaanukalu vesirigaani yeemè tana lemilo tanaku kaligina jeevanamamtayu vesènani vaarito chèppènu.
Kòmdaruidi amdamaina raallatonu arpitamula tonu shrrimgaarimpabadiyunnadani devaalayamunu goorchi, maatalaaduchumdagaa
Aayana ee kattadamulu meeru choochuchunnaare, vaatilo raatimeeda raayi yumda kumda avi padadroyabadu dinamulu vachchu chunnavani chèppènu.
Appudu vaarubodhakudaa, aalaagaite ivi yèppudu jarugunu? ivi jarugabovu nani soochana emani aayana nadugagaa
Aayana meeru mosapokumda choochukònudi. anekulu naa perata vachchinene aayanananiyu, kaalamu sameepimchènaniyu chèppuduru; meeru vaari vèmbadipokudi.
Meeru yuddhamulanu goorchiyu kalahamulanu goorchiyu vininappudu jadiyakudi; ivi mòdata jarugavalasiyunnavi gaani amtamu vèmtane raadani chèppènu.
Mariyu aayana vaarito itlanènujanamumeediki janamunu raajyamumeediki raajyamunu lechunu;
Akka dakkada gòppa bhookampamulu kalugunu, tègullunu karavu lunu tatasthimchunu, aakaashamunumdi mahaa bhayotpaata mulunu gòppa soochanalunu puttunu.

Ivanniyu jarugaka munupu vaaru mimmunu balaatkaaramugaa patti, naa naamamu nimittamu mimmunu raajulayòddakunu adhi patula yòddakunu teesikònipoyi, samaajamamdiramulakunu chèrasaalalakunu appagimchi himsimturu.
Idi saakshyaa rthamai meeku sambhavimchunu.
Kaabatti mememi samaadhaa namu chèppudumaa ani mumdugaa chimtimpakumdumani mee manassulo nishchayimchukònudi.
Mee virodhu lamdaru èduraadutakunu, kaadanutakunu veelukaani vaakkunu j~naanamunu nenu meeku anugrahimtunu.
Talidamdrulachetanu sahodarulachetanu bamdhuvulachetanu snehitulachetanu meeru appagimpabaduduru; vaaru meelo kòmdarini champimturu;
Naa naamamu nimittamu meeru manushyulamdaricheta dveshimpabaduduru.
Gaani mee tala vèmdrukalalo òkatainanu nashimpadu.
Meeru mee orpu cheta mee praanamulanu dakkimchukòmduru.
Yèrooshalemu damdlacheta chuttabaduta meeru choochu nappudu daani naashanamu sameepamaiyunnadani tèlisi kònudi.
Appudu yoodayalo umduvaaru kòmda laku paaripovalènu; daani madhyanumduvaaru vèlupaliki povalènu; pallètoollalonivaaru daanilo praveshimpa koodadu.
Lekhanamulalo vraayabadina vanniyu nèra verutakai avi prati damdana dinamulu.
Aa dinamulalo garbhinulakunu paalichchuvaarikini shrama. bhoomimeeda mikkili yibbamdiyu ee prajalameeda kopamunu vachchunu.
Vaaru kattivaata kooluduru; chèrapattabadina vaarai samastamaina anyajanamula madhyaku povuduru; anyajanamula kaalamulu sampoornamaguvaraku yèroosha lemu anyajanamulacheta tròkkabadunu.
Mariyu soorya chamdra nakshatramulalo soochanalunu, bhoomimeeda samudrataramgamula ghoshavalana kalavarapadina janamulaku shramayu kalugunu.
Aakaashamamdali shaktulu kadilimpa badunu ganuka lokamu meediki raabovuchunna vaati vishayamai bhayamu kaligi, manushyulu èduruchoochuchu dhairyamuchèdi kooluduru.
Appudu manushyakumaarudu prabhaavamutonu mahaa mahimatonu meghaaroodhudai vachchuta chooturu.
Ivi jaruga naarambhimchinappudu meeru dhairyamu tèchchukòni mee talalèttikònudi, mee vidudala sameepimchuchunnadanènu.
Mariyu aayana vaarito ee upamaanamu chèppènu amjoorapu vrrikshamunu samasta vrriksha mulanu choodudi.
Avi chigirimchutachoochi vasamta kaalamappude sameepamaayè nani mee amtata meeru tèlisi kòmduru gadaa?
Atuvalè meeru ee samgatulu jaruguta choochinappudu devuni raajyamu sameepamaayènani tèlisikònudi.
Avanniyu jaruguvaraku ee taramu gatimpadani nishchayamugaa meeto chèppuchunnaanu.
Aakaashamunu bhoomiyu gatimchunu gaani naa maatalemaatramunu gatimpavu.

Mee hrridayamulu òkavela timdivalananu mattuvalananu aihika vichaaramulavalananu mamdamugaa unnamduna aa dinamu akasmaattugaa mee meediki urivachchinattu raakumda mee vishayamai meeru jaagrattagaa umdudi.
Aa dinamu bhoomiyamdamtata nivasimchu vaaramdarimeediki akasmaattugaa vachchunu.
Kaabatti meeru jarugabovu veetinèllanu tappimchu kòni, manushyakumaaruni yèduta niluvabadutaku shaktigala vaaragunatlu èllappudunu praarthanacheyuchu mèlakuvagaa umdudani chèppènu.
Aayana pratidinamu pagatiyamdu devaalayamulo bodhimchuchu raatrivela òleevalakòmdaku vèlluchu kaalamu gadupuchumdènu.
Prajalamdaru aayana maata vinutaku devaalayamulo aayanayòddaku pèmdalakada vachchuchumdiri.
Paskaa anabadina puliyani ròttèla pamduga samee pimchènu.
Pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu prajalaku bhayapadiri ganuka aayananu elaagu champimtumani upaa yamu vèdakuchumdiri.
Amtata pamdrèmdumamdi shishyula samkhyalo cherina iskariyotu anabadina yoodaalo saataanu prave shimchènu
Ganuka vaadu vèlli, aayananu vaarikelaagu appagimpavachchuno daaninigoorchi pradhaana yaaja kulatonu adhipatulatonu maatalaadènu.
Amduku vaaru samto shimchi vaaniki dravyamiyya sammatimchiri.
Vaadu amduku òppukòni, janasamoohamu lenappudu aayananu vaariki appagimchutaku tagina samayamu vèdakuchumdènu.
Paskaapashuvunu vadhimpavalasina puliyani ròttèla dinamuraagaa
Yesu peturunu yohaanunu choochimeeru vèlli manamu bhujimchutakai paskaanu manakòraku siddhaparachudani vaarini pampènu.
Vaarumemèkkada siddhaparachagoruchunnaavani aayananu adugagaa
Aayanaidigo meeru pattanamulo praveshimchunappudu neellakumda mosikònipovuchunna yòkadu meeku èdurugaa vachchunu; atadu praveshimchu imtiloniki atani vèmta vèlli
Nenu naa shishyulato kooda paskaanu bhujimchutaku vididi gadi yèkkadanani bodhakudu ninnaduguchunnaadani yimti yajamaanunito chèppudi.
Atadu saamagrigala yòka gòppa medagadi meeku choopimchunu; akkada siddha parachudani vaarito chèppènu.
Vaaru vèlli aayana tamato chèppinattu kanugòni paskaanu siddhaparachiri.
Aa gadiya vachchinappudu aayanayu aayanatokooda apòstalulunu pamktini koorchumdiri.
Appudaayana nenu shramapadakamunupu meetokooda ee paskaanu bhujimpavalènani mikkili aashapaditini.
Adi devuni raajya mulo nèraveruvaraku ika ènnadunu daani bhujimpanani meeto chèppuchunnaanani vaarito chèppi

Shikshimchi vidudala cheyudunani vaarito chèppagaa
Vaaramdaru veenini champivesi maaku barabbanu vidudala cheyumani ekagreevamugaa kekaluvesiri.
Veedu pattanamulo jarigimchina yòka allari nimittamunu narahatya nimittamunu chèrasaalalo veyabadinavaadu.
Pilaatu yesunu vidudala cheyagori vaarito tirigi maatalaadinanu.
Vaaru veenini siluvaveyumu siluvaveyumu ani kekalu vesiri.
Moodava maaru ataduèmduku? itadu e dushkaaryamu chesènu? itaniyamdu maranamunaku tagina neramemiyu naaku agapadaledu ganuka itani shikshimchi vidudala chetunani vaarito chèppènu.
Ayite vaaròke pattugaa pèdda kekaluvesi, veenini siluvaveyumani adugagaa vaari kekale gèlichènu.
Kaagaa vaaradiginatte jarugavalènani pilaatu teerputeerchi
Allari nimittamunu narahatya nimitta munu chèrasaalalo veyabadiyumdinavaanini vaaradiginattu vaariki vidudalachesi, yesunu vaarikishtamu vachchinattu cheyutaku appagimchènu.
Vaaraayananu teesikònipovuchumdagaa pallètoorinumdi vachchuchunna kureneeyudaina seemonanu òkani pattukòni, yesuvèmta siluvanu moyutaku atanimeeda daanini pèttiri.
Gòppa janasamoohamunu, aayananugoorchi ròmmukòttu kònuchu duhkhimchuchunna chaalamamdi streelunu aayananu vèmbadimchiri.
Yesu vaarivaipu tirigiyèrooshalemu kumaartèlaaraa, naa nimittamu edvakudi; mee nimittamunu mee pillala nimittamunu edvudi.
Idigo gòdraamdrunu kanani garbhamulunu paaliyyani stanamulunu dhanyamulainavani chèppudinamulu vachchuchunnavi.
Appudumaameeda padudani parvatamulatonu, mammu kappudani kòmdalatonu janulu chèppasaaguduru.
Vaaru pachchimraanuke yeelaagu chesinayèdala èmdinadaanikemi cheyuduro ani chèppènu.
Mari yiddaru aayanatokooda champabadutaku tebadiri; vaaru neramu chesinavaaru.
Vaaru kapaalamanabadina sthalamunaku vachchinappudu akkada kudivaipuna òkanini èdamavaipuna òkanini aa nerasthulanu aayanato kooda siluvavesiri.
Yesu tamdree, veeremi cheyuchunnaaro veerèrugaru ganuka veerini kshamimchumani chèppènu. vaaru aayana vastramulu pamchukònutakai cheetluvesiri.
Prajalu niluvabadi choochu chumdiri; adhikaarulunuveedu itarulanu rakshimchènu; veedu devuderparachukònina kreestu ayina yèdala tannutaanurakshimchukònunani apahasimchiri.
Amtata sainikulu aayanayòddaku vachchi aayanaku chirakanichchi
Neevu yoodula raajuvaite ninnu neeve rakshimchukònumani aayananu apahasimchiri.
Itadu yoodula raajani paivilaasamukooda aayanaku paigaa vraayabadènu.
Vrelaadaveyabadina aa nerasthulalo òkadu aayananu dooshimchuchuneevu kreestuvu gadaa? ninnu neevu rakshimchu kònumu, mammunukooda rakshimchumani chèppènu.
Ayite rèmdavavaadu vaanini gaddimchineevu ade shikshaavidhilo unnaavu ganuka devuniki bhayapadavaa?

Paavuramulu ammu vaaritoveetini ikkada numdi teesikònipòmdi; naa tamdri yillu vyaapaaraputillugaa cheyakudani chèppènu.

Appudaa stree ayyaa, yee baavi lotainadi, chedukònutaku neekemiyu lede; aa jeevajalamu elaagu neeku dòrakunu?
