Elaaganagaa naa bamdhakamulu kreestu nimittame kaliginavani pretoryamanu senaloni vaari kamdarikini takkinavaari kamdarikini spashta maayènu.
Mariyu sahodarulaina vaarilo èkkuvamamdi naa bamdhakamula moolamugaa prabhuvunamdu sthira vishvaasamu galavaarai, nirbhayamugaa devuni vaakyamu bodhimchutaku mari visheshadhairyamu tèchchukòniri.
Kòmdaru asooyachetanu kalahabuddhichetanu, marikòmdaru mamchibuddhi chetanu kreestunu prakatimchuchunnaaru.
Vaaraite naa bamdhakamulato kooda naaku shrama toducheyavalènani talamchukòni, shuddhamanassuto kaaka kakshato kreestunu prakatimchuchunnaaru;
Veeraite nenu suvaartapakshamuna vaadimchutaku niyamimpabadiyunnaananiyèrigi, premato prakatimchuchunnaaru.
Ayinanemi? mishachetanegaani satyamuchetane gaani, yevidhamuchetanainanu kreestu praka timpabaduchunnaadu. amduku nenu samtoshimchuchunnaanu. ika mumdunu samtoshimtunu.

Mariyu nenu e vishayamulonu siggupadaka yèppativalène yippudunu poornadhairyamuto bodhimchutavalana naa braduku moolamugaa nainanu sare, chaavu moolamugaanainanu sare, kreestu naa shareeramamdu ghanaparachabadunani

Nenu migula apekshimchuchu nireekshimchuchunna prakaaramugaa mee praarthanavalananu, yesukreestuyòkka aatmanaaku samrriddhigaa kalugutavalananu, aa prakatana naaku rakshanaarthamugaa parina mimchunani nenèrugudunu.
Naamattukaite bradukuta kreeste, chaavaite laabhamu.
Ayinanu shareeramuto nenu jeevimchutaye naakunna paniki phalasaadhanamaina yèdala nenemi korukòmduno naaku tochaledu.
Ee rèmti madhyanu irukunabadiyunnaanu. nenu vèdalipoyi kreestutokooda numdavalènani naaku aashayunnadi, adinaaku mari melu.
Ayinanu nenu shareeramunamdu nilichi yumduta mimmunubatti mari avasaramaiyunnadi.
Mariyu itti nammakamu kaligi, nenu marala meeto kalisi yumdutacheta nannugoorchi kreestu yesunamdu meekunna atishayamu adhikamagunatlu.
Meeru vishvaasamunamdu abhi vrriddhiyu aanamdamunu pòmdu nimittamu, nenu jeevimchi mee amdarito kooda kalisiyumdunani naaku tèliyunu.

Nenu vachchi mimmunu choochinanu, raakapoyinanu, meeru e vishayamulonu èdirimchuvaariki bèdaraka, amdarunu òkka bhaavamaiuto suvaarta vishvaasapakshamuna poraaduchu, eka manassugalavaarai nilichiyunnaarani nenu mimmunu goorchi vinulaaguna, meeru kreestu suvaartaku taginatlugaa pravartimchudi.
Atlu meeru bèdarakumduta vaariki naashanamunu meeku rakshanayunu kalugunanutaku soochanayai yunnadi. idi devunivalana kalugunade.
Elayanagaa meeru naayamdu choochinattiyu, naayamdunnadani meerippudu vinuchunnattiyu poraatamu meekunu kaligi yunnamduna
Kreestunamdu vishvaasamumchutamaatrame gaaka aayana pakshamuna shramapadutayu aayana pakshamuna meeku anugrahimpabadènu.
Kaavuna kreestunamdu e hèchcharikayainanu, prema valana aadaranayainanu, aatmayamdu e sahavaasamainanu, e dayaarasamainanu, vaatsalyamainanu unnayèdala
Meeru ekamanaskulagunatlugaa ekapremakaligi, yeka bhaavamugalavaarugaa umdi, òkkadaaniyamde manassumchuchu naa samtoshamunu sampoornamu cheyudi.
Kakshachetanainanu vrrithaatishayamuchetanainanu emiyu cheyaka, vinayamaina manassugalavaarai yòkaninòkadu tanakamtè yogyudani yèmchuchu
Meelo prativaadunu tana sòmtakaaryamulanu maatramegaaka yitarula kaaryamulanu kooda choodavalènu.
Kreestuyesunaku kaligina yee manassu meerunu kaligiyumdudi.
Aayana devuni svaroo pamu kaliginavaadaiyumdi, devunito samaanamugaa umduta vidichipèttakoodani bhaagyamani yèmchukònaledu gaani
Manushyula polikagaa putti, daasuni svaroopamunu dharimchukòni, tannu taane riktunigaa chesikònènu.
Mariyu, aayana aakaaramamdu manushyudugaa kanabadi, maranamu pòmdunamtagaa, anagaa siluvamaranamu pòmdu namtagaa vidheyata choopinavaadai, tannutaanu taggimchukònènu.
Amduchetanu paralokamamdunnavaarilo gaani, bhoomimeeda unnavaarilo gaani,
Bhoomi krimda unnavaarilo gaani, prativaani mokaalunu yesunaamamuna vamgunatlunu,
Prativaani naalukayu tamdriyaina devuni mahimaarthamai yesukreestu prabhuvani òppukònunatlunu, devudu aayananu adhikamugaa hèchchimchi, prati naama munaku painaamamunu aayanaku anugrahimchènu.

Kaagaa naa priyulaaraa, meerèllappudunu vidheyulai yunna prakaaramu, naayèduta unnappudu maatrame gaaka mari yèkkuvagaa nenu meeto leni yee kaalamamdunu, bhayamutonu vanakutonu mee sòmtarakshananu kònasaagimchukònudi.
Èmdukanagaa meeru ichchayimchuta kunu kaaryasiddhi kalugajesikònutakunu, tana dayaasamkalpamu nèraverutakai meelo kaaryasiddhi kalugajeyuvaadu devude.
Meeru moorkhamaina vakrajanamu madhya, niraparaadhulunu nishkalamkulunu animdyulunaina devuni kumaarulagunatlu,
Sanugulunu samshayamulunu maani, samasta kaaryamulanu cheyudi.
Atti janamu madhyanu meeru jeevavaakyamunu chetapattukòni, lokamamdu jyotulavalè kanabadu chunnaaru. amduvalana nenu vyarthamugaa parugètta ledaniyu, nenu padina kashtamu nish‌pra
Mariyu mee vishvaasayaagamulonu daani sambamdhamaina sevalonu nenu paanaarpanamugaa poyabadinanu, nenaa namdimchi mee yamdaritokooda samtoshimtunu.
Ituvalène meerunu aanamdimchi naatokooda samtoshimchudi.
Nenunu mee kshemamu tèlisikòni dhairyamu tèchchu kònu nimittamu timotini sheeghramugaa meeyòddaku pamputaku prabhuvaina yesunamdu nireekshimchuchunnaanu.
Mee kshemavishayamai nijamugaa chimtimchuvaadu atani vamtivaadèvadunu naayòdda ledu.
Amdarunu tama sòmta kaaryamulane choochukònuchunnaaru gaani, yesukreestu kaaryamulanu choodaru.
Atani yogyata meerèrugu duru. tamdriki kumaarudelaagu sevacheyuno aalaage atadu naatokooda suvaarta vyaapakamu nimittamu seva chesènu.
Kaabatti naakemi sambhavimpanaiyunnado choochinavèmtane atanini pampavalènani anukònuchunnaanu.
Nenunu sheeghramugaa vachchèdanani prabhuvunubatti nammu chunnaanu.
Mariyu naa sahodarudunu, jatapanivaadunu, naatodi yodhudunu, mee dootayu, naa avasaramunaku upacharimchina vaadunaina èpaphròditunu mee yòddaku pamputa agatyamani anukòmtini.
Atadurogi yaayènani meeru vimtiri ganuka atadu mimmunamdarini chooda migula apekshagalavaadai vichaarapaduchumdènu.
Nijamugaa atadu rogiyai chaavunaku siddhamai yumdènu gaani devudatanini kanikarimchènu; atanimaatrame gaaka naaku duhkhamumeeda duhkhamu kalugakumdutakai nannunu kanikarimchènu.
Kaabatti meeru atanini choochi marala samtoshimchunimittamunu naa kunna duhkhamu taggu nimittamunu atanini mari sheeghramugaa pampitini.
Naayèdala mee upacharyalo unna kòduvanu teerchutakai atadu tana praanamunainanu lakshyapèttaka kreestuyòkka pani nimittamu chaavunaku siddhamaiyumdènu
Ganuka poornaa namdamuto prabhuvunamdu atanini cherchukòni attivaarini ghanaparachudi.
Mèttuku naa sahodarulaaraa, prabhuvunamdu aanam dimchudi. adesamgatulanu meeku vraayuta naaku kashtamainadi kaadu, meeku adi kshemakaramu.
Kukkala vishayamai jaagrattagaa umdudi. dushtulaina pani vaari vishayamai jaagrattagaa umdudi, ee chedana naacharimchu vaari vishayamai jaagrattagaa umdudi.
Èmdukanagaa shareeramunu aaspadamu chesikònaka devuniyòkka aatmavalana aaraadhimchuchu, kreestuyesunamdu atishayapaduchunna maname sunnati aacharimchuvaaramu.
Kaavalayunamte nenu shareeramunu aaspadamu chesikònavachchunu; mari èvadainanu shareeramunu aaspadamu chesikònadalachinayèdala nenu mari yèkkuvagaa chesikònavachchunu.
Ènimidavadinamuna sunnati pòmditini, ishraayelu vamshapuvaadanai, bènyaameenu gotramulo putti hèbreeyula samtaanamaina hèbreeyudanai, dharmashaastravishayamu parisayyudanai,
Aasaktivishayamu samghamunu himsimchuvaadanai, dharma shaastramuvalani neetivishayamu animdyudanai yumtini.
Ayinanu evevi naaku laabhakaramulai yumdèno vaatini kreestunimittamu nashtamugaa èmchukòmtini.
Nishcha yamugaa naa prabhuvaina yesukreestunugoorchina atishreshthamaina j~naanamu nimittamai samastamunu nashtamugaa èmchukònuchunnaanu.

Kreestunu sampaadimchukòni, dharmashaastramoolamaina naa neetinigaaka, kreestunamdali vishvaasamuvalananaina neeti, anagaa vishvaasamunubatti devudu anugrahimchu neetigalavaadanai aayanayamdu agapadu nimittamunu,
E vidhamuchetanainanu mrritulalonumdi naaku punarutthaanamu kalugavalènani, aayana maranavishaya mulo samaanaanubhavamugalavaadanai, aayananu aayana punarutthaanabalamunu èrugu nimittamunu,
Aayana shramalalo paalivaadanaguta yèttido yèrugu nimittamunu, samastamunu nashtaparachukòni vaatini pèmtato samaanamugaa èmchukònuchunnaanu.

Idivarake nenu gèlichiti naniyainanu, idivarake sampoorna siddhi pòmditinaniyainanu nenu anukònutaledu gaani, nenu deni nimittamu kreestu yesucheta pattabaditino daanini pattukònavalènani parugèttu chunnaanu.
Sahodarulaaraa, nenidivarake pattukòni yunnaanani talamchukònanu. ayite òkati cheyuchunnaanu; vènuka unnavi marachi mumdunna vaatikòrakai vegirapaduchu
Kreestu yesunamdu devuni unnatamaina pilupunaku kalugu bahumaanamunu pòmdavalènani, guri yòddake parugèttuchunnaanu.
Kaabatti manalo sampoornulamaina vaaramamdaramu ee taatparyame kaligiyumdamu. appudu denigoorchiyainanu meeku veru taatparyamu kaligiyunnayèdala, adiyu devudu meeku bayalu parachunu.
Ayinanu ippativaraku manaku labhimchina daaninibattiye kramamugaa naduchukòmdamu.
Sahodarulaaraa, meeru nannu poli naduchukònudi; memu meeku maadiriyaiyunna prakaaramu naduchukònu vaarini guripètti choodudi.
Anekulu kreestu siluvaku shatruvulugaa naduchukònuchunnaaru; veerini goorchi meeto aneka paryaayamulu chèppi yippudunu edchuchu chèppu chunnaanu.
Naashaname vaari amtamu, vaari kadupe vaari devudu; vaaru taamu siggupadavalasina samgatulayamdu atishayapaduchunnaaru, bhoosambamdhamainavaati yamde manassu numchuchunnaaru.
Mana paurasthiti para lokamunamdunnadi; akkadanumdi prabhuvaina yesukreestu anu rakshakuni nimittamu kanipèttukòniyunnaamu.
Samastamunu tanaku loparachukònajaalina shaktinibatti aayana mana deenashareeramunu tana mahimagala shareeramunaku sama roopamu galadaanigaa maarchunu.
Kaavuna nenapekshimchu naa priya sahodarulaaraa, naa aanamdamunu naa kireetamunaiyunnanaa priyulaaraa, yitlu prabhuvunamdu sthirulai yumdudi.
Prabhuvunamdu ekamanassugalavaarai yumdudani yuvòdiyanu, sumtukenu batimaalukònuchunnaanu.
Avunu, nijamaina sahakaaree aa streelu klèmèmtutonu naa yitara sahakaarulatonu suvaartapanilo naatokooda prayaasapadinavaaru ganuka vaariki sahaa yamu cheyumani ninnu vedukònuchunnaana
Èllappudunu prabhuvunamdu aanamdimchudi,marala chèppu dunu aanamdimchudi.
Mee sahanamunu sakala janulaku tèliyabadaniyyudi. prabhuvu sameepamugaa unnaadu.
Deninigoorchiyu chimtapadakudi gaani prati vishayamulonu praarthana vij~naapanamulacheta krritaj~nataapoorvakamugaa mee vinnapamulu devuniki tèliyajeyudi.
Appudu samasta j~naanamunaku mimchina devuni samaadhaanamu yesukreestuvalana mee hrridayamulakunu mee talampulakunu kaavali yumdunu.

Mèttuku sahodarulaaraa, ye yogyatayainanu mèppainanu umdinayèdala, evi satyamainavo, evi maanya mainavo, evi nyaayamainavo, evi pavitramainavo, evi ramyamainavo, evi khyaatigalavo, vaatimeeda dhyaana mumchukònudi.
Mariyu meeru naavalana evi nerchukòni amgeekarimchitiro, naayamdunnattugaa evi vimtiro evi choochitiro, attivaatini cheyudi; appudu samaadhaana kartayagu devudu meeku todaiyumdunu.
Nannugoorchi meerinnaallaku marala yochana cheya saagitirani prabhuvunamdu mikkili samtoshimchitini. aa vishayamulo meeru yochanachesiyumtiri gaani tagina samayamu dòrakakapoyènu.
Naaku kòduva kaliginamduna neneelaagu chèpputaledu; nenesthitilo unnanu aasthitilo samtrripti kaligiyumda nerchukòni yunnaanu.

Deenasthitilo umda nèrugudunu, sampanna sthitilo umda nèrugudunu; prativishayamulonu anni kaaryamulalonu kadupu nimdiyumdutakunu aakaligòniyumdutakunu, samrriddhikaligiyumdutakunu lemilo umdutakunu nerchu kòniyunnaanu.
Nannu balaparachuvaaniyamde nenu samastamunu cheyagalanu.
Ayinanu naa shramalo meeru paalupuchchukòninadi mamchipani.

Philippeeyulaaraa, suvaartanu nenu bodhimpa naarambhimchi maasidoniyalonumdi vachchinappudu ichchu vishayamulonu puchchukònu vishayamulonu meeru tappa mari e samghapuvaarunu naato paalivaaru kaaledani meeke tèliyunu.
Elayanagaa thèssalòneekalokooda meeru maatimaatiki naa avasaramu teerchutaku sahaayamu chesitiri.
Nenu yeevini apekshimchi yeelaagu chèpputaledu gaani mee lèkkaku vistaaraphalamu raavalènani apekshimchi chèppu chunnaanu.

Naaku samastamunu samrriddhigaa kaligiyunnadi. meeru pampina vastuvulu èpaphròdituvalana puchchukòni yemiyu takkuvaleka yunnaanu; avi manoharamaina suvaasanayu, devuniki preetikaramunu ishtamunaina yaagamunai yunnavi.
Kaagaa devudu tana aishvaryamu chòppuna kreestuyesunamdu mahimalo mee prati avasaramunu teerchunu.
Mana tamdriyaina devuniki yuga yugamulaku mahima kalugunu gaaka. aamen‌.
Prati parishuddhuniki kreestuyesunamdu vamdanamulu chèppudi.
Naatokooda unna sahodarulamdaru meeku vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaaru. parishuddhulamdarunu mukhya mugaa kaisaru imtivaarilo unna parishuddhulunu meeku vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaaru.
Prabhuvaina yesukreestu krripa mee aatmato umdunugaaka.
Kòlòssayilo unna parishuddhulaku, anagaa kreestu namdu vishvaasulaina sahodarulaku.
Devuni chittamuvalana kreestuyesu apòstaludaina paulunu sahodarudaina timoti yunu shubhamanichèppi vraayunadi. mana tamdriyaina devuni numdi krripayu samaadhaanamunu meeku kalugunu gaaka.

Paralokamamdu meekòraku umchabadina nireekshananubatti, kreestuyesunamdu meeku kaligiyunna vishvaasamunu goorchiyu, parishuddhulamdarimeeda meekunna premanu goorchiyu, memu vini yèllappudu mee nimittamu praarthanacheyuchu,
Mana prabhuvagu yesu kreestuyòkka tamdriyaina devuniki krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchuchunnaamu.
Meeyòddaku vachchina suvaarta satyamunugoorchina bodhavalana aa nireekshananugoorchi meeru imtakumumdu vimtiri.
Ee suvaarta sarvalokamulo phalimchuchu, vyaapimchuchunnattugaa meeru devuni krripanugoorchi vini satyamugaa grahimchina naatanumdi meelo sayitamu phalimchuchu vyaapimchuchunnadi.
Èpaphraa anu maa priyudaina todidaasunivalana meeru ee samgatulanu nerchukòmtiri.
Atadu maa vishayamulo nammakamaina kreestu parichaarakudu; atadu aatmayamdali mee premanu maaku tèlipinavaadu.
Amducheta ee samgati vininanaatanumdi memunu mee nimittamu praarthana cheyuta maanaka, meeru sampoorna j~naanamunu aatma sambamdhamaina vivekamuganulavaarunu,
Aayana chittamunu poornamugaa grahimchinavaarunai, prati satkaaryamulo saphalulaguchu, devuni vishayamaina j~naana mamdu abhivrriddhi pòmduchu, anni vishayamulalo prabhuvunu samtoshapèttunatlu,
Aayanaku taginattugaa naduchukònavalènaniyu, aanamdamuto koodina poornamaina orpunu deerghashaamtamunu kanuparachunatlu aayana mahima shaktinibatti sampoorna balamuto balaparachabadavalènaniyu,
Tejovaasulaina parishuddhula svaasthyamulo paalivaaramagutaku manalanu paatrulanugaachesina tamdriki meeru krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimpavalènaniyu devuni batimaalu chunnaamu.
Aayana manalanu amdhakaarasambamdhamaina adhikaaramulonumdi vidudalachesi, taanu premimchina tana kumaaruniyòkka raajyanivaasulanugaa chesènu.
Aa kumaaruniyamdu manaku vimochanamu, anagaa paapakshamaapana kaluguchunnadi.
Aayana adrrishyadevuni svaroopiyai sarvasrrishtiki aadisambhootudai yunnaadu.

Elayanagaa aakaashamamdunnaviyu bhoomiyamdunna viyu, drrishyamainavigaani, adrrishyamainavigaani, avi simhaasanamulainanu prabhutvamulainanu pradhaanulainanu adhikaaramulainanu, sarvamunu aayanayamdu srrijimpa badènu, sarvamunu aayanadvaaraanu aayananubattiyu srrijimpabadènu.
Aayana annitikamtè mumdugaa unna vaadu; aayane samastamunaku aadhaarabhootudu.
Samghamu anu shareeramunaku aayane shirassu; aayanaku annitilo praamukhyamu kalugu nimittamu, aayana aadiyaiyumdi mrritulalonumdi lechutalo aadisambhootudaayènu.
Aayanayamdu sarvasampoornata nivasimpavalènaniyu,

Aayana siluvaraktamucheta samdhichesi, aayanadvaaraa samastamunu, avi bhoolokamamdunnavainanu paraloka mamdunnavainanu, vaatinannitini aayanadvaaraa tanato samaadhaanaparachukòna valènaniyu tamdri abheeshtamaayènu.
Mariyu gatakaala mamdu devuniki doorasthulunu, mee dush‌kriyalavalana mee manassulo virodhabhaavamugalavaarunai yumdina mimmunu kooda
Tana sannidhini parishuddhulugaanu nirdoshulugaanu niraparaadhulugaanu niluvabèttutaku aayana maamsayuktamaina dehamamdu maranamuvalana ippudu mimmunu samaadhaanaparachènu.

Punaadimeeda kattabadinavaarai sthiramugaa umdi, meeru vinnattiyu, aakaashamukrimda unna samastasrrishtiki prakatimpabadinattiyu ee suvaartavalana kalugu nireekshananumdi tòlagipoka, vishvaasamamdu nilichi yumdinayèdala idi meeku kalugunu. paulanu nenu aa suvaartaku parichaarakudanaitini.

Ippudu meekòraku nenu anubhavimchuchunna shramala yamdu samtoshimchuchu, samghamu anu aayana shareeramu kòraku kreestu padinapaatlalo kòduvaina vaatiyamdu naa vamtu naa shareeramamdu sampoornamu cheyuchunnaanu.
Devuni vaakyamunu, anagaa yugamulalonu taramulalonu marugu cheyabadiyunna marmamunu sampoornamugaa praka timchutaku,
Mee nimittamu naaku appagimpabadina devuni yerpaatu5 prakaaramu, nenu aa samghamunaku parichaara kudanaitini.
Anyajanulalo ee marmamuyòkka mahi maishvaryamu èttido adi, anagaa mee yamdunna kreestu, mahima nireekshanayai yunnaadanu6 samgatini devudu tana parishuddhulaku tèliyaparachagori m

Prati manushyuni kreestunamdu sampoornunigaa chesi aayanayèduta niluvabèttavalènani, samastavidhamulaina j~naanamuto memu prati manushyuniki buddhichèppuchu, prati manushyuniki bodhimchuchu, aayananu prakatimchuchunnaamu.
Amdu nimittamu naalo balamugaa, kaaryasiddhikalugajeyu aayana kriyaashaktini batti nenu poraaduchu prayaasapaduchunnaanu.
Mee kòrakunu, lavòdikaya vaari kòrakunu, shareera reetigaa naa mukhamu choodanivaaramdarikòrakunu

Nenu èmtagaa poraaduchunnaano meeru tèlisikònagoru chunnaanu. vaaru premayamdu atukabadi, sampoorna grahimpuyòkka sakalaishvaryamu kaliginavaarai, devuni marmamaiyunna kreestunu, spashtamugaa tèlisikònnavaarai, tama hrridayamulalo aadaranapòmdavalènani vaaramdari kòraku poraaduchunnaanu.
Buddhi j~naanamula sarva sampadalu aayanayamde guptamulaiyunnavi.
Èvadainanu chakkani maatalacheta mimmunu mosaparachakumdunatlu ee samgatini chèppuchunnaanu.
Nenu shareeravishayamulo dooramugaa unnanu aatmavishayamulo meetokooda umdi, mee yogyamaina pravartananu kreestunamdali mee sthiravishvaasamunu choochi aanamdimchuchunnaanu.
Kaavuna meeru prabhuvaina kreestuyesunu amgeekarimchina vidhamugaa aayanayamdu verupaarinavaarai, yimtivalè kattabaduchu,
Meeru nerchukònina prakaaramugaa vishvaasamamdu sthiraparachabaduchu, krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchutayamdu vistarimchuchu, aayanayamdumdi naduchukònudi.

Aayananu anusarimpaka manushyula paaramparyaachaara munu, anagaa ee lokasambamdhamaina moolapaathamulanu anusarimchi mosakaramaina nirarthaka tatva j~naanamucheta mimmunu chèrapattukòni povuvaadèvadaina umdunemo ani jaagrattagaa umdudi.
Elayanagaa devatvamuyòkka sarvaparipoornata shareeramugaa kreestunamdu nivasimchu chunnadi;
Mariyu aayanayamdu meerunu sampoornulai yunnaaru; aayana samasta pradhaanulakunu adhikaarulakunu shirassai yunnaadu;
Meerunu, kreestu sunnatiyamdu, shareerechchalato koodina svabhaavamunu visarjimchi aayanayamdu chetulato cheyabadani sunnati pòmditiri.
Meeru baaptisma mamdu aayanato kooda paatipèttabadinavaarai aayananu mrritulalonumdi lepina devuni prabhaavamamdu vishvasimchuta dvaaraa aayanatokooda lechitiri.
Mariyu aparaadhamula valananu, shareeramamdu sunnatipòmdaka yumdutavalananu, meeru mrritulai yumdagaa,

Devudu vraataroopakamaina aaj~nalavalana manameeda rrinamugaanu manaku virodhamugaanu numdina patramunu mekulato siluvaku kòtti, daanimeedi chevraatanu tudichivesi,manaku addamulekumda daanini ètti vesi mana aparaadhamulanannitini kshamimchi,
Aayanatokooda mimmunu jeevimpachesènu;aayana pradhaanulanu adhikaarulanu niraayudhulanugaachesi, siluvacheta jayotsavamuto vaarini patti tèchchi baahaatamugaa vedukaku kanuparachènu.
Kaabatti annapaanamula vishayamulonainanu, pamduga amaavaasya vishraamtidinamu anuvaati vishayamulonainanu, meeku teerpu teercha nèvanikini avakaashamiyyakudi.
Ivi raabovuvaati chaayayegaani nija svaroopamu kreestulo unnadi
Ati vinayaasaktudai devadootaa raadhanayamdu ichchakaligi, taanu choochinavaatinigoorchi gòppagaa chèppukònuchu, tana shareerasambamdhamaina manassuvalana ooraka uppòmguchu,

Shirassunu hattukònani vaadèvadunu mee bahumaanamunu apaharimpaniyyakudi; aa shirassumoolamugaa sarvashareeramu keellachetanu naramula chetanu poshimpabadi atukabadinadai, devunivalana kalugu vrriddhito abhivrriddhi pòmduchunnadi.
Meeru kreestutokooda lokamuyòkka moolapaatha mula vishayamai mrritipòmdinavaaraite lokamulo braduku chunnattugaa
Manushyula aaj~nalanu paddhatulanu anusarimchicheta pattukònavaddu,ruchichoodavaddu, muttavaddu anu vidhu laku meeru lobadanela?
Avanniyu vaadukònutacheta nashimchipovunu.
Attivi svechchaaraadhana vishayamulonu vinaya vishayamulonu, dehashiksha vishayamulonu j~naana roopakamainavaniyèmchabaduchunnavegaani, shareerechchaanigraha vishayamulo emaatramunu ènnika
Meeru kreestutokooda lepabadinavaaraite painunna vaatine vèdakudi, akkada kreestu devuni kudipaarshvamuna koorchumdiyunnaadu.
Painunna vaatimeedanegaani, bhoosambamdhamainavaatimeeda manassu pèttukònakudi;
Elayanagaa meeru mrritipòmditiri, mee jeevamu kreestutokooda devuniyamdu daachabadiyunnadi.
Manaku jeevamai yunna kreestu pratyakshamainappudu meerunu aayanatokooda mahimayamdu pratyakshaparachabaduduru.
Kaavuna bhoomimeedanunna mee avayavamulanu, anagaa jaaratvamunu, apavitratanu, kaamaaturatanu, duraashanu, vigrahaaraadhanayaina dhanaapekshanu6 champi veyudi.
Vaativalana devuni ugrata avidheyula meediki vachchunu.
Poorvamu vaari madhya jeevimchinappudu meerunu veetini anusarimchi naduchukòmtiri.
Ippudaite meeru, kopamu, aagrahamu, dushtatvamu, dooshana, meenota bootulu anu veetinannitini visarjimchudi.
Òkanito òkadu abaddha maadakudi;elayanagaa praacheenasvabhaavamunu daani kriyalato kooda
Meeru parityajimchi, j~naanamu kalugu nimittamu daanini srrishtimchinavaani polikachòppuna nootana parachabaduchunna naveenasvabhaavamunu dharimchukòni yunnaaru.

Ittivaarilo greesudeshasthudani yoodudani bhedamu ledu; sunnati pòmdutayani sunnati pòmdaka povutayani bhedamu ledu; paradeshiyani sithiyanudani daasudani svatamtrudani ledugaani, kreeste sarvamunu amdarilo unnavaadunai yunnaadu.
Kaagaa, devunicheta erparachabadinavaarunu parishuddhulunu priyulunainavaariki taginatlu, meeru jaaligala manassunu, dayaalutvamunu, vinayamunu, saatvikamunu, deerghashaamta munu dharimchukònudi.
Èvadainanu tanaku haanichesènani yòkadanukònina yèdala òkani nòkadu sahimchuchu òkani nòkadu kshamimchudi, prabhuvu mimmunu kshamimchinalaaguna meerunu kshamimchudi.
Veetannitipaina paripoornataku anu bamdhamaina premanu dharimchukònudi.
Kreestu anu grahimchu samaadhaanamu mee hrridayamulalo elu chumda niyyudi; imdukòrake meeròkka shareeramugaa piluvabaditiri; mariyu krritaj~nulai yumdudi.

Samgeeta mulatonu keertanalatonu aatmasambamdhamaina padyamulatonu òkaniki òkadu bodhimchuchu, buddhi chèppuchu krripaa sahi tamugaa mee hrridayamulalo devunigoorchi gaanamu cheyuchu, samastavidhamulaina j~naanamuto kreestu vaakyamu meelo samrriddhigaa nivasimpaniyyudi.
Mariyu maatacheta gaani kriyacheta gaani, meeremi chesinanu prabhuvaina yesudvaaraa tamdriyaina devuniki krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchuchu, samastamunu aayana perata cheyudi.
Bhaaryalaaraa, mee bhartalaku vidheyulai yumdudi; idi prabhuvunubatti yuktamaiyunnadi.
Bhartalaaraa, mee bhaaryalanu premimchudi, vaarini nishthurapèttakudi.
Pillalaaraa, anni vishayamulalo mee talidamdrula maata vinudi; idi prabhuvunubatti mèchchukònataginadi.
Tamdrulaaraa, mee pillala manassu krumgakumdunatlu vaariki kopamu puttimpakudi.

Daasulaaraa, manushyulanu samtoshapèttu vaarainattu kamtiki kanabadavalènani kaaka, prabhuvunaku bhayapaduchu shuddhaamtahkaranagalavaarai, shareeramunubatti mee yajamaanulainavaariki anni vishayamulalo vidheyulai yumdudi.
Prabhuvuvalana svaasthyamunu pratiphalamugaa pòmdudumani yèruguduru ganuka,
Meeremi chesinanu adi manushyula nimittamu kaaka prabhuvu nimittamani mana sphoortigaa cheyudi, meeru prabhuvaina kreestunaku daasulai yunnaaru.
Anyaayamu chesinavaaniki taanu chesina anyaayamukòladi marala labhimchunu, pakshapaatamumdadu.
Yajamaanulaaraa, paralokamulo meekunu yaja maanudunnaadani yèrigi, nyaayamainadiyu dharmaanu saara mainadiyu mee daasulayèdala cheyudi.
Praarthanayamdu nilukadagaa umdi krritaj~natagalavaarai daaniyamdu mèlakuvagaa umdudi.
Mariyu nenu bamdhaka mulalo umchabadutaku kaaranamaina kreestu marmamunu goorchi nenu bodhimpavalasina vidhamugaane
Aa marmamunu vèlladiparachunatlu vaakyamu chèpputaku anukoolamaina sama yamu devudu dayacheyavalènani3 maakòraku praarthimchudi.
Samayamu poniyyaka sadviniyogamu chesikònuchu, samghamunaku vèlupati vaariyèdala j~naanamu kaligi naduchu kònudi.
Prati manushyuniki elaagu pratyuttaramiyya valèno adi meeru tèlisikònutakai mee sambhaashana uppu vesinattu èllappudu ruchigaladigaanu krripaasahitamugaanu umdaniyyudi.
Priyasahodarudunu, prabhuvunamdu nammakamaina pari chaarakudunu, naa todi sevakudunaina tukiku nannugoorchina samgatulanniyu meeku tèliyajeyunu.
Meeru maa sthiti tèlisikònunatlunu mee hrridayamulanu atadu aadarimchu natlunu,
Atanini atanitokooda nammakamaina priyasaho darudaina ònesimunu meeyòddaku pampuchunnaanu; itadu mee yòddanumdi vachchinavaade; veerikkadi samgatulanniyu meeku tèliyajeturu.

Naatokooda chèralo unna aristaarkunu, barnabaaku sameepaj~naatiyaina maarkunu meeku vamdanamulu chèppu chunnaaru; ee maarkunugoorchi meeru aaj~nalu pòmditiri, itadu meeyòddaku vachchinayèdala itani cherchukònudi.

Mariyu yoostu anu yesukooda meeku vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaadu. veeru sunnati pòmdinavaarilo cherina vaaru, veerumaatrame devuni raajyamu nimittamu naa jata panivaarai yunnaaru, veerivalana naaku aadarana kaligènu.

Meelo òkadunu kreestuyesu daasudunaina èpaphraa meeku vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaadu; meeru sampoornulunu, prati vishayamulo devuni chittamunugoorchi sampoornaatma nishchayatagalavaarunai nilukadagaa umdavalènani yitadèllappu dunu meekòraku tana praarthanalalo poraaduchunnaadu.
Itadu meekòrakunu, lavòdikayavaari kòrakunu, hiyèraa pòlivaarikòrakunu bahu prayaasapaduchunnaadani yitaninigoorchi saakshyamichchuchunnaanu.
Lookaa anu priyudaina vaidyudunu, demaayu meeku vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaaru.
Lavòdikayalo unna sahodarulakunu, numphaakunu, vaari yimta unna samghamunakunu vamdanamulu chèppudi.
Ee patrika meeru chadivimchukònina taruvaata lavòdikaya vaari samghamulonu chadivimchudi; lavòdikayaku vraasi pampina patrikanu meerunu chadivimchukònudi.
Mariyu prabhuvunamdu neeku appa gimpabadina paricharyanu nèraverchutaku daanigoorchi jaagratta padumani arkhipputo chèppudi.
Paulanu nenu svahastamuto naa vamdanamulu vraayuchunnaanu; naa bamdhakamulanu j~naapakamu chesikònudi. krripa meeku todaiyumdunu gaaka.

Tamdriyaina devuniyamdunu prabhuvaina yesukreestu namdunu unna thèssalòneekayula samghamunaku paulunu, silvaanunu, timotiyunu shubhamani chèppi vraayunadi. krripayu samaadhaanamunu meeku kalugunu gaaka.

Vishvaasamutokoodina mee panini, prematokoodina mee prayaasamunu, mana prabhuvaina yesukreestunamdali nireekshanatokoodina mee orpunu, memu mana tamdriyaina devuni yèduta maanaka j~naapakamu chesikònuchu, maa praarthanalayamdu mee vishayamai vij~naapanamu cheyuchu,
Mee amdari nimittamu èllappudunu devu niki krritaj~nataastu tulu chèllimchuchunnaamu.

Elayanagaa devunivalana premimpabadina sahodarulaaraa, meeru erparachabadina samgati, anagaa maa suvaarta, maatato maatramugaaka shaktitonu, parishuddhaatmatonu, sampoorna nishchayatatonu meeyòddaku vachchiyunna samgati maaku tèliyunu.
Mee nimittamu memu meeyèdala èttivaaramai yumtimo meerèruguduru.
Parishuddhaatmavalana kalugu aanamdamuto gòppa upadravamamdu meeru vaakyamu namgeekarimchi, mammunu prabhuvunu poli naduchukòninavaaraitiri.
Kaabatti maasidoniyalonu akayalonu vishvaasulamdarikini maadiriyaitiri; èmdukanagaa meeyòddanumdi prabhuvu vaakyamu maasidoniyalonu akayalonu mrogènu;
Akkadamaatrame gaaka prati sthalamamdunu devuniyèdala unna mee vishvaasamu vèlladaayènu ganuka, mememiyu chèppavalasina avashyamuledu.
Meeyòdda maakètti praveshamu kaligèno, akkadi janulu mammunugoorchi tèliya jèppuchunnaaru. mariyu meeru vigrahamulanu vidichipètti, jeevamugalavaadunu satyavamtudunagu devuniki daasu lagutakunu,

Devudu mrritulalonumdi lepina yesu, anagaa raabovu ugratanumdi manalanu tappimchuchunna aayana kumaarudaina yesu, paralokamunumdi vachchunani yèduru choochutakunu, meerelaagu devuni vaipunaku tirigitiro aa samgati vaare tèliyajeyuchunnaaru.
Sahodarulaaraa, meeyòdda maa praveshamu vyarthamu kaaledu gaani
Meerèriginatte memu philippeelo mumdu shramapadi avamaanamupòmdi, yèmto poraatamuto devuni suvaartanu meeku bodhimchutakai mana devuniyamdu dhairyamu tèchchukòmtimani meeku tèliyunu.
Ela yanagaa maa bodha kapatamainadi kaadu, apavitramainadi kaadu, mosayuktamainadi kaadugaani

Suvaartanu maaku appagimchutaku yogyulamani devunivalana èmchabadina vaaramai, manushyulanu samtoshapèttuvaaramu kaaka mana hrridayamulanu pareekshimchu devunine samtoshapèttu vaaramai bodhimchuchunnaamu.
Meerèrigiyunnattu memu ichchakapu maatalanainanu, dhanaapekshanu kappipèttu veshamunainanu ènnadunu viniyogimpaledu; imduku devude saakshi.
Mariyu memu kreestuyòkka apòsta lulamai yunnamduna adhikaaramucheyutaku samarthulamai yunnanu,meevalanane gaani yitarula valanane gaani, manu shyulavalana kalugu ghanatanu memu koraledu.
Ayite stanyamichchu talli tana sòmta biddalanu gaaravimchunatlugaa, memu mee madhyanu saadhuvulamai yumtimi.
Meeru maaku bahu priyulaiyumtiri ganuka meeyamdu visheshaa peksha galavaaramai devuni suvaartanu maatramu gaaka maa praanamulanukooda meekichchutaku siddhapadiyumtimi.
Avunu sahodarulaaraa, maa prayaasamunu kashtamunu meeku j~naapakamunnadi gadaa. memu meelo èvanikainanu bhaaramugaa umdakoodadani raatrimbagallu kashtamuchesi jeevanamu cheyuchu mee
Memu vishvaasulaina meeyèduta èmta bhaktigaanu, neeti gaanu, animdyamugaanu prava rtimchitimo daaniki meeru saakshulu, devudunu saakshi
Tana raajyamunakunu mahima kunu mimmunu piluchuchunna devuniki taginattugaa meeru naduchukònavalènani memu meelo prativaanini hèchcha rimchuchu, dhairyaparachuchu saakshyamichchuchu,
Tamdri tana biddala yèdala naduchukònureetigaa meelo prativaaniyèdala memu naduchukòmtimani meeku tèliyunu.

Aa hetuvuchetanu, meeru devunigoorchina vartamaana vaakyamu maavalana amgeekarimchinappudu, manushyula vaakya mani yèmchaka adi nijamugaa unnattu devuni vaakyamani daanini amgeekarimchitiri ganuka memunu maanaka devuniki krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchuchunnaamu. aa vaakyame vishvaasulaina meelo kaaryasiddhi kalugajeyuchunnadi.
Avunu sahodarulaaraa, meeru yoodayalo kreestu yesunamdunna devuni samghamulanu poli naduchukònina vaaraitiri. vaaruyoodulavalana anubhavimchinatti shramale meerunu mee sòmtadesha
Aa yoodulu tama paapamulanu èllappudu sampoorti cheyu takai prabhuvaina yesunu pravaktalanu champi mammunu himsimchi,
Anyajanulu rakshanapòmdutakai vaarito memu maatalaadakumda mammunu aatamkaparachuchu,devuniki ishtulu kaanivaarunu manushyulakamdariki virodhulunai yunnaaru; devuni ugrata tudamutta
Sahodarulaaraa, memu shareeramunubatti kòddi kaalamu mimmunu èdabaasiyunnanu, manassunu batti meedaggara umdi, migula apekshato mee mukhamu choodavalènani mari yèkkuvagaa prayatnamu chesitiviu.
Kaabatti memu meeyòddaku raavalènani yumtimi;paulanu nenu palumaaru raavalènani yumtini gaani saataanu mammunu abhyamtaraparachènu.
Elayanagaa maa nireekshanayainanu aanamdamainanu atishayakeereetamainanu edi? mana prabhuvaina yesuyòkka raakada samayamuna aayana yèduta meere gadaa.
Nishchayamugaa meere maa mahimayu aanamda munai yunnaaru.
Kaabatti ika sahimpajaalaka ethènsulo memòmtigaa nainanu umduta mamchidani yèmchi,

Yee shramalavalana èvadunu kadilimpabadakumdunatlu mimmunu sthiraparachutakunu, mee vishvaasavishayamai mimmunu hèchcharimchutakunu, mana sahodarudunu kreestu suvaarta vishayamulo devuni pari chaarakudunaina timotini pampitiviu. memu meeyòdda unnappudu,
Manamu shramanu anubhavimpavalasiyunnadani meeto mumdugaa chèppitiviu gadaa? aalaage jariginadi. idi meekunu tèliyunu;
Atti shramalanu anubhavimchutaku manamu niyamimpabadina vaaramani meerèruguduru.
Imducheta nenunu ikanu nahimpajaalaka, shodhakudu mimmunu òkavela shodhimchènemo aniyu, maa prayaasamu vyarthamai poyènemo aniyu, mee vishvaasamunu tèlisikònavalènani atani pampitini.

Timotiyu ippudu mee yòddanumdi maayòddaku vachchi,memu mimmunu elaagu chooda napekshimchuchunnaamo aalaage meerunu mammunu chooda napekshimchuchu, èllappudunu mammunu premato j~naapakamu chesikònuchunnaarani, mee vishvaasamunu goorchiyu mee premanu goorchiyu samtoshakaramaina samaachaaramunu maaku tèchchènu.
Amducheta sahodaru laaraa, maa yibbamdi amtati lonu shrama amtatilonu mee vishvaasamunu choochi mee vishayamulo aadarana pòmditiviu.
Elayanagaa, meeru prabhuvunamdu sthiramugaa nilichitiraa memunu bradikinatte.
Memu mee mukhamuchoochi mee vishvaasamulo unna lopamunu teerchunatlu anugrahimchumani raatrimbagallu atyadhikamugaa devuni vedukònuchumdagaa,
Mana devuniyèduta mimmunubatti memu pòmduchunna yaavattu aanamdamu nimittamu devuniki taginattugaa krritaj~nataastutulu elaagu chèllimpagalamu?
Mana tamdriyaina devudunu mana prabhuvaina yesunu mammunu niraatamkamugaa meeyòddaku teesikòni vachchunu gaaka.
Mariyu mana prabhuvaina yesu tana parishuddhulamdarito vachchinappudu, mana tamdriyaina devuni yèduta meehrridayamulanu parishuddhata vishayamai animdyamainavigaa aayana sthiraparachutakai,
Memu meeyèdala elaagu premalo abhivrriddhipòmdi vardhilluchunnaamo, aalaage meerunu òkani yèdala òkadunu manushyulamdari yèdalanu,premalo abhi vrriddhipòmdi vardhillunatlu prabhuvu dayacheyunu gaaka.
Mèttuku sahodarulaaraa, memu prabhuvaina yesu dvaaraa meekichchina aaj~nanu meerèruguduru.

Kaagaa meerelaagu naduchukòni devuni samtoshaparachavalèno maavalana nerchukònina prakaaramugaa meeru naduchukònuchunnaaru. ee vishayamulo meeru amtakamtaku abhivrriddhi nòmdavalènani mimmunu vedukòni prabhuvaina yesunamdu hèchcha rimchuchunnaamu.
Meeru parishuddhulagutaye, anagaa meeru jaaratvamunaku dooramugaa umdutaye devuni chittamu.
Meelo prativaadunu, devuni èrugani anyajanulavalè kaamaabhilaashayamdu kaaka,
Parishuddhatayamdunu ghanatayamdunu tana tana ghatamunu ètlu kaapaadukònavalèno adi yèrigiyumdutaye devuni chittamu.

Ee vishayamamdèvadunu atikramimchi tana sahodaruniki mosamu cheyakumdavalènu; èmdukanagaa memu poorvamu meeto chèppi saakshyamichchina prakaaramu prabhuvu veetanniti vishayamai pratidamdana cheyuvaadu.
Parishuddhu lagutake devudu manalanu pilichènugaani apavitrulugaa umdutaku piluvaledu.
Kaabatti upekshimchuvaadu manushyuni upekshimpadu gaani meeku tana parishuddhaatmanu anugrahimchina devunine upekshimchuchunnaadu.
Sahodarapremanugoorchi meeku vraayanakkaraledu; meeru òkani nòkadu premimchutaku devuni chetane nerpa baditiri.
Aalaagunane maasidoniya yamdamtata unna sahodarulamdarini meeru premimchuchunnaaru. saho darulaaraa, meeru premayamdu mariyòkkuvagaa abhi vrriddhinòmduchumdavalènaniyu,
Samghamunaku vèlupativaari yèdala maryaadagaa naduchukònuchu, meekemiyu kòduva lekumdunatlu memu meeku aaj~naa pimchina prakaaramu meeru parulajoliki poka,
Mee sòmtakaaryamulanu jarupukònuta yamdunu mee chetulato panicheyutayamdunu aashakaligi yumdavalènaniyu, mimmunu hèchcharimchuchunnaamu.
Sahodarulaaraa, nireekshanaleni yitarulavalè meeru duhkhapadakumdu nimittamu, nidrimchuchunnavaarini goorchi meeku tèliyakumduta maakishtamuledu.
Yesu mrriti pòmdi tirigi lechènani manamu namimanayèdala, ade prakaaramu yesunamdu nidrimchinavaarini devudaayanato kooda vèmtabèttukòni vachchunu.
Memu prabhuvumaatanu batti meeto chèppunademanagaa, prabhuvu raakadavaraku sajeevulamai nilichiyumdu manamu nidrimchinavaarikamtè mumdugaa aayana sannidhi cheramu.
Aarbhaatamutonu, pradhaanadootashabdamutonu, devuni booratonu paralokamunumdi prabhuvu digivachchunu; kreestunamdumdi mrritulaina vaaru mòdata leturu.
Aa meedata sajeevulamai nilichiyumdu manamu vaaritokooda ekamugaa prabhuvunu èdurkònutaku aakaashamamdalamunaku meghamulameeda kònipobadudumu. kaagaa manamu sadaakaalamu prabhuvuto kooda umdumu.
Kaabatti meeru ee maatalacheta òkaninòkadu aadarimchukònudi.
Sahodarulaaraa, aa kaalamulanugoorchiyu aa sama yamulanugoorchiyu meeku vraayanakkaraledu.
Raatrivela dòmga elaagu vachchuno aalaage prabhuvu dinamu vachchunani meeku baagugaa tèliyunu.

Lokulu nèmmadigaa unnadi, bhayamemiyuledani chèppukònu chumdagaa, garbhinistreeki prasavavedana vachchunatlu vaariki aakasmikamugaa naashanamu tatasthimchunu ganuka vaarèmta maatramunu tappimchukònaleru
Sahodarulaaraa, aa dinamu dòmgavalè meemeediki vachchutaku meeru cheekatilo unnavaarukaaru.
Meeramdaru vèlugu sambamdhulunu pagati sambamdhulunai yunnaaru; manamu raatrivaaramu kaamu, cheekativaaramu kaamu.
Kaavuna itarulavalè nidrapoka mèlakuvagaa umdi mattulamukaaka yumdamu.
Nidrapovuvaaru raatrivela nidrapovuduru, mattugaa umduvaaru raatrivela mattugaa umduru.
Manamu pagativaaramai yunnaamu ganuka mattulamai yumdaka, vishvaasa premalanu kavachamu, rakshananireekshanayanu shirastraana munu dharimchukòmdamu.
Èmdukanagaa mana prabhuvaina yesu kreestudvaaraa rakshanapòmdutake devudu manalanu niyamimchènu gaani ugratapaalagutaku niyamimpaledu.
Manamu melukòniyunnanu nidrapovuchunnanu tanatokooda jeevimchunimittamu aayana manakòraku mrritipòmdènu.
Kaabatti meerippudu cheyuchunnattugaane yòkaninòkadu aadarimchi yòkanikòkadu kshemaabhivrriddhi kalugajeyudi.
Mariyu sahodarulaaraa, meelo prayaasapaduchu prabhuvunamdu meeku paivaaraiyumdi meeku buddhi chèppuvaarini mannanachesi
Vaari paninibatti vaarini premato mikkili ghanamugaa èmchavalènani vedukònuchunnaamu; mariyu òkanito nòkadu samaadhaanamugaa umdudi.

Sahodarulaaraa, memu meeku bodhimchunadi emanagaa akramamugaa naduchukònuvaariki buddhi chèppudi, dhairyamu chèdinavaarini dairyaparachudi, balaheenulaku oota niyyudi, amdariyèdala deergha shaamtamugalavaarai yumdudi.
Èvadunu keedunaku pratikeedu èvanikainanu cheyakumda choochukònudi;meeru òkani yèdala òkadunu manushyulamdari yèdalanu èllappudu melainadaanini anusarimchi naduchukònudi.
Èllappudunu samtoshamugaa umdudi;
Yèdatègaka praarthanacheyudi;
Prati vishayamunamdunu krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchudi. eelaagu cheyuta yesukreestunamdu mee vishayamulo devuni chittamu.
Aatmanu aarpakudi.
Pravachimchutanu nirlakshyamu cheyakudi.
Samastamunu pareekshimchi melainadaanini chepattudi.
Prati vidhamaina keedunakunu dooramugaa umdudi.

Samaadhaanakartayagu devude mimmunu sampoornamugaa parishuddhaparachunu gaaka. mee aatmayu, jeevamunu shareeramunu mana prabhuvaina yesukreestu raakadayamdu nimdaa rahi tamugaanu, sampoornamugaanu umdunatlu kaapaadabadunu gaaka.
Mimmunu piluchuvaadu nammakamainavaadu ganuka aalaagu cheyunu.
Sahodarulaaraa, maakòraku praarthanacheyudi.
Pavitramaina muddupèttukòni sahodarulakamdarikini vamdanamulu cheyudi.
Sahodarulakamdarikini yee patrika chadivi vinipimpavalènani prabhuvupera meeku aana bèttuchunnaanu.
Mana prabhuvaina yesukreestu krripa meeku todai yumdunu gaaka.
Mana tamdriyaina devuniyamdunu prabhuvaina yesu kreestunamdunu unna thèssalòneekayula samghamunaku paulunu, silvaanunu, timotiyunu shubhamani chèppi vraayunadi.
Tamdriyaina devuninumdiyu prabhuvaina yesukreestunumdiyu krripayu samaadhaanamunu meeku kalugunu gaaka.

Sahodarulaaraa, memèllappudu mimmunugoorchi devuniki krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchutaku baddhulamai yunnaamu. idi yuktame; elayanagaa mee vishvaasamu bahugaa abhivrriddhipòmduchunnadi. mee amdarilo prati vaadunu èdutivaaniyèdala choopu prema vistarimchu chunnadi.
Amduvalana mee himsalannitilonu, meeru sahimchuchunna shramalalonu, mee orpunu vishvaasamunu choochi, memu devuni samghamulalo meeyamdu atishaya paduchunnaamu.
Denikòraku meeru shramapaduchunnaaro aa devuni raajyamunaku meeru yogyulani yèmchabadu nimittamu, meeritlu orchukònuta devuni nyaayamaina teerpunaku spashtamaina soochanayaiyunnadi.
Prabhuvaina yesu tana prabhaavamunu kanuparachu dootalatokooda paralokamunumdi agnijvaalalalo pratyakshamai,
Devuni nèruganivaarikini, mana prabhuvaina yesu suvaartaku lobadani vaarikini pratidamdana cheyunappudu
Mimmunu shramaparachu vaariki shramayu, shramapòmduchunna meeku maatokooda vishraamtiyu anugrahimchuta devuniki nyaayame.
Aa dinamuna tana parishuddhulayamdu mahimaparachabadutakunu, vishvasimchinavaaramdari yamdu prashamsimpabadutakunu,prabhuvu vachchinappudu attivaaru
Aayana samukhamu numdiyu aayana prabhaavamamdali mahimanumdiyu paaradolabadi, nityanaashanamanu damdana pòmduduru. ela yanagaa memu meekichchina saakshyamu meeru namimatiri.
Amduvalana mana devuniyòkkayu prabhuvaina yesu kreestuyòkkayu krripachòppuna meeyamdu mana prabhuvaina yesu naamamunu, aayanayamdu meerunu mahimanòmdunatlu,

Melu cheyavalènani meelo kalugu prati yaalochananu, vishvaasayuktamaina prati kaaryamunu balamuto sampoornamu cheyuchu, manadevudu tana pilupunaku mimmunu yogyulugaa èmchunatlu meekòraku èllappudunu praarthimchuchunnaamu.
Sahodarulaaraa, prabhuvudinamippude vachchi yunnattugaa aatma valananainanu, maatavalananainanu, maa yòddanumdi vachchinadani chèppina patrikavalananainanu, èvadainanu chèppinayèdala
Meeru tvarapadi chamchalamanaskulu kaakumdavalènaniyu, bèdarakumdavalènaniyu, mana prabhuvaina yesukreestu raakadanubattiyu, manamu aayanayòdda koodukònutanu battiyu, mimmunu vedukònuchunnaamu.
Mòdata bhrashtatvamu sambhavimchi naashana paatrudagupaapapurushudu bayalupaditenegaani aa dinamu raadu.

Edi devudanabaduno, edi poojimpabaduno, daaninamtatini èdirimchuchu, daanikamtatikipaigaa vaadu tannutaane hèchchimchukònuchu, taanu devudanani tannu kanuparachu kònuchu, devuni aalayamulo koorchumdunu ganuka evidhamugaanainanu èvadunu mimmunu mosaparacha niyyakudi.
Nenimkanu meeyòdda unnappudu ee samgatulanu meeto chèppinadi meeku j~naapakamuledaa?
Kaagaa vaadu tana sòmtakaalamamdu bayaluparachabadavalènani vaanini adda gimchunadi edo adi meerèruguduru.
Dharmavirodha sambamdhamaina marmamu ippatike kriyacheyuchunnadi gaani, yidivaraku addagimchuchunnavaadu madhyanumdi teesi veyabadu varake addagimchunu.
Appudaa dharmavirodhi bayaluparachabadunu. prabhuvaina yesu tana notiyoopiricheta vaanini samharimchi tana aagamana prakaashamucheta naashanamu cheyunu.

Nashimchuchunnavaaru taamu rakshimpa badutakai satyavishayamaina premanu avalambimpaka poyiri ganuka, vaari raaka abaddha vishayamaina samasta balamutonu, naanaavidhamulaina soochakakriyalatonu, mahatkaaryamulatonu
Durneetini puttimchu samasta mosamutonu, nashimchuchunna vaarilo saataanu kanuparachu balamunu anusarimchiyumdunu
Imducheta satyamunu nammaka durneetiyamdu abhilaashagala vaaramdarunu shikshaavidhi pòmdutakai,
Abaddhamunu nammunatlu mosamucheyu shaktini devudu vaariki pampuchunnaadu.

Prabhuvuvalana premimpabadina sahodarulaaraa, aatma mimmunu parishuddhaparachutavalananu, meeru satyamunu nammutavalananu, rakshanapòmdutaku devudu aadinumdi mimmunu erparachukònènu ganuka memu mimmunubatti yèllappudunu devuniki krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimpa baddhulamaiyunnaamu.
Meereelaaguna rakshimpabadi mana prabhuvaina yesukreestuyòkka mahimanu pòmdavalènani, aayana maa suvaarta valana mimmunu pilichènu.
Kaabatti sahodarulaaraa, nilukadagaa umdi maa notimaatavalananainanu maa patrika valananainanu meeku bodhimpabadina vidhulanu chepattudi.
Mana prabhuvaina yesukreestunu, manalanu premimchi, krripacheta nityamaina aadaranayu, shubha nireekshanayu anugrahimchina mana tamdriyaina devudunu,
Mee hrridaya mulanu aadarimchi, pratisatkaaryamamdunu pratisadvaakya mamdunu mimmunu sthiraparachunu gaaka.

Nee ¸°vanamunubatti èvadunu ninnu trrineekarimpaniyyakumu gaani, maatalonu, pravartanalonu, premalonu, vishvaasamulonu, pavitratalonu, vishvaasulaku maadirigaa umdumu.

Naa praarthanalayamdu èdatègaka ninnu j~naapakamu chesikònuchu, nee kanneellanu talachukòni, naaku sampoornaa namdamu kalugutakai ninnu choodavalènani reyimbagalu apekshimchuchu,
Neeyamdunna nishkapatamaina vishvaasamunu j~naapakamu chesikòni, naa pituraachaaraprakaaramu nirmalamaina manassaakshito nenu sevimchuchunna devuniyèdala krritaj~nu danai yunnaanu.
Aa vishvaasamu mòdata nee avvayaina loyilonu nee talliyaina yuneekelonu vasimchènu, adi neeyamdu sahavasimchuchunnadani nenu roodhigaa nammu chunnaanu.
Aa hetuvucheta naa hastanikshepanamuvalana neeku kaligina devuni krripaavaramu prajvalimpa cheyavalènani neeku j~naapakamu cheyuchunnaanu.

Kaabatti neevu mana prabhuvu vishayamaina saakshyamunu goorchiyainanu, aayana khaideenaina nannugoorchiyainanu siggupadaka, devuni shaktinibatti suvaartanimittamaina shramaanubhavamulo paalivaadavai yumdumu.
Mana kriyalanubatti kaaka tana svakeeya samkalpamunu battiyu, anaadikaalamunane kreestuyesunamdu manaku anugrahimpabadinadiyu,

Aa hetuvucheta ee shramalanu anubhavimchuchunnaanu gaani, nenu namimanavaani èrugudunu ganuka siggupadanu; nenu aayanaku appagimchinadaanini raabovu chunna aa dinamuvaraku aayana kaapaadagaladani roodhigaa nammukònuchunnaanu.
Kreestuyesunamdumchavalasina vishvaasa premalu kaliginavaadavai, neevu naavalana vinina hitavaakya pramaanamunu gaikònumu;
Neeku appagimpabadina aa mamchi padaarthamunu manalo nivasimchu parishuddhaatmavalana kaapaadumu.

Naa kumaarudaa, kreestuyesunamdunna krripacheta balavamtudavu kammu.
Neevu aneka saakshulayèduta naavalana vinina samgatulanu itarulakunu bodhimchutaku saamarthyamugala nammakamaina manushyulaku appagimpumu,
Kreestuyesuyòkka mamchi sainikunivalè naatokooda shramanu anubhavimchumu.
Sainikudèvadunu yuddhamunaku povunappudu, tannu damdulo cherchukòninavaanini samtoshapèttavalènani yee jeevana vyaapaaramulalo chikku kònadu.
Mariyu jèttiyainavaadu poraadunappudu, niyamaprakaaramu poraadakumte vaaniki kireetamu dòrakadu.
Paatupadina vyavasaayakude mòdata phala mulalo paalu puchchukònavalasinavaadu.
Nenu chèppu maatalu aalochimchukònumu; anni vishayamulayamdu prabhuvu neeku vivekamanu grahimchunu.
Naa suvaarta prakaaramu, daaveedu samtaanamulo putti mrritulalo numdi lechina yesukreestunu j~naapakamuchesikònumu.
Nenu nerasthudanai yunnattu aa suvaartavishayamai samkèllato bamdhimpabadi shramapaduchunnaanu, ayinanu devuni vaakyamu bamdhimpabadi yumdaledu.
Amducheta erparachabadinavaaru nityamaina mahimatokooda kreestu yesunamdali rakshana pòmdavalènani nenu vaarikòraku samastamu orchukònuchunnaanu.

Kòrukupumdu praakinattu vaarimaatalu praakunu, vaarilo humènaiyunu philetunu unnaaru;

Neevu nerchukòni roodhiyani tèlisikònnavi yèvarivalana nerchukòmtivo aa samgati tèlisikòni, vaatiyamdu nilukadagaa umdumu.
Daivajanudu sannaddhudai prati satkaaryamunaku poornamugaa siddhapadi yumdunatlu daivaaveshamuvalana kaligina pratilekhanamu upadeshimchutakunu,
Khamdimchutakunu, tappu diddutakunu, neetiyamdu shikshacheyutakunu prayojanakaramai yunnadi.
Devuniyèdutanu sajeevulakunu mrritulakunu teerpu teerchu kreestuyesu èdutanu, aayana pratyakshatatodu aayana raajyamutodu, nenu aanabètti chèppunademanagaa
Vaakyamunu prakatimchumu; samayamamdunu asamaya mamdunu prayaasapadumu; sampoornamaina deerghashaamtamuto upadeshimchuchu khamdimchumu gaddimchumu buddhi chèppumu.

Satyamunaku chèviniyyaka kalpanaakathalavaipunaku tirugukaalamu vachchunu.
Ayite neevu annivishayamulalo mitamugaa umdumu, shramapadumu, suvaartikuni panicheyumu, nee paricharyanu sampoornamugaa jarigimchumu.

Ikameedata naa kòraku neetikireeta mumchabadiyunnadi. aa dinamamdu neetigala nyaayaadhi patiyaina prabhuvu adi naakunu, naaku maatrame kaakumda tana pratyakshatanu apekshimchu vaarikamdarikini anugra himchunu.

Neevu vachchunappudu nenu troyalo karpunòdda umchi vachchina amgeeni pustakamulanu,
Mukhyamugaa charmapu kaagitamulanu teesikòni rammu.

Prabhuvu prati dushkaaryamunumdi nannu tappimchi tana paraloka raajyamunaku cherunatlu nannu rakshimchunu. yugayugamulu aayanaku mahima kalugunu gaaka, aamen‌.

Sheetakaalamu raakamunupu neevu vachchutaku praya tnamucheyumu. yuboolu, pude, linu, klaudiyayu sahodarulamdarunu neeku vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaaru.

Nityajeevamunugoorchina nireekshanatokoodina bhaktiki aadhaaramagu satyavishayamaina anubhavaj~naanamu nimittamunu, devuni daasudunu yesukreestu apòstaludunaina paulu, mana amdari vishvaasa vishayamulo

Tamdriyaina devuninumdiyu mana rakshakudaina kreestuyesu numdiyu krripayu kanikaramunu samaadhaanamunu neeku kalugunu gaaka.
Nenu nee kaaj~naapimchina prakaaramu neevu lopamugaa unnavaatini diddi, prati pattanamulonu pèddalanu niya mimchu nimittame nenu kretulo ninnu vidichi vachchitini.

Atithipriyudunu, sajjana priyudunu svasthabuddhigalavaadunu, neetimamtudunu, pavi trudunu, aashaanigrahamugalavaadunai yumdi,

Anekulu, visheshamugaa sunnati sambamdhulunu, avidheyulunu vadarubotulunu mosapuchchuvaarunai yunnaaru.
Vaari nollu mooyimpavalènu. attivaaru upadeshimpakoodanivaatini durlaabhamukòraku upa deshimchuchu, kutumbamulaku kutumbamulane paaducheyu chunnaaru.
Vaarilo òkadu, anagaa vaari sòmta pravaktalalo òkadu itlanènukreteeyulu èllappudu abaddhikulunu, dushtamrrigamulunu, somarulagu timdi potulunai yunnaaru.
Ee saakshyamu nijame. ee hetuvucheta vaaru yoodula kalpanaakathalanu, satyamu numdi tòlagipovunatti manushyula kattadalanu lakshyapèttaka,
Vishvaasavishayamuna svasthulagu nimittamu vaarini kathinamugaa gaddimpumu.
Pavitrulaku anniyu pavitramule gaani apavitrulakunu avishvaa sulakunu ediyu pavitramainadi kaadu; vaari manassunu vaari manassaakshiyu apavitraparachabadi yunnavi.
Devuni èrugudumani vaaru chèppukòmduru gaani, asahyulunu avidheyulunu prati satkaaryamu vishayamu bhrashtulunaiyumdi, tama kriyalavalana aayananu èrugamannattunnaaru.

Elaaganagaa vrriddhulu mitaanubhavamugalavaarunu, maanyulunu, svasthabuddhigalavaarunu, vishvaasa prema sahanamulayamdu lopamulenivaarunai yumdavalè naniyu,

Naa praarthanalayamdu nee nimittamu vij~naapanamucheyuchu, èllappudu naa devuniki krritaj~nataa stutulu chèllimchuchu,

Kreestunubatti meeyamdunna prati shreshthamaina varamu vishayamai neevu anubhavapoorvakamugaa èrugutavalana itarulu nee vishvaasamamdu paalivaaraguta anunadi kaaryakaari kaavalayunani vedukònuchunnaanu.
Sahodarudaa, parishuddhula hrridayamulu nee moolamugaa vishraamti pòmdinamduna nee premanubatti naaku visheshamaina aanamdamunu aadaranayu kaligènu.
Kaavuna yuktamainadaaninigoorchi nee kaaj~naapimchutaku kreestunamdu naaku bahu dhairyamu kaligiyunnanu,
Vrriddhudanu ippudu kreestuyesu khaideenaiyunna paulanu nenu premanubatti vedukònuta mari mamchidanu kòni,
Naa bamdhakamulalo nenu kanina naa kumaarudagu2 ònesimu3 kosaramu ninnu vedukònuchunnaanu.
​atadu munupu neeku nish‌prayojanamainavaade gaani, yippudu neekunu naakunu prayojanakaramainavaadaayènu.

​nenu suvaartakòraku bamdhakamulo umdagaa neeku pratigaa atadu naaku parichaaramucheyu nimittamu naayòdda atani numchukònavalènani yumtini gaani
​nee upakaaramu balavamtamuchetanainattu kaaka svechchaapoorvakamainadigaa umdavalènani, nee sammatileka yemiyu cheyutaku naakishtamuledu.
​atadikameedata daasudugaa umdaka daasunikamtè èkkuvavaadugaanu, priya sahodarudu

Gaanu, visheshamugaa naakunu, shareeravishayamunu prabhuvu vishayamunu mari visheshamugaa neekunu, priya saho darudugaanu, neeyòdda èllappudu umdutake kaabolu atadu kòddikaalamu ninnu èdabaasi yumdènu.
Kaabatti neevu nannu neeto paalivaanigaa èmchinayèdala nannu cherchu kònnattu atanini cherchukònumu.
Atadu neeku e nashtamainanu kalugajesina yèdalanu, neeku emaina rrinamunna yèdalanu, adi naa lèkkalo cherchumu;
Paulanu nenu naa svahastamuto ee maata vraayuchunnaanu adi nene teertunu. ayinanu nee aatmavishayamulo neeve naaku rrinapadiyunnaavani nenu chèppanela?
Avunu sahodarudaa, prabhuvunamdu neevalana naaku aanamdamu kaluganimmu, kreestunamdu naa hrridayamunaku vishraamti kalugajeyumu.
Nenu chèppinadaanikamtè neevu èkkuvagaa chetuvani yèrigi naa maata vimduvani namima neeku vraayuchunnaanu.
Amtekaadu, nee praarthanala moolamugaa nenu neeku anugrahimpabadudunani nireekshimchuchunnaanu ganuka naa nimittamu basa siddhamu cheyumu.
Kreestuyesunamdu naatodi khaideeyaina èpaphraa,
Naa jatapanivaaraina maarku, aristaarku, demaa, lookaa vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaaru.
Mana prabhuvaina yesukreestu krripa mee aatmaku todai yumdunu gaaka. amen‌.
Poorvakaalamamdu naanaasamayamulalonu naanaa vidhamulugaanu pravaktaladvaaraa mana pitarulato maatalaadina devudu
Ee dinamula amtamamdu kumaaruni dvaaraa manato maatalaadènu. aayana aa kumaaruni samastamunakunu vaarasunigaa niyamimchènu. aayana dvaaraa prapamchamulanu nirmimchènu.

Aayana devuni mahima yòkka tejassunu,3 aayana tatvamuyòkka moorti mamtamunaiyumdi, tana mahattugala maatacheta samastamunu nirvahimchuchu, paapamula vishayamulo shuddheekaranamu taane chesi, devadootalakamtè èmta shreshthamaina naamamu pòmdèno vaarikamtè amta shreshthudai, unnata loka
Mamdu mahaamahudagu devuni kudipaarshvamuna koorchum dènu.

Elayanagaa neevu naa kumaarudavu, nenu nedu ninnu kani yunnaanu aniyu, idiyugaaka nenu aayanaku tamdrinaiyumdunu, aayana naaku kumaarudaiyumdunu aniyu aa dootalalo èvanitonaina èppudainanu chèppènaa ?
Mariyu aayana bhoolokamunaku aadisambhootuni marala rappimchinappudu devuni dootalamdaru aayanaku namaskaaramu cheyavalènani chèppuchunnaadu.
Tana dootalanu vaayuvulugaanu tana sevakulanu agni jvaalalugaanu chesikònuvaadu ani tana dootalanugoorchi chèppuchunnaadu
Gaani tana kumaarunigoorchiyaite devaa, nee simhaasanamu niramtaramu niluchunadi;nee raajadamdamu nyaayaarthamayinadi.
Neevu neetini premimchitivi durneetini dveshimchitivi amducheta devudu neetodivaarikamtè ninnu hèchchimchunatlugaa aanamdatailamuto abhishekimchènu.
Mariyu prabhuvaa, neevu aadiyamdu bhoomiki punaadi vesitivi
Aakaashamulukooda nee chetipanule avi nashimchunu gaani neevu nilichiyumduvu avanniyu vastramuvalè paatagilunu
Uttareeyamuvalè vaatini madichivetuvu avi vastramuvalè maarchabadunu gaani neevu ekareetigaane yunnaavu nee samvatsaramulu tarugavu ani chèppuchunnaadu.
Ayite nenu nee shatruvulanu nee paadamulaku paadapeethamugaa cheyu varaku naa kudipaarshvamuna koorchumdumu ani dootalalo èvaninigoorchiyainayèppudainanu chèppènaa?
Veeramdaru rakshanayanu svaasthyamu pòmdabovuvaariki pari chaaramu cheyutakai pampabadina sevakulaina aatmalu kaaraa?
Kaavuna manamu vinina samgatulanu vidichipètti kòttu kònipokumdunatlu vaatiyamdu mari vishesha jaagratta kaligiyumdavalènu.
Èmdukanagaa devadootala dvaaraa palukabadina vaakyamu sthiraparachabadinamduna, prati ati kramamunu avidheyatayu nyaayamaina pratiphalamu pòmdiyumdagaa
Imta gòppa rakshananu manamu nirla kshyamuchesinayèdala elaagu tappimchukòmdumu? atti rakshana prabhuvu bhodhimchutacheta aarambhamai,

Devudu tana chittaanusaaramugaa soochakakriyalachetanu, mahatkaarya mulachetanu,naanaavidhamulaina adbhutamulachetanu, vividhamu laina parishuddhaatma varamulanu anugrahimchutachetanu, vaarito kooda saakshyamichchuchumdagaa vininavaaricheta manaku drridha parachabadènu.
Manamu maatalaaduchunna aa raabovu lokamunu aayana dootalaku loparachaledu.
Ayite òkadu òka chota eelaaguna drridhamugaa saakshyamichchuchunnaadu neevu manushyuni j~naapakamu chesikònutaku vaade paativaadu?

Neevu devadootalakamtè vaanini kòmchèmu takkuvavaanigaa chesitivi mahimaaprabhaavamulato vaaniki kireetamu dharimpa jesitivi nee cheti panulameeda vaanikadhikaaramu anugrahimchitivi vaani paadamulakrimda samastamunu umchitivi.
Aayana samastamunu loparachinappudu vaaniki loparachakumda denini vidichipèttaledu. prastutamamdu manamu samastamunu vaanikiloparachabaduta imkanu chooda ledugaani

Devuni krripavalana aayana prati manushyuni kòraku maranamu anubhavimchunatlu,dootalakamtè kòmchèmu takkuvavaadugaa cheyabadina yesu maranamu pòmdi namduna, mahimaaprabhaavamulato kireetamu dharimchina vaanigaa aayananu choochuchunnaamu

Èvani nimittamu samastamunu unnavo, yèvanivalana samastamunu kalugu chunnavo, aayana anekulaina kumaarulanu mahimaku tèchchuchumdagaa vaari rakshanakartanu shramaladvaaraa sampoo rnunigaa cheyuta aayanaku tagunu.
Parishuddha parachuvaari kini parishuddhaparachabaduvaarikini amdariki òkkate1 moolamu. ee hetuvuchetanu vaarini sahodarulani piluchutaku aayana siggupadaka
Nee naamamunu naa sahodarulaku prachuraparatunu, samaajamumadhya2 nee keertini gaanamu chetunu anènu.
Mariyu ne naayananu nammukòniyumdunu aniyu idigo nenunu devudu naakichchina pillalunu aniyu chèppuchunnaadu.
Kaabatti aa pillalu raktamaamsa mulu galavaarainamduna aa prakaarame maranamuyòkka balamugalavaanini, anagaa apavaadini maranamudvaaraa nashimpajeyutakunu,
Jeevitakaalamamtayu maranabhayamu cheta daasyamunaku lobadinavaarini vidipimchutakunu, aayanakooda raktamaamsamulalo paalivaadaayènu.
Ela yanagaa aayana èmtamaatramunu devadootala svabhaavamunu dharimchukònaka, abraahaamu samtaana svabhaavamunu dharimchukòniyunnaadu.

Kaavuna prajala paapamulaku parihaaramu kalugajeyutakai, devuni sambamdhamaina kaarya mulalo kanikaramunu nammakamunugala pradhaanayaajakudagu nimittamu, annivishayamulalo aayana tana sahodarula vamtivaadu kaavalasivachchènu.
Taanu shodhimpabadi shrama pòmdènu ganuka shodhimpabaduvaarikini sahaayamu cheya galavaadai yunnaadu.
Imduvalana, paralokasambamdhamaina pilupulo paalu pòmdina parishuddha sahodarulaaraa, manamu òppukònina daaniki apòstaludunu pradhaanayaajakudunaina yesumeeda lakshyamumchudi.
Devuni yillamtatilo moshe nammakamugaa umdinattu, eeyanakooda tannu niyamimchina vaaniki nammakamugaa umdènu.
Prati yillunu èvadaina òkanicheta kattabadunu; samastamunu kattinavaadu devude. imtikamtè daanini kattina vaadèkkuva ghanatapòmdinattu,
Eeyana moshekamtè èkkuva mahimaku arhudugaa èmchabadènu.
Mumdu chèppabovu samgatulaku saakshyaartha mugaa moshe parichaarakudaiyumdi devuni yillamtatilo nammakamugaa umdènu.
Ayite kreestu kumaarudaiyumdi, aayana yimtimeeda nammakamugaa unnaadu; dhairyamunu nireekshanavalani utsaahamunu tudamattuku sthiramugaa chepattinayèdala maname aayana yillu.
Mariyu pari shuddhaatmayitlu chèppuchunnaadu.
Nedu meeraayana shabdamunu vininayèdala, aranyamulo shodhana dinamamdu kopamu puttimchinappativalè mee hrridayamulanu kathinaparachukònakudi.
Naluvadi samvatsaramulu naa kaaryamulanu choochi mee pitarulu nannu pareekshimchi shodhimchiri.
Kaavuna nenu aa taramuvaarivalana visigi veerèllappudunu tama hrridayaalochanalalo tappipovuchunnaaru naa maargamulanu tèlisikònaledu.
Ganuka nenu kopamuto pramaanamu chesinattu vaaru naa vishraamtilo praveshimparani chèppitini.
Sahodarulaaraa, jeevamugala devuni vidichipovunatti vishvaasamuleni dushtahrridayamu meelo èvaniyamdainanu òkavela umdunemo ani jaagrattagaa choochukònudi.
Nedu meeraayana shabdamunu vininayèdala, kopamu puttimchi nappativalè mee hrridayamulanu kathinaparachukònakudani aayana chèppènu ganuka,
Paapamuvalana kalugu bhramacheta meelo èvadunu kathinaparachabadakumdunatlunedu anabadu samayamumdagaane, pratidinamunu òkanikòkadu buddhi chèppukònudi.
Elayanagaa mòdatanumdi manakunna drridha vishvaasamu amtamumattuku gattigaa chepattinayèdalane kreestulo paalivaaramai yumdumu.
Vini kopamu puttimchinavaarèvaru? moshecheta nadipimpabadi aiguptulo numdi bayaluderi vachchinavaaramdare gadaa
Èvarimeeda naluvadi emdlu aayana kopagimchènu? paapamu chesinavaari meedane gadaa? vaari shavamulu6 aranyamulo raali poyènu.
Tana vishraamtilo praveshimparani yèvarini goorchi pramaanamu chesènu? avidheyulainavaarinigoorchiye gadaa
Kaagaa avishvaasamuchetane vaaru praveshimpaleka poyirani grahimchuchunnaamu.
Aayanayòkka vishraamtilo praveshimchudumanu vaagdaanamu imka nilichiyumdagaa, meelo èvadainanu òkavela aa vaagdaanamu pòmdakumda tappipovunemo ani bhayamu kaligiyumdamu.
Vaariki prakatimpabadinatlu manakunu suvaarta prakatimpabadènu, gaani vaaru vinina vaarito vishvaasamugalavaarai kalisiyumdaledu ganuka vinna vaakyamu vaariki nish‌prayojanamainadaayènu.

Kaagaa jagatpunaadi veyabadinappude aayana kaaryamu lanniyu sampoortiyaiyunnanu ee vishraamtinigoorchinenu kopamuto pramaanamuchesinattu vaaru naa vishraamtilo praveshimparu ani aayana chèppina maata anusarimchi, vishvaasulamaina manamu aa vishraamtilo praveshimchuchunnaamu.
Mariyu devudu edava dinamamdu tana kaaryamulannitini mugimchi vishramimchènu ani yedava dinamunugoorchi aayana yòkachota chèppi yunnaadu.
Idiyunugaaka ee chotunane vaaru naa vishraamtilo praveshimparu ani chèppiyunnaadu.
Kaagaa èvaro kòmdaru vishraamtilo praveshimchu duranu maata nishchayamu ganukanu, mumdu suvaarta vininavaaru avidheyatacheta praveshimpaledu ganukanu,

Nedu mee raayana maata vininayèdala mee hrridayamulanu kathinaparachukònakudani vènuka chèppabadina prakaaramu, imta kaalamaina taruvaata daaveedu gramthamulonedani yòka dinamunu nirnayimchuchunnaadu.
Yèhoshuva vaariki vishraamti kalugajesinayèdala aa taruvaata mariyòka dinamunugoorchi aayana chèppakapovunu.
Kaabatti devuni prajalaku vishraamti nilichiyunnadi.
Èmdukanagaa devudu tana kaaryamulanu mugimchi vishramimchina prakaaramu, aayanayòkka vishraamtilo praveshimchinavaadu kooda tana kaaryamulanu mugimchi vishramimchunu.
Kaabatti avidhe yatavalana vaaru padipoyinatlugaa manalo èvadunu padipokumda aa vishraamtilo praveshimchutaku jaagratta padudamu.

Èmdukanagaa devuni vaakyamu sajeevamai balamugaladai rèmdamchulugala yètuvamti khadgamukamtènu vaadigaa umdi, praanaatmalanu keellanu mooluganu vibha jimchunamtamattuku dooruchu, hrridayamuyòkka talam pulanu aalochanalanu shodhimchuchunnadi.
Mariyu aayana drrishtiki kanabadani srrishthamu ediyu ledu. manamèvanikilèkka yòppachèppavalasiyunnado aa devuni kannulaku samastamunu maruguleka tetagaa unnadi.
Aakaashamamdalamugumda vèllina devuni kumaarudaina yesu anu gòppa pradhaanayaajakudu manaku unnaadu ganuka manamu òppukòninadaanini gattigaa chepattudamu.
Mana pradhaanayaajakudu mana balaheenatalayamdu manato sahaanubhavamu lenivaadu kaadu gaani, samasta vishayamulalonu manavalène shodhimpabadinanu, aayana paapamu lenivaadugaa umdènu.
Ganuka manamu kanikarimpabadi samayochitamaina sahaayamukòraku krripa pòmdunatlu dhairyamuto krripaasanamunòddaku cherudamu.

Prati pradhaanayaajakudunu manushyulalonumdi yerparachabadinavaadai, paapamulakòraku arpanalanu balulanu arpimchutaku devuni vishayamaina kaaryamulu jarigimchutakai manushyulanimittamu niyamimpabadunu.
Taanukooda balaheenatacheta aavarimpabadiyunnamduna atadu emiyu tèliyanivaariyèdalanu trovatappina vaariyèdalanu taalimi choopagalavaadai yunnaadu.
Aa hetuvucheta prajala kòrakelaago aalaage tanakòrakunu paapamulanimittamu arpanamu cheyavalasinavaadai yunnaadu.
Mariyu èvadunu ee ghanata tanakutaane vahimchukònadu gaani, aharonu piluvabadinattugaa devunicheta piluvabadinavaadai yee ghanatapòmdunu.
Atuvalè kreestukooda pradhaana yaajakudagutaku tannutaane mahimaparachukònaledu gaani neevu naa kumaarudavu, nenu nedu ninnu kaniyunnaanu. ani aayanato chèppinavaade ayananu mahi
Aa prakaarame neevu mèlkeesèdèkuyòkka kramamu chòppuna niramtaramu yaajakudavai yunnaavu ani mariyòkachota chèppuchunnaadu.

Shareeradhaariyai yunna dinamulalo mahaa rodanamutonu kanneellatonu, tannu maranamunumdi rakshimpagalavaaniki praarthanalanu yaachanalanu samarpimchi,bhayabhaktulu kaligi yunnamduna aayana amgeekarimpabadènu.
Aayana,kumaarudaiyumdiyu taanu pòmdina shramalavalana vidheyatanu nerchukònènu.
Mariyu aayana sampoornasiddhi pòmdinavaadai, mèlkee sèdèkuyòkka kramamulocherina pradhaanayaajakudani devunicheta piluvabadi,
Tanaku vidheyulaina vaarikamdarikini nitya rakshanaku kaarakudaayènu.
Imdunugoorchi memu chèppavalasinavi aneka samgatu lunnavi gaani, meeru vinutaku mamdulainamduna vaatini vishadaparachuta kashtamu.

Kaalamunubatti choochite meeru bodhakulugaa umdavalasinavaarai yumdagaa, devoktulalo mòdati moolapaathamulanu òkadu meeku marala bodhimpavalasi vachchènu. meeru paalutraagavalasinavaare gaani balamaina aahaaramu tinagalavaarukaaru.
Mariyu paalu traagu prativaadunu shishuveganuka neeti vaakyavishayamulo anubhavamulenivaadai yunnaadu.
Vayassu vachchina vaaru abhyaasamucheta melu keedulanu vivechimchutaku saadhakamucheyabadina j~naanemdriyamulu kaligiyunnaaru ganuka balamaina ahaaramu vaarike tagunu.
Kaabatti nirjeevakriyalanu vidichi, maarumanassu pòmdu tayu,

Devuniyamdali vishvaasamunu baaptismamulanu goorchina bodhayu, hastanikshepanamunu, mrritula punaru tthaanamunu, nityamainateerpunu anu punaadi marala veyaka, kreestunugoorchina moolopadeshamu maani, sampoornula magutaku saagipodamu.
Devudu sèlavichchinayèdala manamaalaagu cheyudamu.
Òkasaari vèligimpabadi, paralokasambamdhamaina varamunu ruchichoochi, parishuddhaatmalo paalivaarai
Devuni divyavaakyamunu raabovu yuga sambamdhamaina shaktula prabhaavamunu anubhavimchina taruvaata tappipoyinavaaru,
Tama vishayamulo devuni kumaaruni marala siluvaveyuchu, baahaatamugaa aayananu avamaana parachuchunnaaru ganuka maarumanassu pòmdunatlu atti vaarini marala nootanaparachuta asaadhyamu.
Ètlanagaa, bhoomi tanameeda taruchugaa kuriyu varshamunu traagi, yèvarikòraku vyavasaayamu cheyabaduno vaariki anu koolamaina pairulanu phalimchuchu devuni aasheervachanamu pòmdunu.
Ayite mumdlatuppalunu gachcha teegèlunu daanimeeda pèriginayèdala adi panikiraanidani visarjimpabadi shaapamu pòmdataginadagunu. tudakadi kaalchiveyabadunu.
Ayite priyulaaraa, memeelaagu chèppuchunnanu, meerimtakamtè mamchidiyu rakshanakaramainadiyunaina sthitilone yunnaarani roodhigaa nammuchunnaamu.
Meeru chesina kaaryamunu, meeru parishuddhulaku upachaaramuchesi yimkanu upachaaramu cheyuchumdutacheta tana naamamunu batti choopina premanu marachutaku, devudu anyaayasthudu kaadu.
Meeru mamdulu kaaka, vishvaasamu chetanu orpuchetanu vaagdaanamulanu svatamtrimchukònu vaarini poli naduchukònunatlugaa meelo prativaadunu
Mee nireekshana paripoornamagu nimittamu meeridivaraku kanuparachina aasaktini tudamattuku kanuparachavalènani apekshimchu chunnaamu.
Devudu abraahaamunaku vaagdaanamu chesinappudu tanakamtè e gòppavaanitodu ani pramaanamu cheyaleka poyènu ganuka
Tanatodu ani pramaanamuchesi nishchayamugaa nenu ninnu aasheervadimtunu nishchayamugaa ninnu vistarimpajetunu ani chèppènu.
Aa maata namima atadu orputo sahimchi aa vaagdaanaphalamu pòmdènu.
Manushyulu tamakamtè gòppavaanitodu ani pramaanamu cheturu; vaari prati vivaadamulonu vivaadaamshamunu parishkaaramu cheyunadi pramaaname.

Ee vidhamugaa devudu tana samkalpamu nishchalamainadani aa vaagdaanamunaku vaarasulainavaariki mari nishchayamugaa kanuparachavalènani uddeshimchinavaadai,taanu abaddhamaadajaalani nishchalamaina rèmdu samgatulanubatti,
Manayèduta umchabadina nireekshananu chepattutaku sharanaa gatulamaina manaku balamaina dhairyamu kalugunatlu pramaanamu chesi vaagdaanamunu drridhaparachènu.
Ee nireekshana nishchalamunu, sthiramunai, mana aatmaku lamgaruvalènumdi tèralopala praveshimchuchunnadi.
Niramtaramu mèlkeesèdèku kramamu chòppuna pradhaanayaajakudaina yesu amduloniki manakamtè mumdugaa mana pakshamuna prave shimchènu.
Raajulanu samhaaramuchesi, tirigi vachchuchunna abraa haamunu

Èvadu kalisikòni atanini aasheervadimchèno, yèvaniki abraahaamu annitilo padiyavavamtu ichchèno, aa shaalemuraajunu mahonnatudagu devuni yaajakudunaina mèlkeesèdèku niramtaramu yaajakudugaa unnaadu. atani peruku mòdata neetiki raajaniyu, taruvaata samaadhaanapu raajaniyu artha michchunatti shaalemu raajani arthamu.
Atadu tamdrilenivaadunu tallileni vaadunu vamshaavali lenivaadunu, jeevitakaalamunaku aadi yainanu jeevanamunaku amtamainanu lenivaadunaiyumdi devuni kumaaruni poliyunnaadu.
Itadèmta ghanudo choodudi. moolapurushudaina abraa haamu ataniki kòllagònna shreshthamaina vastuvulalo padiyava vamtu ichchènu.

Mariyu levi kumaallalonumdi yaaja katvamu pòmduvaaru, tama sahodarulu abraahaamu garbhavaasamunumdi puttinanu, dharmashaastramu chòppuna vaari yòdda, anagaa prajalayòdda padiyavavamtunu puchchu kònutaku aaj~nanu pòmdiyunnaaru gaani
Vaarito sambamdhimchina vamshaavali lenivaadaina mèlkeesèdèku abraa haamunòdda padiyavavamtu puchchukòni vaagdaanamulanu pòmdinavaanini aasheervadimchènu.
Takkuvavaadu èkkuva vaanicheta aasheervadimpabadunanu maata kevalamu niraakshepamai yunnadi.
Mariyu levikramamu choodagaa chaavunaku lonainavaaru padiyavavamtulanu puchchukònuchunnaaru. ayite ee kramamu choodagaa, jeevimchuchunnaadani saakshyamu pòmdinavaadu puchchukònuchunnaadu.
Amte kaaka òka vidhamuna chèppinayèdala padiyavavamtulanu puchchukònu leviyu abraahaamudvaaraa dashamaamshamulanu ichchènu.
Elaaganagaa mèlkeesèdèku atani pitaruni kalisikòninappudu levi tana pitaruni garbhamulo umdènu.

Aa leveeyulu yaajakulai yumdagaa prajalaku dharma shaastramiyyabadènu ganuka aa yaajakulavalana sampoorna siddhi kaliginayèdala aharonu kramamulo cherinavaadani chèppabadaka mèlkeesèdèku kramamu chòppuna veròka yaajakudu raavalasina avasaramemi?
Idiyugaaka yaajakulu maarchabadinayèdala avashyakamugaa yaajaka dharmamu sahaa maarchabadunu.
Èvanigoorchi yee samgatulu chèppabadèno aayana veròka gotramulo puttènu. aa gotramulonivaadèva dunu balipeethamunòdda paricharyacheya ledu.
Mana prabhuvu yoodaa samtaanamamdu janmimchè nanuta spashtame; aa gotravishayamulo yaajakulanu goorchi moshe yemiyu chèppaledu.
Mariyu shareeraanu saaramugaa nèraverchabadu aaj~nagala dharmashaastramunubatti kaaka, naashanamuleni jeevamunakunna shaktinibatti niyamimpabadi,
Mèlkeesèdèkunu polinavaadaina veròka yaajakudu vachchiyunnaadu. kaavuna memu chèppina samgati marimta vishadamaiyunnadi.
Elayanagaa neevu niramtaramu mèlkeesèdèku kramamu chòppuna yaajakudavai yunnaavu ani aayanavishayamai saakshyamu chèppabadènu.
Aa dharmashaastramu denikini sampoornasiddhi kalugajeyaledu ganuka mumdiyyabadina aaj~na balaheenamainamdunanu nish‌prayojana mainamdunanu adi nivaarana cheyabadiyunnadi;
Amta kamtè shreshthamaina nireekshana daanivèmta praveshapèttabadènu. deenidvaaraa, devuniyòddaku manamu cheruchunnaamu.
Mariyu pramaanamulekumda yesu yaajakudu kaaledu ganuka aayana mari shreshthamaina nibamdhanaku pootakaapaayènu.
Vaaraite pramaanamu lekumda yaajakulaguduru gaani yeeyana neevu niramtaramu yaajakudavai yunnaavani prabhuvu pramaanamu chesènu;
Aayana pashchaattaapapadadu aniyeeyanato chèppinavaanivalana pramaanapoorvakamugaa yaajakudaayènu.
Mariyu aa yaajakulu maranamu pòmdutacheta èllappudunu umda saadhyamu kaanamduna, anekulairi gaani
Eeyana niramtaramu unnavaadu ganuka maarpuleni yaajakatvamu kaligina vaadaayènu.
Eeyana tanadvaaraa devuniyòddaku vachchuvaari pakshamuna, vij~naapanamu cheyutaku niramtaramu jeevimchuchunnaadu ganuka vaarini sampoornamugaa rakshimchutaku shaktimamtudai yunnaadu.
Pavitrudunu, nirdoshiyu, nishkalmashudunu, paapu lalo cheraka pratyekamugaa unnavaadunu. aakaasha mamdalamukamtè mikkili hèchchayinavaadunaina yitti pradhaanayaajakudu manaku saripoyinavaadu.

Dharma shaastramu balaheenatagala manushyulanu yaajakulanugaa niyamimchunu gaani dharmashaastramunaku taruvaata vachchina pramaanapoorvakamaina vaakyamu niramtaramunu sampoorna siddhipòmdina kumaaruni niyamimchènu ganuka,

Eeyana aa pradhaanayaajakulavalè mòdata tana sòmta paapamulakòraku taruvaata prajala paapamulakòrakunu dinadinamu balulanu arpimpavalasina avasaramu galavaadu kaadu; tannu taanu arpimchu kònnappudu òkkasaare yee panichesi mugimchènu.
Memu vivarimchuchunna samgatulaloni saaraamsha medanagaa.

Manaku atti pradhaanayaajakudu òkadunnaadu. aayana parishuddhaalayamunaku, anagaa manushyudukaaka prabhuve sthaapimchina nijamaina gudaaramunaku parichaarakudai yumdi, paralokamamdu mahaamahuni simhaasamunaku kudipaarshvamuna aaseenudaayènu.
Prati pradhaanayaajakudu arpanalanu balulanu arpimchutaku niyamimpa badunu. amducheta arpimchutaku eeyanaku emaina umduta avashyamu.
Dharmashaastraprakaaramu arpanalu arpimchuvaarunnaaru ganuka eeyana bhoomimeeda unna yèdala yaajakudai yumdadu.

Moshe gudaaramu amarchaboyinappudu kòmdameeda neeku choopabadina maadirichòppuna samastamunu cheyutaku jaagrattapadumu ani devunicheta hèchcharimpabadina prakaaramu ee yaajakulu paralokasambamdhamagu vastuvula chaayaa roopakamaina gudaaramunamdu sevacheyuduru.
Eeyana yaite ippudu mariyèkkuvaina vaagdaanamulanubatti niya mimpabadina mari yèkkuvaina nibamdhanaku madhyavartiyai yunnaadu ganuka mari shreshthamaina sevakatvamu pòmdi yunnaadu.
Elayanagaa aa mòdati nibamdhana lopamu lenidaite rèmdavadaaniki avakaashamumdaneradu.
Ayite aayana aakshepimchi vaarito eelaagu chèppuchunnaadu prabhuvu itlanènuidigo yòka kaalamu vachchu chunnadi. appatilo ishraayelu imtivaaritonu yoodaa imtivaaritonu nenu kròttanibamdhana che¸
Adi nenu aiguptudeshamulonumdiveeri pitarulanu vèlupaliki rappimchutakaivaarini chèyyi pattukònina dinamunavaarito nenu chesina nibamdhanavamtidi kaadu.emanagaavaaru naa nibamdhanalo nila

Aa dinamulaina taruvaata ishraayelu imtivaarito nenu cheyabovu nibamdhana yedanagaa,vaari manassulo naa dharmavidhulanu umchèdanu vaari hrridayamulameeda vaatini vraayudunu nenu vaariki devudunai yumdunu vaaru naaku prajalai yumduru.
Vaarilo èvadunu prabhuvunu tèlisikònudani tana pattanasthunikainanu tana sahodarunikainanu upadeshamucheyadu vaarilo chinnalu mòdalukòni pèddala varaku amdarunu nannu tèlisikòmduru.
Nenu vaari doshamula vishayamai dayagaligi vaari paapamulanu ikanu ènnadunu j~naapakamu chesikònanani prabhuvu sèlavichchuchunnaadu.
Aayana kròttanibamdhana ani chèpputacheta mòdatidi paatadigaa chesiyunnaadu. edi paatagili udigipovuno adi adrrishyamagutaku siddhamugaa unnadi.
Mòdati nibamdhanakaite sevaaniyamamulunu ee loka sambamdhamaina parishuddhasthalamunu umdènu.
Elaaganagaa mòdata òka gudaaramerparachabadènu. amdulo deepastambhamunu, ballayu, daanimeeda umchabadina ròttèlunu umdènu, daaniki parishuddhasthalamani peru.
Rèmdava tèraku aavala atiparishuddhasthalamanu gudaaramumdènu.
Amdulo suvarnadhoopaartiyu, amtatanu bamgaarurekulato taapabadina nibamdhanamamdasamunu umdènu. aa mamdasamulo mannaagala bamgaaru paatrayu, chigirimchina aharonu chetikarrayu, nibamdha
Daanipaini karunaapeethamunu kammukònuchunna mahimagala kèroobulumdènu. veetinigoorchi yippudu vivaramugaa chèppa vallapadadu.
Ivi eelaagu erparachabadi nappudu yaajakulu sevacheyuchu, nityamunu ee mòdati gudaaramuloniki vèlluduru gaani

Samvatsaramunaku òkka saari maatrame pradhaana yaajakudòkkade raktamucheta pattukòni rèmdava gudaaramuloniki praveshimchunu. aa raktamu tanakòrakunu prajala aj~naanakrritamula kòrakunu atadarpimchunu.
Deeninibatti aa mòdati gudaara mimka niluchuchumdagaa atiparishuddhasthalamulo praveshimchu maargamu bayaluparachabadaledani parishuddhaatma tèliyajeyu chunnaadu.
Aa gudaaramu prastutakaalamunaku upamaana mugaa unnadi. ee upamaanaarthamunubatti manassaakshi vishayamulo aaraadhakuniki sampoornasiddhi kalugajeyaleni arpanalunu balulunu arpimpabaduchunnavi.
Ivi diddu baatu jarugukaalamu vachchuvaraku vidhimpabadi, annapaana mulatonu naanaavidhamulaina prakshaalanamulatonu sambam dhimchina shareeraachaaramulu maatramaiyunnavi.
Ayite kreestu raabovuchunna melulavishayamai pradhaanayaajakudugaa vachchi, taane nityamaina vimochana sampaadimchi, hastakrritamu kaanidi, anagaa ee srrishti sambamdhamu kaanidiyu, mari ghanamai
Mekalayòkkayu kodèlayòkkayu raktamuto kaaka, tana svaraktamuto òkkasaare parishuddhasthalamulo praveshimchènu.
Elayanagaa mekalayòkkayu, èdlayòkkayu raktamunu, mailapadina vaarimeeda aavudooda boodidè challutayu, shareerashuddhi kalugunatlu vaarini parishuddhapara chinayèdala,

Nityudagu aatmadvaaraa tannutaanu devuniki nirdoshinigaa arpimchu kònina kreestuyòkka raktamu, nirjeevakriyalanu vidichi jeevamugala devuni sevimchutaku mee manassaakshini èmto yèkkuvagaa shuddhicheyunu.

Ee hetuvucheta mòdati nibamdhana kaalamulo jarigina aparaadhamulanumdi vimochanamu kalugutakai aayana maranamu pòmdinamduna, piluvabadina vaaru nityamaina svaasthyamunu goorchina vaagdaanamunu pòmdu nimittamu aayana kròttanibamdhanaku madhyavartiyai yunnaadu.
Maranashaasanamèkkada umduno akkada maranashaasanamu vraasinavaani maranamu avashyamu.
Aa shaasanamunu vraasinavaadu maranamu pòmditene adichèllunu; adi vraasinavaadu jeevimchuchumdagaa adi èppudainanu chèllunaa?
Imducheta mòdati nibamdhanakooda raktamulekumda pratishthimpabadaledu.
Dharmashaastraprakaaramu moshe prati yaaj~nanu prajalato chèppinataruvaata, aayana neellatonu, raktavarnamugala gòrrabòchchutonu, hissoputonu,kodèlayòkkayu mekalayòkkayu raktamunu teesikòni
Devudu meekòraku vidhimchina nibamdhana raktamide ani chèppuchu, gramthamumeedanu prajalamdari meedanu prokshimchènu.
Adevidhamugaa gudaaramumeedanu sevaapaatralanniti meedanu aa raktamunu prokshimchènu.
Mariyu dharmashaastra prakaaramu samasta vastuvulunu raktamucheta shuddhicheyabadunaniyu, raktamu chimdimpakumda paapa kshamaapana kalugadaniyu saamaanyamugaa chèppavachchunu.
Paralokamamdunna vaatini polina vastuvulu itti balula valana shuddhicheyabadavalasiyumdènu gaani paraloka sambamdha mainavi veetikamtè shreshthamaina balulavalana shuddhicheyabada valasiyumdènu.
Amduvalana nijamaina parishuddhasthalamunu poli hastakrritamaina parishuddhasthalamulalo kreestu praveshimpaledu gaani, yippudu manakòraku devuni samukhamamdu kanabadutaku paralò
Amtekaadu, pradhaanayaajakudu prati samvatsaramu tanadikaani raktamu teesikòni parishuddhasthalamuloniki praveshimchinatlu, aayana aneka paryaayamulu tannutaanu arpimchukònutaku praveshim
Atlayinayèdala jagattupunaadi veyabadinadi mòdalukòni aayana aneka paryaayamulu shramapadavalasivachchunu. ayite aayana yugamula samaaptiyamdu tannutaane baligaa arpimchukònutavala
Manushyulòkkasaare mrritipòmdavalènani niyamimpabadènu; aa taruvaata teerpu jarugunu.
Aalaagunane kreestukooda anekula paapamulanu bharimchutaku òkkasaare arpimpabadi, tanakòraku kanipèttukòni yumduvaari rakshana nimittamu paapamulekumda rèmdavasaari pratyaksha magunu.

Dharmashaastramu raabovuchunna melula chaayagaladiye gaani aa vastuvula nijasvaroopamu galadikaadu ganuka aa yaajakulu eteta èdatègakumda arpimchu òkkate vidhamaina balulu vaatini tèchchuvaariki ènnadunu sampoornasiddhi kalugajeya neravu.
Aalaagu cheyagaliginayèdala sevimchuvaaròkkasaare shuddhaparachabadina taruvaata vaari manassaakshiki paapaj~napti ikanu umdadu ganuka vaatini arpimchuta maanuduru gadaa.
Ayite aa balulu arpim chutacheta eteta paapamulu j~naapakamunaku vachchuchunnavi
Elayanagaa èdlayòkkayu mekalayòkkayu raktamu paapamulanu teesiveyuta asaadhyamu.
Kaabatti aayana ee lokamamdu praveshimchunappudu eelaagu chèppu chunnaadu.baliyu arpanayu neevu koraledugaaninaakòka shareeramunu amarchitivi.
Poornahomamulunu paapaparihaaraarthabalulunu neekishthamainavikaavu.
Appudu nenugramthapuchuttalo nannugoorchi vraayabadina prakaaramu, devaa, nee chittamu nèraverchutaku idigo nenu vachchiyunnaanamtini.
Balulu arpanalu poornahomamulu paapapari haaraarthabalulunu neevu koraledaniyu, avi neekishthamainavi kaavaniyu paini chèppina taruvaata

Aayana nee chittamu nèraverchutaku idigo nenu vachchiyunnaanani chèppuchunnaadu. ivanniyu dharmashaastramuchòppuna arpimpa baduchunnavi. aa rèmdavadaanini sthiraparachutaku mòdati daanini kòttiveyuchunnaadu.
Yesukreestuyòkka shareeramu òkkasaariye arpimpabadutacheta aa chittamunu batti manamu parishuddhaparachabadiyunnaamu.
Mariyu prati yaajakudu dinadinamu sevacheyuchu, paapamulanu ènnatikini teesiveyaleni aa balulane maatimaatiki arpim chuchu umdunu.
Eeyanayaite paapamulanimittamai sadaakaalamu niluchu òkka balini arpimchi,
Appatinumdi tana shatruvulu tana paadamulaku paadapeethamugaa cheyabadu varaku kanipèttuchu devuni kudipaarshyamuna aaseenudaayènu.
Òkka arpanacheta eeyana parishuddhaparachabadu vaarini sadaakaalamunaku sampoornulanugaa chesiyunnaadu.
Ee vishayamai parishuddhaatmakooda manaku saakshyamichchu chunnaadu.
Elaaganagaa aa dinamulaina taruvaata nenu vaarito cheyabovu nibamdhana idenaa dharmavidhulanu vaari hrridayamu namdumchi vaari manassumeeda vaatini vraayu dunu ani chèppina taruvaata
Vaari paapamulanu vaari akramamulanu ikanu ènnatikini j~naapakamuchesikònanu ani prabhuvu chèppuchunnaadu.
Veeti kshamaapana èkkada kaluguno akkada paapapari haaraarthabali yikanu ènnadunu umdadu.
Sahodarulaaraa, yesu manakòraku pratishthimchina maargamuna, anagaa nootanamainadiyu, jeevamugaladiyu, aayana shareeramu anu tèradvaaraa yerparachabadinadiyunaina maargamuna,
Aayana raktamuvalana parishuddhasthalamunamdu prave shimchutaku manaku dhairyamu kaligiyunnadi ganukanu,
Devuni yimtipaina manaku gòppa yaajakudunnaadu ganukanu,

Manassaakshiki kalmashamu tochakumdunatlu prokshimpabadina hrridayamulu galavaaramunu, nirmalamaina udakamuto snaanamuchesina shareeramulu galavaaramunai yumdi, vishvaasavishayamulo sampoorna nishchayata kaligi, yathaarthamaina hrridayamuto manamu devuni sanni dhaanamunaku cherudamu.
Vaagdaanamu chesinavaadu nammadagina vaadu ganuka mana nireekshana vishayamai mana mòppukòninadi nishchalamugaa pattukòmdamu.
Kòmdaru maanukònu chunnattugaa, samaajamugaa kooduta maanaka, òkaninòkadu hèchcharimchuchu,
Aa dinamu sameepimchuta meeru choochinakòladi mari yèkkuvagaa aalaagu cheyuchu, prema chooputakunu satkaaryamulu cheyutakunu òkaninòkadu purikòlpavalènani aalochimtamu.
Manamu satyamunugoorchi anubhavaj~naanamu pòmdina taruvaata buddhipoorvakamugaa paapamu chesinayèdala paapa mulaku bali yikanu umdadu gaani
Nyaayapu teerpunaku bhayamuto èduruchoochutayu, virodhulanu dahimpabovu teekshanamaina agniyu nikanu umdunu.
