Èvadainanu moshe dharmashaastramunu niraakarimchinayèdala iddaru mugguru saakshula maatameeda, kanikarimpakumda vaani champimchuduru.

Itlumdagaa devuni kumaaruni, paadamulato tròkki, taanu parishuddhaparachabadutaku saadhanamaina nibamdhana raktamunu apavitramainadigaa èmchi, krripaku moolamagu aatmanu tiraskarimchinavaadu èmta èkkuvaina damdanaku paatrudugaa èmchabadunani meeku tochunu?
Pagateerchuta naa pani, nene pratiphalamittunaniyu mariyu prabhuvu tana prajalaku teerpu teerchunu aniyu chèppinavaanini èrugudumu gadaa.
Jeevamugala devuni chetilo paduta bhayamkaramu.
Ayite meeru vèligimpabadinameedata, shramalato koodina gòppa poraatamu sahimchina poorvapudinamulu j~naapakamu tèchchukònudi.
Òka vidhamugaa choochite, meeru nimdalanu baadhalanu anubhavimchutacheta padimamdilo aaradipaditiri; mariyòka vidhamugaa choochite, vaati nanubha vimchinavaarito paalivaaralaitiri.
Elaaganagaa meeru khaidulo unnavaarini karunimchi, meeku mari shreshthamainadiyu sthiramainadiyunaina svaasthyamunnadani yèrigi, mee aasti kolupovutaku samtoshamugaa òppukòmtiri.
Kaabatti mee dhairyamunu vidichipèttakudi; daaniki pratiphalamugaa gòppa bahumaanamu kalugunu.
Meeru devuni chittamunu nèraverchinavaarai, vaagdaanamupòmdu nimittamu meeku orimi avasaramai yunnadi.
Ika kaalamu bahu kòmchèmugaa unnadi, vachchuchunnavaadu aalasyamucheyaka vachchunu.
Naa yèduta neetimamtudainavaadu vishvaasamoolamugaa jeevimchunu gaani atadu vènukateesina yèdala atani yamdu naa aatmaku samtoshamumdadu.
Ayite manamu nashimchutaku vènukateeyuvaaramu kaamu gaani aatmanu rakshimchukònutaku vishvaasamu kaliginavaaramai yunnaamu.
Vishvaasamanunadi nireekshimpabaduvaatiyòkka nija svaroopamunu, adrrishyamainavi yunnavanutaku rujuvunai yunnadi.
Daaninibattiye pèddalu saakshyamupòmdiri.
Prapamchamulu devuni vaakyamuvalana nirmaanamainavaniyu, amdunubatti drrishyamainadi kanabadèdu padaarthamulache nirmimpa badaledaniyu vishvaasamucheta grahimchukònuchunnaamu.

Vishvaasamunubatti hebèlu kayeenukamtè shreshthamaina bali devuniki arpimchènu. devudatani arpanalanugoorchi saakshyamichchinappudu atadu aa vishvaasamunubatti neeti mamtudani saakshyamu pòmdènu. atadu mrritinòmdiyu aa vishvaasamudvaaraa maatalaaduchunnaadu.
Vishvaasamunubatti hanoku maranamu choodakumdunatlu kòni pobadènu; atadu kònipobadakamunupu devuniki ishtudai yumdènani saakshyamu pòmdènu; kaagaa devudatani kòni poyènu ganuka atadu kanabadaledu.
Vishvaasamulekumda devuniki ishtudaiyumduta asaadhyamu; devuniyòddaku vachchuvaadu aayana yunnaadaniyu, tannu vèdakuvaariki phalamu dayacheyuvaadaniyu nammavalènu gadaa.

Vishvaasa munubatti novahu adivaraku choodani samgatulanugoorchi devunicheta hèchcharimpabadi bhayabhaktulu galavaadai, tana yimtivaari rakshanakòraku òka odanu siddhamuchesènu; amduvalana atadu lokamumeeda nerasthaapanachesi vishvaasa munubatti kalugu neetiki vaarasudaayènu.
Abraahaamu piluva badinappudu vishvaasamunubatti aa pilupunaku lobadi, taanu svaasthyamugaa pòmdanaiyunna pradeshamunaku bayaluvèllènu. mariyu èkkadiki vèllavalèno adi èrugaka bayala
Vishvaasamunubatti atadunu, atanito aa vaagdaanamunaku samaanavaarasulaina issaaku yaakobu anuvaarunu, gudaaramulalo nivasimchuchu, anyula desha mulo unnattugaa vaagdattadeshamulo paravaasulairi.
Elayanagaa devudu deniki shilpiyu nirmaanakudunai yunnaado, punaadulugala aa pattanamukòraku abraahaamu èduruchoochuchumdènu.
Vishvaasamunubatti shaaraayu vaagdaanamu chesinavaadu nammadaginavaadani yèmchu kònènu ganuka taanu vayassu gatimchinadainanu garbhamu dharimchutaku shaktipòmdènu.
Amducheta mrritatulyudaina aa yòkaninumdi, samkhyaku aakaashanakshatramulavalènu, samudrateeramamdali lèkkimpa shakyamukaani yisukavalènu samtaanamu kaligènu.

Veeramdaru aa vaagdaanamula phalamu anubhavimpaka poyi nanu, dooramunumdi choochi vamdanamuchesi, taamu bhoomi meeda paradeshulamunu yaatrikulamunai yunnaamani òppakòni, vishvaasamugalavaarai mrritinòmdiri.
Eelaagu chèppuvaaru tama svadeshamunu vèdakuchunnaamani vishada parachuchunnaaru kaaraa?
Vaaru edeshamunumdi vachchiro aa deshamunu j~naapakamamdumchukònnayèdala marala vèllutaku vaariki veelu kaligiyumdunu.
Ayite vaaru mari shreshthamaina deshamunu, anagaa paralokasambamdhamaina deshamunu koruchunnaaru. amducheta taanu vaari devudanani anipimchukònutaku devudu vaarinigoorchi siggupadada
Abraahaamu shodhimpabadi vishvaasamunubatti issaa kunu baligaa arpimchènu.

Èvadu aa vaagdaanamulu samtoshamuto amgeekarimchèno,issaakuvalananainadi nee samtaanamanabadunu ani yèvanito chèppabadèno, aa abraahaamu, mrritulanu sahitamu leputaku devudu shaktimamtudani yèmchinavaadai,
Tana yekakumaaruni arpimchi, upamaanaroopamugaa atanini mrritulalonumdi marala pòmdènu.
Vishvaasamunubatti issaaku jarugabovu samgatula vishayamai yaakobunu eshaavunu aasheervadimchènu.
Vishvaasamunubatti yaakobu avasaanakaalamamdu yosepu kumaarulalo òkkòkkani aasheervadimchi tana chetikarra mòdalumeeda aanukòni devuniki namaskaaramu chesènu.
Yosepu tanaku avasaanakaalamu sameepimchinappadu vishvaasamunubatti ishraayelu kumaarula nirgamanamunugoorchi prashamsimchi tana shalyamulanu goorchi vaariki aaj~naapimchènu.
Moshe puttinappudu atani talidamdrulu aa shishuvu sumdarudai yumduta choochi, vishvaasamunubatti raajaaj~naku bhayapadaka, moodu maasamulu atani daachipèttiri.
Moshe pèddavaadainappudu vishvaasamunubatti aiguptu dhanamukamtè kreestuvishayamaina nimda gòppa bhaagyamani yèmchukòni,
Alpakaalamu paapa bhogamu anubhavimchutakamtè devuni prajalato shrama anubhavimchuta melani yochimchi,
Pharo kumaartèyòkka kumaarudani anipimchukònutaku òppukònaledu;elayanagaa atadu pratiphalamugaa kalugabovu bahumaanamamdu drrishti yumchènu.
Vishvaasamunubatti atadu adrrishyudainavaanini choochuchunnattu sthirabuddhigalavaadai, raajaagrahamunaku bhayapadaka aiguptunu vidichipoyènu.
Tòlichoolu pillalanu naashanamu cheyuvaadu ishraayeleeyulanu muttakumdu nimittamu atadu vishvaasamunubatti paskaanu, raktaprokshana aachaaramunu aacharimchènu.
Vishvaasamunubatti vaaru pòdi nelameeda nadichinatlu èrrasamudramulo badi nadachipoyiri. aigupteeyulu aalaagu cheyajoochi munigipoyiri.
Vishvaasamunubatti yedu dinamulavaraku pradakshinamu cheyabadina taruvaata yèriko godalu koolènu.
Vishvaasamunubatti raahaabanu veshya vegulavaarini samaadhaana mugaa cherchukòninamduna avidheyulatopaatu nashimpaka poyènu.
Ikanu emi chèppudunu? gidyonu, baaraaku, samsonu, yèphtaa, daaveedu, samooyelanu vaarini goorchiyu, pravaktalanugoorchiyu vivarimchutaku samayamu chaaladu.
Vaaru vishvaasamudvaaraa raajyamulanu jayimchiri; neetikaaryamulanu jarigimchiri; vaagdaanamulanu pòmdiri; simhamula nollanu moosiri;
Agnibalamunu challaarchiri; khadgadhaaranu tappimchukòniri; balaheenulugaa umdi balaparachabadiri; yuddhamulo paraakramashaalulairi; anyula senalanu paaradoliri.
Streelu mrritulaina tama vaarini punarutthaanamuvalana marala pòmdiri. kòmdaraite mari shreshthamaina punarutthaanamu pòmdagori vidudala pòmdanòllaka yaatanapèttabadiri.
Marikòmdaru tiraskaaramulanu kòradaadèbbalanu, mari bamdhakamulanu khaidunu anubha vimchiri.
Raallato kòttabadiri, rampamulato koyabadiri, shodhimpabadiri, khadgamuto champabadiri,gòrracharma mulanu mekacharmamulanu vesikòni, daridrulaiyumdi shramapadi himsapòmduchu,
Adavulalonu kòmdalameedanu guhalalonu sòramgamulalonu tirugulaaduchu samcharimchiri. attivaariki ee lokamu yogyamainadi kaadu.
Veeramdaru tama vishvaasamudvaaraa saakshyamu pòmdina vaarainanu. manamu lekumda sampoornulukaakumdu nimittamu,
Devudu manakòraku mari shreshthamainadaanini mumdugaa siddha parachènu ganuka veeru vaagdaanaphalamu anubhavimpa ledu.
Imta gòppa saakshi samoohamu meghamuvalè manalanu aavarimchiyunnamduna

Manamukooda pratibhaaramunu, suluvugaa chikkulabèttu paapamunu vidichipètti, vishvaasamunaku kartayu daanini kònasaagimchuvaadunaina yesuvaipu choochuchu, mana yèduta umchabadina pamdèmulo opikato parugèttudamu. aayana tanayèduta umchabadina aanamdamukòrakai avamaanamunu nirlakshyapètti, siluvanu sahimchi, devuni simhaasanamuyòkka kudi paarshvamuna aaseenudaiyunnaadu.
Meeru alasata padakayu mee praanamulu visukakayu umdunatlu, paapaatmulu tanaku vyatirekamuga chesina tiraskaara mamtayu orchukònina aayananu talamchukònudi.
Meeru paapamuto poraadutalo raktamu kaarunamtagaa imka daanini èdirimpaledu.
Mariyu naa kumaarudaa, prabhuvu cheyu shikshanu trrineekarimchakumu aayana ninnu gaddimchinappudu visukakumu
Prabhuvu taanu premimchuvaanini shikshimchi taanu sveekarimchu prati kumaaruni damdimchunu ani kumaarulato sambhaashimchinatlu meeto sambhaamshimchu aayana hèchcharikanu marachitiri.
Shikshaaphalamu pòmdutakai meeru sahimchuchunnaaru; devudu kumaarulanugaa mimmunu choochuchunnaadu. tamdri shikshimpani kumaarudèvadu?
Kumaallayinavaaramdaru shikshalo paalupòmduchunnaaru, meeru pòmdaniyèdala durbeejulegaani kumaarulu kaaru.
Mariyu shareera sambamdhulaina tamdrulu manaku shikshakulai yumdiri. vaari yamdu bhayabhaktulu kaligi yumtimi; atlayite aatmalaku tamdriyaina vaaniki mari yèkkuvagaa lobadi braduka valènugadaa?
Vaaru kònnidinamulamattuku tama kishtamu vachchinattu manalanu shikshimchirigaani manamu tana parishuddhatalo paalupòmdavalènani mana melukòrake aayana shikshimchu chunnaadu.
Mariyu prastutamamdu samastashikshayu duhkhakaramugaa kanabadunegaani samtoshakaramugaa kana badadu. ayinanu daaniyamdu abhyaasamu kaliginavaariki adi neetiyanu samaadhaanakaramaina phalamichchunu.
Kaabatti vadalina chetulanu sadalina mokaallanu balaparachudi.
Mariyu kumtikaalu bènakaka baagupadu nimittamu mee paadamulaku maargamulanu saralamu chesikònudi.
Amdarito samaadhaanamunu parishuddhatayu kaligi yumdutaku prayatnimchudi. parishuddhatalekumda èvadunu prabhuvunu choodadu.
Meelo èvadainanu devuni krripanu pòmdakumda tappipovunemo aniyu, chedaina veru edainanu mòlichi kalavaraparachutavalana anekulu apavitrulai povuduremo aniyu,
Òka poota kooti kòraku tana jyeshthatvapu hakkunu amimavesina eshaavuvamti bhrashtudainanu vyabhichaariyainanu umdunemo aniyu, jaagrattagaa choochukònudi.
Eshaavu aa taruvaata aasheervaadamu pòmdagori kanneellu viduchuchu daanikosaramu shraddhato vèdakinanu, maarumanassupòmda navakaashamu dòrakaka visarjimpabadènani meerèruguduru.
Sprrishimchi tèlisikònadaginattiyu, mamduchunnattiyu kòmdakunu, agnikini, kaaru meghamunakunu, gaadhaamdha kaaramunakunu, tupaanukunu,
Booradhvanikini, maatala dhvanikini meeru vachchiyumdaledu. òka jamtuvainanu aa kòmdanu taakinayèdala raallato kòttabadavalènani aaj~naapimchina maataku vaaru taalaleka,
Aa dhvani vininavaaru mari e maatayu tamato chèppavaladani batimaalu kòniri.
Mariyu aa darshanamèmto bhayamkaramugaa unnamduna moshenenu mikkili bhayapadi vanaku chunnaananènu.
Ippudaite seeyonanu kòmdakunu jeevamugala devuni pattanamunaku, anagaa paralokapu yèrooshalemunakunu, vevelakòladi devadootalayòddakunu,
Paralokamamdu vraayabadiyunna jyeshtula samghamunakunu, vaari mahotsavamunakunu, amdari nyaayaadhi patiyaina devuni yòddakunu, sampoornasiddhi pòmdina neeti mamtula aatmala yòddakunu,
Kròttanibamdhanaku madhya vartiyaina yesunòddakunu hebèlukamtè mari shreshthamuga paluku prokshana raktamunakunu meeru vachchiyunnaaru.

Meeku buddhi chèppuchunnavaanini niraakarimpakumdunatlu choochukònudi. vaaru bhoomimeedanumdi buddhichèppina vaanini niraakarimchinappudu tappimchukònakapoyinayèdala, paralokamunumdi buddhichèppuchunna vaanini visarjimchu manamu tappimchukònakapovuta mari nishchayamugadaa.
Appu daayana shabdamu bhoomini chalimpachesènu gaani yippudu ne nimkòkasaari bhoomini maatramekaaka aakaashamunu kooda kampimpachetunu ani maata yichchiyunnaadu.
Imkòkasaari anu maata chalimpacheyabadanivi nilukadagaa umdu nimittamu avi srrishtimpabadinavannattu chalimpacheyabadinavi bòttigaa teesi veyabadunani ardhamichchuchunnadi.
Amduvalana manamu nishchalamaina raajyamunu pòmdi, daiva krripa kaligiyumdamu. aa krripa kaligi vinaya bhayabhaktulato devuniki preetikaramaina sevacheyudamu,
Elayanagaa mana devudu dahimchu agniyai yunnaadu.
Sahodaraprema niluvaramugaa umdaneeyudi
Aatithyamu cheya maravakudi; daanivalana kòmdaru èrugakaye devadootalaku aatithyamuchesiri.
Meerunu vaaritokooda bamdhimpabadinattu bamdhakamulonunna vaarini j~naapakamu chesikònudi.meerunu shareeramuto unnaaru ganuka kashtamula nanubhavimchuchunna vaarini j~naapakamu chesikònudi.
Vivaahamu anni vishayamulalo ghanamainadigaanu, paanupu nishkalmashamainadi gaanu umdavalènu; veshyaa samgulakunu vyabhichaarulakunu devudu teerpu teerchunu.
Dhanaapekshalenivaarai meeku kaliginavaatito trriptipòmdiyumdudi.ninnu emaatramunu viduvanu, ninnu ènnadunu èdabaayanu ani aayanaye chèppènu gadaa.
Kaabatti prabhuvu naaku sahaayudu, nenu bhayapadanu, naramaatrudu naakemi cheyagaladu? animamchi dhairyamuto chèppagalavaaramai yunnaamu.
Meeku devuni vaakyamu bodhimchi, meepaini naayakulugaa unnavaarini j~naapakamu chesikòni, vaari pravartana phalamunu shraddhagaa talamchukònuchu, vaari vishvaasamunu anusarimchudi.
Yesukreestu ninna, nedu, òkkatereetigaa unnaadu; avunu yugayugamulakunu òkkate reetigaa umdunu.

Naanaa vidhamulaina anya bodhalacheta trippabadakudi. bhojanapadaarthamulanubatti kaaka, krripanu battiye hrridayamu sthiraparachukònuta mamchidi; bhojanamu lanubatti pravartimchinavaariki emiyu prayojanamu kaluga ledu.
Manakòka balipeethamunnadi; daani sambamdhamainavaatini tinutaku gudaaramulo sevacheyuvaariki adhikaaramuledu.
Vetiraktamu paapaparihaaraarthamuga parishuddhasthalamuloniki pradhaanayaajakunicheta tebaduno, aa jamtuvulakalebaramulu shibiramunaku vèlupata dahimpabadunu.
Kaavuna yesukooda tana svaraktamucheta prajalanu parishuddhaparachutakai gavini vèlupata shramapòmdènu.
Kaabatti manamaayana nimdanu bharimchuchu shibiramu vèlupaliki aayanayòddaku vèlludamu.
Niluvaramaina pattanamu manakikkada ledu gaani, umdabovuchunnadaani kosamu èduruchoochu chunnaamu.
Kaabatti aayanadvaaraa manamu devuniki èllappudunu stutiyaagamu cheyudamu, anagaa aayana naamamunu òppukònuchu, jihvaaphalamu arpimchudamu.
Upakaaramunu dharmamunu cheya marachipokudi, atti yaagamulu devuni kishtamainavi.

Meepaini naayakulugaa unnavaaru lèkka òppachèppavalasinavaarivalè mee aatmalanu kaayuchunnaaru; vaaru duhkhamuto aa pani chesinayèdala meeku nish‌prayojanamu ganuka duhkhamuto kaaka, aanamdamuto cheyunatlu vaari maata vini, vaariki lobadiyumdudi.
Maa nimittamu praarthanacheyudi; memanni vishaya mulalonu yogyamugaa pravartimpa goruchu mamchi manassaakshi kaligiyunnaamani nammukònuchunnaanu.
Mariyu nenu mari tvaragaa meeyòddaku marala vachchunatlu eelaagu cheyavalènani mari yèkkuvagaa mimmunu bati maalukònuchunnaanu.
Gòrrala gòppa kaapariyaina yesu anu mana prabhuvunu nityamaina nibamdhana sambamdhamagu raktamunubatti mrritulalonumdi lepina samaadhaanakartayagu devudu,

Yesu kreestudvaaraa tana drrishtiki anukoolamainadaanini manalo jarigimchuchu, prati mamchi vishayamulonu tana chittaprakaaramu cheyutaku mimmunu siddhaparachunu gaaka. yesukreestuku yugayugamulaku mahima kalugunugaaka. aamen‌.
Sahodarulaaraa, meeku samkshepamugaa vraasiyunnaanu ganuka ee hèchcharikamaatanu sahimchudani mimmunu vedukònuchunnaanu.
Mana sahodarudaina timotiki vidudala kaliginadani tèlisikònudi. atadu sheeghramugaa vachchinayèdala atanitokooda vachchi mimmunu choochèdanu.
Meepaini naayakulainavaarikamdarikini parishuddhulakamdarikini naa vamdanamulu chèppudi. italeevaaru meeku vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaaru.
Krripa mee amdariki todaiyumdunu gaaka. aamen‌.
Devuniyòkkayu prabhuvaina yesukreestu yòkkayu daasudaina yaakobu anyadeshamulayamdu chèdiriyunna pamdrèmdu gotramulavaariki shubhamani chèppi vraayunadi.
Naa sahodarulaaraa, mee vishvaasamunaku kalugu pareeksha orpunu puttimchunani yèrigi,
Meeru naanaa vidhamulaina shodhanalalo padunappudu, adi mahaanamdamani yèmchukònudi.
Meeru sampoornulunu, anoo naamgulunu,e vishayamulonainanu kòduvalenivaarunai yumdunatlu orpu tana kriyanu kònasaagimpaneeyudi.
Meelo èvanikainanu j~naanamu kòduvagaa unnayèdala atadu devuni adugavalènu, appudadi ataniki anugra himpabadunu. aayana èvanini gaddimpaka amdarikini dhaaraalamuga dayacheyuvaadu.
Ayite atadu emaatramunu samdehimpaka vishvaasamuto adugavalènu; samdehimchuvaadu gaalicheta repabadi yègiripadu samudra taramgamunu poliyumdunu.
Atti manushyudu dvimanaskudai, tana samasta maargamulayamdu asthirudu
Ganuka prabhuvuvalana tanakemainanu dòrukunani talamchu kònaraadu.
Deenudaina sahodarudu tanaku kaligina unnatadasha yamdu atishayimpavalènu, dhanavamtudaina sahodarudu tanaku kaligina deenadashayamdu atishayimpavalènu.
Elayanagaa itadu gaddipuvvuvalè gatimchipovunu.
Sooryudu dayimchi, vadagaali kòtti, gaddini maadchiveyagaa daani puvvu raalunu, daani svaroopa saumdaryamunu nashimchunu; aalaage dhanavamtudunu tana prayatnamulalo vaadi povunu.
Shodhana sahimchuvaadu dhanyudu; atadu shodhanaku nilichinavaadai prabhuvu tannu premimchuvaariki vaagdaanamu chesina jeevakireetamu pòmdunu.
Devudu keedu vishayamai shodhimpabadaneradu; aayana èvanini shodhimpadu ganuka èvadainanu shodhimpabadinappudunenu devunicheta shodhimpa baduchunnaanani anakoodadu.
Prativaadunu tana svakeeyamaina duraashacheta eedvabadi marulu kòlpabadina vaadai shodhimpabadunu.
Duraasha garbhamu dharimchi paapamunu kanagaa, paapamu paripakvamai maranamunu kanunu.
Naa priya sahodarulaaraa, mosapokudi.

Shreshthamaina pratiyeeviyu sampoornamaina prati varamunu, parasambamdhamainadai, jyotirmayudagu tamdriyòddanumdi vachchunu; aayanayamdu e chamchalatvamainanu gamanaagamanamulavalana kalugu e chaayayainanu ledu.
Aayana taanu srrishtimchina vaatilo manamu prathamaphalamugaa umdunatlu satyavaakyamuvalana manalanu tana samkalpa prakaaramu kanènu.
Naa priya sahodarulaaraa, meereesamgati èruguduru ganuka prati manushyudu vinutaku vegirapaduvaadunu, maatalaadutaku nidaanimchuvaadunu, kopimchutaku nidaa nimchuvaadunai yumdavalènu.
Èmdukanagaa naruni kopamu devuni neetini nèraverchadu.
Amducheta samasta kalmashamunu, virraveeguchunna dushtatvamunu maani, lopala naatabadi mee aatmalanu rakshimchutaku shaktigala vaakyamunu saatvikamuto amgeekarimchudi.
Meeru vinuvaaru maatramaiyumdi mimmunu meeru mosapuchchukònakumda, vaakyaprakaaramu pravartimchuvaarunaiyumdudi.
Èvadainanu vaakyamunu vinuvaadaiyumdi daaniprakaaramu pravartimpanivaadaite, vaadu addamulo tana sahajamukhamunu choochukònu manushyuni poliyunnaadu.
Vaadu tannu choochukòni avataliki poyi taanèttivaado vèmtane marachipovunugadaa
Ayite svaatamtryamu nichchu sampoornamaina niyamamulo teri choochi nilukadagaa umduvaadèvado vaadu vini marachuvaadu kaaka, kriyanu cheyuvaadaiyumdi tana kriyalo dhanyudagunu.
Èvadainanu notiki kallèmu pèttukònaka tana hrridayamunu mosaparachukònuchu bhaktigalavaadanani anukònina yèdala vaani bhakti vyarthame.

Tamdriyaina devuniyèduta pavitramunu nishkalamkamunaina bhakti yedanagaa dikkuleni pillalanu vidhavaraamdranu vaari yibbamdilo paraamarshimchu tayu, ihalokamaalinyamu tanakamtakumda tannutaanu kaapaadukònutayune.
Naa sahodarulaaraa, mahimaasvaroopiyagu mana prabhuvaina yesukreestunugoorchina vishvaasavishayamulo momaatamugalavaarai yumdakudi.
Elaaganagaa bamgaaru umgaramu pèttukòni prashasta vastramulu dharimchukònina yòkadu mee samaajamamdiramuloniki vachchinappudu,muriki battalu kattukònina daridrudunu lopaliki vachchinayèdala

Meeru prashasta vastramulu dharimchukòninavaanini choochi sanmaanimchineevikkada mamchi sthalamamdu koorchumdumani chèppi, aa daridrunitoneevakkada niluvumu, leka ikkada naa paadapeethamunaku diguvanu koorchumdumani chèppinayèdala
Mee manassulalo bhedamulu pèttukònimeeru duraalochanato vimarshachesinavaaraguduru kaaraa?

Naa priya sahodarulaaraa, aalakimchudi; ee loka vishayamulo daridrulainavaarini vishvaasamamdu bhaagya vamtulugaanu, tannu premimchuvaariki taanu vaagdaanamuchesina raajyamunaku vaarasulugaanu umdutaku devu derparachukònaledaa?
Ayite meeru daridrulanu avamaanaparachuduru. dhanavamtulu meemeeda kathinamugaa adhikaaramu choopuduru; mimmunu nyaayasabhalaku eedchu chunna vaaru veere gadaa?
Meeku pèttabadina shreshthamaina naamamunu dooshimchuvaaru veere gadaa?
Mèttuku neevalè nee pòruguvaani premimchumanu lekhanamulo unnatti praamukhyamaina yee aaj~nanu meeru nèraverchinayèdala baagugane pravartimchuvaaraguduru.
Meeru pakshapaatamu galavaaraite dharmashaastramuvalana aparaadhulani teerchabadi paapamu cheyuvaaraguduru.
Èvadainanu dharmashaastra mamtayu gaikòniyu, òka aaj~navishayamulo tappi poyinayèdala, aaj~nalanniti vishayamulo aparaadhi yagunu;
Vyabhicharimpavaddani chèppinavaadu narahatyacheya vaddaniyu chèppènu ganuka neevu vyabhicharimpakapoyinanu narahatya chesinayèdala dharmashaastravishayamulo naparaadhi vaitivi.
Svaatamtryamu ichchu niyamamu chòppuna teerpupòmdabovuvaariki taginattugaa maatalaadudi; aalaagu nane pravartimchudi.
Kanikaramu choopanivaadu kanikaramuleni teerpu pòmdunu; kanikaramu teerpunu mimchi atishaya padunu.
Naa sahodarulaaraa, kriyalu lenappudu èvadainanu tanaku vishvaasamu kaladani chèppinayèdala emi prayo janamu? atti vishvaasamatani rakshimpagaladaa?
Sahodaru dainanu sahodariyainanu digambarulai aa naatiki bhojanamuleka yunnappudu.
Meelo èvadainanu shareeramunaku kaavalasinavaatini iyyakasamaadhaanamugaa vèlludi, chali kaachukònudi, trriptipòmdudani chèppinayèdala emi prayojanamu?
Aalaage vishvaasamu kriyalulenidaite adi òmtigaa umdi mrritamainadagunu.
Ayite òkadu neeku vishvaasamunnadi, naaku kriyalunnavi; kriyalu lekumda nee vishvaasamu naaku kanuparachumu, nenu naa kriyalacheta naa vishvaasamu neeku kanuparatunani chèppunu.
Devudòkkade ani neevu nammuchunnaavu. aalaagunammuta mamchide; dayyamulunu namima vanakuchunnavi.
Vyarthudaa, kriyaluleni vishvaasamu nishphalamainadani tèlisi kònagoruchunnaavaa?
Mana pitarudaina abraahaamu tana kumaarudaina issaakunu balipeethamumeeda arpimchi nappudu atadu kriyalavalana neetimamtudani teerpu pòmda ledaa?
Vishvaasamu atani kriyalatokoodi kaaryasiddhi kalugajesènaniyu, kriyalamoolamugaa atani vishvaasamu paripoornamainadaniyu grahimchuchunnaavugadaa?
Kaabatti abraahaamu devuni nammènu adi ataniki neetigaa èmchabadènu anu lekhanamu nèraverchabadènu. mariyu devuni snehitu dani ataniki perukaligènu.
Manushyudu vishvaasamoolamuna maatramukaaka kriyala moolamunanu neeti mamtudani yèmchabadunani, meeru deenivalana grahimchitiri.
Atuvalène raahaabanu veshyakooda dootalanu cherchukòni veròkamaargamuna vaarini vèlupaliki pampivesinappudu kriyalamoolamugaa neetimamturaalani yèmchabadènu gadaa?
Praanamuleni shareeramelaagu mrritamo aalaage kriyalu leni vishvaasamunu mrritamu.
Naa sahodarulaaraa, bodhakulamaina manamu mari kathinamaina teerpu pòmdudumani tèlisikòni meelo anekulu bodhakulu kaakumdudi.
Anekavishayamulalo mana mamdaramu tappipovuchunnaamu. èvadainanu maatayamdu tappaniyèdala attivaadu lopamu lenivaadai,tana sarvashareeramunu svaadheenamamdumchukòna shaktigalavaadaga
Gurramulu manaku lobadutakai notiki kallèmupètti, vaati shareeramamtayu trippudumu gadaa
Odalanukooda choodudi; avi èmto gòppavai pènugaaliki kòttukòni pobadinanu, oda nadupuvaani uddeshamuchòppuna mikkili chinnadagu chukkaanicheta trippabadunu.
Aalaagunane naalukakooda chinna avayavamainanu bahugaa adiri padunu. èmta kòmchèmu nippu èmta vistaaramaina adavini tagulabèttunu!
Naaluka agniye, naaluka mana avayavamulalo umchabadina paapaprapamchamai sarvashareera munaku maalinyamu kalugajeyuchu, prakrriti chakramunaku chichchupèttunu; adi narakamucheta chichchu pèttabadunu.
Mrriga pakshi sarpa jalacharamulalo pratijaatiyu narajaaticheta saadhukaajaalunu, saadhu aayènu gaani
Ye narudunu naalukanu saadhucheyaneradu, adi maranakaramaina vishamuto nimdinadi, adi nirargalamaina dushtatvame.
Deenito tamdriyaina prabhuvunu stutimtumu, deenitone devuni polikègaa puttina manushyulanu shapimtumu.
Òkkanotanumdiye aasheervachanamunu shaapavachanamunu bayaluvèllunu; naa sahodarulaaraa, yeelaagumda koodadu.
Neetibuggalo òkka jèlanumdiye tiyyani neerunu cheduneerunu oorunaa?
Naa sahodarulaaraa, amjoorapuchèttuna òleeva pamdlayinanu draakshateegènu amjoorapu pamdlayinanu kaayunaa? atuvalène uppu neellalonumdi tiyyani neellunu ooravu.
Meelo j~naana vivekamulu galavaadèvadu? vaadu j~naanamutokoodina saatvikamugalavaadai, tana yogya pravartanavalana tana kriyalanu kanuparachavalènu.
Ayite mee hrridayamulalo sahimpanalavikaani matsaramunu vivaadamunu umchukòninavaaraite atishayapadavaddu, satya munaku virodhamugaa abaddhamaadavaddu.
Ee j~naanamu painumdi digivachchunadikaaka bhoosambamdhamainadiyu prakrriti sambamdhamainadiyu dayyamula j~naanamu vamtidiyunai yunnadi.
Elayanagaa, matsaramunu vivaadamunu èkkada umduno akkada allariyu prati neechakaaryamunu umdunu.
Ayite painumdivachchu j~naanamu mòttamòdata pavitramainadi, taruvaata samaadhaanakaramainadi, mrriduvainadi, sulabhamugaa lobadunadi, kanikaramu tonu mamchi phalamulatonu nimdukònina
Neetiphalamu samaadhaanamu cheyuvaariki samaadhaanamamdu vittabadunu.
Meelo yuddhamulunu poraatamulunu deninumdi kaluguchunnavi? mee avayavamulalo poraadu mee bhogechchalanumdiye gadaa?
Meeraashimchuchunnaaru gaani meeku dòrakutaledu; narahatyacheyuduru matsara paduduru gaani sampaadimchukònaleru; potlaaduduru yuddhamu cheyuduru gaani devuni aduganamduna mee kemiyu dòrakadu.
Meeradiginanu mee bhogamula nimittamu viniyogimchutakai duruddeshamuto aduguduru ganuka meekemiyu dòrakutaledu.
Vyabhichaarinulaaraa, yee lokasnehamu devunito vairamani meerèrugaraa? kaabattiyèvadu ee lokamuto snehamu cheyagoruno vaadu devuniki shatruvagunu.
Aayana manayamdu niva simpajesina aatma matsarapadunamtagaa apekshimchunaa anu lekhanamu chèppunadi vyarthamani anukònuchunnaaraa?
Kaadugaani, aayana èkkuva krripa nichchunu; amduchetadevudu ahamkaarulanu èdirimchi deenulaku krripa anugra himchunu ani lekhanamu chèppuchunnadi.
Kaabatti devuniki lobadiyumdudi, apavaadini èdirimchudi, appudu vaadu meeyòddanumdi paaripovunu.
Devuniyòddaku ramdi, appudaayana meeyòddaku vachchunu, paapulaaraa, mee chetulanu shubhramuchesikònudi; dvimanaskulaaraa, mee hrridayamulanu parishuddhaparachukònudi.
Vyaakula padudi, duhkhapadudi, yeduvudi, mee navvu duhkhamunakunu mee aanamdamu chimtakunu maarchukònudi.
Prabhuvu drrishtiki mimmunu meeru taggimchukònudi. appudaayana mimmunu hèchchimchunu.

Sahodarulaaraa, òkaniki virodhamugaa òkadu maata laadakudi. tana sahodaruniki virodhamugaa maatalaadi tana sahodaruniki teerpu teerchuvaadu dharmashaastramunaku vyatirekamugaa maatalaadi dharmashaastramunaku teerputeerchu chunnaadu. neevu dharmashaastramunaku teerpu teerchinayèdala dharmashaastramunu nèraverchuvaadavukaaka nyaayamu vidhimchu vaadavaitivi.
Òkkade dharmashaastramunu niyamimchi nyaayamu vidhimchuvaadu. aayane rakshimchutakunu nashimpajeyutakunu shaktimamtudai yunnaadu; paruniki teerpu teerchutaku neevèvadavu?
Nedainanu repainanu òkaanòka pattanamunaku vèlli akkada òka samvatsaramumdi vyaapaaramuchesi laabhamu sampaadimtamu ramdani chèppukònuvaara laaraa,
Repemi sambhavimchuno meeku tèliyadu. mee jeevamepaatidi? meeru kòmtasepu kanabadi amtalo maayamaipovu aaviri vamtivaare.
Kanukaprabhuvu chittamaite manamu bradikiyumdi idi adi chetamani chèppukònavalènu.
Ippudaite meeru mee dambamulayamdu atishayapaduchunnaaru. itti atishayamamtayu chèddadi.
Kaabatti melainadicheya nèrigiyu aalaagu cheyanivaaniki paapamu kalugunu.
Idigo dhanavamtulaaraa, meemeediki vachchèdi upadrava mulanu goorchi pralaapimchi yeduvudi.
Mee dhanamu chèdipoyènu; mee vastramulu chimmatalu kòttinavaayènu.
Mee bamgaaramunu mee vèmdiyu tuppupattinavi; vaati tuppu meemeeda saakshyamugaa umdi agnivalè mee shareeramulanu tiniveyunu; amtyadinamulayamdu dhanamu koorchu kòmtiri.
Idigo mee chelu kosina panivaarikiyyaka, meeru mosamugaa bigapattina kooli mòrrapèttuchunnadi. mee kotavaari kekalu sainyamulaku adhipatiyagu prabhuvu yòkka chèvulalo chòchchiyunnavi.
Meeru bhoomimeeda sukhamugaa jeevimchi bhogaasaktulai vadhadinamunamdu mee hrridayamulanu poshimchukòmtiri.
Meeru neeti mamtudainavaaniki shikshavidhimchi champuduru, atadu mimmunu èdirimpadu.

Sahodarulaaraa, prabhuvu raakadavaraku opika kaligi yumdudi; choodudi; vyavasaayakudu tòlakari varshamunu kadavari varshamunu samakoodu varaku viluvaina bhoophalamu nimittamu opikato kaachukònuchu daanikòraku kanipèttunu gadaa
Prabhuvuraaka sameepimchuchunnadi ganuka meerunu opika kaligiyumdudi, mee hrridayamulanu sthiraparachu kònudi.
Sahodarulaaraa, meeru teerpu pòmdakumdu nimittamu òkanimeedanòkadu sanagakudi; idigo nyaayaadhipati vaakita nilichiyunnaadu.
Naa sahodarulaaraa, prabhuvu naamamuna bodhimchina pravaktalanu, shramaanubhava munakunu opikakunu maadirigaa pèttukònudi.
Sahimchina vaarini dhanyulanukònuchunnaamu gadaa? meeru yobu yòkka sahanamunugoorchi vimtiri. aayana èmto jaaliyu kanikaramunu galavaadani meeru tèlisikòni yunnaaru.

Naa sahodarulaaraa, mukhyamaina samgati edanagaa, aakaashamutodanigaani bhoomitodanigaani mari deni todanigaani òttupèttukònaka, meeru teerpupaalu kaakumdunatlu avunamte avunu kaadamte kaadu ani umdavalènu.
Meelo èvanikainanu shrama sambhavimchènaa? atadu praarthanacheyavalènu; èvanikainanu samtoshamu kaligènaa? atadu keertanalu paadavalènu.
Meelo èvadainanu rogiyai yunnaadaa? atadu samghapu pèddalanu pilipimpavalènu; vaaru prabhuvu naamamuna ataniki noonè raachi atanikòraku praarthanacheyavalènu.
Vishvaasasahitamaina praarthana aa rogini svasthaparachunu, prabhuvu atani lepunu; atadu paapamulu chesinavaadaite paapakshamaapana nòmdunu.
Mee paapamulanu òkanitonòkadu òppukònudi; meeru svasthatapòmdunatlu òkanikòraku òkadu praarthanacheyudi. neetimamtuni vij~naapana manahpoorvakamainadai bahu balamu galadai yumdunu.
Eleeyaa manavamti svabhaavamugala manushyude; varshimpakumdunatlu atadu aasaktito praarthana cheyagaa moodunnara samvatsaramulavaraku bhoomimeeda varshimpaledu.
Atadu marala praarthanacheyagaa aakaashamu varsha michchènu, bhoomi tana phalamu ichchènu.
Naa sahodarulaaraa, meelo èvadainanu satyamu numdi tòlagipoyinappudu mariyòkadu atanini satya munaku mallimchinayèdala
Paapini vaani tappumaargamunumdi mallimchuvaadu maranamunumdi yòka aatmanu rakshimchi aneka paapamulanu kappiveyunani taanu tèlisikònavalènu.
Yesukreestu apòstaludaina peturu, tamdriyaina devuni bhavishyad‌ j~naanamunubatti,

Aatmavalani parishuddhata pòmdinavaarai vidheyulagutakunu, yesukreestu raktamuvalana prokshimpabadutakunu erparachabadinavaariki, anagaa pòmtu, galateeya, kappadòkiya, aasiya, bituniya anu deshamula yamdu chèdarina vaarilo cherina yaatrikulaku shubhamani chèppi vraayunadi. meeku krripayu samaadhaanamunu vistarillunugaaka.
Mana prabhuvagu yesukreestu tamdriyaina devudu stutimpabadunugaaka.

Mrritulalonumdi yesukreestu tirigi lechutavalana jeevamuto koodina nireekshana manaku kalugunatlu, anagaa akshayamainadiyu, nirmalamainadiyu, vaada baaranidiyunaina svaasyamu manaku kalugunatlu, aayana tana vishesha kanikaramuchòppuna manalanu marala janmimpa jesènu.

Kadavari kaalamamdu bayaluparachabadutaku siddha mugaanunna rakshana meeku kalugunatlu, vishvaasamudvaaraa devuni shakticheta kaapaadabadu meekòraku, aa svaasthyamu paralokamamdu bhadraparachabadiyunnadi.
Imduvalana meeru mikkili aanamdimchuchunnaaru gaani avasaramunubatti naanaa vidhamulaina shodhanalacheta, prastutamuna kòmchèmu kaalamu meeku duhkhamu kaluguchunnadi.

Nashimchipovu suvarnamu agnipareekshavalana shuddhaparachabaduchunnadi gadaa? daanikamtè amoolyamaina mee vishvaasamu ee shodhanalacheta pareekshaku nilichinadai, yesukreestu pratyakshamainappudu meeku mèppunu mahimayu ghanatayu kalugutaku kaarana magunu.
Meeraayananu choodakapoyinanu aayananu premimchuchunnaaru; ippudu aayananu kannulaara choodakaye vishvasimchuchu, mee vishvaasamunaku phalamunu,
Anagaa aatmarakshananu pòmduchu,chèppanashakyamunu mahimaa yuktamunaina samtoshamugalavaarai aanamdimchuchunnaaru.
Meeku kalugu aa krripanugoorchi pravachimchina pravaktalu ee rakshananugoorchi parisheelimchuchu, tamayamdunna kreestu aatma kreestu vishayamaina shramalanugoorchiyu,
Vaati taruvaata kalugabovu mahimalanugoorchiyu mumdugaa saakshyamichchunapudu, aa aatma, ye kaalamunu ètti kaala munu soochimchuchuvachchèno daanini vichaarimchi parisho dhimchiri.

Paralokamunumdi pampabadina parishuddhaatmavalana meeku suvaarta prakatimchinavaaridvaaraa meekippudu tèlupabadina yee samgatulavishayamai, tamakòraku kaadu gaani meekòrake taamu paricharya chesiranu samgati vaariki bayalu parachabadènu; devadootalu ee kaaryamulanu tòmgichooda goruchunnaaru.
Kaabatti mee manassu anu nadumukattukòni nibbara maina buddhigalavaarai, yesukreestu pratyakshamainappudu meeku tebadu krripavishayamai sampoorna nireekshana kaligiyumdudi.
Nenu parishuddhudanai yunnaanu ganuka meerunu parishuddhulai yumdudani vraayabadiyunnadi.
Kaagaa meeru vidheyulagu pillalai, mee poorvapu aj~naanadashalo mee kumdina aashala nanusarimchi pravartimpaka,
Mimmunu pilichina vaadu parishuddhudaiyunna prakaaramu meerunu samasta pravartanayamdu parishuddhulaiyumdudi.
Pakshapaatamu lekumda kriyalanubatti prativaanini teerputeerchuvaadu tamdri ani meeraayanaku praarthanacheyuchunnaaru ganuka meeru paradeshulai yunnamtakaalamu bhayamuto gadupudi.
Pitrripaaramparyamaina mee vyarthapravartananu vidichipèttunatlugaa vèmdi bamgaaramulavamti kshaya vastuvulacheta meeru vimochimpabadaledugaani
Amoolyamaina raktamucheta, anagaa nirdoshamunu nishkalamkamunagu gòrrapillavamti kreestu raktamucheta, vimochimpabaditirani meerèruguduru gadaa

Aayana jagattu punaadi veyabadaka munupe niya mimpabadènu gaani tannu mrritulalonumdi lepi tanaku mahimanichchina devuniyèdala tana dvaaraa vishvaasulaina mee nimittamu, kadavari kaalamulayamdu aayana pratyaksha parachabadènu. kaagaa mee vishvaasamunu nireekshanayu devuni yamdu umchabadiyunnavi.
Meeru kshayabeejamunumdi kaaka, shaashvatamagu jeevamugala devunivaakyamoolamugaa akshayabeejamunumdi puttimpabadinavaaru ganuka nishkapatamaina sahodaraprema kalugunatlu,
Meeru satyamunaku vidheyulavutacheta mee manassulanu pavitraparachukònina vaaraiyumdi, yòkaninòkadu hrridayapoorvakamugaanu mikkatamu gaanu premimchudi.
Elayanagaa sarvashareerulu gaddinipolinavaaru, vaari amda mamtayu gaddipuvvuvalè unnadi;
Gaddi èmdunu daani puvvunu raalunu, ayite prabhuvu vaakyamu èllappudunu niluchunu.
Meeku prakatimpabadina suvaarta yee vaakyame.
Prabhuvu dayaaludani meeru ruchichoochiyunna yèdala
Samastamaina dushtatvamunu, samastamaina kapatamunu, veshadhaarananu, asooyanu, samasta dooshana maatalanu maani,
Kròttagaa janmimchina shishuvulanu polinavaarai, nirmala maina vaakyamanu paalavalana rakshana vishayamulo èdugu nimittamu, aa paalanu apekshimchudi.
Manushyulacheta visarjimpabadinanu, devuni drrishtiki erparachabadinadiyu amoolyamunu sajeevamunaina raayiyagu prabhuvunòddaku vachchina vaarai,

Yesukreestudvaaraa devuniki anukoolamu lagu aatmasambamdhamaina balulanarpimchutaku parishuddhayaaja kulugaa umdunatlu, meerunu sajeevamaina raallavalènumdi aatma sambamdhamaina mamdiramugaa kattabaduchunnaaru.

Elayanagaa idigo nenu mukhyamunu erparachabadinadiyu amoolyamunagu moolaraatini seeyonulò sthaapimchuchunnaanu; aayanayamdu vishvaasamumchu vaadu emaatramunu siggupadadu anu maata lekhanamamdu vraayabadiyunnadi.
Vishva simchuchunna meeku, aayana amoolyamainavaadu; vishva simpanivaarikaite illu kattuvaaru e raatini nishedhimchiro ade moolaku talaraayi aayènu. mariyu adi adduraayiyu addubamdayu aayènu.
Kattuvaaru vaakyamuna kavidheyulai tòtrilluchunnaaru, daanike vaaru niyamimpabadiri.
Ayite meeru cheekatilonumdi aashcharyakaramaina tana vèluguloniki mimmunu pilichina vaani gunaatishayamulanu prachuramucheyu nimittamu, erparachabadina vamshamunu, raajulaina yaajakasava
Òkappudu prajagaa umdaka yippudu devuni prajayaitiri; òkappudu kanikarimpabadaka yippudu kanikarimpabadinavaaraitiri.
Priyulaaraa, meeru paradeshulunu yaatrikulunai yunnaaru ganuka aatmaku virodhamugaa poraadu shareeraasha lanu visarjimchi,
Anyajanulu mimmunu e vishayamulo durmaargulani dooshimturo, aa vishayamulo vaaru mee sat‌kriyalanu choochi, vaatinibatti darshanadinamuna devuni mahimaparachunatlu, vaari madhyanu mam
Manushyulu niyamimchu prati kattadakunu prabhuvu nimittamai lobadiyumdudi.
Raaju amdarikini adhipati yaniyu, naayakulu durmaargulaku pratidamdana cheyuta kunu sanmaargulaku mèppu kalugutakunu raajuvalana pampa badinavaaraniyu vaariki lobadiyumdudi.
Elayanagaa meeritlu yuktapravartana galavaarai, aj~naanamugaa maatalaadu moorkhula noru mooyuta devuni chittamu.
Svatamtrulai yumdiyu dushtatvamunu kappi pèttutaku mee svaatamtrya munu viniyogaparachaka, devuniki daasulamani lobadi yumdudi.
Amdarini sanmaanimchudi, sahodarulanu premimchudi, devuniki bhayapadudi, raajunu sanmaanimchudi.
Panivaaralaaraa, mamchivaarunu saatvikulunainavaariki maatramu kaaka mushkarulaina mee yajamaanulakunu poornabhayamuto lobadiyumdudi.
Èvadainanu anyaaya mugaa shramapòmduchu, devunigoorchina manassaakshikaligi, duhkhamu sahimchinayèdala adi hitamagunu.
Tappida munakai dèbbalu tininappudu meeru sahimchinayèdala meekemi ghanamu? meluchesi baadhapadunappudu meeru sahimchinayèdala adi devuniki hitamagunu;
Imduku meeru piluvabaditiri.kreestukooda meekòraku baadhapadi, meeru tana adugujaadalayamdu naduchukònunatlu meeku maadiri yumchi poyènu.
Aayana paapamu cheyaledu; aayana notanu e kapatamunu kanabadaledu.
Aayana dooshimpa badiyu badulu dooshimpaledu; aayana shramapèttabadiyu bèdirimpaka, nyaayamugaa teerpu teerchu devuniki tannu taanu appagimchukònènu.

Manamu paapamula vishayamai chanipoyi, neetivishayamai jeevimchunatlu, aayana taane tana shareeramamdu mana paapamulanu mraanumeeda mosi kònènu. aayana pòmdina gaayamulacheta meeru svasthata nòmditiri.
Meeru gòrralavalè daaritappipotiri gaani yippudu mee aatmala kaapariyu adhyakshudunaina aayana vaipunaku malliyunnaaru.
Atuvalè streelaaraa, meeru mee svapurushulaku lobadiyumdudi;
Amduvalana vaarilo èvarainanu vaakya munaku avidheyulaite, vaaru bhayamutokoodina mee pavitrapravartana choochi, vaakyamu lekumdane tama bhaaryala nadavadivalana raabattabadavachchunu.
Jadalu allukònutayu, bamgaarunagalu pèttukònutayu, vastramulu dharimchu kònutayunanu vèlupati alamkaaramu meeku alamkaara mugaa umdaka,
Saadhuvainattiyu, mrriduvainattiyunaina gunamanu akshayaalamkaaramugala mee hrridayapu amta ramga svabhaavamu meeku alamkaaramugaa umdavalènu; adi devuni drrishtiki migula viluvagaladi.
Atuvalè poorvamu devuni aashrayimchina parishuddha streelunu tama svapurushulaku lobadiyumdutacheta tammunu taamu alamkarimchukòniri.
Aa prakaaramu shaaraa abraahaamunu yajamaanudani piluchuchu ataniki lobadi yumdènu. meerunu yogyamugaa naduchukònuchu, e bhayamunaku bèdarakayunnayèdala aamèku pillalaguduru.
Atuvalène purushulaaraa, jeevamanu krripaavaramulo mee bhaaryalu meeto paalivaaraiyunnaarani yèrigi, yèkkuva balaheenamaina ghatamani bhaaryanu sanmaanimchi, mee praarthanalaku abhyamtaramu kalugaka
Tudaku meeramdaru ekamanaskulai yòkari sukhaduhkha mulayamdu òkaru paalupadi, sahodaraprema galavaarunu, karunaachittulunu, vinayamanaskulunai yumdudi.
Aasheervaadamunaku vaarasulavutaku meeru piluvabaditiri ganuka keeduku pratikeedainanu dooshanaku prati dooshanayainanu cheyaka deevimchudi.
Jeevamunu premimchi mamchi dinamulu choodagoru vaadu chèddadaani palukakumda tana naalukanu, kapatapu maatalu chèppakumda tana pèdavulanu kaachukònavalènu.
Atadu keedunumdi tòlagi melucheyavalènu, samaadhaanamunu vèdaki daani vèmtaadavalènu.
Prabhuvu kannulu neetimamtula meedanu, aayana chèvulu vaari praarthanala vaipunanu unnavi gaani prabhuvu mukhamu keedu cheyuvaariki virodhamugaa unnadi.
Meeru mamchi vishayamulo aasaktigalavaaraite meeku haanicheyuvaadèvadu?
Meeròkavela neetinimittamu shrama padinanu meeru dhanyule; vaari bèdarimpunaku bhayapadakudi kalavarapadakudi;

Nirmalamaina manassaakshi kaliginavaarai, meelo unna nireekshananugoorchi mimmunu hetuvu adugu prativaanikini saatvikamutonu bhayamutonu samaadhaanamu chèpputaku èllappudu siddhamugaa umdi,mee hrridayamulayamdu kreestunu prabhuvugaa pratishthimchudi;
Appudu meeru denivishayamai durmaargulani dooshimpabadu duro daani vishayamai kreestunamdunna mee sat‌pravartana meeda apanimdaveyuvaaru siggupaduduru.
Devuni chitta maalaagunnayèdala keeduchesi shramapadutakamtè meluchesi shramapadutaye bahu mamchidi.
Elayanagaa manalanu devuniyòddaku tèchchutaku, aneetimamtulakòraku neetimamtu daina kreestu shareeravishayamulo champabadiyu,
Aatmavishaya mulo bradikimpabadi, paapamula vishayamulo òkkasaare shramapadènu.

Devuni deerghashaamtamu imka kani pèttuchumdinappudu poorvamu novahu dinamulalo oda siddhaparachabaduchumdagaa, avidheyulainavaariyòddaku, anagaa chèralo unna aatmalayòddaku, aayana aatmaroopi gaane vèlli vaariki prakatimchènu. aa odalo kòmdaru, anagaa ènimidi mamdi neetidvaaraa rakshanapòmdiri.

Daaniki saadrrishyamaina baaptismamu ippudu mimmunu rakshimchu chunnadi; adedanagaa shareeramaalinyamu teesiveyuta kaadu gaani yesukreestu punarutthaana moolamugaa devuni visha yamu nirmalamaina manassaakshinichchu pratyuttarame.
Aayana paralokamunaku vèlli dootalameedanu adhikaarula meedanu shaktulameedanu adhikaaramu pòmdinavaadai devuni kudipaarshvamuna unnaadu.
Kreestu shareeramamdu shramapadènu ganuka meerunu atti manassunu aayudhamugaa dharimchukònudi.

Shareera vishayamulo shramapadinavaadu shareeramamdu jeevimchu migilinakaalamu ikameedata manujaashalanu anusarimchi naduchukònaka, devuni ishtaanusaaramugaane naduchukònu natlu paapamuto joli yika nemiyuleka yumdunu.

Manamu pokiricheshtalu, duraashalu, madya paanamu, allarito koodina aatapaatalu, traagubotula vimdulu, cheyadagani vigrahapoojalu mòdalainavaatiyamdu naduchukònuchu, anyajanula ishtamu nèraverchuchumdutaku gatimchinakaalame chaalunu,
Aparimitamaina aa durvyaapaaramunamdu tamatokooda meeru parugèttakapoyinamduku vaaru aashcharyapaduchu mimmunu dooshimchuchunnaaru.
Sajeevula kunu mrritulakunu teerputeerchutaku siddhamugaa unnavaaniki vaaruttaravaadulaiyunnaaru.
Mrritulu shareeravishayamulo maanavareetya teerpu pòmdunatlunu aatmavishayamulo devuni batti jeevimchunatlunu vaarikikooda suvaarta prakatimpabadènu.
Ayite anniti amtamu sameepamaiyunnadi. kaagaa meeru svastha buddhigalavaarai, praarthanalu cheyutaku mèlakuvagaa umdudi.
Prema aneka paapamulanu kappunu ganuka annitikamtè mukhyamugaa òkaniyèdala òkadu mikkatamaina premagalavaarai yumdudi.
Sanugukònakumda òkaniki òkadu aatithyamu cheyudi.
Devuni naanaavidhamaina krripavishayamai mamchi grriha nirvaahakulaiyumdi, yòkkòkadu krripaavaramu pòmdina kòladi yòkanikòkadu upachaaramu cheyudi.

Òkadu bodhimchinayèdala daivoktulanu bodhimchunattu bodhimpavalènu; òkadu upachaaramu chesinayèdala devudu anu grahimchu saamarthyamunòmdi cheyavalènu. imduvalana devudu annitilonu yesukreestu dvaaraa mahimaparacha badunu. yugayugamulu mahimayu prabhaavamunu aayanakumdunu gaaka. aamen‌.
Priyulaaraa, mimmunu shodhimchutaku meeku kalugu chunna agnivamti mahaashramanugoorchi meekedo yòka vimta sambhavimchunatlu aashcharyapadakudi.
Kreestu mahima bayaluparachabadinappudu meeru mahaanamdamuto samto shimchu nimittamu, kreestu shramalalo meeru paalivaarai yunnamtagaa samtoshimchudi.
Kreestu naamamu nimittamu meeru nimdapaalainayèdala mahimaasvaroopiyaina aatma, anagaa devuni aatma, meemeeda niluchuchunnaadu ganuka meeru dhanyulu.
Meelo èvadunu narahamtakudugaa gaani, dòmgagaa gaani, durmaargudugaa gaani, parulajoliki povuvaadugaa gaani baadha anubhavimpa tagadu.
Èvadainanu kraistavudainamduku baadha anubhavimchinayèdala atadu siggupadaka, aa perunu battiye devuni mahimaparachavalènu.
Teerpu devuni imtiyòdda aarambhamagu kaalamu vachchi yunnadi; adi manayòddane aarambhamaite devuni suvaartaku avidheyulaina vaari gati yemavunu?
Mariyu neeti mamtude rakshimpabaduta durlabhamaite bhaktiheenudunu paapiyu èkkada niluturu?
Kaabatti devuni chittaprakaaramu baadhapaduvaaru sat‌pravartana galavaarai, nammakamaina srrishtikartaku tama aatmalanu appagimchukònavalènu.
Totipèddanu, kreestu shramalanugoorchina saakshini, bayaluparachabadabovu mahimalo paalivaadanunaina nenu meeloni pèddalanu hèchcharimchuchunnaanu.
Balimicheta kaaka devuni chittaprakaaramu ishtapoorvakamugaanu, durlaabhaa pekshatokaaka siddhamanassutonu, mee madhyanunna devuni mamdanu paivichaaranacheyuchu daanini kaayudi.
Meeku appagimpabadinavaaripaina prabhuvunainattumdaka mamdaku maadi rulugaa umdudi;
Pradhaana kaapari pratyakshamainappudu meeru vaadabaarani mahima kireetamu pòmduduru.

Chinnalaaraa, meeru pèddalaku lobadiyumdudi; meeramdaru èdutivaani yèdala deenamanassu anu vastramu dharimchukòni mimmunu alamkarimchukònudi; devudu ahamkaaru lanu èdirimchi deenulaku krripa anugrahimchunu.
Devudu tagina samayamamdu mimmunu hèchchimchunatlu aayana balishthamaina chetikrimda deenamanaskulai yumdudi.
Aayana mimmunugoorchi chimtimchuchunnaadu ganuka mee chimta yaavattu aayanameeda veyudi.
Nibbaramaina buddhi galavaarai mèlakuvagaa umdudi; mee virodhiyaina apavaadi garjimchu simhamuvalè èvarini mimgudunaa ani vèdakuchu tiruguchunnaadu.
Lokamamdunna mee saho darulayamdu ee vidhamaina shramale nèraveruchunnavani yèrigi,vishvaasamamdu sthirulai vaanini èdirimchudi.
Tana nityamahimaku kreestunamdu mimmunu pilichina sarvakrripaa nidhiyagu devudu, kòmchèmu kaalamu meeru shramapadina pimmata,taane mimmunu poornulanugaachesi sthiraparachi bala parachunu.
Yugayugamulaku prabhaavamaayanaku kalu gunugaaka. aamen‌.

Mimmunu hèchcharimchuchu, idiye devuni satyamaina krripa ani saakshyamu chèppuchu samkshepamugaa vraasi, meeku nammakamaina sahodarudani nenèmchina silvaanucheta deenini pampuchunnaanu. ee satyakrripalo nilukadagaa umdudi.
Babulonulo meevalè nerparachabadina aamèyu, naa kumaarudaina maarkunu, meeku vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaaru.
Premagala mudduto òkaniki òkadu vamdanamulu cheyudi.kreestunamdunna meekamdarikini samaadhaanamu kalugunu gaaka. aamen‌.

Yesukreestu daasudunu apòstaludunaina seemonu peturu, mana devuniyòkkayu rakshakudaina yesukreestu yòkkayu neetinibatti, maavalène amoolyamaina vishvaasamu pòmdinavaariki shubhamani chèppi vraayunadi.

Tana mahimanubattiyu, gunaatishayamunubattiyu, manalanu pilichinavaani goorchina anubhavaj~naanamoolamugaa aayana daivashakti, jeevamunakunu bhaktikini kaavalasinavaatinannitini manaku dayacheyuchunnamduna,
Devunigoorchinattiyu mana prabhuvaina yesunugoorchinattiyunaina anubhavaj~naanamuvalana meeku krripayu samaadhaanamunu vistarimchunu gaaka.

Aa mahima gunaatishayamulanubatti aayana manaku amoolya mulunu atyadhikamulunaina vaagdaanamulanu anugrahimchi yunnaadu. duraashanu anusarimchutavalana lokamamdunna bhrashtatvamunu ee vaagdaanamula moolamugaa meeru tappimchukòni, devasvabhaavamunamdu paalivaaragunatlu vaatini anugrahimchènu
Aa hetuvuchetane meemattuku meeru poornajaagrattagalavaarai, mee vishvaasamunamdu sadguna munu,sadgunamunamdu j~naanamunu,
J~naanamunamdu aashaanigra hamunu, aashaanigrahamunamdu sahanamunu, sahanamu namdu bhaktini,
Bhaktiyamdu sahodarapremanu, sahodara premayamdu dayanu amarchukònudi.
Ivi meeku kaligi vistarimchinayèdala avi mana prabhuvaina yesukreestunugoorchina anubhavaj~naanavishayamulo mimmunu somarulainanu nishphalu lainanu kaakumda cheyunu.
Ivi èvaniki lekapovuno vaadu tana poorvapaapamulaku shuddhi kaligina samgati marachi poyi, gruddivaadunu dooradrrishtilenivaadunagunu.
Amduvalana sahodarulaaraa, mee pilupunu erpaatunu nishchayamu chesikònutaku mari jaagrattapadudi.meeritti kriyalu cheyuvaaraite èppudunu tòtrillaru.
Aalaaguna mana prabhuvunu rakshakudunaina yesukreestu yòkka nityaraajyamulo praveshamu meeku samrriddhigaa anugrahimpabadunu.
Kaabatti meeru ee samgatulanu tèlisikòni meeramgeekarimchina satyamamdu sthiraparachabadiyunnanu, veetinigoorchi èllappudunu meeku j~naapakamu cheyutaku siddhamugaa unnaanu.
Mariyu mana prabhuvaina yesukreestu naaku soochimchina prakaaramu naa gudaaramunu tvaragaa vidichi pèttavalasivachchunaniyèrigi,
Nenu ee gudaaramulo unnamtakaalamu ee samgatulanu j~naapakamuchesi mimmunu reputa nyaayamani yèmchukònuchunnaanu.
Nenu mrritipòmdina taruvaata3 kooda meeru nityamu veetini j~naapakamuchesikònunatlu jaagrattachetunu.
Elayanagaa chamatkaaramugaa kalpimchina kathalanu anusarimchi mana prabhuvaina yesukreestuyòkka shaktini aayana raakadanu memu meeku tèlupaledu gaani

Aayana mahaatmyamunu memu kannulaara choochinavaaramai tèlipitiviu.eeyana naa priyakumaarudu eeyanayamdu nenu aanamdimchuchunnaanu anu shabdamu mahaadivyamahimanumdi aayanayòddaku vachchi nappudu, tamdriyaina devunivalana ghanatayu mahimayu aayana pòmdagaa
Memu aa parishuddha parvatamumeeda aayanatokooda umdina vaaramai, aa shabdamu aakaashamu numdi raagaa vimtimi.

Mariyu imtakamtè sthiramaina pravachanavaakyamu manakunnadi. tèllavaari vekuvachukka mee hrridayamulalo udayimchuvaraku aa vaakyamu cheekatigala chotuna vèlugichchu deepamainattunnadi; daaniyamdu meeru lakshyamumchinayèdala meeku melu.
Òkadu tana oohanubatti chèpputavalana lekhanamulo e pravachanamunu puttadani mòdata grahimchukònavalènu.
Ela yanagaa pravachanamu èppudunu manushyuni ichchanubatti kalugaledu gaani manushyulu parishuddhaatmavalana prerepimpa badinavaarai devuni moolamuga palikiri.

Mariyu abaddhapravaktalu prajalalo umdiri. atuvalène meelonu abaddabodhakulumduru; veeru tammunu kònina prabhuvunukooda visarjimchuchu, tamakutaame sheeghramugaa naashanamu kalugajesikònuchu, naashanakaramagu bhinnaabhipraayamulanu rahasyamugaa bodhimchuduru.
Mariyu anekulu vaari pokiricheshtalanu anusarimchi naduturu; veerinibatti satyamaargamu dooshimpabadunu.
Vaaru adhika lobhulai, kalpanaavaakyamulu chèppuchu, meevalana laabhamu sampaadimchukòmduru; vaariki poorvamu numdi vidhimpabadina teerpu aalasyamu cheyadu, vaari naashanamu kuniki nidrapodu.
Devadootalu paapamu chesinappudu devudu vaarini vidichipèttaka, paataalaloka mamdali katika cheekatigala bilamulaloniki trosi, teerpuku kaavalilo umchabadutaku vaarini appagimchènu.
Mariyu aayana poorvakaalamamdunna lokamunu vidichipèttaka, bhaktiheenula samoohamumeediki jalapralayamunu rappimchi nappudu, neetini prakatimchina novahunu mari yedugurini kaapaadènu.
Mariyu aayana sòdòma gòmòrraalanu pattanamulanu bhasmamuchesi, mumduku bhaktiheenulaguvaariki vaatini drrishtaamtamugaa umchutakai vaatiki naashanamu vidhimchi,
Durmaargula kaama vikaarayuktamaina nadavadicheta bahu baadhapadina neetimamtudagu lotunu tappimchènu.
Aa neetimamtudu vaari madhyanu kaapuramumdi, taanu choochinavaatinibattiyu vininavaatinibattiyu, vaari akramamaina kriyala vishayamulo dinadinamu neetigala tana manassunu nòppimchukònuchu vachchènu.
Bhaktulanu shodhanalonumdi tappimchutakunu, durneetiparulanu mukhya mugaa malinamaina duraashakaligi shareeraanusaaramugaa naduchu kònuchu, prabhutvamunu niraakarimchuchu,
Shi kshalo umcha badinavaarini teerpudinamuvaraku kaavalilo umchutakunu, prabhuvu samarthudu. veeru tèguvagalavaarunu svechchaaparulunai mahaatmulanu dooshimpa vèruvakayunnaaru.
Devadootalu vaarikamtè mari adhikamaina balamunu shaktiyu galavaarainanu, prabhuvu èduta vaarini dooshimchi vaarimeeda neramu mopa vèraturu.

Vaaraite pattabadi champa badutake svabhaavasiddhamugaa puttina vivekashoonyamulagu mrrigamulavalè umdi, tamaku tèliyani vishayamulanu goorchi dooshimchuchu, tama dush‌pravartanaku pratiphalamugaa haani anubhavimchuchu, taamu cheyu naashanamutone taame naashanamu pòmduduru,
Òkanaati sukhaanu bhavamu samtoshamani yèmchukòmduru. vaaru kalamka mulunu nimdaaspadamulunai tama premavimdulalo meetokooda annapaanamulu puchchukònuchu tama bhoga mulayamdu sukhimchuduru.

Vyabhichaarinini choochi aashimchuchu paapamu maanaleni kannulu galavaarunu, asthirulainavaari manassulanu marulukòlpuchu lobhitva mamdu saadhakamucheyabadina hrridayamugalavaarunu, shaapa grastulunaiyumdi,
Tinnanimaargamunu vidichi bèyoru kumaarudaina bilaamu poyina maargamunubatti trova tappipoyiri.

Aa bilaamu durneetivalana kalugu bahu maanamunu premimchènu; ayite taanu chesina atikramamu nimittamu atadu gaddimpabadènu, ètlanagaa noruleni gaardabhamu maanavasvaramuto maatalaadi aa pravaktayòkka vèrritanamu addagimchènu.
Veeru neelluleni baavulunu, pènugaaliki kòttukònipovu meghamulunai yunnaaru. veerikòraku gaadhaamdhakaaramu bhadramu cheyabadiyunnadi.

Veeru vyarthamaina dambapumaatalu palukuchu, taame shareerasambamdhamaina duraashalugalavaarai, tappumaargamamdu naduchuvaarilonumdi appude tappimchu kòninavaarini pokiricheshtalacheta maralukòlpuchunnaaru.
Taame bhrashtatvamunaku daasulaiyumdiyu, attivaariki svaatamtryamu ittumani chèppuduru. òkadu denivalana jayimpabaduno daaniki daasudagunu gadaa

Vaaru prabhuvunu rakshakudunaina yesukreestu vishayamaina anubhava j~naanamucheta ee lokamaalinyamulanu tappimchukònina taruvaata marala vaatilo chikkubadi vaaticheta jayimpa badinayèdala, vaari kadavari sthiti mòdati sthitikamtè mari chèddadagunu.
Vaaru neetimaargamunu anubhavapoorvakamugaa tèlisi kòni, tamaku appagimpabadina parishuddhamaina aaj~nanumdi tòlagipovutakamtè aa maargamu anubhavapoorvakamugaa tèliyaka yumdutaye vaariki melu.
Kukkatana vaamtiki tiriginattunu, kadugabadina pamdi buradalo dòrlutaku malli nattunu anu nijamaina saamitè chòppuna veeriki sambhavimchènu.
Priyulaaraa, yee rèmdava patrika meekippudu vraayuchunnaanu

Parishuddha pravaktalacheta poorvamamdu palukabadina maatalanu, prabhuvaina rakshakudu mee apòstalula dvaaraa ichchina aaj~nanu meeru j~naapakamu chesikònavalènanu vishayamunu meeku j~naapakamuchesi, nirmalamaina mee manassulanu repuchunnaanu.
Amtya dinamulalo apahaasakulu apahasimchuchuvachchi, tama svakeeya duraashalachòppuna naduchukònuchu,
Aayana raakadanu goorchina vaagdaana memaayènu? pitarulu nidrimchinadi mòdalukòni samasta munu srrishti aarambhamunanunnatte nilichi yunnade ani chèppudurani mòdata meeru tèlisikònava
Elayanagaa poorvamunumdi aakaashamumdènaniyu, neellalo numdiyu neellavalananu samakoorchabadina bhoomiyu devuni vaakyamuvalana kaligènaniyu vaaru buddhipoorvakamugaa maraturu.
Aa neellavalana appudunna lokamu neetivaradalo munigi nashimchènu.
Ayite ippudunna aakaashamunu bhoomiyu bhaktiheenula teerpunu naashanamunu jarugu dinamuvaraku agnikòraku niluvacheyabadinavai, ade vaakyamuvalana bhadramu cheyabadiyunnavi.
Priyulaaraa, òka samgati marachipokudi. emanagaa prabhuvu drrishtiki òka dinamu vèyyisamvatsaramulavalènu, vèyyisamvatsaramulu òka dinamuvalènu unnavi.

Kòmdaru aalasyamani yèmchukònunatlu prabhuvu tana vaagdaanamunu goorchi aalasyamu cheyuvaadu kaadu gaani yèvadunu nashimpavalènani yichchayimpaka, amdaru maarumanassu pòmdavalènani koruchu, mee yèdala dheerghashaamtamugalavaadai yunnaadu.
Ayite prabhuvu dinamu dòmgavachchinatlu vachchunu. aa dinamuna aakaashamulu mahaadhvanito gatimchi povunu, pamchabhootamulu mikkatamaina vemdramuto layamaipovunu, bhoomiyu daanimeedana
Ivanniyu itlu layamai povunavi ganuka, aakaashamulu ravulukòni layamaipovu nattiyu, pamchabhootamulu mahaavemdramuto karigipovu nattiyu,
Devuni dinapu raakadakòraku kanipèttuchu, daanini aashato apekshimchuchu, meeru parishuddhamaina pravartanatonu bhaktitonu èmto jaagrattagalavaarai yumdavalènu.
Ayinanu manamaayana vaagdaanamunubatti kròtta aakaashamulakòrakunu kròtta bhoomikòrakunu kanipèttu chunnaamu; vaatiyamdu neeti nivasimchunu.
Priyulaaraa, veetikòraku meeru kanipèttuvaaru ganuka shaamtamugalavaarai, aayana drrishtiki nishkalamkulu gaanu nimdaarahitulugaanu kanabadunatlu jaagratta padudi.
Mariyu mana prabhuvuyòkka deerghashaamtamu rakshanaarthamainadani yèmchukònudi. aalaagu mana priya sahodarudaina paulukooda tanaku anugrahimpabadina j~naanamu chòppuna meeku vraasi yunnaadu.

Veetini goorchi tana patrikalannitilonu bodhimchuchunnaadu; ayite vaatilo kònnisamgatulu grahimchutaku kashtamainavi. veetini vidyaaviheenulunu, asthirulainavaarunu, takkina lekhanamulanu apaarthamuchesinatlu, tama svakeeya naashanamunaku apaarthamu cheyuduru.
Priyulaaraa, meeru ee samgatulu mumdugaa tèlisikòniyunnaaru ganuka meeru neetivirodhula tappubodhavalana tòlagimpabadi, meeku kaligina sthiramanassunu vidichi padipokumda kaachu kòniyumdudi.
Mana prabhuvunu rakshakudunaina yesukreestu anugrahimchu krripayamdunu j~naanamamdunu abhi vrriddhipòmdudi. aayanaku ippudunu yugaamtadinamu varakunu mahima kalugunu gaaka. aamen‌.
Jeevavaakyamunugoorchinadi, aadinumdi edi yumdèno, memedi vimtimo, kannulaara edi choochitimo, edi nidaanimchi kanugòmtimo, maa chetulu denini taaki choochèno, adi meeku tèliyajeyuchunnaamu.
Aa jeevamu pratyakshamaayènu; tamdriyòdda umdi maaku pratyakshamaina aa nityajeevamunu memu choochi, aa jeeva munugoorchi saakshyamichchuchu, daanini meeku tèliya parachuchunnaamu.
Maatokooda meekunu sahavaasamu kalugunatlu memu choochinadaanini vininadaanini meekunu tèliyajeyuchunnaamu. mana sahavaasamaite tamdrito koodanu aayana kumaarudaina yesukreestu tokoodanu unnadi.
Mana samtoshamu paripoornamavutakai memee samgatulanu vraayuchunnaamu.
Memaayanavalana vini meeku prakatimchu vartamaana memanagaadevudu vèlugai yunnaadu; aayanayamdu cheekati èmtamaatramunu ledu.
Aayanatokooda saha vaasamugalavaaramani chèppukòni cheekatilo nadichinayèdala manamabaddhamaaduchu satyamunu jarigimpakumdumu.
Ayite aayana vèlugulonunna prakaaramu manamunu vèlugulo nadichinayèdala. manamu anyonyasahavaasamu galavaaramai yumdumu; appudu aayana kumaarudaina yesu raktamu prati è
Manamu paapamulenivaaramani chèppukònina yèdala, manalanu maname mosapuchchukòmdumu; mariyu manalo satya mumdadu.
Mana paapamulanu manamu òppukònina yèdala, aayana nammadaginavaadunu neetimamtudunu ganuka aayana mana paapamulanu kshamimchi samasta durneetinumdi manalanu pavitrulanugaa cheyunu.
Manamu paapamu cheyaledani chèppukòninayèdala, aayananu abaddhikunigaa cheyuvaara magudumu; mariyu aayana vaakyamu manalo umdadu.
Naa chinnapillalaaraa, meeru paapamu cheyakumdu takai yee samgatulanu meeku vraayuchunnaanu. èvadainanu paapamu chesinayèdala neetimamtudaina yesukreestu anu uttaravaadi tamdriyòdda manakunnaadu.
Aayane mana paapamulaku shaamtikaramai yunnaadu; mana paapa mulaku maatramekaadu. sarvalokamunakunu shaamtikaramai yunnaadu.
Mariyu manamaayana aaj~nalanu gaikònina yèdala, deenivalanane aayananu èrigiyunnaamani tèlisi kòmdumu.
Aayananu èrigiyunnaanani chèppukònuchu, aayana aaj~nalanu gaikònanivaadu abaddhikudu; vaanilo satyamuledu.
Aayana vaakyamu èvadu gaikònuno vaanilo devuni prema nijamugaa paripoornamaayènu;
Aayanayamdu nilichiyunnavaadanani chèppukònuvaadu aayana elaagu naduchukònèno aalaage taanunu naduchukòna baddhudaiyunnaadu. manamaayanayamdunnaamani deenivalana tèlisikònuchunnaamu.
Priyulaaraa, mòdatanumdi meekunna poorvapu aaj~nanegaani kròtta aaj~nanu nenu meeku vraayutaledu; ee poorvapu aaj~na meeru vinina vaakyame.
Mariyu kròtta aaj~nanu meeku vraayuchunnaanu. cheekati gatimchu chunnadi, satyamaina vèlugu ippudu prakaashimchuchunnadi ganuka adi aayanayamdunu meeyamdunu satyame.
Vèlugulo unnaanani chèppukònuchu, tana sahodaruni dveshimchuvaadu ippativarakunu cheekatilone yunnaadu.
Tana sahodaruni premimchuvaadu vèlugulo unnavaadu; ataniyamdu abhyamtarakaaranamediyu ledu.
Tana sahodaruni dveshimchuvaadu cheekatilo umdi, cheekatilo naduchuchunnaadu; cheekati atani kannulaku grudditanamu kalugajesènu ganuka taanèkkadiki povuchunnaado ataniki tèliyadu.
Chinna pillalaaraa, aayana naamamubatti mee paapa mulu kshamimpabadinavi ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu.
Tamdrulaaraa, meeru aadinumdi yunnavaanini èrigi yunnaaru ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu. ¸°vanasthu laaraa, meeru dushtuni jayimchiyunnaaru ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu.

Chinna pillalaaraa, meeru tamdrini èrigiyunnaaru ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu. tamdrulaaraa, meeru aadinumdi yunnavaanini èrigi yunnaaru ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu. ¸°vanasthu laaraa, meeru balavamtulu, devunivaakyamu meeyamdu niluchuchunnadi; meeru dushtuni jayimchiyunnaaru ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu.
Ee lokamunainanu lokamulo unnavaatinainanu premimpakudi. èvadainanu lokamunu premimchinayèdala tamdri prema vaanilo numdadu.
Lokamulo unnadamtayu, anagaa sharee raashayu netraashayu jeevapudambamunu tamdrivalana puttinavi kaavu; avi lokasambamdhamainave.
Lokamunu daani aashayu gatimchipovuchunnavi gaani, devuni chitta munu jarigimchuvaadu niramtaramunu niluchunu.
Chinna pillalaaraa, yidi kadavari gadiya. kreestu virodhi vachchunani vimtiri gadaa ippudunu anekulaina kreestu viro dhulu bayaluderiyunnaaru; idi kadavari gadiya ani deenicheta tèlisikònuchunnaamu.

Vaaru manalonumdi bayaluvèlliri gaani vaaru mana sambamdhulu kaaru; vaaru mana sambamdhulaite manato kooda nilichiyumduru; ayite vaaramdaru mana sambamdhulu kaarani pratyaksha parachabadunatlu vaaru bayaluvèlliri.
Ayite meeru parishuddhunivalana abhishekamu pòmdinavaaru ganuka samastamunu èruguduru.
Meeru satyamèruganivaarainamduna nenu vraayaledu gaani, meeru daanini èrigiyunnamdunanu, e abaddhamunu satyasambamdhamainadi kaadani yèrigi yunnamdunanu meeku vraayuchunnaanu.
Yesu, kreestu kaadani chèppuvaadu tappa èvadabaddhikudu? tamdrini kumaaruni òppukònani veede kreestuvirodhi.
Kumaaruni òppukònani prativaadunu tamdrini amgeekarimchuvaadukaadu; kumaaruni òppukònuvaadu tamdrini amgeekarimchu vaadu.
Ayite meeru mòdatanumdi denini vimtiro adi meelo niluvaniyyudi; meeru mòdatanumdi vininadi meelo nilichinayèdala, meerukooda kumaaruniyamdunu tamdriyamdunu niluturu.
Nityajeevamu anugrahimtu nanunadiye aayana taane manaku chesina vaagdaanamu,
Mimmunu mosaparachuvaarinibatti yee samgatulu meeku vraasiyunnaanu.
Ayite aayanavalana meeru pòmdina abhishekamu meelo niluchuchunnadi ganuka èvadunu meeku bodhimpanakkaraledu; aayana ichchina abhishekamu satyame gaani abaddhamu kaadu; adi annitinigoorchi
Kaabatti chinna pillalaaraa, aayana pratyakshamagunappudu aayana raakadayamdu manamu aayana yèduta siggupadaka dhairyamu kaligiyumdunatlu meeraayana yamdu nilichiyumdudi.
Aayana neetimamtudani meerèrigi yunna yèdala neetini jarigimchu prativaadunu aayana moolamugaa puttiyunnaadani yèruguduru.
Manamu devuni pillalamani piluvabadunatlu tamdri manakètti prema nanugrahimchènò choodudi; manamu devuni pillalame.ee hetuvucheta lokamu manalanu èrugadu, ela yanagaa adi aayananu èrugaledu.

Priyulaaraa, yippudu manamu devuni pillalamai yunnaamu. manamika emavudumo adi imka pratyakshaparachabadaledu gaani aayana pratyakshamainappudu aayana yunnatlugaane aayananu chootumu ganuka aayananu poliyumdumani yèrugu dumu.
Aayanayamdu ee nireekshana pèttukònina prativaadunu aayana pavitrudai yunnattugaa tannu pavitrunigaa chesikònunu.
Paapamu cheyu prativaadunu aaj~nanu atikramimchunu; aaj~naatikramame paapamu.
Paapamulanu teesiveyutakai aayana pratyakshamaayènani meeku tèliyunu; aayanayamdu paapamemiyu ledu.
Aayanayamdu nilichiyumduvaadèvadunu paapamu cheyadu; paapamu cheyuvaadèvadunu aayananu choodanuledu èruganuledu.
Chinna pillalaaraa, yèvanini mimmunu mosaparachaneeyakudi. aayana neetimamtudaiyunnattu neetini jarigimchu prativaadunu neetimamtudu.
Apavaadi mòdata numdi paapamu cheyuchunnaadu ganuka paapamu cheyuvaadu apavaadi sambamdhi; apavaadi yòkka kriyalanu layaparachutake devuni kumaarudu pratyakshamaayènu.
Devuni moolamugaa puttina prativaanilo aayana beejamu niluchunu ganuka vaadu paapamucheyadu; vaadu devuni moolamugaa puttinavaadu ganuka paapamu cheyajaaladu.
Deeninibatti devuni pillalèvaro apavaadi pillalèvaro tetapadunu. neetini jarigimchani prativaadunu, tana sahodaruni premimpani prativaadunu devuni sambamdhulu kaaru.
Manamòkani nòkadu premimpavalènanunadi mòdatanumdi meeru vinina vartamaanamegadaa

Manamu kayeenu vamtivaaramai yumdaraadu. vaadu dushtuni sambamdhiyai tana sahodaruni champènu; vaadatanini èmduku champènu? tana kriyalu chèddaviyu tana sahodaruni kriyalu neeti galaviyunai yumdènu ganukane gadaa?
Sahodarulaaraa, lokamu mimmunu dveshimchina yèdala aashcharyapadakudi.
Manamu sahodarulanu premimchuchunnaamu ganuka maranamulonumdi jeevamuloniki daatiyunnaamani yèrugudumu. prema leni vaadu maranamamdu nilichiyunnaadu.
Tana sahodaruni dveshimchuvaadu narahamtakudu; e narahamtakuniyamdunu nityajeevamumdadani meerèruguduru.
Aayana mana nimittamu tana praanamupèttènu ganuka deenivalana prema yèttidani tèlisikònuchunnaamu. manamukooda sahodarulanimittamu mana praanamulanu pètta baddhulamai yunnaamu.
Ee lokapu jeevanopaadhigalavaadaiyumdi, tana sahodaruniki lemi kaluguta choochiyu, ataniyèdala èmtamaatramunu kanikaramu choopanivaaniyamdu devuni prema yelaagu niluchunu?
Chinna pillalaaraa, maatatonu naalukatonu kaaka kriyatonu satyamutonu premimtamu.

Imdu valana manamu satyasambamdhulamani yèrugudumu. devudu mana hrridayamukamtè adhikudai, samastamunu èrigi yunnaadu ganuka mana hrridayamu e ye vishayamulalo manayamdu doshaaropana cheyuno aa yaa visha yamulalo aayana yèduta mana hrridayamulanu sammati parachukòmdamu.
Priyulaaraa, mana hrridayamu mana yamdu doshaaropana cheyaniyèdala devuni yèduta dhairyamugalavaaramagudumu.
Mariyu manamaayana aaj~nalanu gaikònuchu aayana drrishtiki ishtamainavi cheyu chunnaamu ganuka, manamemi adiginanu adi aayanavalana manaku dòrukunu.
Aayana aaj~na yedanagaaaayana kumaarudaina yesukreestu naamamunu nammukòni, aayana manaku aaj~nanichchina prakaaramugaa òkaninòkadu premimpa valènanunadiye.
Aayana aaj~nalanu gaikònuvaadu aayana yamdu nilichiyumdunu, aayana vaaniyamdu nilichi yumdunu; aayana manayamdu nilichiyunnaadani
Aayana manakanugrahimchina aatmamoolamugaa tèlisikònu chunnaamu.
Priyulaaraa, anekulaina abaddha pravaktalu lokamu loniki bayalu vèlliyunnaaru ganuka prati aatmanu nammaka, aa yaa aatmalu devuni sambamdhamainavo kaavo pareekshimchudi.
Yesukreestu shareeradhaariyai vachchènani, ye aatma òppukònuno adi devuni sambamdhamainadi;
Ye aatma yesunu òppukònado adi devuni sambamdhamainadi kaadu; deeninibattiye devuni aatmanu meerèruguduru. kreestuvirodhi aatma vachchunani meeru vininasamgati ide; yidivarake adi lokamulo unnadi.
Chinnapillalaaraa, meeru devuni sambamdhulu; meelo unnavaadu lokamulo unnavaani kamtè gòppavaadu ganuka meeru vaarini jayimchiyunnaaru.
Vaaru loka sambamdhulu ganuka loka sambamdhulainattu maatalaaduduru, lokamu vaari maata vinunu.

Manamu devuni sambamdhulamu; devuni èriginavaadu mana maata vinunu, devuni sambamdhi kaanivaadu mana maata vinadu. imduvalana manamu satya svaroopa maina aatma yedo, bhramaparachu aatma yedo tèlisikònu chunnaamu.
Priyulaaraa, manamu òkaninòkadu premimtamu; elayanagaa prema devunimoolamugaa kaluguchunnadi; premimchu prativaadunu devuni moolamugaa puttinavaadai devuni èrugunu.
Devudu premaasvaroopi, premaleni vaadu devuni èrugadu.
Manamu aayana dvaaraa jeevimchu natlu, devudu tana adviteeya kumaaruni lokamuloniki pampènu; deenivalana devudu manayamdumchina prema pratyakshaparachabadènu.
Manamu devuni premimchitimani kaadu, taane manalanu premimchi, mana paapamulaku praayashchittamai yumdutaku tana kumaaruni pampènu; imdulo premayunnadi.
Priyulaaraa, devudu manalanu eelaagu premimpagaa manamòkaninòkadu premimpa baddhulamai yunnaamu.
E maanavudunu devuni èppudunu choochiyumda ledu; mana mòkaninòkadu premimchina yèdala devudu manayamdu nilichiyumdunu; aayana prema manayamdu sampoornamagunu.
Deenivalana manamu aayanayamdu nilichiyunnaamaniyu aayana mana yamdunnaadaniyu tèlisikònuchunnaamu; elayanagaa aayana manaku tana aatmalo paalu dayachesiyunnaadu.
Mariyu tamdri tana kumaaruni loka rakshakudugaa umdutaku pampiyumduta memu choochi, saakshyamichchu chunnaamu.
Yesu devuni kumaarudani yèvadu òppu kònuno, vaanilo devudu nilichiyunnaadu, vaadu devuniyamdunnaadu.

Manayèdala devuniki unna premanu manamèriginavaaramai daani nammukòniyunnaamu; devudu premaasvaroopiyai yunnaadu, premayamdu nilichi yumduvaadu devuniyamdu nilichiyunnaadu, devudu vaaniyamdu nilichiyunnaadu.
Teerpudinamamdu manaku dhairyamu kalugunatlu deenivalana prema manalo paripoornamu cheyabadi yunnadi; elayanagaa aayana èttivaadai yunnaado manamukooda ee lokamulo attivaaramai yunnaamu.
Premalo bhayamumdadu; amtekaadu; paripoorna prema bhayamunu vèllagòttunu; bhayamu damdanato koodinadi; bhayapaduvaadu premayamdu paripoornamu cheyabadinavaadu kaadu.
Aayane mòdata manalanu premimchènu ganuka manamu premimchuchunnaamu.
Èvadainanu nenu devuni premimchuchunnaanani chèppi, tana sahodaruni dveshimchinayèdala atadu abaddhikudagunu; taanu choochina tana sahodaruni premimpani vaadu taanu choodani devuni premimpaledu
Devuni premimchuvaadu tana sahodaruni kooda premimpavalè nanu aaj~nanu manamaayanavalana pòmdiyunnaamu.
Yese kreestayi yunnaadani nammu prativaadunu devunimoolamugaa puttiyunnaadu. puttimchinavaanini premimchu prativaadunu aayana moolamugaa puttina vaanini premimchunu.
Manamu devuni premimchuchu aayana aaj~nalanu nèraverchuvaaramaitimaa devuni pillalanu premimchuchunnaamani daanivalanane yèrugudumu.
Manamaayana aaj~nalanu gaikònutaye. devuni premimchuta; aayana aaj~nalu bhaaramainavi kaavu.
Devuni moolamugaa puttinavaaramdarunu lokamunu jayimchuduru; lokamunu jayimchina vijayamu mana vishvaasame
Yesu devuni kumaarudani nammu vaadu tappa lokamunu jayimchuvaadu mari èvadu?
Neelladvaaraanu raktamudvaaraanu vachchina vaadu eeyane, anagaa yesukreeste. eeyana neellato maatramegaaka neellatonu raktamutonu vachchènu. aatma satyamu ganuka saakshyamichchuvaadu aatmaye.
Saakshya michchuvaaru mugguru, anagaa aatmayu, neellunu,raktamunu, ee mugguru ekeebhavimchi yunnaaru.
Manamu manushyula saakshyamu amgeekarimchuchunnaamu gadaa! devuni saakshyamu mari balamainadi. devuni saakshyamu aayana tana kumaaruni goorchi yichchinade.

Devuni kumaaruniyamdu vishvaasa mumchuvaadu tanalone yee saakshyamu kaligiyunnaadu; devuni nammanivaadu aayana tana kumaarunigoorchi yichchina saakshyamunu nammaledu ganuka atadu devuni abaddhikunigaa chesinavaade.
Aa saakshyamemanagaadevudu manaku nitya jeevamunu dayachesènu; ee jeevamu aayana kumaaruni yamdunnadi.
Devuni kumaaruni amgeekarimchuvaadu jeevamu galavaadu; devuni kumaaruni amgeekarimpani vaadu jeevamuleni vaade.
Devuni kumaaruni naamamamdu vishvaasamumchu meeru nityajeevamugalavaarani tèlisikònunatlu nenu ee samgatulanu meeku vraayuchunnaanu.
Aayananubatti manaku kaligina dhairyamedanagaa, aayana chittaanusaaramugaa mana medi adiginanu aayana mana manavi aalakimchunanunadiye.
Manamemi adiginanu aayana mana manavi aalamkimchunani mana mèriginayèdala manamaayananu vedukòninavi manaku kaligina vani yèrugudumu.

Tana sahodarudu maranakaramu kaani paapamu cheyagaa èvadainanu choochinayèdala atadu vedu kònunu; atanibatti devudu maranakaramukaani paapamu chesinavaariki jeevamu dayacheyunu. maranakaramaina paapamu kaladu. attidaanigoorchi vedukònavalènani nenu chèpputaledu.
Sakala durneetiyu paapamu; ayite maranakaramu kaani paapamu kaladu.
Devuni moolamugaa puttiyunna vaadèvadunu paapamu cheyadani yèrugudumu. devunimoolamugaa puttinavaadu tannu bhadramuchesikònunu ganuka dushtudu vaani muttadu.
Manamu devuni sambamdhulamaniyu,lokamamtayu dushtuni yamdunnadaniyu èrugudumu.
Manamu satyavamtudaina vaanini èrugavalènani devuni kumaarudu vachchimanaku viveka manugrahimchiyunnaadani yèrugudumu.
Manamu devuni kumaarudaina yesukreestunamdunna vaaramai satya vamtuni yamdunnaamu. aayane nijamaina devudunu nityajeevamunai yunnaadu.
Chinna pillalaaraa, vigrahamula joliki pokumda jaagrattagaa umdudi.
Pèddanaina nenu, erparachabadinadaina ammagaarikini aamè pillalakunu shubhamani chèppi vraayunadi.
Nenunu, nenu maatrame gaaka satyamu èriginavaaramdarunu, manalo niluchuchu manato èllappudu umdu satyamunubatti mimmunu nijamugaa premimchuchunnaamu.
Satyapremalu manayamdumdagaa tamdriyaina devuni yòddanumdiyu, tamdriyòkka kumaarudagu yesukreestunòddanumdiyu krripayu kanikaramunu samaadhaanamunu manaku todagunu.
Tamdrivalana manamu aaj~nanu pòmdinaprakaaramu nee pillalalo kòmdaru satyamunu anusarimchi1 naduchuchumduta kanugòni bahugaa samtoshimchuchunnaanu.
Kaagaa ammaa, kròtta aaj~na neeku vraasinattu kaadu gaani mòdatanumdi manaku kaligina aaj~nane vraayuchu, manamu òkari nòkaramu premimpavalènani ninnu vedukònuchunnaanu.
Manamaayana aaj~nalaprakaaramu naduchutaye prema; meeru mòdatanumdi vinina prakaaramu premalo naduchukònavalènu anunadiye aa aaj~na.
Yesukreestu shareeradhaariyai vachchènani yòppukònani vamchakulu anekulu lokamulo bayaluderi yunnaaru.
Attivaade vamchakudunu kreestu virodhiyunai yunnaadu. memu mee madhyanu nèraverchina kaaryamulanu chèdagòttukònaka meeru poorna phalamu pòmdunatlu jaagrattagaa choochukònudi.
Kreestubodha yamdu nilichiyumdaka daanini vidichi mumdunakusaagu prativaadunu devuni amgeekarimpanivaadu; aa bodhayamdu nilichiyumduvaadu tamdrini kumaaruni amgeekarimchu vaadu.
Èvadainanu ee bodhanu teka mee yòddaku vachchinayèdala vaanini mee yimta cherchukònavaddu; shubhamani vaanito chèppanu vaddu.
Shubhamani vaanito chèppuvaadu vaani dushtakriyalalo paalivaadagunu.
Aneka samgatulu meeku vraayavalasiyumdiyu siraatonu kaagitamutonu vraaya manassuleka mee samtoshamu paripoornamavunatlu mimmunu kalisikòni mukhaa mukhigaa maatalaada nireekshimchucha
Erparachabadina nee sahodari pillalu neeku vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaaru.
Pèddanaina nenu satyamunubatti premimchu priyudaina gaayunaku shubhamani chèppi vraayunadi.
Priyudaa, nee aatma vardhilluchunna prakaaramu neevu anni vishayamulalonu vardhilluchu saukhyamugaa umdavalènani praarthimchuchunnaanu.
Neevu satyamunu anusarimchi naduchukònuchunnaavu ganuka sahodarulu vachchi nee satyapravartananugoorchi saakshyamu chèppagaa vini bahugaa samtoshimchitini.
Naa pillalu satyamunu anusarimchi naduchukònuchunnaarani vinutakamtè naaku èkkuvaina samtoshamu ledu.
Priyudaa, vaaru paradeshulainanu sahodarulugaa unnavaariki neevu chesinadèlla vishvaasiki taginattugaa cheyu chunnaavu.
Vaaru nee premanugoorchi samghamu èduta saakshyamichchiri. vaaru anyajanulavalana emiyu teesi
Kònaka aayana naamamu nimittamu bayalu deriri ganuka devuniki taginattugaa neevu vaarini saaganampina yèdala neeku yuktamugaa umdunu.
Manamu satyamunaku sahaaya kulamavunattu2 attivaariki upakaaramucheya baddhulamai yunnaamu.
Nenu samghamunaku òka samgati vraasitini. ayite vaarilo pradhaanatvamu koruchunna diyòtrèphe mammunu amgeekarimchutaledu.

Vaadu mammunu goorchi chèddamaatalu vadaruchu, adi chaalanattugaa, sahodarulanu taane cherchu kònaka, vaarini cherchukòna manassugalavaarini kooda aatamka parachuchu samghamulonumdi vaarini vèliveyuchunnaadu; amducheta nenu vachchinappudu vaadu cheyuchunna kriya lanu j~naapakamu chesikòmdunu.
Priyudaa, chèdukaarya munu kaaka mamchikaaryamu nanusarimchi naduchukònumu. melu cheyuvaadu devuni sambamdhi, keeducheyuvaadu devuni choochinavaadukaadu.
Demetriyu amdarivalananu satyamuvalananu mamchi saakshyamu pòmdinavaadu, memu kooda ataniki saakshyamichchuchunnaamu; maa saakshyamu satyamainadani nee vèruguduvu.
Aneka samgatulu neeku vraayavalasiyunnadi gaani siraatonu kalamutonu neeku vraaya naakishtamu ledu;

Sheeghramugaa ninnu chooda nireekshimchuchunnaanu; appudu mukhaamukhigaa maatalaadu kònèdamu. neeku samaadhaanamu kalugunu gaaka. mana snehitulu neeku vamdanamulu chèppuchunnaaru. nee yòddanunna snehitulaku peru peru varusanu vamdanamulu chèppumu.
Yesukreestu daasudunu, yaakobu sahodarudu naina yoodaa, tamdriyaina devuniyamdu premimpabadi, yesukreestunamdu bhadramu cheyabadi piluvabadinavaariki shubhamani chèppi vraayunadi.
Meeku kanikaramunu samaadhaanamunu premayu vistarimchunu gaaka.

Priyulaaraa, manakamdariki kaligèdu rakshananugoorchi meeku vraayavalènani visheshaasaktigalavaadanai prayatnapadu chumdagaa, parishuddhulaku òkkasaare appagimpabadina bodha nimittamu meeru poraadavalènani mimmunu vedukònuchu meeku vraayavalasivachchènu.

Elayanagaa kòmdaru rahasyamugaa jòrabadiyunnaaru. vaaru bhaktiheenulai mana devuni krripanu kaamaaturatvamunaku durviniyoga parachuchu, mana adviteeyanaadhudunu prabhuvunaina yesu kreestunu visarjimchuchunnaaru; ee teerpupòmdutaku vaaru poorvamamde soochimpabadinavaaru.

Ee samgatulanniyu meeru mumdatane yèrigi yunnanu, nenu meeku j~naapakamu cheyagoruchunna demanagaa, prabhuvu aiguptulonumdi prajalanu rakshimchi nanu, vaarilo nammakapoyinavaarini taruvaata naashanamu chesènu.
Mariyu tama pradhaanatvamunu nilupukònaka, tama nivaasasthalamunu vidichina devadootalanu, mahaadinamuna jarugu teerpuvaraku katikacheekatilo nityapaashamulato aayana bamdhimchi bhadramu chesènu.

Aa prakaaramugaane sòdòma gòmòrraalunu vaati chuttupatlanunna pattana mulunu veerivalène vyabhichaaramu cheyuchu, parashareeraanu saarulainamduna nityaagnidamdana anubhavimchuchu drrishtaamta mugaa umchabadènu.
Atuvalène veerunu kalalu kanuchu, shareeramunu apavitraparachukònuchu, prabhutvamunu niraaka rimchuchu, mahaatmulanu dooshimchuchu unnaaru.
Ayite pradhaanadootayaina mikhaayelu apavaadito vaadimchuchu mosheyòkka shareeramunugoorchi tarkimchi nappudu, dooshimchi teerputeercha tègimpakaprabhuvu ninnu gaddimchunu gaaka anènu.
Veeraite taamu grahimpani vishayamulanugoorchi dooshimchuvaarai, vivekashoonyamulagu mrrigamulavalè vetini svaabhaavikamugaa èruguduro vaativalana tammunutaamu naashanamuchesikònuchunnaaru.
Ayyovaariki shrama. vaaru kayeenu nadichina maargamuna nadichiri, bahumaanamu pòmdavalènani bilaamu nadichina tapputrovalo aaturamugaa parugèttiri, korahu chesinattu tiraskaaramu chesi na

Veeru nirbhayamugaa meeto subhojanamu cheyuchu, tammunutaamu nirbhaya mugaa poshimchukònuchu, mee premavimdulalo dòmga mèttalugaa unnaaru. veeru gaalicheta itu atu kòttukònipovu nirjala meghamulugaanu, kaayalu raali phalamulu leka, rèmdu maarulu chachchi vellato pèllagimpa badina chètlugaanu,

Tama avamaanamanu nurugu vèlla grakkuvaarai, samudramuyòkka prachamdamaina alalugaanu, maargamu tappitirugu chukkalugaanu unnaaru; vaarikòraku gaadhaamdhakaaramu niramtaramu bhadramu cheyabadi yunnadi.

Aadaamu mòdalukòni yedava vaadaina hanokukooda veerinigoorchi pravachimchi yitlanènu idigo amdarikini teerpu teerchutakunu, vaarilo bhakti heenulamdarunu bhaktiheenamugaa chesina vaari bhaktiheena kriyalannitini goorchiyu,
Bhaktiheenulaina paapulu tanaku virodhamugaa chèppina kathinamaina maatalannitinigoorchiyu vaarini òppimchutakunu, prabhuvu tana vevela parishuddhula parivaaramuto vachchènu.
Vaaru tama duraashalachòppuna naduchuchu,laabhamunimittamu manushyulanu kòniyaaduchu,6 sanuguvaarunu tama gatinigoorchi nimdimchuvaarunai yunnaaru; vaari noru dambamaina maatalu palukunu.
Ayite priyulaaraa, amtyakaalamunamdu tama bhaktiheenamaina duraashalachòppuna naduchu parihaasakulum durani
Mana prabhuvaina yesukreestu apòstalulu poorva mamdu meeto chèppina maatalanu j~naapakamu chesikònudi.
Attivaaru prakrriti sambamdhulunu aatma lenivaarunaiyumdi bhedamulu kalugajeyuchunnaaru.
Priyulaaraa, meeru vishvasimchu atiparishuddamainadaanimeeda mimmunu meeru kattukònuchu, parishuddhaatmalo praarthanacheyuchu,
Nitya jeevaarthamaina mana prabhuvagu yesukreestu kanikaramukòraku kanipèttuchu, devuni premalo niluchunatlu kaachukòni yumdudi.
Samdehapaduvaarimeeda kanikaramu choopudi.
Agnilonumdi laaginattu kòmdarini rakshimchudi, shareera sambamdhamaina vaari apavitra pravartanaku e maatramu nòppu kònaka daanini asahyimchukònuchu bhayamuto kòmdarini karunimchudi.
Tòtrillakumda mimmunu kaapaadutakunu, tana mahima yèduta aanamdamuto mimmunu nirdoshulanugaa niluva bèttutakunu, shaktigala mana rakshakudaina adviteeya devuniki,
Mana prabhuvaina yesu kreestudvaaraa, mahimayu mahaatmya munu aadhipatyamunu adhikaaramunu yugamulaku poorva munu ippudunu sarvayugamulunu kalugunu gaaka.

Yesukreestu tana daasulaku kanuparachutaku devu daayanaku anugrahimchina pratyakshata. ee samgatulu tvaralo sambhavimpanaiyunnavi; aayana tana doota dvaaraa vartamaanamu pampi tana daasudaina yohaanuku vaatini soochimchènu.
Atadu devuni vaakyamunugoorchiyu yesukreestu saakshyamunugoorchiyu taanu choochinamta mattuku3 saakshyamichchènu.
Samayamu sameepimchinadi ganuka ee pravachanavaakyamulu chaduvuvaadunu, vaatini vini yimdulo vraayabadina samgatulanu gaikònuvaarunu dhanyulu.
Yohaanu aasiyalo unna yedu samghamulaku shubhamani chèppi vraayunadi. vartamaana bhootabhavishya tkaalamulalo unnavaaninumdiyu, aayana simhaa sanamu èdutanunna yedu aatmalanumdiyu,
Nammakamaina saakshiyu, mrritulalonumdi aadi sambhootudugaa lechina vaadunu, bhoopatulaku adhipatiyunaina yesukreestu numdiyu, krripaasamaadhaanamulu meeku kalugunugaaka.

Manalanu premimchuchu tana raktamuvalana mana paapamulanumdi manalanu vidipimchinavaaniki mahimayu prabhaava munu yugayugamulu kalugunugaaka, aamen‌. aayana manalanu tana tamdriyagu devuniki òka raajyamugaanu yaajakulanugaanu jesènu.
Idigo aayana meghaa roodhudai vachchuchunnaadu; prati netramu aayananu choochunu, aayananu pòdichinavaarunu choochèdaru; bhoojanulamdaru aayananu choochi ròmmu kòttukòmduru; avunu aamen‌.
Alphaayu omègayu nene5. vartamaana bhoota bhavishyatkaalamulalo umduvaadanu nene ani sarvaadhi kaariyu devudunagu prabhuvu sèlavichchuchunnaadu.

Mee sahodarudanu, yesunubatti kalugu shrama lonu raajyamulonu sahanamulonu paalivaadanunaina yohaananu nenu devuni vaakyamu nimittamunu yesunu goorchina saakshyamu nimittamunu patmaasu dveepamuna paravaasinaitini.
Prabhuvu dinamamdu aatma vashudanai yumdagaa booradhvanivamti gòppasvaramu
