Neevu choochu chunnadi pustakamulo vraasi, èphèsu, smurna, pèrgamu, tuyataira, saardees‌, philadèlphiya, lavòdikaya anu edu samghamulaku pampumani chèpputa naavènuka vimtini.
Idi vinagaa naato maatalaaduchunna svaramemito ani chooda tirigitini.

Tirugagaa edu suvarna deepastambhamulanu, aa deepastambhamulamadhyanu manushyakumaarunipolina yòkanini choochitini. aayana tana paadamulamattunaku diguchunna vastramu dharimchukòni ròmmunaku bamgaarudatti kattukòniyumdènu.
Aayana talayu talavèmdrukalunu tèllani unnini polinavai himamamta dhavalamugaa umdènu. aayana netramulu agni jvaalavalè umdènu;
Aayana paadamulu kòlimilo putamu veyabadi mèrayu chunna aparamjito samaanamai yumdènu; aayana kamtha svaramu vistaara jalapravaahamula dhvanivalè umdènu.

Aayana tana kudicheta edu nakshatramulu pattukòni yumdènu; aayana notinumdi rèmdamchulugala vaadiyaina khadgamòkati bayalu vèdaluchumdènu; aayana mukhamu mahaa tejassuto prakaashimchuchunna sooryunivalè umdènu.
Nenaaya nanu choodagaane chachchinavaanivalè aayana paadamula yòdda paditini. aayana tana kudichetini naameeda umchi naato itlanènubhayapadakumu;

Nenu mòdativaadanu kadapativaadanu jeevimchuvaadanu; mrritudanaitini gaani idigo yugayugamulu sajeevudanai yunnaanu. mariyu maranamuyòkkayu paataala lokamu yòkkayu taalapuchèvulu naa svaadheenamulo unnavi.
Kaagaa neevu choochinavaatini, unnavaatini, veetivèmta kalugabovuvaatini,
Anagaa naa kudichetilo neevu choochina yedu nakshatramulanu goorchina marmamunu, aa yedu suvarna deepastambhamula samgatiyu vraayumu. aa yedu nakshatramulu edu samghamulaku doota
Èphèsulo unna samghapu dootaku eelaagu vraayumu edu nakshatramulu tana kudicheta pattukòni yedu deepastambhamulamadhya samcharimchuvaadu chèppu samgatu levanagaa
Nee kriyalanu nee kashtamunu nee sahanamunu nenèrugudunu; neevu dushtulanu sahimpalevaniyu, apò stalulu kaakaye taamu apòstalulamani chèppukònu vaarini pareekshimchi vaaru abaddhiku
Neevu sahanamu kaligi naa naamamu nimittamu bhaaramu bharimchi alayaledaniyu nenèrugudunu.
Ayinanu mòdata neekumdina premanu neevu vadilitivani nenu neemeeda tappu òkati mopavalasiyunnadi.

Neevu e sthitilonumdi paditivo adi j~naapakamu chesikòni maaru manassupòmdi aa mòdati kriyalanu cheyumu. atluchesi neevu maaru manassu pòmditene sari; leniyèdala nenu neeyòddaku vachchi nee deepastambhamunu daani chotanumdi teesivetunu.
Ayite ee yòkati neelo unnadi, neekòlaayitula kriyalu neevu dveshimchuchunnaavu; nenukooda veetini dveshimchuchunnaanu.
Chèvigalavaadu aatma samghamulato chèppuchunnamaata vinunugaaka. jayimchu vaaniki devuni paradaisulo unna jeevavrrikshaphalamulu bhujimpa nittunu.
Smurnalounna samghapudootaku eelaagu vraayumumòdativaadunu kadapativaadunai yumdi, mrritudai marala bradikinavaadu chèppu samgatulevanagaa
Nee shramanu daridratanu nenèrugudunu, ayinanu neevu dhanavamtudave; taamu yoodulamani chèppukònuchu, yoodulu kaaka saataanu samaajapu vaarivalana neeku kalugu dooshana ne nèrugu
Idigo meeru shodhimpabadunatlu apavaadi meelo kòmdarini chèralo veyimpabovuchunnaadu; padi dinamulu shrama kalugunu; maranamuvaraku nammakamugaa umdumu. nenu neeku jeevakireeta michchèdanu.
Samghamulato aatmachèppuchunna maata chèvigalavaadu vinunu gaaka.jayim chuvaadu rèmdava maranamuvalana e haaniyuchèmdadu.
Pèrgamulounna samghapu dootaku eelaagu vraayumu vaadiyaina rèmdamchulugala khadgamugalavaadu chèppu samgatulevanagaa
Saataanu simhaasanamunna sthalamulo neevu kaapuramunnaavani nenèrugudunu. mariyu saataanu kaapuramunna aa sthalamulo, naayamdu vishvaasiyaiyumdi nannugoorchi saakshiyaina amtipayanuvaada
Ayinanu nenu neemeeda kònni tappidamulu mopavalasiyunnadi. avevanagaa, vigrahamulaku baliyichchina vaatini tinunatlunu, jaaratvamu cheyunatlunu, ishraayeleeyulaku uri yòddumani baalaaka
Atuvalène neekòlaayitula bodha nanusarimchu vaarunu neelo unnaaru.
Kaavuna maarumanassu pòmdumu; leniyèdala nenu neeyòddaku tvaragaa vachchi naa notanumdi vachchu khadgamucheta veerito yuddhamuchesèdanu.

Samgha mulato aatma chèppuchunna maata chèvigalavaadu vinunu gaaka. jayimchuvaaniki marugaiyunna mannaanu bhujimpa nittunu. mariyu ataniki tèllaraatinittunu; aa raatimeeda chèkkabadina yòka kròttaperumdunu; pòmdina vaanike gaani adi mari yèvanikini tèliyadu.
Tuyatairalo unna samghapu dootaku eelaagu vraayumu agnijvaalavamti kannulunu aparamjinipolina paada mulunugala devuni kumaarudu chèppu samgatulevanagaa
Nee kriyalanu, nee premanu, nee vishvaasamunu, nee paricharyanu, nee sahanamunu nenèrugudunu; nee mòdati kriyala kanna nee kadapati kriyalu mariyèkkuvainavani yèrugu dunu.
Ayinanu neemeeda tappu òkati nenu mopavalasi yunnadi; emanagaa, taanu pravaktrinani chèppukònuchunna yèjèbèlanu streeni nee vumdanichchuchunnaavu. jaaratvamu cheyutakunu, vigrahamulaka
Maarumanassu pòmdutaku nenu daaniki samayamichchitinigaani adi tana jaaratvamu vidichipètti maarumanassu pòmdanòlladu.
Idigo nenu daanini mamchamu pattimchi daanitokooda vyabhicharimchu vaaru daani3 kriyalavishayamai maarumanassu pòmditene gaani vaarini bahu shramalapaalu chetunu,

Daani pillalanu nishchayamugaa champèdanu. amduvalana amtarimdriyamulanu hrridayamulanu pareekshimchuvaadanu nene ani samghamu lanniyu tèlisikònunu. mariyu meelo prativaaniki vaani vaani kriyala chòppuna pratiphalamu ichchèdanu.
Ayite tuyatairalo kadamavaaraina meeto, anagaa ee bodhanu amgeekarimpaka saataanuyòkka goodhamaina samga tulanu èrugamani chèppukònuvaaramdarito nenu chèppuchunnademanagaa meepaini va
Nenu vachchuvaraku meeku kaligiyunnadaanini gattigaa pattu kònudi.
Nenu naa tamdrivalana adhikaaramu pòmdinattu jayimchuchu, amtamuvaraku naa kriyalu jaagrattagaa cheyuvaaniki janulameeda adhikaaramu ichchèdanu.
Atadu inupadamdamuto vaarini elunu; vaaru kummaravaani paatralavalè pagulagòttabaduduru;
Mariyu ataniki vekuva chukkanu ichchèdanu.
Samghamulato aatma chèppuchunna maata chèvi galavaadu vinunugaaka.

Saardees‌lo unna samghapu dootaku eelaagu vraayumu edu nakshatramulunu devuni yedaatmalunu galavaadu chèppu samgatulevanagaanee kriyalanu nenèrugudunu. emanagaa, jeevimchuchunnaavanna perumaatramunnadi gaani neevu mrritudave
Nee kriyalu naa devuni yèduta sampoornamainavigaa naaku kanabadaledu ganuka jaagarookudavai, chaavanaiyunna migilinavaatini balaparachumu.

Neevelaagu upadeshamu pòmditivo yelaagu vimtivo j~naapakamu chesikòni daanini gaikònuchu maarumanassu pòmdumu. neevu jaagarookudavai yumdaniyèdala nenu dòmgavalè vachchèdanu; e gadiyanu nee meediki vachchèdano neeku tèliyane tèliyadu.
Ayite tama vastramulanu apavitraparachukònani kòmdaru saardees‌lo neeyòddaunnaaru. vaaru arhulu ganuka tèllani vastramulu dharimchukòni naatokooda samcharimchèdaru.
Jayimchuvaadu aalaaguna tèllani vastramulu dharimchukònunu; jeeva gramthamulonumdi atani perèmtamaatramunu tudupu pèttaka, naatamdri yèdutanu aayana dootala yèdutanu atani peru òppukòmdunu.
Samghamulato aatma chèppu chunna maata chèvigalavaadu vinunugaaka.

Philadèlphiyalo unna samghapu dootaku eelaagu vraayumu daaveedu taalapuchèvi kaligi, yèvadunu veya lekumda teeyuvaadunu, èvadunu teeyalekumda veyuvaadunaina satyasvaroopiyagu parishuddhudu chèppusamgatu levanagaa
Nee kriyalanu nenèrugudunu; neekunna shakti kòmchèmai yumdinanu neevu naa vaakyamunu gaikòni naa naamamu èrugananaledu. idigo talupu neeyèduta teesiyumchi yunnaanu; daanini èvadunu

Yoodulu kaakaye taamu yoodulamani abaddhamaadu saataanu samaajapu vaarini rappimchèdanu; vaaru vachchi nee paadamula yèduta padi namaskaaramuchesi, idigo, nenu ninnu premimchitinani tèlisikònunatlu chesèdanu.
Neevu naa orpu vishayamaina vaakyamunu gaikòmtivi ganuka bhoo nivaa sulanu shodhimchutaku lokamamtatimeediki raabovu shodhana kaalamulo nenunu ninnu kaapaadèdanu.
Nenu tvaragaa vachchuchunnaanu; èvadunu nee kireetamu napaharimpakumdunatlu neeku kaliginadaanini gattigaa pattukònumu.

Jayimchu vaanini naa devuni aalayamulo òka stambhamugaa chesèdanu; amdulonumdi vaadu ikameedata ènnatikini vèlu palikipodu. mariyu naa devuni perunu, paralokamulo naa devuni yòddanumdi digi vachchuchunna nootanamaina yèrooshalemanu naa devuni pattanapu perunu, naa kròtta perunu vaani meeda vraasèdanu.
Samghamulato aatma chèppuchunna maata chèvigalavaadu vinunugaaka.
Lavòdikayalo unna samghapu dootaku eelaagu vraayumu aamen‌ anuvaadunu nammakamaina satyasaakshiyu devuni srrishtiki aadiyunainavaadu chèppu samgatulevanagaa
Nee kriyalanu nenèrugudunu, neevu challagaanainanu vèchchagaanainanu levu; neevu challagaanainanu vèchchagaanainanu umdina melu.
Neevu vèchchagaanainanu challagaanainanu umdaka, nulivèchchanagaa unnaavu ganuka nenu ninnu naa notanumdi umimaveya nuddeshimchuchunnaanu.

Neevu daurbhaagyudavunu dikkumaalina vaadavunu daridrudavunu gruddivaadavunu digambarudavunai yunnaavani yèrugakanenu dhanavamtudanu, dhanavrriddhi chesiyunnaanu, naakemiyu kòduvaledani chèppukònuchunnaavu.

Neevu dhanavrriddhi chesi kònunatlu agnilo putamuveyabadina bamgaaramunu, nee disamòla siggu kanabadakumdunatlu dharimchukònutaku tèllani vastramulanu, neeku drrishtikalugunatlu nee kannu laku kaatukanu naayòdda kònumani neeku buddhi chèppuchunnaanu.
Nenu premimchuvaarinamdarini gaddimchi shikshimchuchunnaanu ganuka neevu aasakti kaligi maaru manassu pòmdumu.
Idigo nenu talupunòdda niluchumdi tattuchunnaanu. èvadainanu naa svaramu vini taluputeesina yèdala, nenu ataniyòddaku vachchi atanito nenunu, naatokooda atadunu bhojanamu cheyudumu.
Nenu jayimchi naa tamdritokooda aayana simhaasanamunamdu koorchumdi yunna prakaaramu jayimchuvaanini naatokooda naa simhaasanamunamdu koorchumdanichchèdanu.
Samghamulato aatma chèppuchunna maata chèvigalavaadu vinunugaaka.

Ee samgatulu jarigina taruvaata nenu choodagaa, adigo paralokamamdu òka talupu tèruvabadiyumdènu. mariyu nenu mòdata vinina svaramu booradhvanivalè naato maatalaadagaa vimtini. aa maatalaadinavaaduikkadiki èkkirammu; ikameedata jarugavalasinavaatini neeku kanuparachèdananènu
Vèmtane nenu aatmavashudanaitini. adigo paralokamamdu òka simhaasanamu veyabadi yumdènu. simhaasanamunamdu òkadu aaseesudai yumdènu,
Aaseenudainavaadu, drrishtiki sooryakaamta padmaraagamulanu polinavaadu; marakatamuvalè prakaashimchu imdradhanussu simhaasanamunu aavarimchiyumdènu.

Simhaasanamuchuttu iruvadi naalugu simhaasanamulumdènu, ee simhaasanamulamdu iruvadinaluguru pèddalu tèllani vastramulu dharimchukòni, tama talalameeda suvarna kireetamulu pèttukònnavaarai koorchumdiri.
Aa simhaasanamulo numdi mèrupulunu dhvanulunu urumulunu bayalu deruchunnavi. mariyu aa simhaasanamu èduta edu deepamulu prajvalimchuchunnavi; avi devuni yedu aatmalu.
Mariyu aa simhaasanamu èduta sphatikamunu polina gaajuvamti samudramunnattumdènu. aa simhaasana munaku madhyanu simhaa sanamu chuttunu, mumdu vènuka kannulatonimdina naalugu jeevulumdènu.
Mòdati jeevi simhamuvamtidi; rèmdava jeevi doodavamtidi;moodava jeevi manushyuni mukhamu vamti mukhamugaladi; naalugava jeevi yèguruchunna pakshiraajuvamtidi.

Ee naalugu jeevulalo prati jeeviki aaresi rèkkalumdènu, avi chuttunu rèkkala lopatanu kannulato nimdiyunnavi. avibhootavartamaana bhavishyatkaalamulalo umdu sarvaadhikaariyu devudunagu prabhuvu parishuddhudu, parishuddhudu, parishuddhudu, ani maanaka raatrimbagallu chèppuchumdunu.
Aa simhaasanamu namdu aaseenudaiyumdi yugayugamulu jeevimchuchunna vaaniki mahimayu ghanatayu krritaj~nataastutulunu kalu gunugaakani aa jeevulu keertimchuchumdagaa
Aa yiruvadi naluguru pèddalu simhaasanamunamdu aaseenudai yumduvaani yèduta saagilapadi, yugayugamulu jeevimchuchunna vaaniki namaskaaramu cheyuchu
Prabhuvaa, maa devaa, neevu samastamunu srrishtimchitivi; nee chittamunubatti avi yumdènu; daanini battiye srrishtimpabadènu ganuka neeve mahima ghanata prabhaavamulu pòmda narhudavani chè
Mariyu lopatanu vèlupatanu vraatakaligi, yedu mudralu gattigaa vesiyunna yòka gramthamu simhaa sanamunamdu aaseesudaiyumduvaani kudicheta choochitini.
Mariyu daani mudralu teesi aa gramthamu vipputaku yogyudainavaadèvadani balishthudaina yòka devadoota bigga ragaa prachurimpagaa choochitini.
Ayite paralokamamdu gaani bhoomimeedagaani bhoomikrimdagaani aa gramthamu vipputakainanu choochutakainanu èvanikini shakti lekapoyènu.
Aa gramthamu vipputakainanu choochutakainanu yogyudèvadunu kanabadanamduna nenu bahugaa edchuchumdagaa
Aa pèddalalo òkadueduvakumu; idigo daaveeduku chiguraina yoodaa gotrapu simhamu edu mudralanu teesi aa gramthamunu vipputakai jayamupòmdènani naato chèppènu.

Mariyu simhaasanamunakunu aa naalugu jeevula kunu pèddalakunu madhyanu, vadhimpabadinatlumdina gòrrapilla nilichiyumduta choochitini. aa gòrrapillaku edu kòmmulunu edu kannulu numdènu. aa kannulu bhoomi yamdamtatiki pampabadina devuni yedu aatmalu.
Aayana vachchi simhaasanamunamdu aaseenudaiyumduvaani kudichetilo numdi aa gramthamunu teesikònènu.

Aayana daanini teesi kòninappudu aa naalugujeevulunu, veenalanu, dhoopa dravya mulato nimdina suvarnapaatralanu pattukòniyunna aa yiruvadinaluguru pèddalunu, aa gòrrapilla yèduta saagila padiri. ee paatralu parishuddhula praarthanalu.

Aa pèddaluneevu aa gramthamunu teesikòni daani mudralanu vipputaku yogyudavu, neevu vadhimpabadinavaadavai nee raktamichchi, prati vamshamulonu, aayaa bhaashalu maatalaaduvaarilonu, prati prajalonu, prati janamulonu, devunikòraku manushyulanu kòni,
Maa devuniki vaarini òka raajyamugaanu yaajakulanugaanu chesitivi; ganuka vaaru bhoolokamamdu eludurani kròttapaata paaduduru.
Mariyu nenu choodagaa simhaasanamunu jeevulanu, pèddalanu aavarimchi yunna aneka dootala svaramu vinabadènu, vaari lèkka kotlakòladigaa umdènu.
Vaaruvadhimpabadina gòrrapilla, shaktiyu aishvaryamunu j~naanamunu balamunu ghanatayu mahimayu stotramunu pòmdanarhudani gòppa svaramuto chèppuchumdiri.
Amtata paralokamamdunu bhoolokamamdunu bhoomi krimdanu samudramulonu unna prati srrishtamu, anagaa vaatilonunna sarvamunu simhaasanaaseenudai yunnavaanikini gòrrapillakunu stotra
Aa naalugu jeevuluaamen‌ ani chèppagaa aa pèddalu saagilapadi namaskaaramu chesiri.
Aa gòrrapilla aa yedu mudralalo mòdatidaanini vippinappudu nenu choodagaa aa naalugu jeevulalo òkatirammu ani3 urumuvamti svaramuto chèpputa vimtini.
Mariyu nenu choodagaa, idigo òka tèllanigurramu kanabadènu; daanimeeda òkadu villupattukòni koorchumdi yumdènu. ataniki òka kireeta miyyabadènu; atadu jayimchuchu, jayimchutaku bayalu vèllènu.
Aayana rèmdava mudranu vippinappudurammu ani rèmdava jeevi chèpputa vimtini
Appudu èrranidaina veròka gurramu bayaluvèllènu; manushyulu òkani òkadu champu kònunatlu bhoolokamulo samaadhaanamu lekumda cheyutaku ee gurramumeeda koorchunnavaaniki adhikaara mi¸
Aayana moodava mudranu vippinappudu rammu ani moodava jeevi chèpputa vimtini. nenu choodagaa, idigo òka nallani gurramu kanabadènu; daanimeeda òkadu traasucheta pattukòni koorchumdi yumdènu.
Mariyu denaara munaku6 òka seru godhumalaniyu, denaaramunaku moodu serla yavalaniyu, noonènu draakshaarasamunu paaducheya vaddaniyu, aa naalugu jeevulamadhya òka svaramu palikinattu naaku vinabadènu.
Aayana naalugava mudranu vippinappudurammu ani naalugava jeevi chèpputa vimtini.
Appudu nenu choodagaa, idigo paamdura varnamugala òka gurramu kanabadènu; daani meeda koorchunnavaani peru mrrityuvu. paataala lokamu vaanini vèmbadimchènu. khadgamuvalananu karavuvalananu va
Aayana ayidava mudranu vippinappudu, devuni vaakyamu nimittamunu, taamu ichchina saakshyamu nimittamunu vadhimpabadinavaari aatmalanu balipeethamu krimda choochi tini.
Vaarunaathaa, satyasvaroopee, parishuddhudaa, yèmdaaka teerpu teerchakayu, maa raktamu nimittamu bhooni vaasulaku pratidamdana cheyakayu umduvani biggaragaa kekaluvesiri.

Tèllani vastramu vaarilo prativaani kiyya badènu; mariyu--vaarivalène champabadabovuvaari saha daasulayòkkayu sahodarulayòkkayu lèkka poortiyaguvaraku imka kòmchèmu kaalamu vishramimpavalènani vaarito chèppabadènu.
Aayana aarava mudranu vippinappudu nenu choodagaapèdda bhookampamu kaligènu. sooryudu kambalivalè nalu paayènu, chamdrabimbamamtayu raktavarnamaayènu,
Pèdda gaalicheta oogulaadu amjoorapu chèttunumdi akaalapu kaayalu raalinattu aakaasha nakshatramulu bhoomimeedaraalènu.
Mariyu aakaashamamdalamu chuttabadina gramthamu valènai tòlagipoyènu. pratikòmdayu pratidveepamunu vaativaati sthaanamulu tappènu.
Bhooraajulunu, ghanulunu, savaasraadhipatulunu, dhanikulunu, balishthulunu, prati daasudunu, prati svatamtrudunu kòmda guhalalonu
Bamdala samdulalonu daagukònisimhaasanaaseenudai yunna vaaniyòkkayu gòrrapillayòkkayu ugrata mahaadinamu vachchènu; daaniki taalajaalinavaadèvadu?
Meeru maameeda padi aayana sannidhikini gòrrapilla ugratakunu mammunu marugu cheyudi ani parvatamulatonu bamdala tonu chèppuchunnaaru.
Atutaruvaata bhoomiyòkka naalugu dikkulalo naluguru devadootalu nilichiyumdi, bhoomimeedanainanu samudramumeedanainanu e chèttumeedanainanu gaali veecha kumdunatlu bhoomiyòkka naaluga
Mariyu sajeevudagu devuni mudragala veròka doota sooryodaya dishanumdi paiki vachchuta choochitini. bhoomikini samudramunakunu haani kalugajeyutakai adhikaaramupòmdina aa naluguru dootalato
Ee dootamemu maa devuni daasulanu vaari nòsallayamdu mudrimchuvaraku bhoomikainanu samudramunakainanu chètlakainanu haani cheyavaddani biggaragaa chèppènu.
Mariyu mudrimpabadinavaari lèkka chèppagaa vimtini. ishraayeleeyula gotramulannitilo mudrimpa badinavaaru laksha naluvadi naalugu velamamdi.
Yoodaa gotramulo mudrimpabadinavaaru pamdrèmduvelamamdi. roobenu gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi, gaadu gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi,
Aasheru gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi, naphtaali gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi, manashshe gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi,
Shimyonu gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi, levi gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi, ishshaakhaaru gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi,
Jèbooloonu gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi, yosepu gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi, bènyaameenu gotramulo pamdrèmdu velamamdi mudrimpabadiri.
Atu taruvaata nenu choodagaa, idigo, prati janamulonumdiyu prati vamshamulonumdiyu prajalalonumdiyu, aayaa bhaashalu maatalaaduvaarilo numdiyu vachchi, yèvadunu lèkkimpajaalani yòka gò
Simhaasanaa seenudaina maa devunikini gòrrapillakunu maa rakshanakai stotramani mahaashabdamuto èlugètti chèppiri.
Devadootalamdarunu simhaasanamuchuttunu pèddalachuttunu aa naalugu jeevulachuttunu niluvabadiyumdiri. vaaru simhaasanamu èduta saashtaamgapadiaamen‌;
Yugayugamulavaraku maa devuniki stotramunu mahimayu j~naanamunu krritaj~nataa stutiyu ghanatayu shaktiyu balamunu kalugunu gaakani chèppuchu devuniki namaskaaramu chesiri; aamen‌.
Pèddalalo òkadutèllani vastramulu dharimchukòniyunna veerèvaru? èkkadanumdi vachchirani nannu adigènu.
Amduku nenu ayyaa, neeke tèliyunanagaa atadu eelaagu naato chèppènuveeru mahaashramalanumdi vachchina vaaru; gòrrapilla raktamulo tama vastramulanu udukukòni vaatini tèlupuchesikòniri.
Amduvalana vaaru devuni simhaasanamu èduta umdi raatrimbagallu aayana aalaya mulo aayananu sevimchuchunnaaru. simhaasanaaseenudaina vaadu taane tana gudaaramu vaarimeeda kappunu;
Vaariki ikameedata aakaliyainanu daahamainanu umdadu, sooryuni yèmdayainanu e vadagaaliyainanu vaariki taguladu,
Elayanagaa simhaasana madhyamamdumdu gòrrapilla vaariki kaapariyai, jeevajalamula buggalayòddaku vaarini nadipimchunu, devude vaari kannulanumdi prati baashpabimduvunu tudichi veyunu.
Aayana yedava mudranu vippinappudu paraloka mamdu imchumimchu aragamtasepu nishshabdamugaa umdènu.
Amtata nenu devuniyèduta niluchu eduguru dootalanu choochitini; vaariki edu booraliyyabadènu.

Mariyu suvarnadhoopaarti cheta pattukòniyunna veròka dootavachchi balipeethamu èduta niluvagaa simhaa sanamu èduta unna suvarnabalipeethamupaina parishuddhulamdari praarthanalato kaluputakai ataniki bahu dhoopadravyamulu iyyabadènu.
Appudaa dhoopadravyamula pòga parishuddhula praarthanalato kalisi doota chetilonumdi paiki lechi devuni sannidhini cherènu.
Aa doota dhoopaartini teesikòni, bali peethamupainunna nippulato daanini nimpi, bhoomimeeda pada veyagaa urumulu dhvanulu mèrupulu bhookampamunu kaligènu.
Amtata edu booralu pattukòniyunna aa yeduguru dootalu oodutaku siddhapadiri.

Mòdati doota boora oodinappudu raktamuto militamaina vadagamdlunu agniyu putti bhoomipaina padaveyabadènu; amduvalana bhoomilo moodava bhaagamu kaali poyènu, chètlalo moodava bhaagamunu kaalipoyènu, pachchagaddiyamtayu kaalipoyènu.
Rèmdava doota boora oodinappudu agnicheta mamduchunna pèdda kòmdavamtidi òkkati samudramulo pada veyabadènu. amduvalana samudramulo moodava bhaagamu raktamaayènu.
Samudramuloni praanamugala jamtuvulalo moodava bhaagamu chachchènu, odalalo moodava bhaagamu naashana maayènu.
Moodava doota boora oodinappudu diviteevalè mamduchunna yòka pèdda nakshatramu aakaashamunumdi raali nadula moodava bhaagamumeedanu neetibuggala meedanu padènu.
Aa nakshatramunaku maachipatriyani peru. amduvalana neellalo moodavabhaagamu maachipatri yaayènu; neellu chedai poyinamduna vaativalana manushyulalo anekulu chachchiri.

Naalugava doota boora oodinappudu soorya chamdra nakshatramulalo moodava bhaagamu cheekati kammunatlunu, pagatilo moodava bhaagamuna sooryudu prakaashimpa kumdunatlunu, raatrilo moodava bhaagamuna chamdra nakshatramulu prakaashimpakumdunatlunu vaatilo moodava bhaagamu kòttabadènu.

Mariyu nenu choodagaa aakaashamadhyamuna òka pakshi raaju èguruchu--booralu oodabovuchunna mugguru dootala boorala shabdamulanubatti bhoonivaasulaku ayyo, ayyo, ayyo, ani gòppa svaramuto chèpputa vimtini.
Ayidava doota boora oodinappudu aakaashamunumdi bhoomimeeda raalina yòka nakshatramunu choochitini. agaadhamuyòkka taalapuchèvi ataniki iyyabadènu.
Atadu agaadhamu tèravagaa pèdda kòlimilonumdi lechu pògavamti pòga aa agaadhamulonumdi lechènu; aa agaadhamuloni pògacheta sooryunini vaayumamdalamuna cheekati kammènu.
Aa pògalonumdi midatalu bhoomi meediki vachchènu, bhoomilo umdu tellaku balamunnattu vaatiki balamu iyyabadènu.
Mariyu nòsallayamdu devuni mudraleni manushyulake tappa bhoomipainunna gaddikainanu e mòkkalakainanu mari e vrrikshamunakainanu haani kalugajeyakoodadani vaatiki aaj~na iyyabadènu.

Mariyu vaarini champutaku adhikaaramu iyyabadaledu gaani ayidu nèlalavaraku baadhimchutaku vaatiki adhikaaramu iyyabadènu. vaativalava kalugu baadha, telu manushyuni kuttinappudumdu baadhavalè umdunu.
Aa dinamulalo manushyulu maranamunu vèdakuduru gaani adi vaariki dòrakane dòrakadu; chaavavalènani aashapaduduru gaani maranamu vaariyòddanumdi paaripovunu.
Aa midatala roopamulu yuddhamunaku siddhaparachabadina gurramulanu poli yunnavi. bamgaaramuvalè mèrayu kireetamulavamtivi vaati talalameeda umdènu; vaati mukhamulu manushya mukhamulavamtivi,
Streela talavèmdrukalavamti vèmdrukalu vaatikumdènu. vaati pamdlu simhapu koralavalè umdènu.
Inupa maimaruvulavamti maimaruvulu vaati kumdènu. vaati rèkkala dhvani yuddhamunaku parugèttunatti vistaaramaina gurrapu rathamula dhvanivalè umdènu.
Tellatokalavamti tokalunu kòmdlunu vaatikumdènu. ayidu nèlalavaraku vaati tokalacheta manushyulaku haani cheyutaku vaatiki adhikaaramumdènu.
Paataalapu doota vaatipaina raajugaa unnaadu; hèbreebhaashalo vaaniki abaddonani peru, greesudeshapu bhaashalo vaaniperu apòlluyonu.
Mòdati shrama gatimchènu; idigo mari rèmdu shramalu itutaruvaata vachchunu.
Aarava doota boora oodinappudu devuniyèduta unna suvarna balipeethamuyòkka kòmmulanumdi yòka svaramu yoophrateesu
Anu mahaanadiyòdda bamdhimpabadiyunna naluguru dootalanu vadilipèttumani boora pattukòni yunna aa yaarava dootato chèpputa vimtini.
Manu shyulalo moodava bhaagamunu samharimpavalènani ade samvatsaramuna ade nèlalo ade dinamuna, ade gamtaku siddhaparachabadiyumdina aa naluguru dootalu vadilipètta badiri.
Gurrapurautula sainyamula lèkka yiruvadikotlu; vaari lèkka yimta ani nenu vimtini.

Mariyu naaku kaligina darshanamamdu eelaagu choochitini. aa gurra mulakunu vaati meeda koorchumdiyunnavaarikini, nippuvalè èrupu varnamu, neelavarnamu, gamdhakavarnamula maimaruvu lumdènu. aa gurramula talalu simhapu talalavamtivi, vaati nollalonumdi agni dhoomagamdhakamulu bayalu vèdaluchumdènu.
Ee moodu dèbbalacheta, anagaa veeti nollalonumdi bayaluvèdaluchunna agni dhoomagamdhaka mulacheta, manushyulalo moodava bhaagamu champabadènu,
Aa gurramula balamu vaati nollayamdunu vaati tokala yamdunu unnadi, èmdukanagaa vaati tokalu paamulavalè umdi talalu kaliginavainamduna vaaticheta avi haani cheyunu.

Ee dèbbalacheta chaavaka migilina janulu, dayya mulanu, choodanu vinanu naduvanu shaktilenivai, bamgaaru vèmdi kamchu raayi karralato cheyabadina tama hastakrritamulaina vigrahamulanu poojimpakumda vidichipèttunatlu maarumanassu pòmdaledu.
Mariyu taamu cheyu chunna narahatyalunu maayamamtramulunu jaarachoratva mulunu cheyakumdunatlu vaaru maarumanassu pòmdina vaaru kaaru.

Balishthudaina veròka doota paralokamunumdi digivachchuta choochitini. aayana meghamu dharimchukòni yumdènu, aayana shirassumeeda imdradhanussumdènu; aayana mukhamu sooryabimbamuvalènu aayana paadamulu agnistambhamulavalènu umdènu.
Aayana chetilo vippa badiyunna yòka chinna pustakamumdènu. aayana tana kudipaadamu samudramumeedanu èdama paadamu bhoomi meedanu mopi,
Simhamu garjimchunatlu gòppa shabdamuto aarbhatimchènu. aayana aarbhatimchinappudu edu urumulu vaativaati shabdamulu palikènu.
Aa yedu urumulu palikinappudu nenu vraayabovuchumdagaaedu urumulu palikina samgatulaku mudraveyumu, vaatini vraayavaddani paralokamunumdi yòka svaramu palukuta vimtini.
Mariyu samudramumeedanu bhoomimeedanu nilichiyumdagaa nenu choochina aa doota tana kudichèyyi aakaashamutattu ètti
Paralokamunu amdulo unna vaatini, bhoomini amdulo unnavaatini, samudramunu amdulo unna vaatini srrishtimchi, yugayugamulu jeevimchuchunna vaanitodu òttupèttukòniika aalasyamumdadu gaani
Yedava doota paluku dinamulalo atadu boora oodabovuchumdagaa, devudu tana daasulagu pravaktalaku tèlipina suvaartaprakaaramu devuni marmamu samaaptamagunani chèppènu.
Amtata paralokamunumdi nenu vinina svaramu marala naato maatalaaduchuneevu vèlli samudramumeedanu bhoomimeedanu nilichiyunna aa doota chetilo vippabadiyunna aa chinna pustakamu teesi kò
Nenu aa doota yòddaku vèlliee chinna pustakamu naakimmani adugagaa aayanadaani teesikòni tiniveyumu, adi nee kadupuku chedagunu gaani nee notiki tenèvalè madhuramugaa umdunani naato chèppènu.
Amtata nenu aa chinna pustakamunu doota chetilonumdi teesikòni daanini tinivesitini; adi naa notiki tenèvalè madhuramugaa umdènugaani nenu daanini tini vesina taruvaata naa kadupuku chedaayènu
Appudu vaaruneevu prajalanugoorchiyu, janamulanugoorchiyu, aa yaa bhaashalu maatalaaduvaarinigoorchiyu, anekamamdi raajulanugoorchiyu marala pravachimpa nagatyamani naato chèppiri.
Mariyu òkadu chetikarravamti kòlakarra naakichchineevu lechi devuni aalayamunu balipeethamunu kòlatavesi, aalayamulo poojimchuvaarini lèkkapèttumu.
Aalaya munaku vèlupati aavaranamunu kòlataveyaka vidichi pèttumu; adi anyulakiyyabadènu, vaaru naluvadi rèmdu nèlalu parishuddhapattanamunu kaalito tròkkuduru.
Nenu naa yiddaru saakshulaku adhikaaramu ichchèdanu; vaaru gonèpatta dharimchukòni vèyyinni rèmduvamdala aruvadi dinamulu pravachimturu.
Veeru bhoolokamunaku prabhuvaina vaani yèduta niluchuchunna rèmdu òleevachètlunu deepastambhamulunai yunnaaru.

Èvadainanu vaariki haani cheya nuddeshimchinayèdala vaari notanumdi agni bayalu vèdali vaari shatruvulanu dahimchiveyunu ganuka èvadainanu vaariki haanicheya nuddeshimchinayèdala aalaaguna vaadu champabadavalènu.

Taamu pravachimpu dinamulu varshamu kuruva kumda aakaashamunu mooyutaku vaariki adhikaaramu kaladu. mariyu vaarikishtamainappudèlla neellu raktamugaa cheyutakunu, naanaavidhamulaina tègullato bhoomini baadhimchutakunu vaariki adhikaaramu kaladu.
Vaaru saakshyamu chèpputa mugimpagaane agaadhamulonumdi vachchu krooramrrigamu vaarito yuddhamuchesi jayimchi vaarini champunu.
Vaari shavamulu aa mahaapattanapu samta veedhilo padiyumdunu; vaaniki upamaanaroopamugaa sòdòma aniyu aiguptu aniyu peru; achchata vaari prabhuvukooda siluvaveyabadènu.

Mariyu prajalakunu, vamshamulakunu, aa yaa bhaashalu maatalaaduvaarikini, janamu lakunu sambamdhimchinavaaru moodu dinamulannara vaari shavamu lanu choochuchu vaari shavamulanu samaadhilo pèttaniyyaru.
Ee yiddaru pravaktalu bhoonivaasulanu baadhimchinamduna bhoonivaasulu vaari gati choochi samtoshimchuchu, utsa himchuchu, òkanikòkadu katnamulu pampukòmduru.
Ayite aa moodudinamulannarayaina pimmata devuniyòdda numdi jeevaatma vachchi vaarilo praveshimchènu ganuka vaaru paadamulu ooni nilichiri; vaarini choochina vaariki migula bhayamu kaligènu.
Appuduikkadiki èkkiramdani paralokamunumdi gòppa svaramu tamato chèpputa vaaru vini, meghaaroodhulai paralokamunaku aarohanamairi; vaaru povuchumdagaa vaari shatruvulu vaarini choochiri

Aa gadiyalone gòppa bhookampamu kaliginamduna aa pattanamulo padiyava bhaagamu koolipoyènu. aa bhookampamuvalana eduvelamamdi chachchiri. migilinavaaru bhayaakraamtulai paralokapu devuni mahimaparachiri.
Rèmdava shrama gatimchènu; idigo moodava shrama tvaragaa vachchuchunnadi.
Edava doota boora oodinappudu paralokamulo gòppa shabdamulu puttènu. aa shabdamuluee loka raajyamu mana prabhuvu raajyamunu aayana kreestu raajyamu naayènu; aayana yugayugamula varaku elu nanènu.
Amtata devuniyèduta simhaasanaaseenulagu aa yiruvadi naluguru pèddalu saashtaamgapadi devuniki nama skaaramuchesi
Vartamaanabhootakaalamulalo umdu devudavaina prabhuvaa, sarvaadhikaaree, neevu nee mahaabalamunu sveekarimchi yeluchunnaavu ganuka memu neeku krritaj~nataastutulu chèllimchuchunnaamu.

Janamulu kopa gimchinamduna neeku kopamu vachchènu. mrritulu teerpu pòmdutakunu, nee daasulagu pravaktalakunu parishuddhulakunu, nee naamamunaku bhayapaduvaarikini tagina phalamunichchutakunu, gòppavaaremi kòddivaaremi bhoomini nashimpajeyu vaarini nashimpajeyutakunu samayamu vachchiyunnadani chèppiri.
Mariyu paralokamamdu devuni aalayamu tèrava badagaa devuni nibamdhanamamdasamu aayana aalayamulo kanabadènu. appudu mèrupulunu dhvanulunu urumulunu bhookampamunu gòppa vadagamdlunu puttènu.
Appudu paralokamamdu òka gòppa soochana kanabadènu. adedanagaa sooryuni dharimchukònina yòka stree aamè paadamulakrimdachamdrudunu shirassumeeda pamdrèmdu nakshatramula kireetamunu
Aamè garbhiniyai prasavavedanapaduchu aa nòppulaku kekalu veyuchumdènu.
Amtata paralokamamdu imkòka soochana kanabadènu. idigo yèrrani mahaaghatasarpamu; daaniki edu talalunu padi kòmmulunu umdènu; daani talalameeda edu kireetamu lumdènu.

Daani toka aakaasha nakshatramulalo moodava bhaagamu needchi vaatini bhoomimeeda padavesènu. kananaiyunna aa stree kanagaane, aamè shishuvunu mimgiveyavalènani aa ghatasarpamu stree yèduta niluchumdènu.
Samasta janamulanu inupadamdamuto elanaiyunna yòka magashishuvunu aamè kanagaa, aamè shishuvu devuniyòddakunu aayana simhaasanamunòddakunu kònipobadènu.
Aa stree aranyamunaku paaripoyènu; achchata vaaru vèyyinni rèmduvamdala aruvadi dinamulu aamènu poshimpavalènani devudaamèku òka sthalamu siddhaparachiyumchènu.
Amtata paralokamamdu yuddhamu jarigènu. mikhaa yelunu atani dootalunu aa ghatasarpamuto yuddhamu cheyavalènani yumdagaa
Aa ghatasarpamunu daani dootalunu yuddhamu chesiri gaani gèluva lekapoyiri ganuka paralokamamdu vaarikika sthalamu lekapoyènu.

Kaagaa sarvalokamunu mosa puchchuchu, apavaadiyaniyu saataananiyu perugala aadisarpamaina aa mahaa ghatasarpamu padadroyabadènu. adi bhoomimeeda pada droyabadènu; daani dootalu daanito kooda padadroyabadiri.

Mariyu òka gòppa svaramu paraloka mamdu eelaagu chèpputa vimtiniraatrimbagallu mana devuniyèduta mana sahodarulameeda neramu mopuvaadaina apavaadi padadroyabadi yunnaadu ganuka ippudu rakshanayu shaktiyu raajyamunu mana devuni vaayènu; ippudu adhikaaramu aayana kreestudaayènu.
Vaaru gòrrapilla raktamunu battiyu, taamichchina saakshya munubattiyu vaanini jayimchiyunnaaru gaani, maranamu varaku tama praanamulanu premimchina vaaru kaaru.
Amducheta paralokamaa, paralokanivaasulaaraa, utsahimchudi; bhoomee, samudramaa, meeku shrama; apavaadi tanaku samayamu kòmchème ani tèlisikòni bahu krodhamu galavaadai meeyòddaku digi
Aa ghatasarpamu taanu bhoomimeeda padadroyabadi yumduta choochi, aa magashishuvunu kanina streeni himsim chènu;
Amduvalana aamè aranyamulo unna tana chotiki ègurunatlu gòppa pakshiraaju rèkkalu rèmdu aamèku iyyabadènu. achchata aa sarpamukhamunu chooda kumda aamè òkakaalamu kaalamulu ardhakaalamu poshim
Kaavuna aa stree, pravaahamunaku kòttukòni povalènani aa sarpamu tana notinumdi neellu nadeepravaahamugaa aamè vènuka vèllagrakkènugaani
Bhoomi aa streeki sahakaariyai tana noru tèrachi aa ghatasarpamu, tana notanumdi grakkina pravaahamunu mimgivesènu.
Amducheta aa ghatasarpamu aagrahamu tèchchukòni, devuni aj~nalu gaikònuchu yesunugoorchi saakshyamichchuchu unna vaaraina aamè samtaanamulo sheshimchina vaarito yuddhamu cheyutakai bayaluvèda
Mariyu padi kòmmulunu edu talalunu gala yòka krooramrrigamu samudramulonumdi paiki vachchuta choochitini. daani kòmmulameeda padi kireetamulunu daani talalameeda devadooshanakaramaina pellunu umdènu.

Nenu choochina aa mrrigamu chirutapulini poliyumdènu. daani paadamulu èlugubamti paadamulavamtivi, daani noru simhapunoruvamtidi, daaniki aa ghatasarpamu tana balamunu tana simhaasanamunu gòppa adhikaaramunu ichchènu.
Daani talalalo òkadaaniki chaavudèbba tagilinattumdènu; ayite aa chaavudèbba maanipoyènu ganuka bhoojanulamdaru mrrigamu vèmta vèlluchu aashcharyapaduchumdiri.

Aa mrrigamunaku adhikaaramichchinamduna vaaru ghatasarpa munaku namaskaaramuchesiri. mariyu vaaruee mrriga muto saati yèvadu? daanito yuddhamu cheyagala vaadèvadu? ani chèppukònuchu aa mrrigamunaku namaskaa ramuchesiri.
Dambapu maatalanu devadooshanalanu paluku òka noru daaniki iyya badènu. mariyu naluvadirèmdu nèlalu tana kaaryamu jarupa nadhikaaramu daaniki erpaa taayènu
Ganuka devuni dooshimchutakunu, aayana naamamunu, aayana gudaaramunu, paralokanivaasulanu dooshimchutakunu adi tana noru tèrachènu.

Mariyu parishuddhulato yuddhamucheyanu vaarini jayimpanu daaniki adhikaaramiyyabadènu. prati vamshamumeedanu prati prajameedanu aa yaa bhaashalu maatalaaduvaarimeedanu prati janamumeedanu adhikaaramu daanikiyyabadènu.
Bhooni vaasulamdarunu, anagaa jagadutpatti mòdalukòni vadhimpa badiyunna gòrrapillayòkka jeevagramthamamdu èvari peru vraayabadaledo vaaru, aa mrrigamunaku namaskaaramu cheyuduru.
Èvadainanu chèvigalavaadaite vinunu gaaka;

Èvadainanu chèrapattavalènani yunnayèdala vaadu chèraloniki povunu, èvadainanu khadgamucheta champinayèdala vaadu khadgamucheta champabadavalènu; ee vishayamulo parishuddhula orpunu vishvaasamunu kanabadunu.
Mariyu bhoomilonumdi mariyòka krooramrrigamu paikivachchuta choochitini. gòrrapilla kòmmuvamti rèmdu kòmmulu daanikumdènu; adi ghatasarpamuvalè maatalaadu chumdènu;
Adi aa mòdati krooramrrigamunakunna adhi kaarapu cheshtalanniyu daaniyèduta cheyuchunnadi; mariyu chaavudèbbatagili baagupadiyunna aa mòdati mrrigamunaku bhoomiyu daanilo nivasimchuvaam
Adi aakaashamunumdi bhoomiki manushyulayèduta agni digivachchunattugaa gòppa soochanalu cheyuchunnadi.

Katti dèbba tiniyu bradikina yee krooramrrigamunaku pratimanu cheyavalènani adi bhoonivaasulato chèppuchu, aa mrrigamu èduta cheyutaku tanakiyyabadina soochanalavalana bhoonivaasulanu mosapuchchuchunnadi.

Mariyu aa mrrigamuyòkka pratima maatalaadunatlunu, aa mrrigamu yòkka pratimaku namaskaaramu cheyani vaarini hatamu cheyunatlunu, aa mrrigamuyòkka pratimaku praana michchutakai daaniki adhikaaramu iyyabadènu.
Kaagaa kòddivaarugaani gòppavaarugaani, dhanikulugaani daridrulugaani, svatamtrulugaani daasulugaani, amdarunu tama kudichetimeedanainanu tama nòpatiyamdainanu mudra veyimchukònunatlunu,
Aa mudra, anagaa aa mrrigamu perainanu daani periti samkhyayainanu galavaadu tappa, kraya vikrayamulu cheyutaku mari yèvanikini adhikaaramu lekumdunatlunu adi vaarini balavamtamu cheyu chunnadi.
Buddhigalavaadu mrrigamuyòkka samkhyanu lèkkimpanimmu; adi yòka manushyuni samkhyaye; aa samkhya aaruvamdala aruvadi yaaru; imdulo j~naanamu kaladu.

Mariyu nenu choodagaa, idigo, aa gòrrapilla seeyonu parvatamumeeda niluvabadiyumdènu. aayana naamamunu aayana tamdri naamamunu nòsallayamdu likhimpabadiyunna noota naluvadi naalugu velamamdi aayanato kooda umdiri.

Mariyu vistaaramaina jalamula dhvanitonu gòppa urumu dhvanitonu samaanamaina yòka shabdamu paralokamulonumdi raagaa vimtini. nenu vinina aa shabdamu veenalu vaayimchuchunna vainikula naadamunu polinadi.

Vaaru simhaasanamu èdutanu, aa naalugu jeevula yèdutanu, pèddalayèdutanu òka kròtta keertana paaduchunnaaru; bhoolokamulonumdi kònabadina aa noota naluvadi naaluguvelamamdi tappa mari èvarunu aa keertana nerchukònajaalaru.

Veeru stree saamgatyamuna apavitrulu kaanivaarunu, stree saamgatyamu èrugani vaarunaiyumdi, gòrrapilla èkkadiki povuno akkadikèlla aayananu vèmbadimturu;veeru devuni kòrakunu gòrra pillakòrakunu prathamaphalamugaa umdutakai manushyulalonumdi kònabadinavaaru.
Veerinota e abaddhamunu kanabadaledu; veeru animdyulu.
Appudu mariyòka dootanu choochitini. atadu bhoonivaasulaku, anagaa prati janamunakunu prati vamsha munakunu aa yaa bhaashalu maatalaaduvaarikini prati prajakunu prakatimchunatlu nityasuvaarta ti
Atadumeeru devuniki bhayapadi aayananu mahimaparachudi; aayana teerputeerchu gadiya vachchènu ganuka aakaashamunu bhoomini samudramunu jaladhaaralanu kalugajesina vaanike namaskaara
Veròka doota, anagaa rèmdava doota atani vèmbadi vachchimohodrekamuto koodina tana vyabhichaara madyamunu samasta janamulaku traagimchina yee mahaa babulonu koolipoyènu koolipoyènu ani chèppènu.

Mariyu veròka doota, anagaa moodava doota veeri vèmbadi vachchi gòppa svaramuto eelaagu chèppènu aa krooramrrigamunaku gaani daani pratimaku gaani yèvadainanu namaskaaramuchesi, tana nòsatiyamdemi cheti meedanemi aa mudra veyimchukòninayèdala
Emiyu kalapabadakumda devuni ugratapaatralo poyabadina devuni kopamanu madyamunu vaadu traagunu. parishuddha dootala yèdutanu gòrrapilla yèdutanu agnigamdhakamulacheta vaadu baadhimpabadunu.

Vaari baadhasambamdhamaina pòga yugayugamulu lechunu; aa krooramrrigamunaku gaani daani pratimaku gaani namaskaaramucheyuvaarunu, daani perugala mudra èvadainanu veyimchukòninayèdala vaadunu raatrimbagallu nèmmadilenivaarai yumduru.
Devuni aaj~nalanu yesunugoorchina vishvaasamunu gaikònuchunna parishuddhula orpu imdulo kanabadunu.
Amtata ippatinumdi prabhuvunamdu mrritinòmdu mrritulu dhanyulani vraayumani paralokamunumdi yòka svaramu chèppagaa vimtini. nijame; vaaru tama prayaasamulu maani vishraamti pòmdudum

Mariyu nenu choodagaa, idigo tèllani meghamu kanapadènu. manushyakumaaruni polina yòkadu aa meghamumeeda aaseenudaiyumdènu aayana shirassumeeda suvarnakireetamunu, chetilo vaadigala kòdavaliyu umdènu.
Appudu mariyòka doota devaalayamulonumdi vèdalivachchi bhoomi pairupamdi yunnadi, kotakaalamu vachchinadi, nee kòdavalipètti koyumani gòppa svaramuto aa meghamumeeda aaseenudaiyuna
Meghamumeeda aaseenudai yunnavaadu tana kòdavali bhoomimeeda veyagaa bhoomi pairu koyabadènu.
Imkòka doota paralokamunamdunna aalayamulonumdi vèdalivachchènu; itani yòddanu vaadigala kòdavali yumdènu.

Mariyòkadoota balipeethamunumdi vèdali vachchènu. itadu agnimeeda adhikaaramu nòmdinavaadu; itadu vaadiyaina kòdavaligalavaanini gòppa svaramuto pilichibhoomimeeda unna draakshapamdlu paripakvamainavi; vaadiyaina nee kòdavalipètti daani gèlalu koyumani chèppènu.
Kaagaa aa doota tana kòdavali bhoomimeeda vesi bhoomimeedanunna draakshapamdlanu kosi, devuni kopamanu draakshala pèdda tòttilo vesènu
Aa draakshalatòtti pattanamunaku vèlupata tròkkabadènu; nooru kosula dooramu gurramula kallèmumattuku draakshala tòttilonumdi raktamu pravahimchènu.
Mariyu aashcharyamaina mariyòka gòppa soochana paralokamamdu choochitini. ademanagaa, edu tègullu cheta pattukòniyunna yeduguru dootalu. ive kadavari tègullu; veetito devuni kopamu samaaptamaayènu.

Mariyu agnito kalisiyunna sphatikapu samudramu vamtidi òkati nenu choochitini. aa krooramrrigamunakunu daani pratimakunu daani perugala samkhyakunu lobadaka vaatini jayimchinavaaru devuni veenalugalavaarai, aa sphatikapu samudramunòdda nilichiyumduta choochitini.
Vaaru prabhuvaa, devaa, sarvaadhikaaree, nee kriyalu ghanamainavi, aashcharyamainavi; yugamulaku raajaa, nee maargamulu nyaayamulunu satyamulunai yunnavi;

Prabhuvaa, neevu maatramu pavitrudavu, neeku bhayapadani vaadèvadu? nee naamamunu mahimaparachanivaadèvadu? nee nyaayavidhulu pratyakshaparachabadinavi ganuka janamulamdaru vachchi nee sannidhini namaskaaramuchesèdarani chèppuchu, devuni daasudagu moshe keertanayu gòrrapilla keertanayu paaduchunnaaru.
Atutaruvaata nenu choodagaa, saakshyapu gudaara sambamdhamaina aalayamu paralokamamdu tèravabadènu.

Edu tègullu cheta pattukòniyunna aa yeduguru dootalu, nirmalamunu prakaashamaanamunaina raatini3 dharimchu kòni, ròmmulameeda bamgaaru datteelu kattukòninavaarai aa aalayamulonumdi vèlupaliki vachchiri.
Appudaa naalugu jeevulalo òka jeevi, yugayugamulu jeevimchu devuni kopamuto nimdiyunna yedu bamgaaru paatralanu aa yeduguru dootala kichchènu.
Amtata devuni mahimanumdiyu aayana shaktinumdiyu vachchina pògato aalayamu nimpabadinamduna aa yeduguru dootalayòdda unna yedu tègullu samaaptiyaguvaraku aalayamamdu èva
Mariyumeeru poyi devuni kopamuto nimdina aa yedu paatralanu bhoomimeeda kummarimchudani aalaya mulonumdi gòppa svaramu aa yeduguru devadootalato chèppagaa vimtini.
Amtata mòdati doota vèlupaliki vachchi tana paatranu bhoomimeeda kummarimpagaa aa krooramrrigamuyòkka mudragalavaarikini daani pratimaku namaskaaramucheyuvaarikini baadhakaramaina chèdda pum
Rèmdava doota tana paatranu samudramulo kummarimpagaa samudramu peenuga raktamu vamtidaayènu. amdu valana samudramulo unna jeevajamtuvulanniyu chachchènu.
Moodava doota tana paatranu nadulalonu jaladhaaralalonu kummarimpagaa avi raktamaayènu.
Appudu vartamaana bhootakaalamulalo umdu pavitrudaa, parishuddhula raktamunu pravaktala raktamuma vaaru kaarchinamduku teerputeerchi vaariki raktamu traaganichchitivi;
Deeniki vaaru paatrule. neevu eelaagu teerputeerchitivi ganuka neevu nyaayavamtudavani jalamula devadoota chèppagaa vimtini.
Amduku avunu prabhuvaa, devaa, sarvaadhikaaree, nee teerpulu satyamulunu nyaayamulunai yunnavani balipeethamu chèpputa vimtini.
Naalugava doota tana paatranu sooryunimeeda kumma rimpagaa manushyulanu agnito kaalchutaku sooryuniki adhikaaramu iyyabadènu.
Kaagaa manushyulu teevramaina vedimito kaalipoyi, yee tègullameeda adhikaaramugala devuni naamamunu dooshimchiri gaani, aayananu mahima parachunatlu vaaru maarumanassu pòmdinavaarukaaru.
Ayidava doota tana paatranu aa krooramrrigamu yòkka simhaasanamumeeda kummarimpagaa, daani raajyamu cheekati kammènu; manushyulu tamaku kaligina vedananubatti tama naalukalu karachukò
Tamaku kaligina vedanalanu battiyu pumdlanu battiyu paralokamamdunna devuni dooshimchiri gaani tama kriyalanu maani maaru manassu pòmdinavaaru kaaru.
Aarava doota tana paatranu yoophrateesu anu mahaanadimeeda kummarimpagaa toorpunumdi vachchu raajulaku maargamu siddhaparachabadunatlu daani neellu yèmdi poyènu.
Mariyu aa ghatasarpamu nota numdiyu krooramrrigamu notanumdiyu abaddha pravakta notanumdiyu kappalavamti moodu apavitraatmalu bayaluvèdalagaa choochitini.
Avi soochanalu cheyunatti dayyamula aatmale; avi sarvaadhikaariyaina devuni mahaadinamuna jarugu yuddhamunaku lokamamtata unna raajulanu pogucheyavalènani vaariyòddaku bayalu vèlli
Hèbreebhaashalo haar‌ mègiddonanu chotuku vaarini poguchesènu.
Idigo nenu dòmgavalè vachchuchunnaanu; taanu digambarudugaa samcharimchuchunnamduna janulu tana disamòlanu chooturemo ani mèlakuvagaa umdi tana vastramu kaapaadu kònuvaadu dhanyudu.
Edava doota tana paatranu vaayumamdalamumeeda kummarimpagaasamaaptamainadani chèppuchunnayòka gòppa svaramu garbhaalayamulo unna simhaasanamu numdi vachchènu.
Appudu mèrupulunu dhvanulunu urumulunu puttènu, pèdda bhookampamunu kaligènu. manushyulu bhoomimeeda puttinadi mòdalukòni atti mahaabhookampamu kalugaledu, adi amta gò

Prasiddhamaina mahaapattanamu moodu bhaagamulaayènu, anyajanula pattanamulu koolipoyènu, tana teekshanamaina ugratayanu madyamugala paatranu mahaa babulonunaku iyyavalènani daanini devuni samukhamamdu j~naapakamu chesiri.
Prati dveepamu paaripoyènu, parvatamulu kanabadaka poyènu.
Ayidesi manugula baruvugala pèddavadagamdlu aakaashamu numdi manushyulameeda padènu; aa vadagamdla dèbba mikkili gòppadainamduna manushyulu aa dèbbanubatti devuni dooshimchiri.

Aa yedu paatralanu pattukòniyunna yedugurudevadootalalo òkaduvachchi naato maatalaaduchu eelaagu chèppènu. neevikkadiki rammu, vistaara jalamulameeda koorchunna mahaaveshyaku cheyabadu teerpu neeku kanuparachè danu;
Bhooraajulu aamèto vyabhicharimchiri, bhoonivaasulu aamè vyabhichaara madyamulo mattulairi.
Appudatadu aatmavashudanaina nannu aranyamunaku kònipogaa, deva dooshana naamamulato nimdukòni, yedu talalunu padi kòmmulunugala èrrani mrrigamumeeda koorchumdina yòka streeni choochitini

Aa stree dhoomraraktavarnamugala vastramu dharimchukòni, bamgaaramutonu ratnamulatonu mutyamulatonu alamkarimpabadinadai, ehyamaina kaaryamulatonu taanu cheyuchunna vyabhichaarasambamdhamaina apavitrakaaryamulatonu nimdina yòka suvarna paatranu tanacheta pattukòniyumdènu.
Daani nòsata daani peru eelaagu vraayabadiyumdènumarmamu, veshyalakunu bhoomiloni ehyamainavaatikini talliyaina mahaa babulonu.
Mariyu aa stree parishuddhula raktamuchetanu, yesuyòkka hatasaakshula raktamuchetanu mattilliyumduta choochitini. nenu daani choochi bahugaa aashcharyapadagaa
Aa doota naato itlanènuneevela aashcharyapaditivi? yee streenigoorchina marmamunu, edu talalunu padi kòmmulunu galigi daani moyuchunna krooramrrigamunugoorchina marmamunu nenu neeku tèlipèdanu.

Neevu choochina aa mrrigamu umdènu gaani yippudu ledu; ayite adi agaadha jalamulonumdi paiki vachchutakunu naashanamunaku povutakunu siddhamugaa unnadi. bhoonivaasulalo jaga dutpatti mòdalukòni jeevagramthamamdu èvari peru vraayabadaledo vaaru, aa mrrigamumdènu gaani yippudu ledu ayite mumduku vachchunanna samgati tèlisikòni ashcharyapaduduru.
Imdulo j~naanamugala manassu kanabadunu. aa yedu talalu aa stree koorchunna yedu kòmdalu;
Mariyu eduguru raajulu kalaru; ayiduguru koolipoyiri, òkadunnaadu, kadamavaadu imkanu raaledu, vachchinappudu atadu kòmchèmu kaalamumdavalènu.
Umdinadiyu ippudu lenidiyunaina yee krooramrrigamu aa yedugurito paatu òkadunaiyumdi, taane yènimidava raajaguchu naashanamunaku povunu.
Neevu choochina aa padi kòmmulu padimamdi raajulu. vaaridivaraku raajyamunu pòmdaledu gaani yòkagadiya krooramrrigamutokooda raajulavalè adhikaaramu pòmduduru.
Veeru ekaabhipraayamugalavaarai tama balamunu adhikaaramunu aa mrrigamunaku appagimturu.

Veeru gòrrapillato yuddhamu cheturu gaani, gòrrapilla prabhuvulaku prabhuvunu raajulaku raajunai yunnamdunanu, tanatokooda umdinavaaru piluvabadinavaarai, yerparacha badinavaarai, nammakamainavaarai yunnamdunanu, aayana aa raajulanu jayimchunu.
Mariyu aa doota naato eelaagu chèppènuaa veshya koorchunnachota neevu choochina jalamulu prajalanu, janasamoohamulanu, jana mulanu, aa yaa bhaashalu maatalaaduvaarini soochimchunu.

Neevu aa padi kòmmulugala aa mrrigamunu choochitive, vaaru aa veshyanu dveshimchi, daanini dikku lenidaanigaanu digambarigaanu chesi, daani maamsamu bhakshimchi agnicheta daanini bòttigaa kaalchiveturu.
Devuni maatalu nèraveruvaraku vaaru ekaabhipraayamugalavaarai tama raajyamunu aa mrrigamunaku appagimchutavalana tana samkalpamu kònasaagimchunatlu devudu vaariki buddhi puttimchènu.
Mariyu neevu choochina aa stree bhooraajulanelu aa mahaapattaname.
Atutaruvaata mahaadhikaaramugala veròka doota paralokamunumdi digivachchuta choochitini. atani mahimacheta bhoomi prakaashimchènu.
Atadu gòppa svaramuto arbhatimchi yitlanènumahaababulonu koolipoyènu koolipoyènu. adi dayyamulaku nivaasasthalamunu, prati apavitraatmaku unikipattunu, apavitramunu asahyamunaina

Elayanagaa samastamaina janamulu mohodrekamuto koodina daani vyabhichaara madyamunu traagi padipoyiri, bhooraajulu daanito vyabhicharimchiri, bhoolokamamdali vartakulu daani sukhabhogamulavalana dhanavamtulairi.

Mariyu imkòka svaramu paralokamulonumdi eelaagu chèppagaa vimtininaa prajalaaraa, meeru daani paapamulalo paalivaarukaakumdunatlunu, daani tègullalo ediyu meeku praaptimpakumdunatlunu daanini vidichiramdi.
Daani paapamulu aakaashamunamtuchunnavi, daani neramulanu devudu j~naapakamu chesikòniyunnaadu.
Adi yichchinaprakaaramu daaniki iyyudi; daani kriyala chòppuna daaniki rèttimpu cheyudi; adi kalipina paatralo daanikòraku rèmdamtalu kalipi pèttudi.
Adi nenu raaninigaa koorchumdudaananu, nenu vidhavaraalanu kaanu, duhkhamu choodane choodanani tana manassulo anukònènu ganuka, adi tannutaanu èmtagaa gòppachesikòni sukha bhogamulanu anubha
Amducheta òkka dinamunane daani tègullu, anagaa maranamunu duhkhamunu karavunu vachchunu; daaniki teerputeerchuchunna devudaina prabhuvu balishthudu ganuka adi agnicheta bòttigaa kaalchive¸
Daanito vyabhichaaramuchesi sukhabhogamulanu anubhavimchina bhooraajulu daani baadha choochi bhayaa kraamtulai dooramuna niluvabadi daani dahanadhoomamunu choochunappudu
Daani vishayamai ròmmu kòttukònuchu edchuchu--ayyo, ayyo, babulonu mahaapattanamaa, balamaina pattanamaa, òkka gadiyalone neeku teerpuvachchènu gadaa ani chèppukòmduru.

Lokamuloni vartakulunu, aa pattanamunu choochi yedchuchu, tama sarakulanu, anagaa bamgaaru vèmdi ratnamulu mutyamulu sannapu naara battalu oodaa ramgubattalu pattubattalu raktavarnapubattalu mòdalaina sarakulanu,
Pratividhamaina dabbamraanunu prati vidhamaina damtapu vastuvulanu, mikkili viluvagala karra yittadi yinumu chaluvaraallu mòdalainavaatito cheyabadina pratividhamaina vastuvulanu,

Daalchinichèkka omamu dhoopadravyamulu attaru saambraani draakshaarasamu noonè mèttanipimdi godumalu pashuvulu gòrralu mòdalagu vaatini, gurramulanu rathamulanu daasulanu manushyula praanamulanu ikameedata èvadunu kònadu;

Nee praanamunaku ishtamaina phalamulu ninnu vidichipoyènu, ruchya mainavanniyu divyamainavanniyu neeku dòrakakumda nashimchi poyinavi, avi yikameedata kanabadane kanabadavani chèppu kònuchu, daanigoorchi duhkhapaduduru.
Aa pattanamucheta dhanavamtulaina yee sarakula vartakulu edchuchu duhkhapaduchu
Ayyo, ayyo, sannapu naarabattalanu dhoomrarakta varnapu vastramulanu dharimchukòni, bamgaaramutonu ratnamulatonu mutyamulatonu alamkarimpabadina mahaapattanamaa, yimta aishvaryamu
Prati naavikudunu, èkkadikainanu saburucheyu prativaadunu, odavaarunu, samudramumeeda panichesi jeevanamucheyu vaaramdarunu dooramugaa nilichi daani dahana dhoomamunu choochi
Ee mahaapattanamuto samaanamainadedi ani chèppukònuchu kekaluvesi

Tama talalameeda dummuposi kòni yedchuchu duhkhimchuchu ayyo, ayyo, aa mahaapattanamu; amdulo samudramumeeda odalugala vaaramdaru, daaniyamdali adhika vyayamucheta dhanavamtulairi; adi òkka gadiyalo paadaipoyène ani chèppu kònuchu kekalu veyuchumdiri.
Paralokamaa, parishuddhu laaraa, apòstalulaaraa, pravaktalaaraa, daanigoorchi aanam dimchudi, elayanagaa daanicheta meeku kaligina teerpuku pratigaa devudu aa pattanamunaku teerpu teerchiyunnaadu.
Taruvaata balishthudaina yòka doota gòppa tirugati raativamti raayi yètti samudramulo padavesieelaagu mahaapattanamaina babulonu vegamugaa padadroyabadi ika ènnatikini kanabadakapovunu.

Nee vartakulu bhoomimeeda gòppa prabhuvulai yumdiri; janamulanniyu nee maayamamtramulacheta mosapoyiri; kaavuna vainikula yòkkayu, gaayakulayòkkayu, pillanagrovi oodu vaariyòkkayu booralu ooduvaariyòkkayu shabdamu ika ènnadunu neelo vinabadadu. mari e shilpamaina cheyu shilpi yèvadunu neelo èmtamaatramunu kanabadadu, tirugatidhvani yika ènnadunu neelo vinabadadu,
Deepapu vèlugu neelo ikanu prakaashimpane prakaashimpadu, pèmdli kumaaruni svaramunu pèmdlikumaartè svaramunu neelo ika ènnadunu vinabadavu ani chèppènu.
Mariyu pravaktala yòkkayu, parishuddhulayòkkayu, bhoomimeeda vadhimpa badinavaaramdariyòkkayu raktamu aa pattanamulo kanabadè nanènu.
Atutaruvaata bahu janulashabdamuvamti gòppasvaramu paralokamamdu eelaagu chèppagaa vimtiniprabhuvunu stutimchudi, rakshana mahima prabhaavamulu mana devunike chèllunu;

Aayana teerpulu satyamulunu nyaayamulunai yunnavi; tana vyabhichaaramuto bhooloka munu chèripina gòppa veshyaku aayana teerpu teerchi tana daasula raktamunubatti daaniki pratidamdana chesènu; mari rèmdavasaari vaaruprabhuvunu stutimchudi aniri.
Aa pattanapu pòga yugayugamulu paiki lechuchunnadi.
Appudu aa yiruvadi naluguru pèddalunu naalugu jeevu lunu saagilapadiaamen‌, prabhuvunu stutimchudi ani chèppuchu simhaasanaaseenudagu devuniki namaskaaramu chesiri.
Mariyumana devuni daasulaaraa, aayanaku bhayapaduvaaralaaraa, kòddivaaremi gòppavaaremi meeramdaru aayananu stutimchudi ani chèppuchunna yòka svaramu simhaasanamunòddanumdi vachchènu.
Appudu gòppa jana samoohapu shabdamunu, vistaaramaina jalamula shabdamunu, balamaina urumula shabdamunu polina yòka svaramusarvaadhikaariyu prabhuvunagu mana devudu eluchunnaadu

Aayananu stutimchudi, gòrrapilla vivaahotsava samayamu vachchinadi,aayana bhaarya tannutaanu siddha parachukòniyunnadi; ganuka manamu samtoshapadi utsahimchi aayananu mahima parachèdamani chèppagaa vimtini.
Mariyu aamè dharimchukònutaku prakaashamulunu nirmala mulunaina sannapu naarabattalu aamèkiyyabadènu; avi parishuddhula neetikriyalu.
Mariyu atadu naato eelaagu chèppènugòrrapilla pèmdlivimduku piluvabadina vaaru dhanyulani vraayumu; mariyu ee maatalu devuni yathaartha maina maatalani naato chèppènu.
Amduku nenu ataniki namaskaaramu cheyutakai atani paadamula yèduta saagilapadagaa ataduvaddu sumee. nenu neetonu, yesunugoorchina saakshyamu chèppu nee sahodarulatonu sahadaasuda

Mariyu paralokamu tèruvabadiyumduta choochitini. appudidigo, tèllani gurramòkati kanabadènu. daanimeeda koorchumdiyunnavaadu nammakamainavaadunu satyavamtu dunu anu naamamu galavaadu. aayana neetinibatti vimarsha cheyuchu yuddhamu jarigimchuchunnaadu
Aayana netramulu agnijvaala vamtivi, aayana shirassumeeda aneka kireetamulumdènu. vraayabadinayòka naamamu aayanaku kaladu, adi aayanakegaani mari èvanikini tèliyadu;
Rakta mulo mumchabadina vastramu aayana dharimchukòni yumdènu. mariyu devuni vaakyamu anu naamamu aayanaku pèttabadiyunnadi.
Paralokamamdunna senalu shubhramaina tèllani naarabattalu dharimchukòni tèllani gurramu lèkki aayananu vèmbadimchuchumdiri.

Janamulanu kòttutakai aayana notanumdi vaadigala khadgamu bayalu vèdalu chunnadi. aayana yinupadamdamuto vaarini elunu; aayane sarvaadhikaariyagu devuni teekshanamaina ugrata anu madyaputòtti tròkkunu.
Raajulaku raajunu prabhuvulaku prabhuvunu anu naamamu aayana vastramumeedanu tòdameedanu vraayabadiyunnadi.
Mariyu òka doota sooryabimbamulo nilichi yumduta choochitini.
Atadu gòppa shabdamuto aarbha étimchiramdi, raajula maamsamunu sahasraadhipatula maamsamunu balishthula maamsamunu gurramula maamsamunu vaatimeeda koorchumduvaari maamsamunu, svatam
Mariyu aa gurramumeeda koorchunnavaanitonu aayana senatonu yuddhamucheyutakai aa krooramrrigamunu bhooraajulunu vaari senalunu koodiyumdagaa choochitini.
Appudaa mrrigamunu, daaniyèduta soochaka kriyalu chesi daani mudranu veyimchukònina vaarini aa mrrigapu pratimaku namaskarimchinavaarini mosaparachina aa abaddhapravaktayu, pattabadi vaariddaru
Kadama vaaru gurramumeeda koorchunna vaani notanumdi vachchina khadgamucheta vadhimpabadiri; vaari maamsamunu pakshulanniyu kadupaara tinènu.
Mariyu pèddasamkèllanu cheta pattukòni agaadhamu yòkka taalapuchèvigala yòka devadoota paralokamunumdi digivachchuta choochitini.
Atadu aadisarpamunu, anagaa apavaadiyu saataanunu anu aa ghatasarpamunu pattukòni vèyyi samvatsaramulu vaanini bamdhimchi agaadhamulo padavesi,
Aa vèyyi samvatsaramulu gadachuvaraku ika janamulanu mosaparachakumdunatlu agaadhamunu moosi daaniki mudra vesènu; atupimmata vaadu kòmchèmu kaalamu vidichi pèttabadavalènu.
Amtata simhaasanamulanu choochitini; vaatimeeda aaseenulai yumduvaariki vimarshacheyutaku adhikaaramu iyyabadènu. mariyu krooramrrigamunakainanu daani pratimakainanu namaskaaramucheya
Aa vèyyi samvatsaramulu gadachuvaraku kadama mrritulu braduka ledu; idiye mòdati punarutthaanamu.

Ee mòdati punarutthaana mulo paalugalavaaru dhanyulunu parishuddhulunai yumduru. ittivaarimeeda rèmdava maranamunaku adhikaaramuledu; veeru devunikini kreestukunu yaajakulai kreestutokooda vèyyi samvatsaramulu raajyamu cheyuduru.
Vèyyi samvatsaramulu gadachina taruvaata saataanu taanunna chèralonumdi vidipimpabadunu.
Bhoomi nalu dishalayamdumdu janamulanu, lèkkakusamudrapu isukavalè unna gogu maagogu anuvaarini mosaparachi vaarini yuddhamunaku pogucheyutakai vaadu bayaluderunu.
Vaaru bhoomiyamdamtata vyaapimchi, parishuddhula shibiramunu priyamaina pattanamunu muttadiveyagaa paralokamulonumdi agni digivachchi vaarini dahimchènu.
Vaarini mosaparachina apavaadi agni gamdhakamulugala gumdamulo padaveyabadènu. achchata aa krooramrrigamunu abaddha pravaktayu unnaaru; vaaru yugayugamulu raatrimbagallu baadhimpabaduduru.
Mariyu dhavalamaina mahaa simhaasanamunu daaniyamdu aaseenudaiyunna yòkanini choochitini; bhoomyaakaashamulu aayana samukhamunumdi paaripoyènu; vaatiki niluva chotu kanabadakapoyènu.

Mariyu gòppavaaremi kòddivaaremi mrritulainavaaramdaru aa simhaasanamu èduta niluvabadiyumduta choochitini. appudu gramthamulu vippabadènu; mariyu jeevagramthamunu veròka gramthamu vippabadènu; aa gramthamulayamdu vraayabadiyunna vaatinibatti tama kriyalachòppuna mrritulu teerpu pòmdiri.
Samudramu tanalo unna mrritulanu appagimchènu; maranamunu paataalalokamunu vaati vashamunanunna mrritula nappagimchènu; vaarilo prativaadu tana kriyala chòppuna teerpupòmdènu.
Maranamunu mrritula lokamunu agnigumdamulo padaveyabadènu; ee agnigumdamu rèmdava maranamu.
Èvani perainanu4 jeevagramthamamdu vraayabadinattu kanabadaniyèdala vaadu agnigumdamulo padaveyabadènu.
Amtata nenu kròtta aakaashamunu kròtta bhoomini choochitini. mòdati aakaashamunu mòdati bhoomiyu gatimchipoyènu. samudramunu ikanu ledu.
Mariyu nenu nootanamaina yèrooshalemu anu aa parishuddhapattanamu tana bhartakòraku alamkarimpabadina pèmdlikumaartèvalè siddhapadi paralokamamdunna devuni yòddanumdi digi vachchuta choochitini.
Appuduidigo devuni nivaasamu manushyulato kooda unnadi, aayana vaarito kaapura mumdunu, vaaraayana prajalaiyumduru, devudu taane vaari devudaiyumdi vaariki todaiyumdunu.

Aayana vaari kannula prati baashpabimduvunu tudichiveyunu, maranamu ika umdadu, duhkhamainanu edpainanu vedanayainanu ika umdadu, mòdati samgatulu gatimchi poyènani simhaasanamulonumdi vachchina gòppa svaramu chèpputa vimtini.
Appudu simhaasanaaseenudaiyunnavaaduidigo samastamunu nootanamainavigaa cheyuchunnaanani chèppènu; mariyu--ee maatalu nammakamunu nijamunai yunnavi ganuka vraayumani aayana naato chè
Mariyu aayana naato itlanènusamaaptamainavi; nene alphaayu omègayu, anagaa aadiyu amtamunai yunnavaadanu; dappigònu vaaniki jeevajalamula buggaloni jalamunu nenu uchitamugaa anugrahimtunu.
Jayimchuvaadu veetini svatamtrimchu kònunu; nenataniki devudanai yumdunu atadu naaku kumaarudai yumdunu.

Pirikivaarunu, avishvaasulunu, asahyulunu, narahamtakulunu, vyabhichaarulunu, maamtri kulunu, vigrahaaraadhakulunu, abaddhikulamdarunu agni gamdhakamulato mamdu gumdamulo paalupòmduduru; idi rèmdava maranamu.
Amtata aa kadapati yedu tègullato nimdina yedu paatralanu pattukòniyunna yeduguru devadootalalo òkadu vachchi itu rammu, pèmdlikumaartènu, anagaa gòrrapillayòkka bhaaryanu neeku choo
Aatmavashudanaiyunna nannu yèttayina gòppa parvatamumeediki kònipoyi, yèrooshalemu anu parishuddha pattanamu devuni mahimagaladai paraloka mamdunna devuni yòddanumdi digivachchuta naaku choopènu.
Daaniyamdali vèlugu dhagadhaga mèrayu sooryakaamtamuvamti amoolya ratnamunu poliyunnadi.

Aa pattanamunaku èttayina gòppa praakaaramunu pamdrèmdu gummamulunu umdènu; aa gummamulayòdda panniddaru devadootalumdiri, ishraa yeleeyula pamdrèmdu gotramula naamamulu aa gummamula meeda vraayabadiyunnavi.
Toorpuvaipuna moodu gummamulu, uttarapuvaipuna moodu gummamulu, dakshinapu vaipuna moodu gummamulu, pashchimapuvaipuna moodu gummamu lunnavi.
Aa pattanapu praakaaramu pamdrèmdu punaadulugaladi, aa punaadulapainagòrra pillayòkka panniddaru apòstalula pamdrèmdu perlu kanabaduchunnavi.
Aa pattanamunu daani gummamulanu praakaaramunu kòluchutakai naato maatalaadu vaani yòdda bamgaaru kòlakarra yumdènu.

Aa pattanamu chachchavukamainadi, daani pòdugu daani vèdalputo samaanamu. atadu aa kòlakarrato pattanamunu kòluvagaa daani kòlata yedu vamdala yebadi kosulainadi; daani pòdugunu èttunu vèdalpunu samamugaa unnadi.
Mariyu atadu praakaaramunu kòluvagaa adi manushyuni kòlata chòppuna noota nalubadinaalugu mooralainadi; aa kòlata dootakòlataye.
Aa pattanapu praakaaramu sooryakaamtamulato kattabadènu; pattanamu svachchamagu sphatikamuto samaanamaina shuddhasuvarnamugaa unnadi.
Aa pattanapu praakaarapu punaadulu amoolyamaina naanaavidha ratnamulato alamkarimpabadiyumdènu. mòdati punaadi sooryakaamtapuraayi, rèmdavadi neelamu, moodavadi yamunaaraayi, naalugavadi pachcha,
Ayidavadi vaidooryamu, aaravadi kèmpu, edavadi suvarnaratnamu, ènimidavadi gomedhikamu, tòmimadavadi pushyaraagamu, padiyavadi suvarnala shuneeyamu, padakòmdavadi padmaraagamu,
Daani pamdrèmdu gummamulu pamdrèmdu mutyamulu; òkkòka gummamu òkkòka mutyamuto kattabadiyunnadi. pattanapu raajaveedhi shuddha suvarnamayamai svachchamaina sphatikamunu poliyunnadi.
Daanilo e devaalayamunu naaku kanabadaledu. sarvaadhi kaariyaina devudagu prabhuvunu gòrrapillayu daaniki devaalayamai yunnaaru.
Aa pattanamulo prakaashimchutakai sooryudainanu chamdrudainanu daanikakkaraledu; devuni mahimaye daanilo prakaashimchuchunnadi. gòrrapillaye daaniki deepamu.
Janamulu daani vèlugunamdu samcharimturu; bhooraajulu tama mahimanu daaniloniki teesikònivatturu.
Akkada raatri lenamduna daani gummamulu pagativela emaatramunu veyabadavu.
Janamulu tama mahimanu ghanatanu daaniloniki teesikòni vachchèdaru.

Gòrrapillayòkka jeevagramthamamdu vraaya badinavaare daanilo praveshimturu gaani nishiddhamaina dedainanu, asahyamainadaanini abaddhamainadaanini jarigimchu vaadainanu daaniloniki praveshimpane praveshimpadu.
Mariyu sphatikamuvalè mèrayunatti jeevajalamula nadi devuniyòkkayu gòrrapillayòkkayu simhaa sanamunòddanumdi

Aa pattanapu raajaveedhimadhyanu pravahimchuta aa doota naaku choopènu. aa nadiyòkka eevalanu aavalanu jeevavrrikshamumdènu; adi nèlanèlaku phalimchuchu pamdrèmdu kaapulu kaayunu. aa vrrikshamu yòkka aakulu janamulanu svasthaparachutakai viniyo gimchunu.
Ikameedata shaapagrastamainadediyu daanilo umdadu, devuniyòkkayu gòrrapillayòkkayu simhaasanamu daanilo umdunu.
Aayana daasulu aayananu sevimchuchu aayana mukhadarshanamu cheyu chumduru; aayana naamamu vaari nòsallayamdumdunu.
Raatri yikanènnadu umdadu; deepakaamtiyainanu soorya kaamtiyainanu vaarikakkaraledu; devudaina prabhuve vaarimeeda prakaashimchunu. vaaru yugayugamulu raajyamu cheyuduru.

Mariyu aa doota yeelaagu naato chèppènu ee maatalu nammakamulunu satyamulunai yunnavi; pravaktala aatmalaku devudagu prabhuvu, tvaralo sambhavimpa valasinavaatini tana daasulaku chooputakai tana dootanu pampènu.
Idigo nenu tvaragaa vachchuchunnaanu, ee gramthamuloni pravachanavaakyamulanu gaikònuvaadu dhanyudu.
Yohaananu nenu ee samgatulanu vininavaadanu choochinavaadanu; nenu vini choochinappudu vaatini naaku choopuchunna dootapaadamula yèduta namaskaaramu cheyutaku saagilapadagaa,
Atadu vaddusumee, nenu neetonu, pravaktalaina nee sahodarulatonu, ee gramtha mamdunna vaakyamulanu gaikònuvaaritonu sahadaasudanu; devunike namaskaaramu cheyumani chèppènu.
Mariyu atadu naato eelaagu chèppènuee gramthamamdunna pravachanavaakyamulaku mudraveyavaladu; kaalamu sameepamaiyunnadi;
Anyaayamu cheyuvaadu imkanu anyaayame cheyanimmu, apavitrudaina vaadu imkanu apavitrudugaane yumda nimmu, neeti mamtudu imkanu neetimamtudugaane yumdanimmu. pari shuddhudu im
Idigo tvaragaa vachchuchunnaanu. vaanivaani kriyachòppuna prativaani kichchutaku nenu siddhaparachina jeetamu naayòdda unnadi.
Nene alphaayu omègayu, mòdativaadanu kadapativaadanu, aadiyu amtamunai yunnaanu.
Jeeva vrrikshamunaku hakkugalavaarai, gummamulagumda aa pattanamu loniki praveshimchunatlu tama vastramulanu udukukònuvaaru dhanyulu.
Kukkalunu maamtrikulunu vyabhichaarulunu narahamta kulunu vigrahaaraadhakulunu abaddhamunu premimchi jarigimchu prativaadunu vèlupatanumduru.
Samghamulakosamu ee samgatulanugoorchi meeku saakshyamichchutaku yesu anu nenu naa dootanu pampi yunnaanu. nenu daaveedu veruchigurunu samtaanamunu, prakaashamaanamaina vekuva chukkayunai yunnaanu.
Aatmayu pèmdli kumaartèyu rammu ani chèppu chunnaaru; vinuvaadunu rammu ani chèppavalènu; dappi gònina vaanini raanimmu; ichchayimchuvaanini jeevajalamunu uchitamugaa puchchukònanimmu.

Ee gramthamamdunna pravachanavaakyamulanu vinu prati vaaniki nenu saakshyamichchunadi emanagaa èvadainanu veetito mari edainanu kalipinayèdala, ee gramthamulo vraayabadina tègullu devudu vaaniki kalugajeyunu;
Èvadainanu ee pravachana gramthamamdunna vaakyamulalo edainanu teesivesinayèdala. devudu ee gramthamulo vraayabadina jeevavrrikshamulonu parishuddhapattanamulonu vaaniki paalulekumda cheyunu.
Ee samgatulanugoorchi saakshyamichchuvaadu avunu, tvaragaa vachchuchunnaanani chèppuchunnaadu. aamen‌; prabhuvaina yesoo, rammu.
Prabhuvaina yesu krripa parishuddhulaku todai yumdunu gaaka. aamen‌.
